```html
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />

      rel="stylesheet"
    />

    <script>
      (function() {
        try {
          const mode = localStorage.getItem('socialverse_theme_mode');
          if (mode === 'light') {
            document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
          } else {
            document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
          }
        } catch(e) {
          document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        }
      })();
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root"></div>
    <script type="module" src="/src/main.jsx"></script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```javascript
// frontend/public/sw.js
self.addEventListener('push', function(event) {
  const data = event.data.json();
  
  self.registration.showNotification(data.title, {
    body: data.body,
    icon: '/pwa-192x192.png', // Ensure this exists in public/
    badge: '/masked-icon.svg',
    data: { url: data.url }
  });
});

self.addEventListener('notificationclick', function(event) {
  event.notification.close();
  event.waitUntil(
    self.clients.openWindow(event.notification.data.url || '/')
  );
});
```

```css
  margin: 0 auto;

}

.logo {
  height: 6em;
  padding: 1.5em;
  will-change: filter;
  transition: filter 300ms;
}
.logo:hover {
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2em #646cffaa);
}
.logo.react:hover {
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2em #61dafbaa);
}

@keyframes logo-spin {
  from {
    transform: rotate(0deg);
  }
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  a:nth-of-type(2) .logo {
    animation: logo-spin infinite 20s linear;
  }
}

.card {
  padding: 2em;
}

.read-the-docs {
  color: #888;
}
```

```jsx
import CommentsModal from './components/posts/CommentsModal';
import CreatePostModal from './components/posts/CreatePostModal';
import IncomingCallModal from './components/common/IncomingCallModal';
import CommandPalette from './components/common/CommandPalette';
import InstallAppModal from './components/common/InstallAppModal';
import AdminCyberGateway from './components/common/AdminCyberGateway';
import UpdateNotificationBanner from './components/common/UpdateNotificationBanner';
import CinematicEnvironmentalBackdrop from './components/common/CinematicEnvironmentalBackdrop';
import ProtectedRoute from './components/common/ProtectedRoute';
import AdminRoute from './components/common/AdminRoute';
import ErrorBoundary from './components/common/ErrorBoundary';
import NotFound from './pages/misc/NotFound';
import { PageTransition } from './components/PageTransition';

import './index.css';

const Feed = lazy(() => import('./pages/home/Feed'));
const Explore = lazy(() => import('./pages/explore/Explore'));
const SwipeExplore = lazy(() => import('./pages/discovery/SwipeExplore'));
const NotificationsPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/notifications/NotificationsPage'));
const SavedPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/saved/Saved'));
const MemoriesPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/memories/Memories'));
const TagFeed = lazy(() => import('./pages/explore/TagFeed'));
const SearchAdvanced = lazy(() => import('./pages/explore/SearchAdvanced'));

const ProfilePage = lazy(() => import('./pages/profile/ProfilePage'));
const PostPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/posts/PostPage'));
const ReelsPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/reels/ReelsPage'));
const DraftsPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/posts/DraftsPage'));

const ChatPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/chat/ChatPage'));
const CallRoom = lazy(() => import('./pages/chat/CallRoom'));

const LoginPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/auth/Login'));
const RegisterPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/auth/Register'));
const ForgotPassword = lazy(() => import('./pages/auth/ForgotPassword'));
const ResetPassword = lazy(() => import('./pages/auth/ResetPassword'));
const VerifyAccount = lazy(() => import('./pages/auth/VerifyAccount'));

const EventsPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/events/EventsPage'));
const WalletPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/wallet/WalletPage'));
const GamesPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/games/GamesPage'));
const AnalyticsPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/analytics/AnalyticsPage'));
const Marketplace = lazy(() => import('./pages/shop/Marketplace'));

const FeatureHub = lazy(() => import('./pages/misc/FeatureHub'));
const FollowSuggestions = lazy(() => import('./pages/discovery/FollowSuggestions'));
const ScheduledPosts = lazy(() => import('./pages/posts/ScheduledPosts'));
const SettingsPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/settings/SettingsPage'));
const SafetyPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/safety/SafetyPage'));
const LiveList = lazy(() => import('./pages/live/LiveList'));
const LiveStudio = lazy(() => import('./pages/live/LiveStudio'));
const LiveWatch = lazy(() => import('./pages/live/LiveWatch'));

const StoriesPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/stories/StoriesPage'));

const AdminDashboard = lazy(() => import('./pages/admin/AdminDashboard'));
const CreatorPayouts = lazy(() => import('./pages/admin/CreatorPayouts'));
const ModerationDashboard = lazy(() => import('./pages/admin/ModerationDashboard'));

const NewsPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/apps/NewsPage'));
const MarketPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/apps/MarketPage'));
const Onboarding = lazy(() => import('./pages/intro/Onboarding'));

function LoadingShell() {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-[#04070D]">
      <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4">
        <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center">
          <div className="absolute h-24 w-24 rounded-full bg-[#00F2FE]/20 blur-2xl animate-pulse" />
          <motion.div
            animate={{ scale: [0.94, 1.06, 0.94], rotate: [0, 180, 360] }}
            transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 2.8, ease: "easeInOut" }}
            className="h-16 w-16 rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(0,242,254,0.25)] bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#00F2FE] via-[#10B981] to-[#D4AF37] p-[2px] shadow-2xl shadow-[#00F2FE]/30"
          >
            <div className="h-full w-full rounded-[14px] bg-[#04070D] flex items-center justify-center">
              <span className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-[#00F2FE] animate-ping" />
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
        <p className="font-display text-xs tracking-widest uppercase bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00F2FE] via-[#10B981] to-[#D4AF37] bg-clip-text text-transparent font-semibold">
          SocialVerse ∞ • Beyond Social
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const RootRoute = () => {
  const { user, isLoading } = useSelector((s) => s.auth);
  const hasSeenOnboarding = localStorage.getItem('hasSeenOnboarding');

  if (!hasSeenOnboarding) return <Navigate to="/welcome" replace />;
  if (isLoading) return <LoadingShell />;
  if (!user) return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  return <Feed />;
};

function AppContent() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const [viewPostId, setViewPostId] = useState(null);
  const [commentPostId, setCommentPostId] = useState(null);
  const [openCreate, setOpenCreate] = useState(false);
  const [createContent, setCreateContent] = useState(null);
  const [isOnline, setIsOnline] = useState(navigator.onLine);
  const [showAdminPortal, setShowAdminPortal] = useState(false);
  const [showInstallModal, setShowInstallModal] = useState(false);

  const { socket } = useSocket();
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();

  const isImmersiveRoute =
    location.pathname.match(/\/chat\/[a-zA-Z0-9]+/) ||
    location.pathname.includes('/reels') ||
    location.pathname.includes('/live/watch');

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOnline = () => setIsOnline(true);
    const handleOffline = () => setIsOnline(false);

    const handleLogoutEvent = () => {
      dispatch(logout());
      navigate('/login', { replace: true });
    };

    const onOpenView = (e) => {
      if (e?.detail) setViewPostId(e.detail);
    };

    const onOpenComments = (e) => {
      if (e?.detail) setCommentPostId(e.detail);
    };

    const onOpenCreate = (e) => {
      if (e.detail) setCreateContent(e.detail);
      else setCreateContent(null);
      setOpenCreate(true);
    };

    const onOpenAdmin = () => setShowAdminPortal(true);
    const onOpenInstall = () => setShowInstallModal(true);

    const onApiError = (e) => {
      addToast(e.detail, { type: 'error' });
    };

    window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
    window.addEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
    window.addEventListener('auth:logout', handleLogoutEvent);
    window.addEventListener('openViewPost', onOpenView);
    window.addEventListener('openComments', onOpenComments);
    window.addEventListener('openCreatePost', onOpenCreate);
    window.addEventListener('openAdminGateway', onOpenAdmin);
    window.addEventListener('openInstallApp', onOpenInstall);
    window.addEventListener('api:error', onApiError);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', handleOnline);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
      window.removeEventListener('auth:logout', handleLogoutEvent);
      window.removeEventListener('openViewPost', onOpenView);
      window.removeEventListener('openComments', onOpenComments);
      window.removeEventListener('openCreatePost', onOpenCreate);
      window.removeEventListener('openAdminGateway', onOpenAdmin);
      window.removeEventListener('openInstallApp', onOpenInstall);
      window.removeEventListener('api:error', onApiError);
    };
  }, [dispatch, addToast, navigate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!socket) return;

    const onNotification = (data) => {
      if (data.type === 'message') return;
      addToast(data.message, { type: 'info', timeout: 4000 });
    };

    socket.on('notification', onNotification);
    return () => socket.off('notification', onNotification);
  }, [socket, addToast]);

  return (
    <div className="app-layout-frame relative flex h-[100dvh] overflow-hidden bg-[#04070D] font-sans text-[#F8FAFC]">
      <CinematicEnvironmentalBackdrop />

      {!isOnline && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-0 z-[9999] bg-[#070F1E] border-b border-[#00F2FE]/40 py-1 text-center text-xs font-bold text-[#00F2FE] shadow-md">
          You are offline. Reconnecting to SocialVerse network...
        </div>
      )}

      <Navbar />

      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute left-[-10%] top-[-20%] h-[50%] w-[50%] rounded-full bg-[#00F2FE]/10 blur-[150px]" />
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute top-[25%] right-[-10%] h-[45%] w-[45%] rounded-full bg-[#10B981]/08 blur-[160px]" />
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-[-20%] left-[20%] h-[50%] w-[50%] rounded-full bg-[#D4AF37]/07 blur-[160px]" />

      <main
        id="main-scroll-container"
        className={`relative z-10 h-full w-full overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden scroll-smooth pt-20 md:pt-0 ${
          isImmersiveRoute ? 'pb-0' : 'pb-24'
        } md:pb-0 md:ml-[270px] md:w-[calc(100%-270px)]`}
      >
        <Suspense fallback={<LoadingShell />}>
          <ErrorBoundary>
            <Routes>
              <Route path="/welcome" element={<PageTransition><Onboarding /></PageTransition>} />
                <Route path="/login" element={<PageTransition><LoginPage /></PageTransition>} />
                <Route path="/register" element={<PageTransition><RegisterPage /></PageTransition>} />
                <Route path="/forgot-password" element={<PageTransition><ForgotPassword /></PageTransition>} />
                <Route path="/reset-password" element={<PageTransition><ResetPassword /></PageTransition>} />
                <Route path="/verify-account" element={<PageTransition><VerifyAccount /></PageTransition>} />

                <Route element={<MainLayout />}>
                  <Route path="/" element={<PageTransition><RootRoute /></PageTransition>} />
                  <Route path="/explore" element={<PageTransition><Explore /></PageTransition>} />
                  <Route path="/search/advanced" element={<PageTransition><SearchAdvanced /></PageTransition>} />
                  <Route path="/reels" element={<PageTransition><ReelsPage /></PageTransition>} />
                  <Route path="/tags/:tag" element={<PageTransition><TagFeed /></PageTransition>} />

                  <Route path="/chat" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><ChatPage /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/chat/:id" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><ChatPage /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/notifications" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><NotificationsPage /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/saved" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><SavedPage /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/memories" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><MemoriesPage /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/groups" element={<PageTransition><FollowSuggestions /></PageTransition>} />
                  <Route path="/drafts" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><DraftsPage /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />

                  <Route path="/profile" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><ProfilePage /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/profile/:id" element={<PageTransition><ProfilePage /></PageTransition>} />
                  <Route path="/post/:id" element={<PageTransition><PostPage /></PageTransition>} />

                  <Route path="/shop" element={<PageTransition><Marketplace /></PageTransition>} />
                  <Route path="/marketplace" element={<Navigate to="/shop" replace />} />
                  <Route path="/events" element={<PageTransition><EventsPage /></PageTransition>} />
                  <Route path="/wallet" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><WalletPage /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/games" element={<PageTransition><GamesPage /></PageTransition>} />
                  <Route path="/analytics" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><AnalyticsPage /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/settings" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><SettingsPage /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/report" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><SafetyPage /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />

                  <Route path="/apps/news" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><NewsPage /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/apps/markets" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><MarketPage /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />

                  <Route path="/live" element={<ProtectedRoute><LiveList /></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/live/list" element={<ProtectedRoute><LiveList /></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/live/studio" element={<ProtectedRoute><LiveStudio /></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/live/watch/:roomId" element={<ProtectedRoute><LiveWatch /></ProtectedRoute>} />

                  <Route path="/stories" element={<ProtectedRoute><StoriesPage /></ProtectedRoute>} />
                  <Route path="/feature-hub" element={<PageTransition><FeatureHub /></PageTransition>} />
                  <Route path="/command-center" element={<PageTransition><FeatureHub /></PageTransition>} />
                  <Route path="/discovery/follow-suggestions" element={<PageTransition><FollowSuggestions /></PageTransition>} />
                  <Route path="/scheduled-posts" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><ScheduledPosts /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />

                  <Route element={<AdminRoute />}>
                    <Route path="/admin/dashboard" element={<PageTransition><AdminDashboard /></PageTransition>} />
                    <Route path="/admin/payouts" element={<PageTransition><CreatorPayouts /></PageTransition>} />
                    <Route path="/admin/moderation" element={<PageTransition><ModerationDashboard /></PageTransition>} />
                  </Route>
                </Route>

                <Route path="/discover" element={<PageTransition><SwipeExplore /></PageTransition>} />
                <Route path="/chat/call/:roomId" element={<ProtectedRoute><PageTransition><CallRoom /></PageTransition></ProtectedRoute>} />
                <Route path="*" element={<PageTransition><NotFound /></PageTransition>} />
            </Routes>
          </ErrorBoundary>
        </Suspense>

        <CreatePostModal
          isOpen={openCreate}
          onClose={() => setOpenCreate(false)}
          initialData={createContent}
          onPosted={() => {
            setOpenCreate(false);
            setCreateContent(null);
          }}
        />
        <CommentsModal postId={commentPostId} isOpen={!!commentPostId} onClose={() => setCommentPostId(null)} />
        <PostModal postId={viewPostId} isOpen={!!viewPostId} onClose={() => setViewPostId(null)} />
        <IncomingCallModal />
        <UpdateNotificationBanner />
        <CommandPalette onOpenAdminPortal={() => setShowAdminPortal(true)} />
        <AdminCyberGateway isOpen={showAdminPortal} onClose={() => setShowAdminPortal(false)} />
        <InstallAppModal isOpen={showInstallModal} onClose={() => setShowInstallModal(false)} />
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <Router future={{ v7_startTransition: true, v7_relativeSplatPath: true }}>
      <AppContent />
    </Router>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export default function ActiveCallOverlay({ peerName = "Connected", isMuted, isVideoOn }) {
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0);

  // Timer for call duration
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setDuration((prev) => prev + 1);
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const formatTime = (seconds) => {
    const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
    const s = (seconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
    return `${m}:${s}`;
  };

  return (
    <div className="absolute top-6 left-6 bg-gray-900/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl p-4 rounded-2xl z-30 flex flex-col gap-2 min-w-[160px] transition-all duration-300">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        {/* Pulsing active indicator */}
        <div className="w-3 h-3 bg-green-500 rounded-full animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(34,197,94,0.8)]"></div>
        <h3 className="text-white font-bold tracking-wide">{peerName}</h3>
      </div>
      
      <div className="text-gray-300 font-mono text-sm tracking-wider">
        {formatTime(duration)}
      </div>

      {/* Status Badges */}
      {(isMuted || !isVideoOn) && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-1">
          {isMuted && (
            <span className="bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/30 text-red-400 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold">
              Mic Muted
            </span>
          )}
          {!isVideoOn && (
            <span className="bg-orange-500/20 border border-orange-500/30 text-orange-400 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold">
              Video Off
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/auth/GoogleLoginButton.jsx
import React from 'react';
import { useGoogleLogin } from '@react-oauth/google';
import { FaGoogle } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux';
import { setUser } from '../../redux/slices/authSlice'; 
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';

export default function GoogleLoginButton() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();

  const login = useGoogleLogin({
    onSuccess: async (tokenResponse) => {
      try {
        const res = await API.post('/auth/google-login', { 
            token: tokenResponse.access_token 
        });
        
        const payload = res.data.data || res.data;
        const { token, refreshToken, user } = payload;
        
        if (!user || !user._id) {
            throw new Error("Invalid user data received");
        }
        
        localStorage.setItem('token', token);
        if (refreshToken) localStorage.setItem('refreshToken', refreshToken);
        localStorage.setItem('meId', user._id);
        
        dispatch(setUser(user));
        
        addToast(`Welcome back, ${user.name}!`, { type: 'success' });
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            window.location.href = '/'; 
        }, 500);

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Google Login Error', error);
        addToast('Login failed. Please try again.', { type: 'error' });
      }
    },
    onError: () => {
        addToast('Google popup closed or failed.', { type: 'error' });
    }
  });

  return (
    <button
      type="button" 
      onClick={() => login()}
      className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-3 py-3 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#070B14]/90 hover:bg-[#0A111E] text-[#F7F7FC] transition-all active:scale-95 border border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] group"
    >
      <FaGoogle className="text-[#FF6B8A] group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(255,107,138,0.5)]" />
      <span className="font-semibold text-sm tracking-wide text-[#CBD5E1]">Continue with Google</span>
    </button>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/chat/AudioRecorder.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { FaMicrophone, FaStop, FaTrash, FaPaperPlane, FaPlay, FaPause } from 'react-icons/fa';
import API from '../../services/api';

export default function AudioRecorder({ chatId, onSent, onFileReady }) {
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);
  const [audioBlob, setAudioBlob] = useState(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);

  const audioRef = useRef(new Audio());
  const mediaRecorder = useRef(null);
  const chunks = useRef([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (previewUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
      try {
        audioRef.current.pause();
      } catch (_) {}
    };
  }, [previewUrl]);

  const startRecording = async () => {
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
      mediaRecorder.current = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      chunks.current = [];

      mediaRecorder.current.ondataavailable = (e) => chunks.current.push(e.data);
      mediaRecorder.current.onstop = () => {
        const blob = new Blob(chunks.current, { type: 'audio/webm' });
        const file = new File([blob], 'voice_note.webm', { type: 'audio/webm' });

        if (onFileReady) {
          onFileReady(file);
          setAudioBlob(null);
        } else {
          setAudioBlob(blob);
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          setPreviewUrl(url);
          audioRef.current.src = url;
          audioRef.current.onended = () => setIsPlaying(false);
        }

        chunks.current = [];
        stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      };

      mediaRecorder.current.start();
      setRecording(true);
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Microphone access denied');
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = () => {
    mediaRecorder.current?.stop();
    setRecording(false);
  };

  const togglePreview = () => {
    if (!audioRef.current.src) return;
    if (isPlaying) audioRef.current.pause();
    else audioRef.current.play();
    setIsPlaying((v) => !v);
  };

  const discard = () => {
    setAudioBlob(null);
    setPreviewUrl(null);
    setIsPlaying(false);
  };

  const sendAudioToChat = async () => {
    if (!audioBlob || !chatId) return;
    setUploading(true);
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('audio', audioBlob, 'voice.webm');
    try {
      const res = await API.post(`/extra/voice/${chatId}`, fd);
      onSent?.(res.data);
      discard();
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  if (onFileReady) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={recording ? stopRecording : startRecording}
        className={`rounded-full p-2 transition-all ${
          recording ? 'bg-[#052E24] text-white shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(139,0,24,0.6)] animate-pulse' : 'text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:text-[#00F2FE]'
        }`}
      >
        {recording ? <FaStop /> : <FaMicrophone size={18} />}
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
      {audioBlob ? (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#04070D] p-1.5 pr-3 transition-all">
          <button onClick={discard} className="rounded-full p-1.5 text-[#10B981] hover:bg-[#052E24]/15 transition-colors">
            <FaTrash size={10} />
          </button>

          <button onClick={togglePreview} className="flex min-w-[60px] items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#D4AF37]">
            {isPlaying ? <FaPause size={10} /> : <FaPlay size={10} />}
            {isPlaying ? 'Playing' : 'Listen'}
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={sendAudioToChat}
            disabled={uploading}
            className="rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#00F2FE] p-1.5 text-white transition hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {uploading ? (
              <div className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white" />
            ) : (
              <FaPaperPlane size={10} />
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <button
          onClick={recording ? stopRecording : startRecording}
          className={`rounded-full p-2 transition-all ${
            recording ? 'bg-[#052E24] text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(139,0,24,0.6)] animate-pulse' : 'text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:text-[#00F2FE]'
          }`}
        >
          {recording ? <FaStop /> : <FaMicrophone size={20} />}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// src/components/chat/AudioSpace.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaMicrophone, FaMicrophoneSlash, FaTimes, FaHeadphones, FaMusic, FaUserFriends } from 'react-icons/fa';
import UserAvatar from '../ui/UserAvatar';
import { useSocket } from '../../contexts/SocketContext'; // Access global socket

export default function AudioSpace() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(true);
  const [speakers, setSpeakers] = useState([]); // Real users list
  const { socket } = useSocket();

  // Handle Join/Leave
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!socket) return;

    if (isOpen) {
        // 1. Join Room
        socket.emit('lounge:join');

        // 2. Listen for updates
        const onUpdate = (users) => {
            setSpeakers(users);
        };
        socket.on('lounge:update', onUpdate);

        return () => {
            socket.emit('lounge:leave'); // Leave on close
            socket.off('lounge:update', onUpdate);
        };
    }
  }, [isOpen, socket]);

  // Handle Mute Toggle
  const toggleMute = () => {
      const newState = !isMuted;

            <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 bg-[#052E24] text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-white/20 shadow-md">
                {speakers.length}
            </span>
        )}
      </motion.button>

      {/* The Space Sheet */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isOpen && (
          <motion.div 
            initial={{ y: "100%" }}
            animate={{ y: 0 }}
            exit={{ y: "100%" }}
            transition={{ type: "spring", damping: 25, stiffness: 200 }}
            className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-[#04070D]/95 text-[#F7F7FC] rounded-t-[2.5rem] shadow-[0_-10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] z-50 p-6 min-h-[50vh] border-t border-white/10 backdrop-blur-2xl flex flex-col"
          >
            <div className="w-12 h-1.5 bg-white/20 rounded-full mx-auto mb-6" />
            
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-8">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="relative flex h-3 w-3">
                  <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-[#14B8A6] opacity-75"></span>
                  <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-3 w-3 bg-[#14B8A6]"></span>
                </span>
                <div>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-xl tracking-tight leading-none text-[#F7F7FC] font-serif">Late Night Lounge 🌙</h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/70 mt-1">{speakers.length} online • {speakers.filter(s => !s.isMuted).length} speaking</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)} className="bg-[#0A111E] p-2.5 rounded-full hover:bg-white/10 text-[#CBD5E1] border border-white/10 transition"><FaTimes /></button>
            </div>

            {/* Visualizer Placeholder */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 h-8 mb-6 opacity-60">
                {[...Array(15)].map((_, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="w-1 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#00F2FE] rounded-full animate-music-bar" style={{ height: `${Math.random() * 100}%`, animationDelay: `${i * 0.1}s` }} />
                ))}
            </div>

            {/* Grid of Real Users */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-6 mb-8 overflow-y-auto max-h-[40vh] custom-scrollbar p-2">
              {speakers.map((s) => (
                <div key={s._id} className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 relative">
                  <div className={`relative p-1 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${!s.isMuted ? 'bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#14B8A6] to-[#00F2FE] scale-110 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(100,223,223,0.4)]' : 'bg-transparent'}`}>
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-[#070B14] border-2 border-white/10 overflow-hidden relative">
                        <UserAvatar src={s.avatar} name={s.name} className="w-full h-full" />
                        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/10" />
                    </div>
                    {/* Status Icon Overlay */}
                    <div className={`absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 p-1.5 rounded-full border border-white/20 ${s.isMuted ? 'bg-[#0A111E] text-[#CBD5E1]/50' : 'bg-[#14B8A6] text-white'}`}>
                        {s.isMuted ? <FaMicrophoneSlash size={8} /> : <FaMicrophone size={8} />}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium text-[#CBD5E1] truncate max-w-[80px] text-center">
                      {s.name}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
              
              {speakers.length === 0 && (
                  <div className="col-span-full text-center text-[#CBD5E1]/40 py-10">
                      <FaUserFriends className="mx-auto text-3xl mb-2 opacity-50 text-[#D4AF37]"/>
                      <p>Joining room...</p>
                  </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Controls */}
            <div className="flex justify-center gap-6 mt-auto pt-6 border-t border-white/10">
              <button 
                onClick={toggleMute}
                className={`w-16 h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-2xl transition shadow-lg transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 border border-white/20 ${isMuted ? 'bg-[#0A111E] text-[#F7F7FC] hover:bg-[#250E1A]' : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#14B8A6] to-[#00F2FE] text-black hover:opacity-90'}`}
              >
                {isMuted ? <FaMicrophoneSlash /> : <FaMicrophone />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
      <style>{`
        @keyframes music-bar { 0%, 100% { height: 20%; } 50% { height: 100%; } }
        .animate-music-bar { animation: music-bar 0.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
      `}</style>
    </>
  );
}
```

```jsx
export default function ChatBox({ chatId, onBack }) {
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();
  const currentUser = useSelector((s) => s.auth.user);
  const myId = currentUser?._id;
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false);

  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  const [otherUser, setOtherUser] = useState(null);
  const [isTyping, setIsTyping] = useState(false);
  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState(0);
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);

  const [isSecretMode, setIsSecretMode] = useState(false);
  const [ephemeralTimer, setEphemeralTimer] = useState(0); // 0, 10, 60, 3600, 86400

  const [replyingTo, setReplyingTo] = useState(null);
  const [editingMsg, setEditingMsg] = useState(null);
  const [pinnedIds, setPinnedIds] = useState([]);
  const [forwardMsg, setForwardMsg] = useState(null);

  const [showSearch, setShowSearch] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState([]);
  const [searchIndex, setSearchIndex] = useState(0);

  const [showNewMsgBtn, setShowNewMsgBtn] = useState(false);

  const listRef = useRef(null);
  const bottomRef = useRef(null);
  const typingTimeoutRef = useRef(null);
  const atBottomRef = useRef(true);
  const mountedRef = useRef(false);

  const scrollToBottom = (behavior = 'smooth') => {
    bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior, block: 'end' });
    setShowNewMsgBtn(false);
  };

  const loadData = async () => {
    if (!chatId) return;
    setLoading(true);

    if (chatId.startsWith('demo_chat_') || DEMO_CHAT_MESSAGES[chatId]) {
      const demo = DEMO_CHAT_MESSAGES[chatId] || DEMO_CHAT_MESSAGES.demo_chat_ai;
      setMessages(demo.messages.slice());
      setOtherUser(demo.other);
      setLoading(false);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollToBottom('auto'));
      return;
    }

    try {
      const { data } = await API.get(`/chat/${chatId}`);
      const chat = data?.data || data;

      setMessages((chat.messages || []).slice());
      setPinnedIds(chat.pinnedMessages || []);

      if (typeof chat.isSecret === 'boolean') setIsSecretMode(chat.isSecret);
      if (typeof chat.ephemeralDuration === 'number') setEphemeralTimer(chat.ephemeralDuration);

      const other = chat.participants?.find((p) => String(p._id) !== String(myId)) || chat.participants?.[0] || null;
      setOtherUser(other);

      API.post(`/chat/${chatId}/read`).catch(() => {});
      requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollToBottom('auto'));
    } catch (err) {
      if (DEMO_CHAT_MESSAGES[chatId]) {
        const demo = DEMO_CHAT_MESSAGES[chatId];
        setMessages(demo.messages.slice());
        setOtherUser(demo.other);
      } else {
        onBack?.();
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const getTimerLabel = (secs) => {
    if (!secs) return 'Off';
    if (secs < 60) return `${secs}s`;
    if (secs < 3600) return `${Math.floor(secs / 60)}m`;
    if (secs < 86400) return `${Math.floor(secs / 3600)}h`;
    return `${Math.floor(secs / 86400)}d`;
  };

  const toggleSecretMode = async () => {
    const nextState = !isSecretMode;
    setIsSecretMode(nextState);
    addToast(nextState ? '🔒 End-to-End Encryption enabled' : '🔓 Secret Mode disabled', { type: 'info' });
    try {
      await API.put(`/chat/${chatId}/ephemeral`, { isSecret: nextState });
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  const cycleEphemeralTimer = async () => {
    const timers = [0, 10, 60, 3600, 86400];
    const currentIndex = timers.indexOf(ephemeralTimer);
    const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % timers.length;
    const nextTimer = timers[nextIndex];
    setEphemeralTimer(nextTimer);
    addToast(nextTimer ? `⏱️ Messages will disappear after ${getTimerLabel(nextTimer)}` : '⏱️ Disappearing messages turned off', { type: 'info' });
    try {
      await API.put(`/chat/${chatId}/ephemeral`, { ephemeralDuration: nextTimer });
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    if (!chatId) return undefined;

    setMessages([]);
    setReplyingTo(null);
    setEditingMsg(null);
    setPinnedIds([]);
    setText('');
    setShowSearch(false);
    setSearchResults([]);
    setShowNewMsgBtn(false);

    loadData();

    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
    };
  }, [chatId, myId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!chatId) return undefined;

    if (!socket.connected) socket.connect();
    socket.emit('joinRoom', { room: chatId });

    const handleMsg = (payload) => {
      if (payload.chatId !== chatId) return;
      setMessages((prev) => {
        if (prev.some((m) => m._id === payload.message._id)) return prev;
        return [...prev, payload.message];
      });
      setIsTyping(false);

      if (atBottomRef.current) {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          scrollToBottom('smooth');
        });
        API.post(`/chat/${chatId}/read`).catch(() => {});
      } else {
        setShowNewMsgBtn(true);
      }
    };

    const handleUpdate = (payload) => {
      if (payload.chatId !== chatId) return;
      setMessages((prev) =>
        prev.map((m) =>
          m._id === payload.messageId
            ? {
                ...m,
                content: payload.newContent ?? m.content,
                pollOptions: payload.pollOptions ?? m.pollOptions,
                editedAt: payload.editedAt ?? m.editedAt,
              }
            : m
        )
      );
    };

    const handleDelete = (payload) => {
      if (payload.chatId !== chatId) return;
      setMessages((prev) => prev.filter((m) => m._id !== payload.messageId));
    };

    const handlePin = ({ chatId: pinnedChatId, pinnedMessages }) => {
      if (pinnedChatId !== chatId) return;
      setPinnedIds(pinnedMessages || []);
    };

    const onTyping = (data) => {
      if (data.chatId === chatId && data.userId !== myId) {
        setIsTyping(true);
        window.clearTimeout(typingTimeoutRef.current);
        typingTimeoutRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => setIsTyping(false), 2500);
      }
    };

    socket.on('receiveMessage', handleMsg);
    socket.on('message:updated', handleUpdate);
    socket.on('message:deleted', handleDelete);
    socket.on('chat:pinned', handlePin);
    socket.on('typing', onTyping);

    return () => {
      socket.emit('leaveRoom', { room: chatId });
      socket.off('receiveMessage', handleMsg);
      socket.off('message:updated', handleUpdate);
      socket.off('message:deleted', handleDelete);
      socket.off('chat:pinned', handlePin);
      socket.off('typing', onTyping);
      window.clearTimeout(typingTimeoutRef.current);
    };
  }, [chatId, myId]);

  const loadOlderMessages = async () => {
    if (!chatId || messages.length === 0 || loadingMore) return 0;
    setLoadingMore(true);
    try {
      const oldestMsg = messages[0];
      const res = await API.get(`/chat/${chatId}/messages?before=${encodeURIComponent(oldestMsg.createdAt)}`);
      const older = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.data || [];
      if (older.length > 0) {
        setMessages((prev) => [...older.reverse(), ...prev]);
        return older.length;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('History load error', e);
    } finally {
      setLoadingMore(false);
    }
    return 0;
  };

  const handleTyping = (e) => {
    setText(e.target.value);
    socket.emit('typing', { chatId });
  };

  const handleSearch = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return;
    try {
      const res = await API.get(`/chat/${chatId}/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(searchQuery)}`);
      const list = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.data || [];
      setSearchResults(list);
      setSearchIndex(0);
      if (list.length === 0) addToast('No results found', { type: 'info' });
    } catch (e2) {
      addToast('Search failed', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const nextResult = () => {
    if (searchResults.length === 0) return;
    const nextIdx = (searchIndex + 1) % searchResults.length;
    setSearchIndex(nextIdx);
    const targetId = searchResults[nextIdx]?._id;
    if (!targetId) return;
    const index = messages.findIndex((m) => m._id === targetId);
    if (index !== -1) {
      const el = document.getElementById(`msg-${targetId}`);
      el?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    }
  };

  const handleReply = (msg) => {
    setReplyingTo(msg);
    setEditingMsg(null);
    document.getElementById('chat-input')?.focus();
  };

  const handleEdit = (msg) => {
    setEditingMsg(msg);
    setReplyingTo(null);
    setText(msg.content || '');
    document.getElementById('chat-input')?.focus();
  };

  const handleForward = (msg) => setForwardMsg(msg);

  const handleDelete = async (msgId) => {
    try {
      await API.delete(`/chat/${chatId}/message/${msgId}`);
      setMessages((prev) => prev.filter((m) => m._id !== msgId));
    } catch (e) {
      addToast(e.response?.data?.message || 'Delete failed', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handlePinAction = async (msgId) => {
    try {
      await API.put(`/chat/${chatId}/pin/${msgId}`);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const handleStartCall = () => {
    if (!otherUser?._id) {
      addToast('Cannot call this user', { type: 'error' });
      return;
    }
    const callRoomId = `call_${chatId}_${Date.now()}`;
    socket.emit('call:start', {
      toUserId: otherUser._id,
      roomId: callRoomId,
      callerName: currentUser?.name || 'Friend',
      callerAvatar: currentUser?.avatar || null,
    });
    navigate(`/chat/call/${callRoomId}`);
  };

  const cancelAction = () => {
    setReplyingTo(null);
    setEditingMsg(null);
    setText('');
    setFile(null);
  };

  const sendMessage = async (e) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    if (!text.trim() && !file) return;

    if (editingMsg) {
      try {
        const res = await API.put(`/chat/${chatId}/message/${editingMsg._id}`, { newContent: text });
        const updated = res.data?.data || res.data;
        setMessages((prev) => prev.map((m) => (m._id === editingMsg._id ? { ...m, ...updated } : m)));
        cancelAction();
      } catch (e2) {
        addToast('Edit failed', { type: 'error' });
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      let mediaUrl = null;
      if (file) {
        setIsUploading(true);
        const fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('media', file);
        const res = await API.post('/extra/upload', fd, {
          onUploadProgress: (p) => setUploadProgress(Math.round((p.loaded * 100) / p.total)),
        });
        mediaUrl = res.data?.url || res.data?.data?.url || null;
        setIsUploading(false);
        setUploadProgress(0);
      }

      const processedContent = isSecretMode ? await encryptMessage(text, chatId) : text;
      const payload = {
        content: processedContent,
        media: mediaUrl,
        isEncrypted: isSecretMode,
        isEphemeral: ephemeralTimer > 0,
        ephemeralDuration: ephemeralTimer,
      };

      if (replyingTo) payload.replyTo = replyingTo._id;

      if (chatId.startsWith('demo_chat_')) {
        const myMsg = {
          _id: 'msg_' + Date.now(),
          content: text,
          sender: { _id: myId || 'me', name: currentUser?.name || 'You' },
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
        };
        setMessages((prev) => [...prev, myMsg]);
        cancelAction();
        requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollToBottom('smooth'));

        // Interactive AI and peer response simulation
        setTimeout(() => {
          setIsTyping(true);
          setTimeout(() => {
            setIsTyping(false);
            let replyText = "Received! Let me review this and get back to you shortly.";
            if (chatId === 'demo_chat_ai') {
              replyText = `✨ Social AI: Analyzing "${text}". High engagement potential detected! Adding smart hashtags #SocialVerse #BeyondSocial.`;
            } else if (chatId === 'demo_chat_elena') {
              replyText = "Sounds incredible! Looking forward to collaborating on this.";
            } else if (chatId === 'demo_chat_aarav') {
              replyText = "100%! Testing it right away on my phone.";
            }
            const replyMsg = {
              _id: 'reply_' + Date.now(),
              content: replyText,
              sender: otherUser || { name: 'Peer' },
              createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
            };
            setMessages((prev) => [...prev, replyMsg]);
            requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollToBottom('smooth'));
          }, 1200);
        }, 600);
        return;
      }

      const res = await API.post(`/chat/${chatId}/message`, payload);
      const sent = res.data?.data || res.data;
      if (sent?._id) setMessages((prev) => [...prev, sent]);
      cancelAction();
      requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollToBottom('smooth'));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Send failed', err);
      setIsUploading(false);
      addToast(err.response?.data?.message || 'Send failed', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const pinnedMessages = useMemo(
    () => messages.filter((m) => pinnedIds.includes(m._id)),
    [messages, pinnedIds]
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center bg-[#04070D]">
        <Spinner />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col overflow-hidden bg-[#04070D]">
      <div className="flex h-[75px] flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] px-4 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#070B14]/90 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {onBack && (
            <button onClick={onBack} className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#CBD5E1] hover:bg-white/[0.08] md:hidden">
              <FaArrowLeft />
            </button>
          )}
          <UserAvatar src={otherUser?.avatar} name={otherUser?.name} userId={otherUser?._id} className="h-9 w-9" />
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h3 className="truncate text-sm font-black text-[#F8FAFC]">
              {otherUser?.name || 'Chat'}
            </h3>
            <div className="h-4">
              {isTyping ? (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#00F2FE] animate-pulse">Typing…</span>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[#CBD5E1]/60">
                  {otherUser?.isVerified ? 'Verified' : otherUser?.userStatus || ''}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {/* E2EE Secret Chat Toggle */}
          <button
            onClick={toggleSecretMode}
            title={isSecretMode ? 'End-to-End Encryption (AES-GCM): ON' : 'Turn on End-to-End Encryption'}
            className={`rounded-full p-2 text-xs transition-all ${
              isSecretMode
                ? 'bg-[#0F766E]/20 text-[#00F2FE] ring-1 ring-[#00F2FE]/50 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(100,223,223,0.3)]'
                : 'text-[#CBD5E1]/50 hover:bg-white/[0.06] hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            {isSecretMode ? <FaLock size={14} /> : <FaLockOpen size={14} />}
          </button>

          {/* Ephemeral Disappearing Messages Timer */}
          <button
            onClick={cycleEphemeralTimer}
            title={ephemeralTimer > 0 ? `Disappearing Messages: ${getTimerLabel(ephemeralTimer)}` : 'Disappearing Messages: OFF'}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
              ephemeralTimer > 0
                ? 'bg-[#D4AF37]/20 text-[#D4AF37] ring-1 ring-[#D4AF37]/50 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(212,140,123,0.3)]'
                : 'text-[#CBD5E1]/50 hover:bg-white/[0.06] hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <FaHourglassHalf size={12} className={ephemeralTimer > 0 ? 'animate-pulse' : ''} />
            {ephemeralTimer > 0 && <span>{getTimerLabel(ephemeralTimer)}</span>}
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={handleStartCall}
            title="Start Video Call"
            className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#CBD5E1]/60 transition-colors hover:text-[#00F2FE] hover:bg-white/[0.06]"
          >
            <FaVideo size={15} />
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setShowSearch((v) => !v)}
            title="Search in chat"
            className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#CBD5E1]/60 transition-colors hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.06]"
          >
            <FaSearch size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Ambient Security & Privacy Status Bar */}
      {(isSecretMode || ephemeralTimer > 0) && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-[#070B14] border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.08)] px-4 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium select-none">
          {isSecretMode && (
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[#0F766E] font-semibold">
              <FaShieldAlt className="text-[10px] text-[#00F2FE]" /> End-to-End Encrypted (AES-GCM-256)
            </span>
          )}
          {isSecretMode && ephemeralTimer > 0 && <span className="text-white/20">•</span>}
          {ephemeralTimer > 0 && (
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[#D4AF37]">
              <FaHourglassHalf className="text-[10px] animate-pulse" /> Self-destructing after {getTimerLabel(ephemeralTimer)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {showSearch && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] bg-[#070B14] px-3 py-2">
          <form onSubmit={handleSearch} className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-2">
            <input
              autoFocus
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Find in chat..."
              className="flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)] bg-[#04070D] px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00F2FE]"
            />
            <button type="submit" className="rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#00F2FE] px-3 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm">
              Find
            </button>
          </form>
          {searchResults.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/60 font-mono">
              <span>
                {searchIndex + 1}/{searchResults.length}
              </span>
              <button onClick={nextResult} className="rounded-full p-2 hover:bg-white/[0.08] text-[#CBD5E1]">
                <FaChevronDown />
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => setSearchIndex(Math.max(0, searchIndex - 1))} className="rounded-full p-2 hover:bg-white/[0.08] text-[#CBD5E1]">
                <FaChevronUp />
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
          <button onClick={() => { setShowSearch(false); setSearchResults([]); }} className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:text-[#10B981]">
            <FaTimes />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="z-20">
        <PinnedMessage messages={pinnedMessages} onUnpin={handlePinAction} />
      </div>

      <div ref={listRef} className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-3 py-4">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-2">
          {messages.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-16 text-center text-sm text-[#CBD5E1]/50">
              No messages yet. Say hello.
            </div>
          ) : (
            messages.map((m) => (
              <div id={`msg-${m._id}`} key={m._id}>
                <MessageBubble
                  message={m}
                  isMe={String(m.sender?._id || m.sender) === String(myId)}
                  onReply={handleReply}
                  onDelete={handleDelete}
                  onEdit={handleEdit}
                  onForward={handleForward}
                  onPin={handlePinAction}
                />
              </div>
            ))
          )}

          <div ref={bottomRef} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {showNewMsgBtn && (
        <div className="absolute bottom-28 left-1/2 z-20 -translate-x-1/2">
          <button onClick={() => scrollToBottom('smooth')} className="rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#00F2FE] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-sapphireGlow">
            New messages
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <AnimatePresence>
        {replyingTo && (
          <motion.div initial={{ y: 20, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }} exit={{ y: 20, opacity: 0 }} className="border-t border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] bg-[#070B14] px-4 py-2 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]">
            Replying to: <span className="font-semibold text-[#F8FAFC]">{replyingTo.content || 'Attachment'}</span>
            <button onClick={() => setReplyingTo(null)} className="ml-2 text-[#10B981] hover:text-red-400">
              <FaTimes />
            </button>

      <div className="border-t border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] bg-[#070B14]/95 p-3.5 backdrop-blur-xl">
        {isUploading && (
          <div className="mb-2 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#04070D]">
            <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#00F2FE]" style={{ width: `${uploadProgress}%` }} />
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={sendMessage} className="mx-auto flex max-w-4xl items-center gap-2.5">
          <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#04070D] px-3 py-2.5 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] hover:border-[#00F2FE]/50 transition-colors">
            <FaImage className="text-[#00F2FE]" />
            <span className="hidden md:inline font-semibold">Attach</span>
            <input
              type="file"
              className="hidden"
              accept="image/*,video/*"
              onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
            />
          </label>

          <div className="flex-1">
            {file && (
              <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#04070D] px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                <span className="truncate text-[#F8FAFC]">{file.name}</span>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setFile(null)} className="ml-auto text-[#10B981] hover:text-red-400">
                  <FaTimes />
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            <input
              id="chat-input"
              value={text}
              onChange={handleTyping}
              placeholder="Write a message…"
              className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#04070D] px-4 py-3 text-sm text-[#F8FAFC] outline-none placeholder:text-[#CBD5E1]/40 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00F2FE] transition-all"
            />
          </div>

          <AudioRecorder
            chatId={chatId}
            onSent={(msg) => {
              if (msg?._id) setMessages((prev) => [...prev, msg]);
              requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollToBottom('smooth'));
            }}
          />

          <button
            type="submit"
            className="grid h-12 w-12 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#2563EB] to-[#00F2FE] text-white transition shadow-sapphireGlow hover:scale-[1.04] active:scale-95"
          >
            <FaPaperPlane />
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>

      <ForwardModal isOpen={!!forwardMsg} onClose={() => setForwardMsg(null)} message={forwardMsg} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaTimes, FaSignOutAlt, FaCrown, FaUserMinus, FaPen, FaCheck } from 'react-icons/fa';
import UserAvatar from '../ui/UserAvatar';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';

export default function ChatInfoModal({ isOpen, onClose, chat, onLeave, onUpdate }) {
  const { user: me } = useSelector((s) => s.auth);
  const { add } = useToast();
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [editName, setEditName] = useState(chat?.name || chat?.chatName || '');

  useEffect(() => {
    setEditName(chat?.name || chat?.chatName || '');
  }, [chat]);

  const amIAdmin = useMemo(() => {
    if (!chat || !me?._id) return false;
    if (chat.participants?.some((p) => String(p._id) === String(me._id) && p.isAdmin)) return true;
    return chat.admins?.some((a) => String(typeof a === 'string' ? a : a?._id) === String(me._id));
  }, [chat, me]);

  if (!isOpen || !chat) return null;

  const isAdmin = (uid) => chat.admins?.some((a) => String(typeof a === 'string' ? a : a?._id) === String(uid));

  const handleAction = async (userId, action) => {
    try {
      const res = await API.put(`/chat/${chat._id}/members`, { userId, action });
      onUpdate?.(res.data?.data || res.data);
      add(`User ${action}ed`, { type: 'success' });
    } catch (e) {
      add(e.response?.data?.message || 'Action failed', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleSaveGroup = async () => {
    if (!editName.trim()) return;
    try {
      const res = await API.put(`/chat/${chat._id}/details`, { name: editName.trim() });
      onUpdate?.(res.data?.data || res.data);
      setIsEditing(false);
      add('Group updated', { type: 'success' });
    } catch (e) {
      add(e.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to update group', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleLeave = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm('Leave group?')) return;
    try {
      await API.post(`/chat/${chat._id}/leave`);
      onLeave?.();
      onClose?.();
    } catch (e) {
      add(e.response?.data?.message || 'Failed', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 p-4 backdrop-blur-md">
      <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-[28px] border border-white/10 bg-[#070B14] p-6 shadow-[0_25px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9)] backdrop-blur-2xl">
        <div className="mb-6 flex items-center justify-between">
          {isEditing ? (
            <div className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 pr-2">
              <input
                value={editName}
                onChange={(e) => setEditName(e.target.value)}
                className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0A111E] px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[#F7F7FC] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50"
                autoFocus
              />
              <button onClick={handleSaveGroup} className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#14B8A6] hover:bg-[#0F766E]/20">
                <FaCheck />
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => setIsEditing(false)} className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#10B981] hover:bg-[#052E24]/20">
                <FaTimes />
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
              <h3 className="truncate text-lg font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] font-serif">
                {chat.name || chat.chatName || 'Group Info'}
              </h3>
              {amIAdmin && (
                <button onClick={() => setIsEditing(true)} className="rounded-full p-1.5 text-[#D4AF37] hover:text-[#F4D49A]">
                  <FaPen size={12} />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {!isEditing && (
            <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white transition">
              <FaTimes />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="mb-6">
          <div className="mb-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CBD5E1]/60">
            Members ({chat.participants?.length || 0})
          </div>

          <div className="max-h-64 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1 custom-scrollbar">
            {chat.participants?.map((p) => (
              <div key={p._id} className="group flex items-center justify-between rounded-2xl px-2.5 py-2 transition hover:bg-white/[0.04] border border-transparent hover:border-white/5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <UserAvatar src={p.avatar} name={p.name} className="h-9 w-9 border border-white/10" />
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-[#CBD5E1]">{p.name}</span>
                  {isAdmin(p._id) && <FaCrown className="text-xs text-[#F4D49A]" />}
                </div>

                {amIAdmin && String(p._id) !== String(me?._id) && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 opacity-100 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100">
                    {!isAdmin(p._id) && (
                      <button onClick={() => handleAction(p._id, 'promote')} className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-white/10" title="Promote">
                        <FaCrown />
                      </button>
                    )}
                    <button onClick={() => handleAction(p._id, 'remove')} className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#10B981] hover:bg-[#052E24]/20" title="Remove">
                      <FaUserMinus />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-white/10 pt-4">
          <button onClick={handleLeave} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-[#FF6B8A] hover:bg-[#052E24]/20 transition">
            <FaSignOutAlt /> Leave
          </button>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md hover:opacity-90 transition">
            Done
          </button>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/chat/CreateGroupModal.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaUsers, FaSearch, FaCheck, FaTimes } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function CreateGroupModal({ isOpen, onClose, onCreated }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [results, setResults] = useState([]);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState([]);

  const search = async (q) => {
    setQuery(q);
    if (q.length > 2) {
      try {
        const r = await API.get(`/users/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`);
        setResults(r.data.users || r.data.data || r.data || []);
      } catch (_) {
        setResults([]);
      }
    } else {
      setResults([]);
    }
  };

  const toggleUser = (u) => {
    setSelected((prev) => {
      if (prev.some((s) => s._id === u._id)) return prev.filter((s) => s._id !== u._id);
      return [...prev, u];
    });
  };

  const create = async () => {
    if (!name.trim() || selected.length === 0) return;
    try {
      const res = await API.post('/chat', {
        name: name.trim(),
        isGroup: true,
        participants: selected.map((u) => u._id),
      });
      onCreated?.(res.data?.data || res.data);
      onClose?.();
      setName('');
      setQuery('');
      setResults([]);
      setSelected([]);
    } catch (e) {
      alert(e.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to create group');
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 p-4 backdrop-blur-md">
      <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0.92, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} className="w-full max-w-md rounded-[28px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.16)] bg-[#070B14] p-6 shadow-2xl text-[#F8FAFC]">
        <div className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] pb-3">
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xl font-black text-[#F8FAFC]">
            <FaUsers className="text-[#00F2FE]" /> Create Group
          </h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.08] transition-colors">
            <FaTimes />
          </button>
        </div>

        <input
          value={name}
          onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Group name"
          className="mb-4 w-full rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#04070D] px-4 py-3 text-sm text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00F2FE] transition-all"
        />

        <div className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1]/80">Add members</div>
        <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {selected.map((u) => (
            <span
              key={u._id}
              onClick={() => toggleUser(u)}
              className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-[#D4AF37]/20 border border-[#D4AF37]/40 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/30 transition-colors"
            >
              {u.name} <FaTimes size={10} />
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="relative mb-4">
          <FaSearch className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#CBD5E1]/40" />
          <input
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => search(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search users..."
            className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#04070D] px-4 py-3 pl-10 text-sm text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00F2FE] transition-all"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="mb-5 max-h-48 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {results.map((u) => {
            const active = selected.some((s) => s._id === u._id);
            return (
              <button
                key={u._id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggleUser(u)}
                className={`flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl px-3 py-2 text-left transition ${
                  active ? 'bg-[#1D4ED8]/25 border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.15)]' : 'hover:bg-white/[0.06]'
                }`}
              >
                <img
                  src={u.avatar || '/default-avatar.png'}
                  alt={u.name}
                  className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full object-cover"
                />
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-[#F8FAFC]">{u.name}</div>
                  <div className="truncate text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/60">@{u.email?.split('@')[0] || 'user'}</div>
                </div>
                {active && <FaCheck className="text-[#00F2FE]" />}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] pt-4">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1]/70 hover:bg-white/[0.06] hover:text-white transition-colors">
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={create}
            disabled={!name.trim() || selected.length === 0}
            className="rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#2563EB] to-[#00F2FE] px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 shadow-sapphireGlow hover:opacity-95 transition-all"
          >
            Create Group
          </button>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/chat/ForwardModal.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaTimes, FaPaperPlane, FaSearch } from 'react-icons/fa';
import UserAvatar from '../ui/UserAvatar';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';

export default function ForwardModal({ isOpen, onClose, message }) {
  const [chats, setChats] = useState([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(null);
  const myId = useSelector((s) => s.auth.user?._id);
  const { add } = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    API.get('/chat')
      .then((r) => setChats(r.data?.data || r.data || []))
      .catch(() => setChats([]));
  }, [isOpen]);

  const getOther = (c) =>
    c.participants?.find((p) => String(p._id) !== String(myId)) ||
    c.participants?.[0] ||
    { name: 'User' };

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return chats;
    return chats.filter((c) => getOther(c).name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [chats, search, myId]);

  if (!isOpen || !message) return null;

  const handleForward = async (chatId) => {
    setSending(chatId);
    try {
      await API.post(`/chat/${chatId}/message`, {
        content: message.content || '',
        media: message.media || null,
        audio: message.audio || null,
        replyTo: null,
        isForwarded: true,
        isEncrypted: Boolean(message.isEncrypted),
      });
      add('Message forwarded!', { type: 'success' });
      onClose?.();
    } catch (e) {
      add(e.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to forward', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setSending(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[80] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 p-4 backdrop-blur-md">
      <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0.92, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} className="flex max-h-[70vh] w-full max-w-sm flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.16)] bg-[#070B14] shadow-2xl text-[#F8FAFC]">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] p-4">
          <h3 className="font-black text-[#F8FAFC]">Forward to…</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.08] transition-colors">
            <FaTimes />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.08)] bg-[#04070D] px-4 py-3 text-xs italic text-[#CBD5E1]/70">
          "{message.content || 'Media Attachment'}"
        </div>

        <div className="p-3">
          <div className="flex items-center rounded-2xl bg-[#04070D] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)] px-3 py-2">
            <FaSearch className="mr-2 text-[#CBD5E1]/40" />
            <input
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search chats..."
              className="w-full bg-transparent text-sm outline-none text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40"
              autoFocus
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-2">
          {filtered.map((c) => {
            const other = getOther(c);
            return (
              <button
                key={c._id}
                onClick={() => handleForward(c._id)}
                className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-2xl px-3 py-3 text-left transition hover:bg-white/[0.06]"
              >
                <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
                  <UserAvatar src={other.avatar} name={other.name} className="h-10 w-10" />
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-[#F8FAFC]">{other.name}</div>
                    <div className="truncate text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/60">
                      {c.lastMessage?.content || 'No messages yet'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span className="ml-3 text-[#00F2FE]">
                  {sending === c._id ? (
                    <span className="inline-block h-4 w-4 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.2)] border-t-[#00F2FE]" />
                  ) : (
                    <FaPaperPlane />
                  )}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaVideo, FaTimes, FaPhone } from 'react-icons/fa';
import socket from '../../services/socket';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

export default function IncomingCall() {
  const [call, setCall] = useState(null);
  const nav = useNavigate();
  const audioRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    audioRef.current = new Audio('/ringtone.mp3');
    audioRef.current.loop = true;

    const stopRingtone = () => {
      if (!audioRef.current) return;
      audioRef.current.pause();
      audioRef.current.currentTime = 0;
    };

    const onIncoming = (data) => {
      setCall(data);
      audioRef.current?.play().catch(() => {});
    };

    const onEnd = () => {
      setCall(null);
      stopRingtone();
    };

    socket.on('call:incoming', onIncoming);
    socket.on('call:ended', onEnd);
    socket.on('call:rejected', onEnd);

    return () => {
      socket.off('call:incoming', onIncoming);
      socket.off('call:ended', onEnd);
      socket.off('call:rejected', onEnd);
      stopRingtone();
    };
  }, []);

  const accept = () => {
    if (!call) return;
    audioRef.current?.pause();
    nav(`/chat/call/${call.roomId}`);
    setCall(null);
  };

  const reject = () => {
    if (call) socket.emit('call:rejected', { roomId: call.roomId });
    setCall(null);
    audioRef.current?.pause();
    if (audioRef.current) audioRef.current.currentTime = 0;
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {call && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ y: -100, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ y: -100, opacity: 0 }}
          className="fixed left-1/2 top-4 z-[100] flex w-[95%] max-w-sm -translate-x-1/2 items-center justify-between rounded-[24px] border border-white/10 bg-[#0f1318]/95 p-4 text-white shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md ring-2 ring-[#c89b5c]/40"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="relative">
              <img
                src={call.from?.avatar || '/default-avatar.png'}
                className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full border-2 border-emerald-500 object-cover"
                alt="Caller"
              />
              <span className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 p-1 animate-ping" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-lg font-bold leading-tight">{call.from?.name || 'Unknown'}</div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-[#e1bf8e]">
                <FaVideo size={10} /> Incoming video call…
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={reject}
              className="grid h-10 w-10 place-items-center rounded-full bg-rose-500 shadow-lg shadow-rose-500/30 transition hover:bg-rose-600 active:scale-95"
            >
              <FaTimes />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={accept}
              className="grid h-10 w-10 place-items-center rounded-full bg-emerald-500 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/30 transition hover:bg-emerald-600 active:scale-95"
            >
              <FaPhone className="rotate-90" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}
```
