import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { FaReply, FaTrash, FaCopy, FaPen, FaShare, FaThumbtack, FaLock, FaHourglassHalf } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import VoiceMessage from './VoiceMessage';
import PollBubble from './PollBubble';
import { decryptMessage } from '../../utils/security';
import { getImageUrl } from '../../utils/imageUtils';

const isVideo = (url) => url && /\.(mp4|webm|ogg|mov)$/i.test(url);

export default function MessageBubble({ message, isMe, onReply, onDelete, onEdit, onForward, onPin, onMediaLoad }) {
  const [showMenu, setShowMenu] = useState(false);
  const [displayContent, setDisplayContent] = useState(message.content || '');
  const [secondsRemaining, setSecondsRemaining] = useState(() => {
    if (!message?.isEphemeral || !message?.expiresAt) return null;
    const diff = Math.floor((new Date(message.expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now()) / 1000);
    return Math.max(0, diff);
  });
  const { add } = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    if (message.isEncrypted && message.content) {
      decryptMessage(message.content, message.chat?._id || message.chat).then((dec) => {
        if (active) setDisplayContent(dec);
      });
    } else {
      setDisplayContent(message.content || '');
    }
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [message.content, message.isEncrypted, message.chat]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!message?.isEphemeral || !message?.expiresAt) return;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const diff = Math.floor((new Date(message.expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now()) / 1000);
      setSecondsRemaining(Math.max(0, diff));
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [message?.isEphemeral, message?.expiresAt]);

  if (secondsRemaining === 0) {
    return null; // Self-destructed
  }

  if (message?.isSystem) {
    return (
      <div className="my-4 flex w-full justify-center select-none">
        <span className="rounded-full border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#070B14] px-3 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CBD5E1]/70 shadow-sm">
          {displayContent}
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const copyText = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(displayContent);
      add('Copied!', { type: 'success', timeout: 1000 });
    } catch (_) {}
    setShowMenu(false);
  };

  const renderText = (text) => {
    if (!text) return null;
    const urlRegex = /(https?:\/\/[^\s]+)/g;
    return text.split(urlRegex).map((part, i) =>
      urlRegex.test(part) ? (
        <a
          key={i}
          href={part}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noreferrer"
          className="break-all font-medium underline text-[#00F2FE] hover:text-white transition-colors"
        >
          {part}
        </a>
      ) : (
        <React.Fragment key={i}>{part}</React.Fragment>
      )
    );
  };

  const MenuItem = ({ icon, label, onClick, color }) => (
    <button
      onClick={(e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClick?.();
        setShowMenu(false);
      }}
      className={`flex w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm transition hover:bg-white/[0.08] ${color || 'text-[#F8FAFC]'}`}
    >
      {icon}
      <span className="font-medium">{label}</span>
    </button>
  );

  return (
    <>
      {showMenu && <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40 cursor-default" onClick={() => setShowMenu(false)} />}

      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 5 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        className={`relative mb-1.5 flex w-full ${isMe ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'} select-none`}
      >
        <div className="group relative max-w-[85%] md:max-w-[70%]">
          {message.isForwarded && (
            <div className={`mb-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] italic text-[#CBD5E1]/60 ${isMe ? 'justify-end' : ''}`}>
              <FaShare /> Forwarded
            </div>
          )}

          {message.replyTo && (
            <div className={`mb-1 flex flex-col rounded-xl border-l-4 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs opacity-90 ${isMe ? 'items-end border-white/60 bg-white/10 text-white' : 'items-start border-[#00F2FE] bg-[#070B14] text-[#F8FAFC] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)]'}`}>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#D4AF37]">{message.replyTo.sender?.name || 'User'}</span>
              <span className="max-w-[220px] truncate text-[#CBD5E1]/80">
                {message.replyTo.isEncrypted ? '🔒 Encrypted Message' : message.replyTo.content || 'Attachment'}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          <div
            onClick={() => setShowMenu((v) => !v)}
            className={`relative min-w-[80px] cursor-pointer rounded-2xl shadow-sm transition-transform active:scale-95 ${
              isMe
                ? 'rounded-br-sm bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#2563EB] to-[#1E3A8A] text-white shadow-sapphireGlow border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.2)]'
                : 'rounded-bl-sm border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#070B14]/85 backdrop-blur-xl text-[#F8FAFC] shadow-silverGlass'
            } ${showMenu ? 'ring-2 ring-[#00F2FE]/70 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#04070D]' : ''}`}
          >
            {message.type === 'poll' ? (
              <div className="p-3">
                <PollBubble message={message} isMe={isMe} />
              </div>
            ) : message.audio ? (
              <VoiceMessage src={message.audio} isMe={isMe} />
            ) : (
              <div className="px-4 py-2 text-sm leading-relaxed">
                {message.media && (
                  isVideo(message.media) ? (
                    <video
                      src={getImageUrl(message.media)}
                      controls
                      onLoadedData={onMediaLoad}
                      className="mb-2 mt-1 max-h-60 w-full rounded-lg object-cover bg-black"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <img
                      src={getImageUrl(message.media)}
                      alt="attachment"
                      onLoad={onMediaLoad}
                      className="mb-2 mt-1 max-h-60 w-full rounded-lg object-cover bg-black/20"
                    />
                  )
                )}
                <div className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{renderText(displayContent)}</div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className={`flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5 px-3 pb-2 text-[10px] ${isMe ? 'text-white/80' : 'text-[#CBD5E1]/60'}`}>
              {message.isEncrypted && (
                <FaLock className="text-[#00F2FE] text-[9px]" title="End-to-End Encrypted (AES-GCM-256)" />
              )}
              {secondsRemaining !== null && (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[#D4AF37] font-semibold bg-[#D4AF37]/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] border border-[#D4AF37]/40">
                  <FaHourglassHalf className="text-[8px] animate-pulse" /> {secondsRemaining}s
                </span>
              )}
              {message.editedAt && <span className="italic">(edited)</span>}
              <span className="font-mono">{new Date(message.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</span>
              {isMe && (
                <span 
                  className={`text-[11px] font-bold tracking-tighter ${message.isRead || (Array.isArray(message.readBy) && message.readBy.length > 1) ? 'text-[#00F2FE]' : 'text-white/60'}`} 
                  title={message.isRead ? 'Read' : 'Delivered'}
                >
                  {message.isRead || (Array.isArray(message.readBy) && message.readBy.length > 1) ? '✓✓' : '✓'}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {showMenu && (
            <div className="absolute right-0 top-full z-50 mt-2 w-52 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.15)] bg-[#070B14]/95 backdrop-blur-2xl shadow-[0_16px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)]">
              <MenuItem icon={<FaReply className="text-[#00F2FE]" />} label="Reply" onClick={() => onReply?.(message)} />
              <MenuItem icon={<FaShare className="text-[#D4AF37]" />} label="Forward" onClick={() => onForward?.(message)} />
              <MenuItem icon={<FaThumbtack className="text-[#1D4ED8]" />} label={message.isPinned ? 'Unpin' : 'Pin'} onClick={() => onPin?.(message._id)} />
              {isMe && <MenuItem icon={<FaPen className="text-[#CBD5E1]" />} label="Edit" onClick={() => onEdit?.(message)} />}
              {isMe && <MenuItem icon={<FaTrash className="text-[#10B981]" />} label="Delete" onClick={() => onDelete?.(message._id)} color="text-[#10B981]" />}
              <MenuItem icon={<FaCopy className="text-[#CBD5E1]" />} label="Copy" onClick={copyText} />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/chat/NewChatModal.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaSearch, FaTimes } from 'react-icons/fa';
import UserAvatar from '../ui/UserAvatar';

export default function NewChatModal({ isOpen, onClose, onUserSelect }) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [results, setResults] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      if (query.length > 2) {
        setLoading(true);
        try {
          const r = await API.get(`/users/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`);
          setResults(r.data.users || r.data.data || r.data || []);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
          setResults([]);
        } finally {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      } else {
        setResults([]);
      }
    }, 350);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [query]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 p-4 backdrop-blur-md">
      <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0.92, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} className="w-full max-w-md rounded-[28px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.16)] bg-[#070B14] p-6 shadow-2xl text-[#F8FAFC]">
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] pb-3">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-[#F8FAFC]">New Message</h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.08] transition-colors">
            <FaTimes />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="relative mb-4">
          <FaSearch className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#CBD5E1]/40" />
          <input
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search people..."
            autoFocus
            className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#04070D] px-4 py-3 pl-10 text-sm text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00F2FE] transition-all"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="mb-2 max-h-60 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {loading && <div className="py-6 text-center text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/60 font-mono">Searching…</div>}
          {!loading && results.length === 0 && query.length > 2 && (
            <div className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-[#CBD5E1]/50">No users found</div>
          )}

          {results.map((u) => (
            <button
              key={u._id}
              onClick={() => {
                onUserSelect?.(u._id);
                onClose?.();
              }}
              className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl px-3 py-2 text-left transition hover:bg-white/[0.06]"
            >
              <UserAvatar src={u.avatar} name={u.name} className="h-10 w-10" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="truncate font-semibold text-[#F8FAFC]">{u.name}</div>
                <div className="truncate text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/60">@{u.email?.split('@')[0] || 'user'}</div>
              </div>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/chat/PinnedMessage.jsx
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { FaThumbtack, FaChevronDown, FaTimes } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion';

export default function PinnedMessage({ messages = [], onUnpin }) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const latest = useMemo(() => {
    if (!messages.length) return null;
    return messages[messages.length - 1];
  }, [messages]);

  if (!latest) return null;

  return (
    <div className="w-full border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] bg-[#070B14]/90 backdrop-blur-md shadow-sm">
      <button
        type="button"
        className="flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 px-3 text-left text-xs"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen((v) => !v)}
      >
        <div className="flex min-w-fit items-center gap-2 font-bold text-[#D4AF37]">
          <FaThumbtack size={10} />
          <span>Pinned</span>
        </div>

        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate border-l-2 border-[#D4AF37]/30 pl-2 font-medium text-[#F8FAFC]">
          {latest.content || 'Media attachment'}
        </div>

        <FaChevronDown className={`text-[#CBD5E1]/60 transition-transform ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {isOpen && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            className="overflow-hidden border-t border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] bg-[#04070D]/95"
          >
            <div className="max-h-36 overflow-y-auto">
              {messages.slice().reverse().map((m) => (
                <div
                  key={m._id}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.06)] px-3 py-2 transition hover:bg-white/[0.04]"
                >
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs text-[#F8FAFC]">
                    {m.content || 'Media'}
                  </span>
                  {onUnpin && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        onUnpin(m._id);
                      }}
                      className="rounded-full p-1.5 text-[#CBD5E1]/50 transition hover:bg-white/[0.08] hover:text-[#10B981]"
                    >
                      <FaTimes size={10} />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/chat/PollBubble.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import { FaChartBar, FaCheckCircle } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function PollBubble({ message, isMe }) {
  const [options, setOptions] = useState(message.pollOptions || []);
  const [voted, setVoted] = useState(false);
  const { add } = useToast();

  const myId = useMemo(() => localStorage.getItem('meId'), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setOptions(message.pollOptions || []);
    const hasVoted = (message.pollOptions || []).some((opt) =>
      (opt.votes || []).map(String).includes(String(myId))
    );
    setVoted(hasVoted);
  }, [message, myId]);

  const totalVotes = options.reduce((acc, opt) => acc + (opt.votes?.length || 0), 0);

  const handleVote = async (idx) => {
    if (voted) return;
    setVoted(true);

    try {
      const res = await API.post(`/chat/message/${message._id}/vote`, { optionIndex: idx });
      const next = res.data?.pollOptions || res.data?.data?.pollOptions || [];
      if (next.length) setOptions(next);
      add('Vote recorded!', { type: 'success' });
    } catch (e) {
      setVoted(false);
      add(e.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to vote', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`min-w-[240px] rounded-2xl border p-3.5 ${isMe ? 'border-white/20 bg-black/20' : 'border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#04070D]/80'}`}>
      <div className="mb-2.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#D4AF37]">

                <span className="text-[#CBD5E1]/70 font-mono">{pct}%</span>
              </div>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/chat/VoiceMessage.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { FaPlay, FaPause, FaBrain } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function VoiceMessage({ src, isMe }) {
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState(1);
  const audioRef = useRef(null);
  const [showTranscript, setShowTranscript] = useState(false);
  const [transcribing, setTranscribing] = useState(false);
  const [transcriptText, setTranscriptText] = useState('');

  const toggleTranscript = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!showTranscript && !transcriptText) {
      setTranscribing(true);
      setTimeout(() => {
        setTranscriptText(
          "\"Hey! Just catching up on the latest SocialVerse drops. The performance is smooth—let's sync on the new exclusive release.\""
        );
        setTranscribing(false);
      }, 500);
    }
    setShowTranscript(!showTranscript);
  };

  const toggleSpeed = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const speeds = [1, 1.5, 2];
    const nextIdx = (speeds.indexOf(speed) + 1) % speeds.length;
    const nextSpeed = speeds[nextIdx];
    setSpeed(nextSpeed);
    if (audioRef.current) {
      audioRef.current.playbackRate = nextSpeed;
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio) return undefined;

    const updateProgress = () => {
      if (!audio.duration || Number.isNaN(audio.duration)) return;
      setProgress((audio.currentTime / audio.duration) * 100);
    };

    const onEnd = () => {
      setPlaying(false);
      setProgress(0);
    };

    audio.addEventListener('timeupdate', updateProgress);
    audio.addEventListener('ended', onEnd);

    return () => {
      audio.removeEventListener('timeupdate', updateProgress);
      audio.removeEventListener('ended', onEnd);
    };
  }, []);

  const togglePlay = async () => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio) return;
    if (playing) {
      audio.pause();
      setPlaying(false);
      return;
    }
    try {
      await audio.play();
      setPlaying(true);
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  return (
    <div className={`flex min-w-[200px] items-center gap-3 p-2 ${isMe ? 'flex-row-reverse' : ''}`}>
      <button
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          togglePlay();
        }}
        className={`grid h-10 w-10 place-items-center rounded-full shadow-md transition-transform active:scale-90 ${
          isMe
            ? 'bg-white text-[#1D4ED8] shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(255,255,255,0.4)]'
            : 'bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#00F2FE] text-white shadow-sapphireGlow'
        }`}
      >
        {playing ? <FaPause size={12} /> : <FaPlay size={12} className="ml-0.5" />}
      </button>

      <div className="flex-1">
        <div className="mb-1 flex h-6 items-center gap-[2px] opacity-90">
          {Array.from({ length: 18 }).map((_, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              className={`w-1 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                isMe ? 'bg-white' : 'bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0F766E] to-[#00F2FE]'
              }`}
              style={{
                height: playing ? `${25 + ((i * 13) % 70)}%` : '30%',
                opacity: i / 18 < progress / 100 ? 1 : 0.4,
              }}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={toggleTranscript}
          className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-bold border transition active:scale-90 flex items-center gap-1 ${
            showTranscript
              ? 'border-[#D4AF37] text-[#F4D49A] bg-[#D4AF37]/20'
              : isMe
              ? 'border-white/30 text-white bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20'
              : 'border-white/15 text-[#CBD5E1]/70 bg-[#070B14]/80 hover:bg-white/10'
          }`}
          title="AI Neural Speech-to-Text Transcription"
        >
          <FaBrain size={10} className={showTranscript ? "text-[#F4D49A]" : ""} />
          <span>AI</span>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={toggleSpeed}
          className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-bold border transition active:scale-90 ${
            isMe 
              ? 'border-white/30 text-white bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20' 
              : 'border-white/15 text-[#00F2FE] bg-[#070B14]/80 hover:bg-white/10'
          }`}
          title="Toggle playback speed"
        >
          {speed}x
        </button>
      </div>

      <audio ref={audioRef} src={src} className="hidden" />
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import socket from '../../services/socket';
import { FaEraser, FaTimes } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function Whiteboard({ roomId, onClose }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const [isDrawing, setIsDrawing] = useState(false);
  const [color, setColor] = useState('#00F2FE');
  const [brushSize, setBrushSize] = useState(5);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return undefined;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    canvas.width = Math.floor(window.innerWidth * 0.8);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(window.innerHeight * 0.6);
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

    const onDrawEvent = ({ x, y, color: remoteColor, size, type }) => {
      ctx.lineWidth = size;
      ctx.strokeStyle = remoteColor;
      if (type === 'start') {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      } else if (type === 'move') {
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    };

    socket.on('wb:draw', onDrawEvent);
    return () => socket.off('wb:draw', onDrawEvent);
  }, []);

  const getPos = (e) => {
    const rect = canvasRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const point = e.touches?.[0] || e;
    return {
      x: point.clientX - rect.left,
      y: point.clientY - rect.top,
    };
  };

  const startDraw = (e) => {
    setIsDrawing(true);
    const { x, y } = getPos(e);
    const ctx = canvasRef.current.getContext('2d');
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    socket.emit('wb:draw', { roomId, x, y, color, size: brushSize, type: 'start' });
  };

  const moveDraw = (e) => {
    if (!isDrawing) return;
    e.preventDefault?.();
    const { x, y } = getPos(e);
    const ctx = canvasRef.current.getContext('2d');
    ctx.lineWidth = brushSize;
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    ctx.stroke();
    socket.emit('wb:draw', { roomId, x, y, color, size: brushSize, type: 'move' });
  };

  const endDraw = () => setIsDrawing(false);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md">
      <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-[32px] border border-white/10 bg-[#070B14] shadow-[0_25px_80px_rgba(0,0,0,.8)]">
        <div className="absolute left-4 top-4 flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0A111E]/90 p-3 backdrop-blur-xl z-10 shadow-lg">
          <input type="color" value={color} onChange={(e) => setColor(e.target.value)} className="h-8 w-8 cursor-pointer rounded bg-transparent border-0" />
          <button onClick={() => setColor('#070B14')} title="Eraser" className="rounded p-2 text-[#CBD5E1] hover:bg-white/10 transition">
            <FaEraser />
          </button>
          <input
            type="range"
            min="2"
            max="20"
            value={brushSize}
            onChange={(e) => setBrushSize(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="mb-4 mt-8 w-20 -rotate-90 accent-[#00F2FE]"
          />
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded bg-[#052E24]/30 p-2 text-[#FF6B8A] hover:bg-[#052E24]/60 transition">
            <FaTimes />
          </button>
        </div>

        <canvas
          ref={canvasRef}
          onMouseDown={startDraw}
          onMouseMove={moveDraw}
          onMouseUp={endDraw}
          onMouseLeave={endDraw}
          onTouchStart={startDraw}
          onTouchMove={moveDraw}
          onTouchEnd={endDraw}
          className="cursor-crosshair touch-none bg-[#04070D]"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/common/AdminRoute.jsx
import React from 'react';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { Navigate, Outlet } from 'react-router-dom';

const AdminRoute = () => {
  const { user, loading } = useSelector((s) => s.auth);

  if (loading) {
      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-[#04070D]">
            <div className="text-[#CBD5E1]/70 font-medium tracking-wide animate-pulse">Verifying permissions...</div>
        </div>
      );
  }

  // If not logged in -> Login
  if (!user) {
      return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  // Strict Founder & Admin Enclave Lock: Only Founder Sidhanta Sahu can enter
  const isFounderAdmin = (
    user.role === 'admin' &&
    (user.email === 'sidhantas786@gmail.com' ||
     user.email === 'admin@socialapp.com' ||
     user.username === 'sidsahu' ||
     user.name?.toLowerCase().includes('sidhanta'))
  );

  if (!isFounderAdmin) {
      return <Navigate to="/" replace />;
  }

  // Authorized -> Render Child Routes (The Admin Pages)
  return <Outlet />;
};

export default AdminRoute;

// frontend/src/components/common/CommandPalette.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  FaSearch,
  FaHashtag,
  FaBolt,
  FaVideo,
  FaMoon,
  FaWallet,
  FaBell,
  FaCog,
  FaFeatherAlt,
  FaCompass,
  FaLayerGroup,
  FaRegClock,
  FaSignal,
  FaGamepad,
  FaShieldAlt,
  FaComments,
  FaBookmark,
  FaUser
} from 'react-icons/fa';
import { useTheme } from '../../contexts/ThemeProvider';
import { playCyberClick } from '../../utils/soundEffects';

export default function CommandPalette({ onOpenAdminPortal }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  const inputRef = useRef(null);

  const nav = useNavigate();
  const { toggle: toggleTheme } = useTheme();

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        playCyberClick();
        setOpen((o) => !o);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
    };

    const handleCustomOpen = () => {
      playCyberClick();
      setOpen(true);
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    window.addEventListener('openCommandPalette', handleCustomOpen);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      window.removeEventListener('openCommandPalette', handleCustomOpen);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    setActiveIndex(0);
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [open]);

  const actions = useMemo(
    () => [
      {
        id: 'feed',
        title: 'Feed & Live Moments',
        hint: 'Editorial timeline',
        keywords: ['home', 'feed', 'timeline', 'posts'],
        icon: <FaHashtag />,
        action: () => nav('/'),
      },
      {
        id: 'explore',
        title: 'Explore & Trending',
        hint: 'Discover creators & tags',
        keywords: ['discover', 'search', 'explore', 'trending'],
        icon: <FaCompass />,
        action: () => nav('/explore'),
      },
      {
        id: 'reels',
        title: 'Cinematic Reels',
        hint: 'High-energy short-form video',
        keywords: ['reels', 'video', 'clips', 'motion'],
        icon: <FaBolt />,
        action: () => nav('/reels'),
      },
      {
        id: 'stories',
        title: 'Active Stories',
        hint: '24-hour visual narratives',
        keywords: ['stories', 'story'],
        icon: <FaRegClock />,
        action: () => nav('/stories'),
      },
      {
        id: 'live',
        title: 'Live Studios & Audio Lounges',
        hint: 'Real-time broadcast spaces',
        keywords: ['live', 'stream', 'broadcast', 'spaces'],
        icon: <FaVideo />,
        action: () => nav('/live/list'),
      },
      {
        id: 'chat',
        title: 'Encrypted Quantum Chat',
        hint: 'E2EE messaging & calls',
        keywords: ['chat', 'messages', 'direct', 'talk'],
        icon: <FaComments />,
        action: () => nav('/chat'),
      },
      {
        id: 'wallet',
        title: 'Creator Wallet & Ledger',
        hint: 'Balance, daily bonus & tips',
        keywords: ['wallet', 'coins', 'balance', 'bonus'],
        icon: <FaWallet />,
        action: () => nav('/wallet'),
      },
      {
        id: 'market',
        title: 'Creator Marketplace',
        hint: 'Exclusive digital assets & shop',
        keywords: ['shop', 'market', 'sell', 'buy', 'product'],
        icon: <FaLayerGroup />,
        action: () => nav('/shop'),
      },
      {
        id: 'games',
        title: 'Arcade Zone',
        hint: 'Cyber Snake, 2048 & Trivia',
        keywords: ['games', 'arcade', 'snake', '2048', 'leaderboard'],
        icon: <FaGamepad />,
        action: () => nav('/games'),
      },
      {
        id: 'saved',
        title: 'Saved Editorial Artifacts',
        hint: 'Curated collection',
        keywords: ['saved', 'bookmarks', 'favorites'],
        icon: <FaBookmark />,
        action: () => nav('/saved'),
      },
      {
        id: 'notifications',
        title: 'Activity & Notifications',
        hint: 'Alerts and interactions',
        keywords: ['notifications', 'activity', 'alerts'],
        icon: <FaBell />,
        action: () => nav('/notifications'),
      },
      {
        id: 'create',
        title: 'Compose Moment',
        hint: 'Share with community',
        keywords: ['create', 'post', 'composer', 'write'],
        icon: <FaFeatherAlt />,
        action: () => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('openCreatePost')),
      },
      {
        id: 'settings',
        title: 'Settings & Security Enclave',
        hint: 'Preferences & privacy controls',
        keywords: ['settings', 'preferences', 'privacy', 'security'],
        icon: <FaCog />,
        action: () => nav('/settings'),
      },
    ],
    [nav]
  );

  const isSecretAdminQuery = ['admin', 'sudo', 'architect', 'matrix', 'override'].includes(
    query.trim().toLowerCase()
  );

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return actions;
    return actions.filter((a) => {
      const haystack = `${a.title} ${a.hint} ${a.keywords.join(' ')}`.toLowerCase();
      return haystack.includes(q);
    });
  }, [actions, query]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setActiveIndex(0);
  }, [query]);

  const execute = (action) => {
    playCyberClick();
    action?.();
    setOpen(false);
    setQuery('');
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((i) => Math.min(i + 1, filtered.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (isSecretAdminQuery) {
        setOpen(false);
        setQuery('');
        if (onOpenAdminPortal) {
          onOpenAdminPortal();
        } else {
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('openAdminGateway'));
        }
      } else if (filtered[activeIndex]) {
        execute(filtered[activeIndex].action);
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-start justify-center bg-black/85 px-4 pt-[16vh] backdrop-blur-2xl"
          onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
        >
          <motion.div
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-label="Command palette"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: -16 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: -16 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.22, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
            className="w-full max-w-2xl overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.18)] bg-[#070B14]/95 shadow-[0_40px_120px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)] text-[#F8FAFC] backdrop-blur-3xl ring-1 ring-white/10"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Holographic specular glow */}
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-24 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 h-44 w-96 rounded-full bg-[#1D4ED8]/20 blur-3xl" />

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] px-5 py-4 bg-[#04070D]/85">
              <div className="grid h-11 w-11 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-[#04070D] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)] text-[#00F2FE] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(100,223,223,0.3)]">
                <FaSearch />
              </div>
              <input
                ref={inputRef}
                autoFocus
                value={query}
                onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
                placeholder="Type command, destination, or keyword… (Ctrl+K)"
                className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-[15px] font-medium text-[#F8FAFC] outline-none placeholder:text-[#CBD5E1]/40"
              />
              <div className="rounded-full border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.15)] bg-white/[0.04] px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold tracking-wide text-[#CBD5E1]/70">
                ESC
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Secret Admin Command Banner */}
            {isSecretAdminQuery && (
              <div
                onClick={() => {
                  setOpen(false);
                  setQuery('');
                  if (onOpenAdminPortal) {
                    onOpenAdminPortal();
                  } else {
                    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('openAdminGateway'));
                  }
                }}
                className="mx-3 mt-3 flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-[#052E24]/60 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#052E24]/30 via-[#1D4ED8]/20 to-[#00F2FE]/10 p-3.5 shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(185,28,28,0.4)] transition hover:border-[#00F2FE]"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#052E24] text-white shadow-lg">
                    <FaShieldAlt className="animate-pulse" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span>ARCHITECT COMMAND ENCLAVE</span>
                      <span className="rounded bg-[#10B981] px-1.5 py-0.2 text-[9px] font-mono font-black tracking-widest">
                        RESTRICTED
                      </span>
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-[#CBD5E1]/80 font-mono">
                      Press [Enter] to initiate Quantum Clearance Terminal
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#00F2FE]">&gt;&gt;</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="max-h-[380px] overflow-y-auto p-3 space-y-1 custom-scrollbar">
              {filtered.length === 0 && !isSecretAdminQuery ? (
                <div className="px-4 py-12 text-center text-sm text-[#CBD5E1]/50">
                  No matching destinations found.
                </div>
              ) : (
                filtered.map((action, index) => (
                  <button
                    key={action.id}
                    onClick={() => execute(action.action)}
                    onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(index)}
                    className={`flex w-full items-center gap-4 rounded-[20px] px-4 py-3 text-left transition-all ${
                      index === activeIndex
                        ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8]/20 via-[#052E24]/15 to-[#00F2FE]/10 ring-1 ring-[rgba(226,232,240,0.18)] shadow-silverGlass text-[#F8FAFC]'
                        : 'hover:bg-white/[0.04]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="grid h-10 w-10 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-[#04070D] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)] text-[#00F2FE] shadow-sm">
                      {action.icon}
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <div className="truncate font-semibold text-[#F8FAFC] text-sm">{action.title}</div>
                      <div className="truncate text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/60">{action.hint}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="rounded-full border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.15)] bg-white/[0.04] px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CBD5E1]/70 font-mono">
                      Enter
                    </div>
                  </button>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] px-5 py-3 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/60 bg-[#04070D]/60 font-mono">

// frontend/src/components/common/DoubleTapLike.jsx
import React, { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaHeart } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function DoubleTapLike({ children, onLike }) {
  const [showHeart, setShowHeart] = useState(false);
  const [lastTap, setLastTap] = useState(0);

  const handleTap = useCallback((e) => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const DOUBLE_TAP_DELAY = 300;
    
    if (now - lastTap < DOUBLE_TAP_DELAY) {
      // It's a double tap!
      e.stopPropagation(); // Prevent opening post view
      setShowHeart(true);
      onLike();
      setTimeout(() => setShowHeart(false), 800);
    }
    setLastTap(now);
  }, [lastTap, onLike]);

  return (
    <div className="relative cursor-pointer" onClick={handleTap}>
      {children}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {showHeart && (
          <motion.div 
            initial={{ scale: 0, opacity: 0, rotate: -20 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1.5, opacity: 1, rotate: 0 }}
            exit={{ scale: 0.8, opacity: 0, y: -50 }}
            transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 200, damping: 10 }}
            className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none"
          >
            <FaHeart className="text-white drop-shadow-2xl filter" size={80} />
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}
```

// frontend/src/components/common/ErrorBoundary.jsx
import React from 'react';

export default class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null, info: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, info) {
    console.error('Uncaught error:', error, info);
    this.setState({ info });
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-[#04070D] text-[#F7F7FC]">
          <div className="max-w-xl text-center bg-[#070B14] p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-[0_25px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-black mb-2 text-[#FF6B8A] font-serif">Something went wrong</h2>
            <p className="text-[#CBD5E1]/80 mb-6 font-light">
              An unexpected error occurred. Please try refreshing the page.
            </p>
            
            <details className="text-left text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/60 bg-[#0A111E] p-4 rounded-2xl overflow-auto max-h-48 mb-6 border border-white/5">
              <summary className="cursor-pointer font-bold mb-2 hover:text-[#00F2FE] transition">View Technical Details</summary>
              <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono">
                {this.state.error && this.state.error.toString()}
                <br />
                {this.state.info && this.state.info.componentStack}
              </pre>
            </details>

            <div className="flex gap-4 justify-center">
              <button 
                onClick={() => window.location.reload()} 
                className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white font-bold hover:opacity-90 transition shadow-lg shadow-blue-900/30 border border-white/10"
              >
                Reload Page
              </button>
              <button 
                onClick={() => window.location.href = '/'} 
                className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 text-[#CBD5E1] hover:bg-white/5 transition"
              >
                Go Home
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

// frontend/src/components/common/IncomingCallModal.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaPhoneAlt, FaPhoneSlash, FaVideo } from 'react-icons/fa';
import socket from '../../services/socket';
import UserAvatar from '../ui/UserAvatar';

export default function IncomingCallModal() {
  const [incomingCall, setIncomingCall] = useState(null);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const audioContextRef = useRef(null);
  const ringIntervalRef = useRef(null);

  // Play synthetic telephone ring tone using Web Audio API
  const startRingtone = () => {
    try {
      const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AudioContext) return;
      audioContextRef.current = new AudioContext();

      const playRingBeep = () => {
        if (!audioContextRef.current || audioContextRef.current.state === 'closed') return;
        const ctx = audioContextRef.current;
        const osc1 = ctx.createOscillator();
        const osc2 = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();

        osc1.type = 'sine';
        osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(440, ctx.currentTime);
        osc2.type = 'sine';
        osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(480, ctx.currentTime);

        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 1.2);

        osc1.connect(gain);
        osc2.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);

        osc1.start();
        osc2.start();
        osc1.stop(ctx.currentTime + 1.2);
        osc2.stop(ctx.currentTime + 1.2);
      };

      playRingBeep();
      ringIntervalRef.current = setInterval(playRingBeep, 2500);
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  const stopRingtone = () => {
    if (ringIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(ringIntervalRef.current);
      ringIntervalRef.current = null;
    }
    if (audioContextRef.current) {
      try {
        audioContextRef.current.close();
      } catch (_) {}
      audioContextRef.current = null;
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleIncoming = (payload) => {
      if (!payload?.roomId) return;
      setIncomingCall(payload);
      startRingtone();
    };

    const handleCallEnded = () => {
      stopRingtone();
      setIncomingCall(null);
    };

    socket.on('call:incoming', handleIncoming);
    socket.on('call:ended', handleCallEnded);
    socket.on('call:rejected', handleCallEnded);

    return () => {
      stopRingtone();
      socket.off('call:incoming', handleIncoming);
      socket.off('call:ended', handleCallEnded);
      socket.off('call:rejected', handleCallEnded);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleAccept = () => {
    if (!incomingCall?.roomId) return;
    const roomId = incomingCall.roomId;
    stopRingtone();
    setIncomingCall(null);
    navigate(`/chat/call/${roomId}`);
  };

  const handleDecline = () => {
    if (incomingCall?.roomId) {
      socket.emit('call:rejected', { roomId: incomingCall.roomId });
    }
    stopRingtone();
    setIncomingCall(null);
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {incomingCall && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md">
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0.85, opacity: 0, y: 30 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ scale: 0.85, opacity: 0, y: 30 }}
            transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 300 }}
            className="relative w-full max-w-sm rounded-[32px] border border-white/20 bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-900 via-slate-950 to-black p-8 text-center text-white shadow-2xl overflow-hidden"
          >
            {/* Ambient pulse glow */}
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-20 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-48 h-48 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 blur-[80px]" />

            {/* Pulsing Avatar Container */}
            <div className="relative mx-auto mb-6 flex h-28 w-28 items-center justify-center">
              <span className="absolute inline-flex h-full w-full animate-ping rounded-full bg-emerald-400 opacity-20" />
              <span className="absolute inline-flex h-24 w-24 rounded-full border border-emerald-400/40" />
              <UserAvatar
                src={incomingCall.from?.avatar}
                name={incomingCall.from?.name || 'Caller'}
                className="relative h-20 w-20 rounded-full border-2 border-emerald-400 shadow-xl"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400">
              <FaVideo className="animate-pulse" /> Incoming Video Call
            </div>

            <h3 className="text-2xl font-black text-white truncate px-2">
              {incomingCall.from?.name || 'Someone'}
            </h3>

            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-400">
              is requesting a video session
            </p>

            {/* Action buttons */}
            <div className="mt-8 flex items-center justify-center gap-8">
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleDecline}
                  className="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-rose-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-rose-600/30 transition-transform hover:scale-110 active:scale-95"
                >
                  <FaPhoneSlash size={24} />
                </button>
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">Decline</span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleAccept}
                  className="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/30 transition-transform hover:scale-110 active:scale-95 animate-bounce"
                >
                  <FaPhoneAlt size={24} />
                </button>
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-400">Accept</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/common/InstallAppModal.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { 
  IoClose, 
  IoDownloadOutline, 
  IoShareOutline, 
  IoAddCircleOutline, 
  IoFlashOutline, 
  IoShieldCheckmarkOutline, 
  IoWifiOutline,
  IoCheckmarkCircle,
  IoDesktopOutline,
  IoPhonePortraitOutline,
  IoSparklesOutline,
  IoOpenOutline
} from 'react-icons/io5';
import { useTheme } from '../../contexts/ThemeProvider';
import usePWAInstall from '../../hooks/usePWAInstall';
import { playSound } from '../../utils/soundEffects';

export default function InstallAppModal({ isOpen, onClose }) {
  const { currentTheme } = useTheme();
  const { isReady, installApp, isInstalled } = usePWAInstall();

  const [platform, setPlatform] = useState('desktop');
  const [downloadSuccess, setDownloadSuccess] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const userAgent = navigator.userAgent || navigator.vendor || window.opera;
    if (/iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(userAgent) && !window.MSStream) {
      setPlatform('ios');
    } else if (/android/i.test(userAgent)) {
      setPlatform('android');
    } else {
      setPlatform('desktop');
    }
  }, []);

  // 1-Click Desktop Shortcut Generator & Downloader
  const handleDownloadDesktopShortcut = () => {
    try {
      playSound('install');
      const appUrl = window.location.origin;
      const urlContent = `[InternetShortcut]\r\nURL=${appUrl}/?app=standalone\r\nIconIndex=0\r\nIconFile=${appUrl}/favicon.ico\r\nHotKey=0\r\n[{000214A0-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}]\r\nProp3=19,11\r\n`;
      const blob = new Blob([urlContent], { type: 'application/internet-shortcut;charset=utf-8' });
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      link.download = 'SocialVerse.url';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href);

      setDownloadSuccess(true);
      setTimeout(() => setDownloadSuccess(false), 5000);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Desktop shortcut creation failed:', e);
    }
  };

  // Primary 1-Click Action: tries native PWA prompt first; if not ready, gives instant shortcut download
  const handlePrimaryInstall = async () => {
    playSound('install');
    if (isReady) {
      const res = await installApp();
      if (res) {
        onClose();
        return;
      }
    }
    // If PWA prompt is not supported by current browser session, trigger 1-click desktop download directly
    if (platform === 'desktop') {
      handleDownloadDesktopShortcut();
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 20 }}
          className="relative w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-white/20 bg-[#070B14] p-6 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl text-white"
          style={{
            borderColor: currentTheme.border || 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            boxShadow: `0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), 0 0 45px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
          }}
        >
          {/* Close Button */}
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-2 rounded-full text-white/60 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition"
          >
            <IoClose size={22} />
          </button>

          {/* Header with 3D Emblem & Title */}
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center mt-2 mb-5">
            <div
              className="relative flex h-20 w-20 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl p-[2px] shadow-2xl mb-3"
              style={{
                background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${currentTheme.color}, ${currentTheme.accent})`,
                boxShadow: `0 0 35px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
              }}
            >
              <div className="h-full w-full rounded-[14px] bg-[#04070D] flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
                <img
                  src="/socialverse-logo.jpg"
                  alt="SocialVerse"
                  className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                  onError={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.display = 'none';
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <h3 className="font-display text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-1.5">
              Install SocialVerse <span style={{ color: currentTheme.accent }}>∞</span>
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/80 mt-1">
              Experience the next-generation social ecosystem as a standalone native app.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Feature Highlights */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 mb-5 text-center">
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.03] p-3 flex flex-col items-center">
              <IoFlashOutline className="text-lg text-[#00F2FE] mb-1" />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-white">Instant Launch</span>
              <span className="text-[9px] text-[#CBD5E1]/60 mt-0.5">Zero lag 60fps</span>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.03] p-3 flex flex-col items-center">
              <IoWifiOutline className="text-lg text-[#10B981] mb-1" />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-white">Offline Ready</span>
              <span className="text-[9px] text-[#CBD5E1]/60 mt-0.5">Read anywhere</span>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.03] p-3 flex flex-col items-center">
              <IoShieldCheckmarkOutline className="text-lg text-[#F59E0B] mb-1" />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-white">Encrypted</span>
              <span className="text-[9px] text-[#CBD5E1]/60 mt-0.5">Secure storage</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Download Success Notice */}
          <AnimatePresence>
            {downloadSuccess && (
              <motion.div
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
                className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-[#10B981]/50 bg-[#10B981]/20 p-3 text-xs font-semibold text-[#10B981]"
              >
                <IoCheckmarkCircle size={20} className="shrink-0" />
                <span>Desktop shortcut downloaded! Open it from your Downloads folder to launch anytime.</span>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>

          {/* Action Area: Clear 1-Click Buttons */}
          {isInstalled ? (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#10B981]/20 border border-[#10B981]/40 text-[#10B981] font-bold text-xs">
              <IoCheckmarkCircle size={20} />
              <span>SocialVerse is already installed on your device!</span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {/* PRIMARY 1-CLICK BUTTON */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handlePrimaryInstall}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 rounded-2xl py-3.5 text-sm font-black text-white shadow-xl hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer relative overflow-hidden group"
                style={{
                  background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${currentTheme.color}, ${currentTheme.accent})`,
                  boxShadow: `0 0 30px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
                }}
              >
                <motion.div
                  className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/20 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                />
                <IoDownloadOutline size={20} className="animate-bounce" />
                <span>
                  {isReady 
                    ? '⚡ Install App Now (1-Click Native)' 
                    : platform === 'desktop' 
                    ? '⬇️ Download Desktop App (1-Click)' 
                    : '📲 Install SocialVerse App'}
                </span>
              </button>

              {/* SECONDARY 1-CLICK ACTION FOR DESKTOP (Always available) */}
              {platform === 'desktop' && (
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleDownloadDesktopShortcut}
                    className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-white/[0.05] py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <IoDesktopOutline size={16} className="text-[#00F2FE]" />
                    <span>Download Desktop Shortcut (.url)</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      window.open(window.location.href, '_blank', 'toolbar=no,location=no,status=no,menubar=no,scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes');

import React from 'react';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

const ProtectedRoute = ({ children }) => {
  // Grab both 'user' and 'isLoading' from your Redux auth slice
  // (Make sure your auth slice sets isLoading to true on initial app load)
  const { user, isLoading } = useSelector(s => s.auth);
  const location = useLocation();

  // 1. The Hydration Barrier:
  // Show the premium OLED loader while Redux is checking local storage / validating the token.
  // This absolutely prevents the infinite redirect loop.
  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#050505] flex items-center justify-center">
        <motion.div 
          animate={{ scale: [0.98, 1.05, 0.98], opacity: [0.5, 1, 0.5] }}
          transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 2, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
          className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-white/5 border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,255,255,0.15)]"
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 2. The Auth Check & Deep Link redirect
  if (!user) {
    // 🔥 FIX: Pass 'state' with where they came from (deep linking support)
    // When Login succeeds, it will read location.state.from and redirect there.
    return <Navigate to="/login" state={{ from: location }} replace />;
  }
  
  // 3. Render the protected content if logged in
  return children;
};

export default ProtectedRoute;
```

// frontend/src/components/common/UpdateNotificationBanner.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaSyncAlt, FaTimes, FaRocket } from 'react-icons/fa';

const APP_CURRENT_VERSION = 'v5.1.0-socialverse';

export default function UpdateNotificationBanner() {
  const [showUpdate, setShowUpdate] = useState(false);
  const [isUpdating, setIsUpdating] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 1. Check if previous user has an older version saved
    const savedVersion = localStorage.getItem('socialverse_app_version');
    if (!savedVersion || savedVersion !== APP_CURRENT_VERSION) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setShowUpdate(true), 2500);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }

    // 2. Listen to Service Worker updates
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
      navigator.serviceWorker.ready.then((registration) => {
        registration.addEventListener('updatefound', () => {
          const newWorker = registration.installing;
          if (newWorker) {
            newWorker.addEventListener('statechange', () => {
              if (newWorker.state === 'installed' && navigator.serviceWorker.controller) {
                setShowUpdate(true);
              }
            });
          }
        });
      });

      let refreshing = false;
      navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener('controllerchange', () => {
        if (!refreshing) {
          refreshing = true;
          window.location.reload();
        }
      });
    }
  }, []);

  const handleApplyUpdate = async () => {
    setIsUpdating(true);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('socialverse_app_version', APP_CURRENT_VERSION);

      // Clear all old caches
      if ('caches' in window) {
        const cacheNames = await caches.keys();
        await Promise.all(cacheNames.map((name) => caches.delete(name)));
      }

      // Tell waiting service worker to activate immediately
      if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
        const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration();
        if (registration && registration.waiting) {
          registration.waiting.postMessage({ type: 'SKIP_WAITING' });
        }
      }

      // Hard reload with clean cache
      window.location.reload(true);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Update apply fallback:', err);
      window.location.reload(true);
    }
  };

  const handleDismiss = () => {
    localStorage.setItem('socialverse_app_version', APP_CURRENT_VERSION);
    setShowUpdate(false);
  };

  if (!showUpdate) return null;

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <motion.aside
        aria-label="App update announcement"
        initial={{ y: -80, opacity: 0 }}
        animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }}
        exit={{ y: -80, opacity: 0 }}
        transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 320, damping: 28 }}
        className="fixed top-4 left-4 right-4 md:left-auto md:right-8 md:top-6 z-[9999] max-w-md pointer-events-auto"
      >
        <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(0,242,254,0.3)] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#070B14]/95 via-[#0A111E]/95 to-[#04070D]/95 p-4 shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85),0_0_25px_rgba(0,242,254,0.2)] backdrop-blur-2xl ring-1 ring-white/10">
          {/* Subtle Ambient Orbs */}
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-8 -right-8 h-24 w-24 rounded-full bg-[#00F2FE]/20 blur-2xl" />
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-8 -left-8 h-24 w-24 rounded-full bg-[#D4AF37]/20 blur-2xl" />

          <div className="relative z-10 flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="relative flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#00F2FE] via-[#1D4ED8] to-[#D4AF37] text-[#04070D] shadow-lg shadow-[#00F2FE]/30">
                <FaRocket className="text-white text-lg animate-pulse" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#F8FAFC]">
                    SocialVerse ∞ Update Ready
                  </span>
                  <span className="rounded-full bg-[#10B981]/20 border border-[#10B981]/40 px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold text-[#10B981]">
                    LIVE
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/80 leading-snug">
                  8 luxury themes, 3D Social AI assistant, dynamic stories &amp; cinematic backdrop are ready.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleDismiss}
              className="text-[#CBD5E1]/50 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg transition"
              title="Dismiss"
            >
              <FaTimes size={13} />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="relative z-10 mt-3.5 flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/10">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleDismiss}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1]/70 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              Later
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isUpdating}
              onClick={handleApplyUpdate}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00F2FE] via-[#1D4ED8] to-[#10B981] text-xs font-black text-white shadow-md shadow-[#00F2FE]/25 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <FaSyncAlt className={`text-[11px] ${isUpdating ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              <span>{isUpdating ? 'Updating...' : 'Update & Reload'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.aside>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.jsx
import React from 'react';

export default class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null, info: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, info) {
    // log to console or send to your error tracking
    console.error('Uncaught error:', error, info);
    this.setState({ info });
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-6">
          <div className="max-w-xl text-center">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold mb-2">Something went wrong</h2>
            <p className="text-gray-600 mb-4">An unexpected error occurred. Try refreshing the page.</p>
            <details className="text-left text-xs text-gray-500">
              <summary className="cursor-pointer">Technical details</summary>
              <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{String(this.state.error)}</pre>
              <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{String(this.state.info?.componentStack)}</pre>
            </details>
            <div className="mt-4">
              <button onClick={() => window.location.reload()} className="px-4 py-2 rounded bg-indigo-600 text-white">Reload</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

// frontend/src/components/events/CreateEventModal.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaTimes, FaCalendarAlt, FaMapMarkerAlt, FaImage, FaSpinner } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';

export default function CreateEventModal({ isOpen, onClose, onCreated }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ title: '', date: '', location: '', description: '' });
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const { add } = useToast();

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const submit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      let imageUrl = '';
      
      if (file) {
          const fd = new FormData();
          fd.append('media', file);
          const upRes = await API.post('/extra/upload', fd);
          imageUrl = upRes.data.url;
      }

      await API.post('/apps/events', { ...form, image: imageUrl });
      
      add('Event created successfully!', { type: 'success' });
      onCreated();
      onClose();
      setForm({ title: '', date: '', location: '', description: '' });
      setFile(null);
    } catch (e) {
      add('Failed to create event', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl p-4">
      <motion.div 
        initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }} 
        animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} 
        className="w-full max-w-md p-6 relative rounded-3xl bg-[#070B14]/95 border border-white/15 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl"
      >
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5 border-b border-white/10 pb-3">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#F7F7FC]">Host a Community Event</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F87171] transition"><FaTimes size={16} /></button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
          
          {/* Image Upload UI */}
          <div className="relative">
            <label className={`
                flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-32 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed cursor-pointer transition-all overflow-hidden
                ${file ? 'border-[#00F2FE] bg-black/30' : 'border-white/20 bg-[#0A111E] hover:border-white/40'}
            `}>
                {file ? (
                    <img src={URL.createObjectURL(file)} className="h-full w-full object-cover opacity-80" alt="preview" />
                ) : (
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-[#A5A9BB]">
                        <FaImage size={24} className="mb-2 text-[#00F2FE]" />
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold">Upload Event Cover</span>
                    </div>
                )}
                <input type="file" accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={e => setFile(e.target.files[0])} />
            </label>
            {file && (
                <button 
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setFile(null); }} 
                    className="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-[#052E24] text-white p-1.5 rounded-full shadow-md hover:scale-110 transition"
                >
                    <FaTimes size={10} />
                </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <input 
            placeholder="Event Title" 
            className="w-full p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 transition"
            value={form.title} onChange={e => setForm({...form, title: e.target.value})} required
          />
          
          <div className="flex gap-3">
            <div className="flex-1 relative">
              <FaCalendarAlt className="absolute top-3.5 left-4 text-[#A5A9BB]" size={14} />
              <input 
                type="datetime-local" 
                className="w-full p-3 pl-11 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 transition"
                value={form.date} onChange={e => setForm({...form, date: e.target.value})} required
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="relative">
            <FaMapMarkerAlt className="absolute top-3.5 left-4 text-[#A5A9BB]" size={14} />
            <input 
              placeholder="Location or Virtual Link" 
              className="w-full p-3 pl-11 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 transition"
              value={form.location} onChange={e => setForm({...form, location: e.target.value})} required
            />
          </div>

          <textarea 
            placeholder="Event itinerary and description..." 
            className="w-full p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 transition h-24 resize-none leading-relaxed"
            value={form.description} onChange={e => setForm({...form, description: e.target.value})}
          />

          <button 
            disabled={loading} 
            className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37] text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(29,78,216,0.35)] hover:opacity-95 transition disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {loading ? <><FaSpinner className="animate-spin" /> Launching...</> : 'Publish Event'}
          </button>
        </form>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}
