```jsx
// frontend/src/components/games/SnakeGame.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { FaTrophy, FaTimes, FaPlay, FaRedo, FaArrowUp, FaArrowDown, FaArrowLeft, FaArrowRight } from 'react-icons/fa';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';

const GRID_SIZE = 20;
const SPEED = 150;

export default function SnakeGame({ onClose, onScoreSaved }) {
  const [snake, setSnake] = useState([[5, 5]]);
  const [food, setFood] = useState([10, 10]);
  const [dir, setDir] = useState([0, 1]); // [y, x]
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  
  const { add } = useToast();
  
  // Refs to hold mutable data for the game loop without triggering re-renders
  const savedCallback = useRef();
  const dirRef = useRef([0, 1]); // Holds latest direction to prevent rapid key-press bugs

  // Sync direction state to ref for the loop
  useEffect(() => {
    dirRef.current = dir;
  }, [dir]);

  // Prevent background scrolling
  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => { document.body.style.overflow = ''; };
  }, []);

  // Keyboard Controls
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKey = (e) => {
      if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
      
      // Use current direction from state to prevent 180 turns
      // We check against the current dir state to prevent reversing
      switch(e.key) {
        case 'ArrowUp': 
          if(dir[0] !== 1) setDir([-1, 0]); 
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown': 
          if(dir[0] !== -1) setDir([1, 0]); 
          break;
        case 'ArrowLeft': 
          if(dir[1] !== 1) setDir([0, -1]); 
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight': 
          if(dir[1] !== -1) setDir([0, 1]); 
          break;
        default: break;
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
  }, [dir]);

  // Core Game Logic
  const moveSnake = () => {
    const currentDir = dirRef.current;
    const newHead = [snake[0][0] + currentDir[0], snake[0][1] + currentDir[1]];

    // Collision Detection (Walls)
    if (newHead[0] < 0 || newHead[0] >= GRID_SIZE || newHead[1] < 0 || newHead[1] >= GRID_SIZE) {
      return endGame();
    }
    
    // Collision Detection (Self)
    if (snake.some(s => s[0] === newHead[0] && s[1] === newHead[1])) {
      return endGame();
    }

    const newSnake = [newHead, ...snake];
    
    // Eat Food
    if (newHead[0] === food[0] && newHead[1] === food[1]) {
      setScore(s => s + 10);
      generateFood(newSnake);
    } else {
      newSnake.pop(); // Remove tail
    }
    
    setSnake(newSnake);
  };

  const generateFood = (currentSnake) => {
    let newFood;
    let placed = false;
    while (!placed) {
      newFood = [Math.floor(Math.random() * GRID_SIZE), Math.floor(Math.random() * GRID_SIZE)];
      // Ensure food doesn't spawn on snake body
      const isOnSnake = currentSnake.some(s => s[0] === newFood[0] && s[1] === newFood[1]);
      if (!isOnSnake) placed = true;
    }
    setFood(newFood);
  };

  const endGame = async () => {
    setGameOver(true);
    setIsPlaying(false);
    try {
      await API.post('/apps/games/score', { gameId: 'snake', score });
      add(`Score: ${score} saved!`, { type: 'success' });
      if(onScoreSaved) onScoreSaved();
    } catch(e) {
      // Silent fail on score save
    }
  };

  const startGame = () => {
    setSnake([[5, 5]]);
    setFood([10, 10]);
    setDir([0, 1]);
    dirRef.current = [0, 1];
    setScore(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPlaying(true);
  };

  // --- GAME LOOP FIX ---
  // 1. Save the latest callback to a ref. This allows the interval to always access fresh state.
  useEffect(() => {
    savedCallback.current = moveSnake;
  });

  // 2. Set up the interval only when playing state changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying || gameOver) return;
    
    const tick = () => {
      if (savedCallback.current) savedCallback.current();
    };

    const id = setInterval(tick, SPEED);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [isPlaying, gameOver]); // Dependency array is now stable!

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-sm p-4">
      <div className="bg-gray-900 p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-gray-700 w-full max-w-sm relative">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 text-white">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-yellow-400 text-xl"><FaTrophy /> {score}</div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 bg-gray-800 rounded-full hover:bg-red-500 transition"><FaTimes /></button>
        </div>

        {/* Game Board */}
        <div className="relative w-full aspect-square bg-gray-800 rounded-lg overflow-hidden grid border border-gray-700" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${GRID_SIZE}, 1fr)` }}>
          {Array.from({ length: GRID_SIZE * GRID_SIZE }).map((_, i) => {
            const y = Math.floor(i / GRID_SIZE);
            const x = i % GRID_SIZE;
            const isSnake = snake.some(s => s[0] === y && s[1] === x);
            const isFood = food[0] === y && food[1] === x;
            return (
              <div key={i} className={`${isSnake ? 'bg-green-500 rounded-sm' : isFood ? 'bg-red-500 rounded-full animate-pulse' : ''}`} />
            );
          })}
          
          {(!isPlaying || gameOver) && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm text-white z-10">
              {gameOver && <div className="text-3xl font-black text-red-500 mb-2">GAME OVER</div>}
              <button onClick={startGame} className="btn-primary flex items-center gap-2 px-8 py-3 text-lg rounded-full animate-bounce">
                {gameOver ? <><FaRedo /> Try Again</> : <><FaPlay /> Start Game</>}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        
        {/* Mobile Controls */}
        <div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 max-w-[200px] mx-auto md:hidden">
            <div />
            <button onPointerDown={() => setDir([-1, 0])} className="p-4 bg-gray-700 rounded-lg active:bg-green-500 text-white"><FaArrowUp /></button>
            <div />
            <button onPointerDown={() => setDir([0, -1])} className="p-4 bg-gray-700 rounded-lg active:bg-green-500 text-white"><FaArrowLeft /></button>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center text-gray-500 text-xs font-bold">PAD</div>
            <button onPointerDown={() => setDir([0, 1])} className="p-4 bg-gray-700 rounded-lg active:bg-green-500 text-white"><FaArrowRight /></button>
            <div />
            <button onPointerDown={() => setDir([1, 0])} className="p-4 bg-gray-700 rounded-lg active:bg-green-500 text-white"><FaArrowDown /></button>
            <div />
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 text-center text-gray-500 text-xs hidden md:block">Use Arrow Keys to Play</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/gamification/StreakQuestsModal.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaFire, FaTimes, FaCoins, FaCheck, FaAward, FaBolt } from 'react-icons/fa';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import { playCyberClick, playSuccessChord } from '../../utils/soundEffects';

export default function StreakQuestsModal({ isOpen, onClose }) {
  const [data, setData] = useState({
    streak: { count: 1, bestStreak: 1 },
    quests: []
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [claimingId, setClaimingId] = useState(null);
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      loadQuests();
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const loadQuests = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const res = await API.get('/users/quests');
      if (res.data?.success) {
        setData({
          streak: res.data.streak || { count: 1, bestStreak: 1 },
          quests: res.data.quests || []
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Could not load quests:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const claimQuest = async (questId) => {
    try {
      setClaimingId(questId);
      playCyberClick();
      const res = await API.post(`/users/quests/${questId}/claim`);
      if (res.data?.success) {
        playSuccessChord();
        addToast(res.data.message || 'Reward claimed!', { type: 'success' });
        setData((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          quests: prev.quests.map((q) => (q.id === questId ? { ...q, claimed: true } : q))
        }));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      addToast(err.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to claim reward', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setClaimingId(null);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const streakDays = data.streak?.count || 1;
  const streakTier =
    streakDays >= 30
      ? 'AETHERIA SOVEREIGN'
      : streakDays >= 14
      ? 'IMPERIAL EMERALD'
      : streakDays >= 7
      ? 'ELECTRIC OCEAN'
      : 'ROYAL OBSIDIAN';

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md">
      <motion.div
        initial={{ scale: 0.94, opacity: 0 }}
        animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
        exit={{ scale: 0.94, opacity: 0 }}
        className="relative w-full max-w-lg overflow-hidden rounded-[32px] border border-[rgba(0,242,254,0.22)] bg-gradient-to-br from-[#070B14] via-[#0A111E] to-[#04070D] p-6 text-[#F8FAFC] shadow-[0_25px_70px_rgba(0,0,0,0.95)] backdrop-blur-3xl ring-1 ring-white/10"
      >
        {/* Ambient Glow Orbs */}
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-16 -top-16 h-48 w-48 rounded-full bg-[#10B981]/25 blur-[90px]" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-16 -left-16 h-48 w-48 rounded-full bg-[#00F2FE]/20 blur-[90px]" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-40 w-40 rounded-full bg-[#D4AF37]/15 blur-[100px]" />

        {/* Close Button */}
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="absolute right-5 top-5 z-20 flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-[#CBD5E1]/70 hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
        >
          <FaTimes size={14} />
        </button>

        {/* Streak Header */}
        <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center gap-4 border-b border-white/10 pb-5">
          <div className="relative flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#052E24] via-[#10B981] to-[#D4AF37] text-white shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)] border border-[rgba(212,175,55,0.4)]">
            <FaFire size={32} className="animate-pulse text-[#FEF3C7]" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#D4AF37]">
                {streakTier}
              </span>
              <span className="rounded-full bg-[#00F2FE]/15 border border-[#00F2FE]/30 px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9px] text-[#00F2FE]">
                AETHERIA PRESTIGE
              </span>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight text-[#F8FAFC] font-display">
              {streakDays} Day Streak<span className="text-[#D4AF37]">.</span>
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/70">
              Personal best: {data.streak?.bestStreak || streakDays} days in a row
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Quests Container */}
        <div className="relative z-10 mt-5 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CBD5E1]/80 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <FaBolt className="text-[#D4AF37]" /> Daily Action Quests
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#00F2FE]">RESETS AT MIDNIGHT</span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2.5 max-h-[280px] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-1">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="py-12 text-center text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/50">
                Synchronizing daily ledger quests...
              </div>
            ) : data.quests.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/50">
                All daily quests completed! Check back tomorrow for new bounties.
              </div>
            ) : (
              data.quests.map((q) => (
                <div
                  key={q.id}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(0,242,254,0.12)] bg-[#04070D]/85 p-3.5 transition hover:border-[rgba(0,242,254,0.3)] shadow-inner"
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0 pr-3">
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-[#F8FAFC] truncate">{q.title}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-black text-[#D4AF37]">
                        <FaCoins size={10} className="text-[#F59E0B]" /> +{q.reward} Coins
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-[#CBD5E1]/50 font-mono">
                        Progress: {q.progress || 1}/{q.target || 1}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    disabled={q.claimed || claimingId === q.id}
                    onClick={() => claimQuest(q.id)}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition shrink-0 cursor-pointer ${
                      q.claimed
                        ? 'bg-white/5 text-[#CBD5E1]/40 border border-white/5 cursor-default'
                        : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00F2FE] via-[#1D4ED8] to-[#10B981] text-white shadow-md shadow-[#00F2FE]/25 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {q.claimed ? (
                      <>
                        <FaCheck size={11} className="text-[#10B981]" />
                        <span>Claimed</span>
                      </>
                    ) : claimingId === q.id ? (
                      'Claiming...'
                    ) : (
                      'Claim'
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer note */}
        <div className="relative z-10 mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[rgba(212,175,55,0.25)] bg-[rgba(212,175,55,0.03)] p-3 text-center text-[11px] text-[#CBD5E1]/70">
          Maintain your streak daily to multiply XP and unlock legendary Aetheria Imperial badges.
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

    if (hours < 12) return 'Good Morning';
    if (hours < 17) return 'Good Afternoon';
    return 'Good Evening';

  const displayName = user?.name ? user.name.split(' ')[0] : 'Sidhanta';

    weekday: 'short',
    day: '2-digit',
    month: 'short',

          className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#04070D]/95 via-[#070B14]/75 to-transparent"
          style={{
            backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(90deg, #04070D 0%, rgba(7, 11, 20, 0.85) 45%, ${currentTheme.glow} 100%)`,
          }}
        />
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#04070D] via-transparent to-transparent opacity-80" />

        {/* Animated Sunlit Mountain Peak Flare */}
        <motion.div
          animate={{ opacity: [0.2, 0.45, 0.2], scale: [0.95, 1.1, 0.95] }}
          transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 7, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
          className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-10 right-1/4 h-56 w-72 rounded-full blur-3xl"

              <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-[#CBD5E1]/80">

              <span

            className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-black/40 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white backdrop-blur-xl shadow-lg transition-all hover:bg-black/60 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer self-start md:self-auto"
            style={{
              borderColor: currentTheme.border || 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/home/SocialAiWidget.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { IoSparkles, IoPaperPlane, IoCopyOutline, IoCheckmark, IoClose } from 'react-icons/io5';
import { useTheme } from '../../contexts/ThemeProvider';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import API from '../../services/api';

const PROMPT_CHIPS = [
  { id: 'write', label: 'Write a post', icon: '📝', query: 'Write a viral engaging post about tech innovations and lifestyle' },
  { id: 'reel', label: 'Create a reel', icon: '🎬', query: 'Give me a 30-second viral reel script with hook and caption' },
  { id: 'ideas', label: 'Post ideas', icon: '💡', query: 'Top 5 trending post ideas for creators this week' },
  { id: 'tips', label: 'Growth tips', icon: '📈', query: 'How to increase engagement and reach on SocialVerse' },
];

export default function SocialAiWidget({ onUseContent }) {
  const { currentTheme } = useTheme();
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();

  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [response, setResponse] = useState(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const handleSendPrompt = async (queryText) => {
    const textToSend = queryText || input;
    if (!textToSend.trim() || loading) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setInput('');
    setResponse(null);

    try {
      const tone = textToSend.toLowerCase().includes('reel') ? 'viral' : 'visionary';
      const res = await API.post('/posts/ai/compose', { prompt: textToSend, tone });
      if (res.data?.caption) {
        setResponse(res.data.caption);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Fallback to rich dynamic generator below
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
      let resultText = '';
      const q = textToSend.toLowerCase();

      if (q.includes('reel')) {
        resultText = `🎬 VIRAL REEL SCRIPT:\n• Hook (0-3s): "Stop scrolling if you want to elevate your daily routine in 2026."\n• Visual: Quick kinetic cuts, city lights timelapse.\n• Body: 3 key insights on digital mindfulness & creative focus.\n• CTA: "Save this for later and drop your thoughts below! ✨"\n\n#ReelLife #Mindset2026 #CreativeVibes #SocialVerse`;
      } else if (q.includes('growth') || q.includes('tips')) {
        resultText = `📈 3 GOLDEN GROWTH RULES:\n1. Post during peak transit hours (8:30 AM & 7:15 PM).\n2. Reply to first 10 comments within 15 minutes to trigger the algorithm.\n3. Utilize rich high-contrast media with at least 3 curated hashtags.\n\nConsistent daily streaks boost profile visibility by 3.4x! 🔥`;
      } else if (q.includes('ideas')) {
        resultText = `💡 5 TRENDING TOPICS TODAY:\n1. "A day in my workspace setup in Mumbai"\n2. "What AI tools I actually use everyday"\n3. "City dusk photography secrets"\n4. "Weekly milestones & lessons learned"\n5. "Interactive poll: Remote vs Studio life"`;
      } else {
        resultText = `✨ CREATED FOR YOU:\n"City lights, calm mind, and endless possibilities ✨ Every moment spent building what you love pays off in ways you can't predict yet. Keep pushing boundaries.\n\n#NightVibes #Mindset #Cityscape #CreatorsOfInstagram #SocialVerse"`;
      }

      setResponse(resultText);
      setLoading(false);
    }, 600);
  };

  const handleCopy = () => {
    if (!response) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(response);
    setCopied(true);
    addToast('Copied to clipboard!', { type: 'success' });
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleUseInPost = () => {
    if (onUseContent && response) {
      onUseContent(response);
    } else {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('openCreatePost', { detail: { content: response } }));
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-[26px] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.14)] bg-[#070B14]/90 p-5 shadow-[0_16px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.65)] backdrop-blur-2xl transition-all duration-300 hover:border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.22)]"
      style={{
        boxShadow: `0 16px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 30px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
        borderColor: currentTheme.border || 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)',
      }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div
            className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl shadow-md"
            style={{
              background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${currentTheme.color}, ${currentTheme.accent})`,
              boxShadow: `0 0 15px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
            }}
          >
            <IoSparkles className="text-white text-sm animate-pulse" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h3 className="font-display text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Social AI</h3>
              <span className="rounded-full bg-white/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CBD5E1]">
                Beta
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-[#CBD5E1]/70">Your personal social assistant</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Luminous Animated Multi-Strand Fluid Ribbon Waveform (Matching Images 1 & 2) */}
      <div className="relative my-3.5 h-14 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-black/50 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center p-2">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 340 50" className="w-full h-full" preserveAspectRatio="none">
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id="aiWaveGrad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#00F2FE" />
              <stop offset="35%" stopColor="#9B6DFF" />
              <stop offset="70%" stopColor="#FF6B8A" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#F59E0B" />
            </linearGradient>
            <linearGradient id="aiWaveGrad2" x1="100%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="0%">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#00F2FE" stopOpacity="0.4" />
              <stop offset="50%" stopColor="#FF6B8A" stopOpacity="0.7" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#9B6DFF" stopOpacity="0.3" />
            </linearGradient>
            <filter id="aiWaveGlow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
              <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="blur" />
              <feComposite in="SourceGraphic" in2="blur" operator="over" />
            </filter>
          </defs>

          {/* Strand 1 */}
          <motion.path
            d="M0,25 C60,5 120,45 180,25 C240,5 300,45 340,25"
            fill="none"
            stroke="url(#aiWaveGrad1)"
            strokeWidth="3.5"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            filter="url(#aiWaveGlow)"
            animate={{
              d: loading
                ? [
                    "M0,25 C60,2 120,48 180,25 C240,2 300,48 340,25",
                    "M0,25 C60,48 120,2 180,25 C240,48 300,2 340,25",
                    "M0,25 C60,2 120,48 180,25 C240,2 300,48 340,25",
                  ]
                : [
                    "M0,25 C60,10 120,40 180,25 C240,10 300,40 340,25",
                    "M0,25 C60,38 120,12 180,25 C240,38 300,12 340,25",
                    "M0,25 C60,10 120,40 180,25 C240,10 300,40 340,25",
                  ],
            }}
            transition={{ duration: loading ? 0.9 : 2.8, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
          />

          {/* Strand 2 */}
          <motion.path
            d="M0,25 C80,45 150,5 220,35 C280,15 310,35 340,25"
            fill="none"
            stroke="url(#aiWaveGrad2)"
            strokeWidth="2"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            filter="url(#aiWaveGlow)"
            animate={{
              d: loading
                ? [
                    "M0,25 C80,5 150,45 220,15 C280,35 310,15 340,25",
                    "M0,25 C80,45 150,5 220,35 C280,15 310,35 340,25",
                  ]
                : [
                    "M0,25 C80,35 150,15 220,30 C280,20 310,30 340,25",
                    "M0,25 C80,15 150,35 220,20 C280,30 310,20 340,25",
                    "M0,25 C80,35 150,15 220,30 C280,20 310,30 340,25",
                  ],
            }}
            transition={{ duration: loading ? 1.2 : 3.5, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut', delay: 0.3 }}
          />
        </svg>

        {/* Dancing Pulsing Particles */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-around pointer-events-none px-4">
          {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
            <motion.div
              key={i}
              animate={{ y: [-4, 4, -4], opacity: [0.3, 0.9, 0.3] }}
              transition={{ duration: 1.6 + i * 0.3, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
              className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-white shadow-[0_0_8px_#00F2FE]"
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Quick Action Prompt Chips */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-3">
        {PROMPT_CHIPS.map((chip) => (
          <button
            key={chip.id}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleSendPrompt(chip.query)}
            disabled={loading}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.03] px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-[#CBD5E1] transition-all hover:bg-white/[0.08] hover:border-white/20 hover:text-white cursor-pointer active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <span>{chip.icon}</span>
            <span className="truncate">{chip.label}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Interactive Input Form */}
      <form
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleSendPrompt();
        }}
        className="relative flex items-center"
      >
        <input
          type="text"
          value={input}
          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Ask anything about content, trends..."
          disabled={loading}
          className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-white/15 bg-black/60 py-2.5 pl-4 pr-11 text-xs text-white placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 outline-none transition-all focus:border-white/40 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white/20 disabled:opacity-50 shadow-inner"
        />

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={!input.trim() || loading}
          className="absolute right-2 flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-white shadow-md transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-90 disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
          style={{
            background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${currentTheme.color}, ${currentTheme.accent})`,
          }}
        >
          {loading ? (
            <div className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-white border-t-transparent" />
          ) : (
            <IoPaperPlane size={13} />
          )}
        </button>
      </form>

      {/* Generated Response Drawer */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {response && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
            className="mt-3 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/15 bg-black/70 p-3.5 text-xs text-white backdrop-blur-xl shadow-xl"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-white/10">
              <span className="font-bold text-[11px] text-[#F4D49A] flex items-center gap-1">
                <IoSparkles size={12} /> Social AI Suggestion
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setResponse(null)}
                className="text-white/60 hover:text-white p-0.5 rounded-full"
              >
                <IoClose size={15} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-2.5 max-h-40 overflow-y-auto whitespace-pre-wrap font-sans text-[11.5px] leading-relaxed text-[#CBD5E1] pr-1">
              {response}
            </div>

            <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/10">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCopy}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white/80 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                {copied ? <IoCheckmark className="text-[#10B981]" /> : <IoCopyOutline />}
                <span>{copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy'}</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleUseInPost}
                className="rounded-lg px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-white shadow-md hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
                style={{
                  background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${currentTheme.color}, ${currentTheme.accent})`,
                }}
              >
                Use in Post ✨
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
  const { socket } = useSocket();
  const { isReady, installApp } = usePWAInstall();
  const { currentTheme } = useTheme();

  const [msgCount, setMsgCount] = useState(5);
  const [activityCount, setActivityCount] = useState(7);
  const [showMoreFeatures, setShowMoreFeatures] = useState(false);
  const [showMobileDrawer, setShowMobileDrawer] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (location.pathname.startsWith('/chat')) {
      setMsgCount(0);
    }
    if (location.pathname.startsWith('/notifications')) {
      setActivityCount(0);
    }
  }, [location.pathname]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!socket) return;
    const onNewMessage = () => setMsgCount((c) => c + 1);
    const onNewNotification = () => setActivityCount((c) => c + 1);
    socket.on('chat:message', onNewMessage);
    socket.on('notification', onNewNotification);
    return () => {
      socket.off('chat:message', onNewMessage);
      socket.off('notification', onNewNotification);
    };
  }, [socket]);

  const isActive = (path) => {
    if (path === '/' && (location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/welcome')) return true;
    return location.pathname.startsWith(path) && path !== '/';
  };

  const triggerHaptic = (ms = 15) => {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.vibrate) {
      try {
        navigator.vibrate(ms);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  };

  const openCreate = () => {
    triggerHaptic(20);
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('openCreatePost'));
  };

  // Core Main Sidebar Links (Images 1 & 2)
  const navLinks = [
    { to: '/', label: 'Home', iconActive: <IoHome />, iconInactive: <IoHomeOutline /> },
    { to: '/explore', label: 'Explore', iconActive: <IoCompass />, iconInactive: <IoCompassOutline /> },
    { to: '/reels', label: 'Reels', iconActive: <IoVideocam />, iconInactive: <IoVideocamOutline /> },
    { to: '/chat', label: 'Messages', iconActive: <IoChatbubbleEllipses />, iconInactive: <IoChatbubbleEllipsesOutline />, badge: msgCount > 0 ? msgCount : null },
    { to: '/notifications', label: 'Notifications', iconActive: <IoHeart />, iconInactive: <IoHeartOutline />, badge: activityCount > 0 ? activityCount : null },
    { to: '/discovery/follow-suggestions', label: 'Groups', iconActive: <IoPeople />, iconInactive: <IoPeopleOutline /> },
    { to: '/events', label: 'Events', iconActive: <IoCalendar />, iconInactive: <IoCalendarOutline /> },
    { to: '/saved', label: 'Saved', iconActive: <IoBookmark />, iconInactive: <IoBookmarkOutline /> },
    { to: '/memories', label: 'Memories', iconActive: <IoTime />, iconInactive: <IoTimeOutline /> },
    { to: '/shop', label: 'Marketplace', iconActive: <IoStorefront />, iconInactive: <IoStorefrontOutline /> },
  ];

  // Extended Previous App Features (Fully Preserved & Integrated)
  const studioFeatures = [
    { to: '/live', label: 'Live Studio', icon: <IoVideocamOutline /> },
    { to: '/games', label: 'Games Arcade', icon: <IoGameControllerOutline /> },
    { to: '/wallet', label: 'Creator Wallet', icon: <IoWalletOutline /> },
    { to: '/analytics', label: 'Analytics', icon: <IoStatsChartOutline /> },
    { to: '/discover', label: 'Swipe Discovery', icon: <IoFlameOutline /> },
    { to: '/feature-hub', label: 'Features Hub', icon: <IoGridOutline /> },
    { to: '/scheduled-posts', label: 'Scheduled Posts', icon: <IoTimeOutline /> },
    { to: '/report', label: 'Safety Center', icon: <IoShieldCheckmarkOutline /> },
    { to: '/settings', label: 'Settings', icon: <IoSettingsOutline /> },
  ];

  const displayName = user?.name || 'Sidhanta Sahu';
  const username = user?.username || 'sidhanta';

  return (
    <>
      {/* =========================================================================
          DESKTOP LEFT SIDEBAR (Images 1 & 2)
          ========================================================================= */}
      <aside
        className="hidden md:flex h-screen w-[275px] flex-col border-r border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.12)] bg-[#070B14]/94 backdrop-blur-3xl fixed left-0 top-0 z-40 transition-colors duration-300 shadow-[4px_0_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.7)]"
        style={{
          borderColor: currentTheme.border || 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
        }}
      >
        {/* Brand & Mini Profile Header */}
        <div className="p-5 pb-3">
          <Link to="/" onClick={scrollToTop} className="block cursor-pointer">
            <Logo size={40} subtitle="Beyond Social" />
          </Link>

          {/* User Mini Profile Badge with iridescent border */}
          {user && (
            <Link
              to={`/profile/${user._id}`}
              className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.03] p-2.5 transition-all hover:bg-white/[0.07] hover:border-white/20 group cursor-pointer"
            >
              <div
                className="rounded-full p-[2px] transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105"
                style={{

              >

              </div>

              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 leading-tight">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">

              </div>

          )}

          {/* Gamification Level 8 Card */}
          {user && (
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-black/40 p-3 shadow-inner">

            <Link

              >
                {isActive('/reels') ? <IoVideocam /> : <IoVideocamOutline />}

              <span className="text-[10px] font-medium tracking-tight mt-0.5">Reels</span>

            {/* 5. Profile */}
            <Link
              to={user ? `/profile/${user._id}` : '/login'}

              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-medium tracking-tight mt-0.5">Profile</span>
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </nav>
    </>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/live/LiveOverlay.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import socket from '../../services/socket';

export default function LiveOverlay({ roomId }) {
  const [comments, setComments] = useState([]);
  const [reaction, setReaction] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onComment = (c) => setComments(s => [...s.slice(-80), c]);
    const onReaction = (r) => { setReaction(r.reaction); setTimeout(()=>setReaction(null), 2200); };

    socket.on('live:comment', onComment);
    socket.on('live:reaction', onReaction);
    return () => { socket.off('live:comment', onComment); socket.off('live:reaction', onReaction); };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none">
      <div className="absolute left-4 bottom-20 flex flex-col gap-2 max-w-xs">
        {comments.slice().reverse().map(c => (
          <div key={c.id} className="bg-black/60 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-sm backdrop-blur-sm">
            <b className="mr-2">{c.from?.name||'anon'}</b>{c.message}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {reaction && (
        <div className="absolute right-6 top-8 text-4xl animate-pop">
          {reaction}
        </div>
      )}

      <style>{`.animate-pop{ animation: pop .6s ease } @keyframes pop { from{ transform: scale(.4); opacity:0 } to{ transform:scale(1); opacity:1 } }`}</style>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/posts/CommentsModal.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from "react";
import API from "../../services/api";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import { useToast } from "../ui/ToastProvider";
import socket from '../../services/socket';
import UserAvatar from "../ui/UserAvatar";
import { FaTrash, FaHeart, FaRegHeart, FaTimes, FaReply } from "react-icons/fa";
import { useSelector } from "react-redux"; 
import { getImageUrl } from "../../utils/imageUtils"; 
import AudioRecorder from "../chat/AudioRecorder"; 
import { playSound } from "../../utils/soundEffects";

const QUICK_EMOJIS = ['❤️', '🔥', '👏', '✨', '💎', '🙌', '💯', '😍', '🚀'];

const CommentsModal = ({ postId, isOpen, onClose }) => {
    const [post, setPost] = useState(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [content, setContent] = useState("");
    const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
    const [audioFile, setAudioFile] = useState(null);

    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);

    const inputRef = useRef(null);
    const { add } = useToast();
    const myId = useSelector(s => s.auth.user?._id);

    // Socket Logic
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!postId) return;
        socket.emit('joinRoom', { room: `post:${postId}` });
        
        const onNewComment = (newComment) => {
            if (newComment.user?._id === myId || newComment.user === myId) {
                return;
            }

            if (newComment.post === postId || (post && post._id === postId)) {
                setPost(prev => ({
                    ...prev,
                    comments: [newComment, ...(prev?.comments || [])],
                }));
            }
        };
        
        const onDeleteComment = ({ commentId }) => {
            setPost(prev => ({
                ...prev,
                comments: (prev?.comments || []).filter(c => c._id !== commentId)
            }));
        };

        socket.on('comment:created', onNewComment);
        socket.on('comment:deleted', onDeleteComment); 

        return () => {
            socket.off('comment:created', onNewComment);
            socket.off('comment:deleted', onDeleteComment);
        };
    }, [postId, post, myId]); 

    const loadComments = async (isReset = false) => {
        const p = isReset ? 0 : page;
        if (isReset) setLoading(true);

        try {
            const res = await API.get(`/comments/${postId}?page=${p}`);
            const payload = res.data?.data || res.data;
            const newComments = Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : [];
            
            if (newComments.length < 20) setHasMore(false);
            
            if (isReset) {
                setPost(prev => ({ ...prev, comments: newComments }));
            } else {
                setPost(prev => ({
                    ...prev,
                    comments: [...(prev?.comments || []), ...newComments]
                }));
            }
            setPage(p + 1);
        } catch(e) {
            if (isReset) {
                try {
                    const r = await API.get(`/posts/${postId}`);
                    const postPayload = r.data?.data || r.data;
                    setPost(postPayload);
                    setHasMore(false); 
                } catch (err) { onClose(); }
            }
        } finally {
            if (isReset) setLoading(false);
        }
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        if (isOpen && postId) {
            setPage(0);
            setHasMore(true);
            loadComments(true);
        }
    }, [isOpen, postId]);

    const submit = async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!content.trim() && !audioFile) return;

        setSending(true);
        playSound('cyber');

        try {
            let audioUrl = null;

            if (audioFile) {
                const fd = new FormData();
                fd.append('media', audioFile); 
                const upRes = await API.post('/extra/upload', fd);
                audioUrl = upRes.data?.url || upRes.data?.data?.url;
            }

            const res = await API.post(`/comments/${postId}`, { 
                text: content, 
                audio: audioUrl 
            });

            const createdComment = res.data?.data || res.data;

            setPost(prev => ({
                ...prev,
                comments: [createdComment, ...(prev?.comments || [])]
            }));

            setContent("");
            setAudioFile(null);

        } catch (err) {
            add("Failed to comment", { type: "error" });
            console.error(err);
        } finally {
            setSending(false);
        }
    };

    const deleteComment = async (commentId) => {
        if(!window.confirm("Delete comment?")) return;
        try {
            await API.delete(`/comments/${commentId}`);
            setPost(prev => ({
                ...prev,
                comments: (prev?.comments || []).filter(c => c._id !== commentId)
            }));
            add("Comment deleted", { type: "info" });
        } catch(e) {
            add("Failed to delete", { type: "error" });
        }
    };

    const toggleCommentLike = async (commentId, likesArray) => {
        playSound('pop');
        setPost(prev => ({
            ...prev,
            comments: (prev?.comments || []).map(c => {
                if (c._id === commentId) {
                    const isLiked = c.likes?.includes(myId);
                    return {
                        ...c,
                        likes: isLiked 
                            ? c.likes.filter(id => id !== myId)
                            : [...(c.likes || []), myId]
                    };
                }
                return c;
            })
        }));

        try {
            await API.post(`/comments/like/${commentId}`);
        } catch (e) { }
    };

    const handleReplyTo = (username) => {
        if (!username) return;
        setContent(prev => `@${username} ${prev.replace(/@\w+\s?/, '')}`);
        if (inputRef.current) {
            inputRef.current.focus();
        }
    };

    const handleInsertEmoji = (emoji) => {
        playSound('pop');
        setContent(prev => prev + emoji);
        if (inputRef.current) {
            inputRef.current.focus();
        }
    };

    if (!isOpen) return null;

    return (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-2xl animate-fade-in">
            <motion.div 
              initial={{ y: 25, opacity: 0, scale: 0.98 }} 
              animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} 
              exit={{ y: 25, opacity: 0, scale: 0.98 }}
              className="w-full max-w-lg bg-[#070B14]/95 border border-white/15 rounded-[32px] flex flex-col max-h-[85vh] shadow-[0_25px_80px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9)] overflow-hidden backdrop-blur-3xl"
            >
                {/* Header */}
                <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-white/10 flex justify-between items-center bg-[#0A111E]/80 backdrop-blur-md">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-[#00F2FE] animate-pulse" />
                        <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-wide font-display">Community Dialogue</h3>
                    </div>
                    <button 
                      onClick={onClose} 
                      className="p-1.5 rounded-full text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F7F7FC] hover:bg-white/10 transition"
                    >
                      <FaTimes size={15} />
                    </button>
                </div>

                {/* Comments List */}
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 md:p-5 space-y-4">
                    {loading && <div className="text-center py-8 text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] animate-pulse">Loading dialogue matrix...</div>}
                    
                    {!loading && (!post?.comments || post.comments.length === 0) && (
                        <div className="text-[#A5A9BB] text-center py-16 text-xs flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
                            <span className="text-3xl mb-2">💬</span>
                            <span>No comments yet. Start the conversation!</span>
                        </div>
                    )}
                    
                    {(post?.comments || []).map((c) => {
                        const isLiked = c.likes?.includes(myId);
                        const isOwner = String(c.user?._id) === String(myId) || String(post?.user?._id) === String(myId);
                        
                        return (
                            <div key={c._id} className="flex gap-3 group">
                                <UserAvatar 
                                  src={c.user?.avatar} 
                                  name={c.user?.name} 
                                  userId={c.user?._id} 
                                  className="w-8 h-8 flex-shrink-0 border border-white/15" 
                                />
                                <div className="flex-1">
                                    <div className="bg-[#0A111E]/90 border border-white/10 p-3.5 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-none relative pr-8 transition-colors hover:border-white/20">
                                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-1">
                                            <span className="font-bold text-xs text-[#F7F7FC]">{c.user?.name}</span>
                                            <button
                                                onClick={() => handleReplyTo(c.user?.username || c.user?.name)}
                                                className="text-[10px] text-[#00F2FE] hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition"
                                            >
                                                <FaReply size={9} /> Reply
                                            </button>
                                        </div>
                                        
                                        {/* Display Text */}
                                        {c.text && <div className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] leading-relaxed break-words">{c.text}</div>}
                                        
                                        {/* Display Audio Note */}
                                        {c.audio && (
                                            <div className="mt-2">
                                                <audio controls src={getImageUrl(c.audio)} className="w-full h-8 rounded-lg" />
                                            </div>
                                        )}
                                        
                                        {/* Like Button */}
                                        <button 
                                            onClick={() => toggleCommentLike(c._id, c.likes)}
                                            className="absolute bottom-2.5 right-3 text-xs flex items-center gap-1 transition active:scale-125"
                                        >
                                            {isLiked ? (
                                                <FaHeart className="text-[#10B981]" />
                                            ) : (
                                                <FaRegHeart className="text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#10B981]" />
                                            )}
                                            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#A5A9BB] font-mono">{c.likes?.length || 0}</span>
                                        </button>

                                        {/* Delete Button for Author */}
                                        {isOwner && (
                                            <button 
                                                onClick={() => deleteComment(c._id)}
                                                className="absolute top-2.5 right-2.5 text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F87171] opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition p-1 hover:bg-[#052E24]/20 rounded"
                                                title="Delete comment"
                                            >
                                                <FaTrash size={10} />
                                            </button>
                                        )}
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="text-[10px] text-[#A5A9BB] mt-1 ml-1 font-mono">
                                        {new Date(c.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit' })}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        );
                    })}

                    {/* Load More Button */}
                    {!loading && hasMore && (post?.comments?.length > 0) && (
                        <button 
                            onClick={() => loadComments(false)}
                            className="w-full py-2.5 text-xs text-[#00F2FE] font-semibold hover:bg-white/5 transition rounded-xl border border-white/5"
                        >
                            Load earlier comments
                        </button>
                    )}
                </div>

                {/* Input & Quick Reactions Area */}
                <div className="p-3.5 border-t border-white/10 bg-[#070B14]">
                    {/* Quick Emojis Strip */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mb-2 px-1 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
                        {QUICK_EMOJIS.map((emoji) => (
                            <button
                                key={emoji}
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleInsertEmoji(emoji)}
                                className="text-sm px-1.5 py-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition hover:scale-125 active:scale-95"
                            >
                                {emoji}
                            </button>
                        ))}
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        {audioFile ? (
                           <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-[#0F766E]/20 text-[#00F2FE] rounded-full border border-[#0F766E]/30 text-xs font-bold animate-pulse whitespace-nowrap">
                               <span>🎵 Audio Note Ready</span>
                                <button 
                                   type="button"
                                   onClick={() => setAudioFile(null)} 
                                   className="text-[#F87171] hover:opacity-80 ml-1 p-0.5"
                               >
                                   <FaTimes size={10} />
                               </button>
                           </div>
                        ) : (
                           <AudioRecorder 
                               chatId="comment_temp"
                               onFileReady={(file) => setAudioFile(file)} 
                           />
                        )}

                        <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex-1 flex gap-2">
                            <input 
                                ref={inputRef}
                                value={content} 
                                onChange={(e) => setContent(e.target.value)} 
                                placeholder={audioFile ? "Add caption (optional)..." : "Write a comment..."}
                                className="flex-1 bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/15 rounded-full px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE] transition" 
                            />
                            <button 
                              type="submit"
                              disabled={sending || (!content.trim() && !audioFile)} 
                              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white font-bold text-xs disabled:opacity-40 transition hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-md"
                            >
                              Post
                            </button>
                        </form>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </motion.div>
        </div>
    );
};

export default CommentsModal;
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/posts/CreatePost.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux';
import { fetchFeed } from '../../redux/slices/postSlice';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

const CreatePost = () => {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const [content, setContent] = useState('');
  const [media, setMedia] = useState([]);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);

  const handleFiles = (e) => {
    setMedia(Array.from(e.target.files || []));
  };

  const submit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!content.trim() && media.length === 0) {
      alert('Write something or add media');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setSending(true);

      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('content', content);
      media.forEach((m) => fd.append('media', m));

      await API.post('/posts', fd, {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
      });

      setContent('');
      setMedia([]);
      dispatch(fetchFeed());
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('create post err', err);
      alert(err.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to create post');
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <motion.div
      className="mb-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#070B14]/85 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] p-4 shadow-silverGlass text-[#F8FAFC]"
      initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
    >
      <form onSubmit={submit}>
        <textarea
          value={content}
          onChange={(e) => setContent(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Share a moment with the world…"
          className="mb-3 w-full resize-none rounded-xl bg-[#04070D] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)] p-3 text-sm text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00F2FE] transition-all"
          rows={3}
        />
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <label className="cursor-pointer rounded-xl bg-white/[0.06] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)] px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1] hover:text-[#00F2FE] transition-colors">
            Add media
            <input
              onChange={handleFiles}
              type="file"
              accept="image/*,video/*"
              multiple
              className="hidden"
            />
          </label>

          <div className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/60 font-mono">{media.length} files selected</div>

          <button
            disabled={sending}
            className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#2563EB] to-[#00F2FE] px-5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-sapphireGlow disabled:opacity-50 transition-all hover:opacity-95"
          >
            {sending ? 'Posting...' : 'Post'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

export default CreatePost;
```

```jsx
        <div
          onClick={() => handleAction('post')}
          className="relative flex-1 flex items-center justify-between rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.04] px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/70 transition-all hover:bg-white/[0.08] hover:border-white/20 hover:text-white cursor-pointer shadow-inner"
        >
          <span className="font-medium truncate">What's on your mind, {displayName}?</span>
          <IoImageOutline size={18} className="text-[#38BDF8] shrink-0 ml-2 opacity-80 group-hover:opacity-100" />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Action Buttons Row */}
      <div className="mt-3.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-1 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pt-2 border-t border-white/10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-2 shrink-0">
          {/* Photo */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleAction('photo')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1] transition-all hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
          >
            <IoImageOutline className="text-sm text-[#10B981]" />
            <span>Photo</span>
          </button>

          {/* Video */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleAction('video')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1] transition-all hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
          >
            <IoVideocamOutline className="text-sm text-[#8B5CF6]" />
            <span>Video</span>
          </button>

          {/* Reel */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleAction('reel')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1] transition-all hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
          >
            <IoFilmOutline className="text-sm text-[#EC4899]" />
            <span>Reel</span>
          </button>

          {/* Live */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleAction('live')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1] transition-all hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
          >
            <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2">
              <span className="absolute inline-flex h-full w-full animate-ping rounded-full bg-[#EF4444] opacity-75" />
              <span className="relative inline-flex h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-[#EF4444]" />
            </span>
            <IoRadioOutline className="text-sm text-[#EF4444]" />
            <span>Live</span>
          </button>

          {/* Poll */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleAction('poll')}
            className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1] transition-all hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
          >
            <IoBarChartOutline className="text-sm text-[#F59E0B]" />
            <span>Poll</span>
          </button>

          {/* Feeling */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleAction('feeling')}
            className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1] transition-all hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
          >
            <IoHappyOutline className="text-sm text-[#FBBF24]" />
            <span>Feeling</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Right Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          {/* AI Post Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleAction('ai')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.2)] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8]/30 via-[#8B0018]/25 to-[#00F2FE]/20 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-sm hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
            style={{
              boxShadow: `0 0 15px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
            }}
          >
            <IoSparkles className="text-xs text-[#F4D49A] animate-pulse" />
            <span className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#F8FAFC] via-[#F4D49A] to-[#00F2FE] bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              AI Post
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px]">✨</span>
          </button>

          {/* Submit Post Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleAction('post')}
            className="rounded-xl px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-md hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
            style={{
              background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${currentTheme.color}, ${currentTheme.accent})`,
              boxShadow: `0 0 15px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
            }}
          >
            Post
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
