```jsx
// frontend/src/components/profile/EditProfileModal.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import { FaCamera, FaTimes, FaSpinner } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux';
import { updateAuthUser } from '../../redux/slices/authSlice';

export default function EditProfileModal({ isOpen, onClose, user }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(user?.name || '');
  const [bio, setBio] = useState(user?.bio || '');
  const [location, setLocation] = useState(user?.location || '');
  
  const [avatar, setAvatar] = useState(null);
  const [cover, setCover] = useState(null); 
  
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const { add } = useToast();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleUpdate = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('name', name);
      fd.append('bio', bio);
      fd.append('location', location);
      if (avatar) fd.append('avatar', avatar);
      if (cover) fd.append('coverPhoto', cover); 

      const res = await API.put(`/users/${user._id}`, fd, {
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' }
      });

      const updatedUser = res.data?.data || res.data?.user || res.data;
      dispatch(updateAuthUser(updatedUser));
      add("Profile updated successfully!", { type: 'success' });
      onClose();
      window.location.reload(); 
    } catch (err) {
      add("Update failed", { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-[32px] overflow-hidden relative bg-[#070B14] backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_25px_80px_rgba(0,0,0,.85)]">
        
        {/* Cover Image Input */}
        <div className="h-40 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#052E24]/40 via-[#1D4ED8]/30 to-[#0F766E]/40 relative group">
            <img 
                src={cover ? URL.createObjectURL(cover) : (user.coverPhoto || user.coverImage || '/default-cover.jpg')} 
                className="w-full h-full object-cover opacity-75" 
                alt="cover"
            />
            <label className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 cursor-pointer transition">
                <FaCamera className="text-white text-2xl" />
                <input type="file" className="hidden" onChange={e => setCover(e.target.files[0])} accept="image/*" />
            </label>
            <button onClick={onClose} className="absolute top-3 right-3 text-[#CBD5E1] bg-black/60 hover:bg-black/80 rounded-full p-2 transition"><FaTimes size={12}/></button>
        </div>

        {/* Avatar Input */}
        <div className="px-6 relative">
            <div className="-mt-14 w-28 h-28 rounded-full border-4 border-[#070B14] overflow-hidden relative group bg-[#0A111E] shadow-xl">
                <img 
                    src={avatar ? URL.createObjectURL(avatar) : user.avatar} 
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover" 
                    alt="avatar"
                />
                <label className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 cursor-pointer transition">
                    <FaCamera className="text-white" />
                    <input type="file" className="hidden" onChange={e => setAvatar(e.target.files[0])} accept="image/*" />
                </label>
            </div>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleUpdate} className="p-6 space-y-4">
            <input value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 text-sm" placeholder="Name" />
            <input value={location} onChange={e => setLocation(e.target.value)} className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 text-sm" placeholder="Location" />
            <textarea value={bio} onChange={e => setBio(e.target.value)} className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 text-sm h-24 resize-none" placeholder="Bio" />
            
            <button disabled={loading} className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white font-bold tracking-wide shadow-lg shadow-blue-900/40 hover:opacity-90 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition">
                {loading ? <FaSpinner className="animate-spin" /> : 'Save Profile'}
            </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/profile/FollowButton.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';

const FollowButton = ({ userId, initialStatus, onChange }) => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isFollowing, setIsFollowing] = useState(false);
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialStatus !== undefined) {
      setIsFollowing(initialStatus);
    } else {
      checkStatus();
    }
  }, [userId, initialStatus]);

  const checkStatus = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await API.get(`/users/${userId}`);
      setIsFollowing(res.data.isFollowing);
    } catch (e) {
      // quiet fail
    }
  };

  const toggle = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if (loading) return;
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const r = await API.post(`/users/${userId}/follow`);
      const nowFollowing = r.data.following;
      setIsFollowing(nowFollowing);
      
      if (nowFollowing) {
        addToast("Followed user", { type: 'success' });
      } else {
        addToast("Unfollowed user", { type: 'info' });
      }

      if (onChange) onChange();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      addToast(err.userMessage || 'Action failed', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <button 
      onClick={toggle} 
      disabled={loading}
      className={`
        px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold tracking-wide transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm
        ${isFollowing 
          ? 'bg-[#0A111E] text-[#CBD5E1] border border-white/10 hover:border-[#052E24]/40 hover:bg-[#052E24]/20 hover:text-[#FF6B8A]' 
          : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white hover:opacity-90 shadow-md shadow-blue-900/30 border border-white/10'
        }
        ${loading ? 'opacity-70 cursor-wait' : ''}
      `}
    >
      {loading ? '...' : (isFollowing ? 'Following' : 'Follow')}
    </button>
  );
};

export default FollowButton;
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/profile/FollowRequestButton.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';

export default function FollowRequestButton({ userId, onChange }) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const r = await API.get(`/users/${userId}`);
        if (mounted) setStatus(r.data.isFollowing ? 'following' : (r.data.isMe ? 'me' : 'not_following'));
      } catch (e) {}
    })();
    return () => mounted = false;
  }, [userId]);

  const toggle = async () => {
    try {
      const r = await API.post(`/users/${userId}/follow`);
      setStatus(r.data.following ? 'following' : 'not_following');
      onChange && onChange();
    } catch (e) { alert('Failed'); }
  };

  return (
    <button onClick={toggle} className={`px-4 py-2 rounded ${status === 'following' ? 'bg-white border' : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'}`}>
      {status === 'me' ? 'You' : (status === 'following' ? 'Following' : 'Follow')}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileCompletion.jsx
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { FaUserPlus, FaMapMarkerAlt, FaLink, FaCheckCircle } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function ProfileCompletion({ user }) {
  const { score, missing } = useMemo(() => {
    if (!user) return { score: 0, missing: [] };

    let s = 20; // Base score for account creation
    const m = [];

    if (user.avatar) s += 20; 
    else m.push({ label: 'Add Avatar', icon: <FaUserPlus />, link: '/settings' });

    if (user.bio) s += 20; 
    else m.push({ label: 'Add Bio', icon: <FaUserPlus />, link: '/settings' });

    if (user.coverPhoto) s += 20;

    if (user.location) s += 10;
    else m.push({ label: 'Add Location', icon: <FaMapMarkerAlt />, link: '/settings' });

    if (user.socialLinks?.twitter || user.socialLinks?.instagram || user.website) s += 10;
    else m.push({ label: 'Add Socials', icon: <FaLink />, link: '/settings' });

    return { score: Math.min(s, 100), missing: m };
  }, [user]);

  if (!user || score >= 100) return null;

  return (
    <div className="bg-[#070B14] p-5 rounded-2xl mb-6 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] animate-fade-in backdrop-blur-xl">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
        <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-[#F7F7FC] flex items-center gap-2 font-serif">
          <FaCheckCircle className="text-[#00F2FE]" /> Complete your profile
        </h4>
        <span className="font-black text-lg text-[#F4D49A]">{score}%</span>
      </div>
      
      {/* Progress Bar */}
      <div className="h-2.5 w-full bg-[#0A111E] rounded-full overflow-hidden mb-4 border border-white/5 shadow-inner">
        <div 
            className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#0F766E] to-[#00F2FE] transition-all duration-1000 ease-out rounded-full" 
            style={{ width: `${score}%` }} 
        />
      </div>

      {/* Action Chips */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {missing.map((item, i) => (
          <Link 
            key={i} 
            to={item.link} 
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold bg-[#0A111E] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full shadow-sm hover:shadow-md text-[#CBD5E1] border border-white/10 transition hover:border-[#00F2FE]/40 hover:text-white"
          >
            <span className="text-[#D4AF37]">{item.icon}</span> {item.label}
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
    // Preview States
    const [previewAvatar, setPreviewAvatar] = useState(null);
    const [previewCover, setPreviewCover] = useState(null);
    
    const [deleteAvatar, setDeleteAvatar] = useState(false);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

    // Initialize Data
    useEffect(() => {
        if(user) {
            setForm({ 
                name: user.name || '', 
                bio: user.bio || '', 
                website: user.website || '',
                socialLinks: {
                    twitter: user.socialLinks?.twitter || '',
                    instagram: user.socialLinks?.instagram || '',
                    linkedin: user.socialLinks?.linkedin || ''
                }
            });
        }
        setAvatarFile(null);
        setCoverFile(null);
        setDeleteAvatar(false);
    }, [user, isOpen]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!avatarFile) {
            setPreviewAvatar(null);
            return;
        }
        const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(avatarFile);
        setPreviewAvatar(objectUrl);
        return () => URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
    }, [avatarFile]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!coverFile) {
            setPreviewCover(null);
            return;
        }
        const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(coverFile);
        setPreviewCover(objectUrl);
        return () => URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
    }, [coverFile]);

    if (!isOpen) return null;

    const handleFileChange = (e, type) => {
        const file = e.target.files?.[0];
        if (!file) return;

        if (type === 'avatar') {
            setAvatarFile(file);
            setDeleteAvatar(false);
        } else {
            setCoverFile(file);
        }
    };

    const handleDeleteAvatar = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault(); 
        e.stopPropagation(); 
        setAvatarFile(null);
        setDeleteAvatar(true); 
    };

    const sanitizeLink = (url) => {
        if (!url) return '';
        const trimmed = url.trim();
        if (trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://')) return trimmed;
        return `https://${trimmed}`;
    };

    const submit = async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (saving) return;

        setSaving(true);
        try {
            const fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('name', form.name);
            fd.append('bio', form.bio);
            
            fd.append('website', sanitizeLink(form.website));
            fd.append('socialLinks[twitter]', sanitizeLink(form.socialLinks.twitter));
            fd.append('socialLinks[instagram]', sanitizeLink(form.socialLinks.instagram));
            fd.append('socialLinks[linkedin]', sanitizeLink(form.socialLinks.linkedin));

            if (deleteAvatar) fd.append('deleteAvatar', 'true');

            if (avatarFile) {
                const compressed = await compressImage(avatarFile);
                fd.append('avatar', compressed);
            }
            if (coverFile) {
                const compressed = await compressImage(coverFile);
                fd.append('coverPhoto', compressed);
            }
            
            const targetId = user?._id || user?.id || localStorage.getItem('meId') || 'me';
            const res = await API.put(`/users/${targetId}`, fd, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } });
            
            addToast('Profile saved successfully!', { type: 'success' });
            
            const updatedUser = res.data?.data || res.data?.user || res.data;
            dispatch(setUser(updatedUser)); 
            
            if (onUpdate) {
                onUpdate(updatedUser);
            }
            if (onUpdated) {
                onUpdated(updatedUser);
            }
            onClose();
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('save profile err', err);
            addToast(err.userMessage || 'Failed to save profile', { type: 'error' });
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    };

    const handleSocialChange = (platform, value) => {
        setForm(prev => ({
            ...prev,
            socialLinks: { ...prev.socialLinks, [platform]: value }
        }));
    };

    return (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md">
            <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ scale: 1 }} className="w-full max-w-2xl bg-[#070B14] rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-[0_25px_80px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)] border border-white/10 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5 border-b border-white/10 pb-4">
                    <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] font-serif">Edit Profile</h3>
                    <button onClick={onClose} disabled={saving} className="text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:text-white p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-white/10 transition"><FaTimes /></button>
                </div>

                <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
                    {/* Basic Info */}
                    <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        <div>
                            <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CBD5E1]/70 mb-1.5 block">Display Name</label>
                            <input value={form.name} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,name:e.target.value})} className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 text-sm" />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CBD5E1]/70 mb-1.5 block">Website</label>
                            <input value={form.website} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,website:e.target.value})} className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 text-sm" placeholder="https://" />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div>
                        <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CBD5E1]/70 mb-1.5 block">Bio</label>
                        <textarea value={form.bio} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,bio:e.target.value})} className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 text-sm resize-none" rows={3} />
                    </div>

                    {/* Social Links Section */}
                    <div className="bg-[#0A111E]/80 border border-white/5 p-4 rounded-2xl space-y-3">
                        <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#D4AF37] mb-2 block">Social Channels</label>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <FaTwitter className="text-[#55E6FF]" />
                            <input value={form.socialLinks.twitter} onChange={e=>handleSocialChange('twitter', e.target.value)} placeholder="Twitter URL" className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#070B14] border border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/40" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <FaInstagram className="text-[#FF6B8A]" />
                            <input value={form.socialLinks.instagram} onChange={e=>handleSocialChange('instagram', e.target.value)} placeholder="Instagram URL" className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#070B14] border border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/40" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <FaLinkedin className="text-[#1D4ED8]" />
                            <input value={form.socialLinks.linkedin} onChange={e=>handleSocialChange('linkedin', e.target.value)} placeholder="LinkedIn URL" className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#070B14] border border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/40" />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* Media Uploads */}
                    <div className="flex gap-4 pt-2">
                        {/* Avatar */}
                        <label className="flex-1 cursor-pointer bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 p-3 rounded-2xl text-center relative overflow-hidden group h-28 flex flex-col items-center justify-center hover:border-white/20 transition">
                            <div className="font-semibold text-sm z-10 relative flex items-center gap-2 text-[#CBD5E1]"><FaCamera /> Avatar</div>
                            <input type="file" accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={(e) => handleFileChange(e, 'avatar')} />
                            
                            {(previewAvatar || (user?.avatar && !deleteAvatar)) && (
                                <>
                                    <img src={previewAvatar || user.avatar} className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover opacity-40 group-hover:opacity-20 transition" alt="preview" />
                                    <div className="absolute bottom-1.5 text-[10px] text-[#00F2FE] font-bold bg-[#04070D]/80 border border-white/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full z-20">
                                        {previewAvatar ? 'Selected' : 'Current'}
                                    </div>
                                    
                                    <button 
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={handleDeleteAvatar}
                                        className="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-[#052E24] text-white p-1.5 rounded-full z-30 hover:bg-[#10B981] shadow-md transition-transform active:scale-95"
                                        title="Remove Photo"
                                    >
                                        <FaTimes size={10} />
                                    </button>
                                </>
                            )}
                            
                            {deleteAvatar && (
                                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[#052E24]/30 flex items-center justify-center text-[#FF6B8A] text-xs font-bold">
                                    Removed
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </label>

                        {/* Cover */}
                        <label className="flex-1 cursor-pointer bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 p-3 rounded-2xl text-center relative overflow-hidden group h-28 flex flex-col items-center justify-center hover:border-white/20 transition">
                            <div className="font-semibold text-sm z-10 relative flex items-center gap-2 text-[#CBD5E1]"><FaCamera /> Cover</div>
                            <input type="file" accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={(e) => handleFileChange(e, 'cover')} />
                            {previewCover && (
                                <>
                                    <img src={previewCover} className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover opacity-40 group-hover:opacity-20 transition" alt="preview" />
                                    <div className="absolute bottom-1.5 text-[10px] text-[#00F2FE] font-bold bg-[#04070D]/80 border border-white/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full z-20">Selected</div>
                                </>
                            )}
                        </label>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-4 border-t border-white/10">
                        <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 text-[#CBD5E1] hover:bg-white/5 transition">Cancel</button>
                        <button disabled={saving} className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white font-bold hover:opacity-90 shadow-lg shadow-blue-900/30 transition">{saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Changes'}</button>
                    </div>
                </form>
            </motion.div>
        </div>
    );
};

export default ProfileEditModal;
```

```jsx
import React from 'react';
import { QrReader } from 'react-qr-reader';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

export default function ScanQR(){
  const nav = useNavigate();
  return (
    <div className="p-6 max-w-lg mx-auto">
      <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-3">Scan QR</h3>
      <QrReader
        constraints={{ facingMode: 'environment' }}
        onResult={(r) => {
          if (r?.text) {
            try {
              const url = new URL(r.text);
              window.location.href = url.href;
            } catch {}
          }
        }}
        style={{ width: '100%' }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import Lenis from '@studio-freight/lenis';

export const SmoothScroll = ({ children }) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    // Initialize the premium physics scroll
    const lenis = new Lenis({
      duration: 1.2, // Smooth, deliberate timing
      easing: (t) => Math.min(1, 1.001 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t)), // Cinematic ease-out
      direction: 'vertical',
      gestureDirection: 'vertical',
      smooth: true,
      smoothTouch: false, // Leave native touch scrolling for mobile
    });

    function raf(time) {
      lenis.raf(time);
      requestAnimationFrame(raf);
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(raf);

    return () => {
      lenis.destroy(); // Clean up when unmounted
    };
  }, []);

  return <>{children}</>;
};
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/spaces/AudioSpaceModal.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import socket from '../../services/socket';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import UserAvatar from '../ui/UserAvatar';
import {
  FaMicrophone,
  FaMicrophoneSlash,
  FaHandPaper,
  FaTimes,
  FaHeadphones,
  FaUsers,
  FaCrown,
  FaBroadcastTower,
} from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function AudioSpaceModal({ space, isOpen, onClose, onSpaceEnded }) {
  const currentUser = useSelector((s) => s.auth?.user);
  const myId = currentUser?._id;
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();

  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(false);
  const [hasRaisedHand, setHasRaisedHand] = useState(false);
  const [speakers, setSpeakers] = useState(space?.speakers || []);
  const [listeners, setListeners] = useState(space?.listeners || []);
  const [activeSpeakers, setActiveSpeakers] = useState({});

  const isHost = String(space?.host?._id || space?.host) === String(myId);
  const isSpeaker = speakers.some((s) => String(s._id || s) === String(myId));

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!space?._id || !isOpen) return;

    // Join room
    socket.emit('space:join', { spaceId: space._id, user: currentUser });

    const handleUserJoined = ({ user }) => {
      if (!user?._id) return;
      setListeners((prev) => {
        if (prev.some((p) => String(p._id) === String(user._id))) return prev;
        return [...prev, user];
      });
    };

    const handleUserLeft = ({ userId }) => {
      setListeners((prev) => prev.filter((p) => String(p._id || p) !== String(userId)));
      setSpeakers((prev) => prev.filter((p) => String(p._id || p) !== String(userId)));
    };

    const handleHandRaised = ({ user }) => {
      if (isHost && user) {
        addToast(`✋ ${user.name || 'A listener'} requested to speak`, { type: 'info' });
      }
    };

    const handleSpeakerPromoted = ({ targetUserId }) => {
      if (String(targetUserId) === String(myId)) {
        addToast('🎙️ You are now a speaker! Unmute to join the conversation.', { type: 'success' });
      }
    };

    const handleSpeaking = ({ userId, audioLevel }) => {
      setActiveSpeakers((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [userId]: audioLevel > 10,
      }));
    };

    socket.on('space:user-joined', handleUserJoined);
    socket.on('space:user-left', handleUserLeft);
    socket.on('space:hand-raised', handleHandRaised);
    socket.on('space:speaker-promoted', handleSpeakerPromoted);
    socket.on('space:speaking', handleSpeaking);

    // Simulate speaking audio level interval for host/speakers
    const micInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (isSpeaker && !isMuted) {
        const fakeLevel = Math.random() > 0.4 ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 80) + 20 : 0;
        socket.emit('space:speaking', { spaceId: space._id, userId: myId, audioLevel: fakeLevel });
      }
    }, 400);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(micInterval);
      socket.emit('space:leave', { spaceId: space._id, userId: myId });
      socket.off('space:user-joined', handleUserJoined);
      socket.off('space:user-left', handleUserLeft);
      socket.off('space:hand-raised', handleHandRaised);
      socket.off('space:speaker-promoted', handleSpeakerPromoted);
      socket.off('space:speaking', handleSpeaking);
    };
  }, [space?._id, isOpen, myId, isSpeaker, isMuted, isHost, currentUser, addToast]);

  const toggleMute = () => {
    setIsMuted((prev) => !prev);
    addToast(!isMuted ? 'Microphone muted' : 'Microphone unmuted', { type: 'info' });
  };

  const handleRaiseHand = () => {
    setHasRaisedHand(true);
    socket.emit('space:raise-hand', { spaceId: space._id, user: currentUser });
    addToast('✋ Hand raised! Waiting for host approval.', { type: 'info' });
  };

  const handlePromote = (user) => {
    if (!isHost) return;
    setSpeakers((prev) => [...prev, user]);
    setListeners((prev) => prev.filter((l) => String(l._id) !== String(user._id)));
    socket.emit('space:promote-speaker', { spaceId: space._id, targetUserId: user._id });
    addToast(`Promoted ${user.name} to speaker`, { type: 'success' });
  };

  const handleEndSpace = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm('Are you sure you want to end this space?')) return;
    try {
      await API.post(`/spaces/${space._id}/end`);
      addToast('Audio space ended', { type: 'info' });
      onSpaceEnded?.();
      onClose();
    } catch (_) {
      onClose();
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen || !space) return null;

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-xl">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ scale: 0.92, opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ scale: 0.92, opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          className="relative w-full max-w-2xl overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] bg-[#070B14]/95 border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.18)] shadow-[0_24px_80px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)] p-6 md:p-8 text-[#F8FAFC]"
        >
          {/* Ambient Lighting Layers */}
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-24 -right-24 h-56 w-56 rounded-full bg-[#1D4ED8]/20 blur-3xl" />
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-24 -left-24 h-56 w-56 rounded-full bg-[#052E24]/25 blur-3xl" />

          {/* Header */}
          <div className="relative z-10 flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] pb-4">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#10B981] mb-1">
                <span className="relative flex h-2.5 w-2.5">
                  <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-[#10B981] opacity-75" />
                  <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-[#052E24]" />
                </span>
                <span className="text-[#F4D49A]">Live Audio Space • {space.topic}</span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="font-display text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#F8FAFC]">
                {space.title}
              </h2>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.08] transition-colors"
            >
              <FaTimes size={18} />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Speakers Section */}
          <div className="relative z-10 my-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#D4AF37] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <FaCrown className="text-[#F4D49A]" /> Stage Speakers ({speakers.length})
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[#00F2FE] font-semibold bg-[#0F766E]/20 border border-[#0F766E]/40 px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(100,223,223,0.2)]">
                <FaBroadcastTower className="animate-pulse" />
                <span className="flex items-end gap-0.5 h-3">
                  <span className="w-0.5 h-full bg-[#00F2FE] animate-pulse" />
                  <span className="w-0.5 h-2 bg-[#00F2FE] animate-ping" />
                  <span className="w-0.5 h-3 bg-[#00F2FE] animate-pulse" />
                  <span className="w-0.5 h-1.5 bg-[#00F2FE] animate-bounce" />
                </span>
                <span>Live Spectrum</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              {speakers.map((spk) => {
                const spkId = String(spk._id || spk);
                const isSpeaking = activeSpeakers[spkId];
                return (
                  <div key={spkId} className="flex flex-col items-center text-center group">
                    <div className="relative mb-2">
                      <div
                        className={`rounded-full p-0.5 transition-all duration-300 ${
                          isSpeaking
                            ? 'ring-4 ring-[#00F2FE] shadow-[0_0_24px_rgba(100,223,223,0.8)]'
                            : 'ring-1 ring-[rgba(226,232,240,0.22)]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <UserAvatar user={spk} size="w-16 h-16" />
                      </div>
                      {String(space.host?._id || space.host) === spkId && (
                        <div className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] to-[#F4D49A] text-[#04070D] text-[10px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shadow-md">
                          Host
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {spkId === String(myId) && isMuted && (
                        <div className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 bg-[#052E24] text-white p-1 rounded-full text-[10px] shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(139,0,24,0.6)]">
                          <FaMicrophoneSlash />
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#F8FAFC] max-w-[80px] truncate">
                      {spk.name || 'Speaker'}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-[#CBD5E1]/60">
                      {isSpeaking ? (
                        <span className="text-[#00F2FE] font-bold">Speaking...</span>
                      ) : (
                        'Speaker'
                      )}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Listeners Section */}
          <div className="relative z-10 border-t border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] pt-4 mb-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CBD5E1]/80 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <FaHeadphones className="text-[#0F766E]" /> In the Audience ({listeners.length + 1})
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 max-h-24 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar">
              {listeners.map((lst) => (
                <div
                  key={String(lst._id || lst)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#04070D] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] shadow-sm"
                >
                  <UserAvatar user={lst} size="w-5 h-5" />
                  <span className="max-w-[70px] truncate">{lst.name || 'User'}</span>
                  {isHost && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handlePromote(lst)}
                      title="Invite to speak"
                      className="ml-1 text-[#00F2FE] hover:underline text-[10px] font-bold"
                    >
                      + Mic
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Bottom Action Controls Bar */}
          <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] pt-4">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-[14px] bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.12] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] text-[#CBD5E1] text-xs font-semibold transition-colors"
            >
              ✌️ Leave Quietly
            </button>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {isSpeaker ? (
                <button
                  onClick={toggleMute}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-[14px] text-xs font-bold transition shadow-lg ${
                    isMuted
                      ? 'bg-[#052E24]/25 text-red-300 border border-[#052E24]/60 hover:bg-[#052E24]/40'
                      : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#00F2FE] text-white shadow-[0_0_18px_rgba(100,223,223,0.4)] hover:opacity-95'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isMuted ? <FaMicrophoneSlash size={14} /> : <FaMicrophone size={14} />}
                  <span>{isMuted ? 'Unmute' : 'Mute Mic'}</span>
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button
                  onClick={handleRaiseHand}
                  disabled={hasRaisedHand}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-[14px] text-xs font-bold transition border ${
                    hasRaisedHand
                      ? 'bg-[#D4AF37]/25 text-[#F4D49A] border-[#D4AF37]/50 opacity-80'
                      : 'bg-white/[0.08] text-[#F8FAFC] border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.15)] hover:bg-white/[0.14]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <FaHandPaper className="text-[#D4AF37]" />
                  <span>{hasRaisedHand ? 'Hand Raised' : 'Raise Hand'}</span>
                </button>
              )}

              {isHost && (
                <button
                  onClick={handleEndSpace}
                  className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-[14px] bg-[#052E24] hover:bg-[#10B981] text-white text-xs font-bold transition shadow-lg shadow-[#052E24]/40"
                >
                  End Space
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/spaces/LiveSpacesBar.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import UserAvatar from '../ui/UserAvatar';
import AudioSpaceModal from './AudioSpaceModal';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import { FaBroadcastTower, FaPlus, FaHeadphones, FaTimes } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function LiveSpacesBar() {
  const [spaces, setSpaces] = useState([]);
  const [selectedSpace, setSelectedSpace] = useState(null);
  const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false);
  const [newTitle, setNewTitle] = useState('');
  const [newTopic, setNewTopic] = useState('');
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();

  const fetchSpaces = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await API.get('/spaces');
      if (res.data?.data) {
        setSpaces(res.data.data);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchSpaces();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchSpaces, 20000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const handleCreateSpace = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newTitle.trim()) {
      addToast('Please enter a space title', { type: 'error' });
      return;
    }
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      const res = await API.post('/spaces', {
        title: newTitle.trim(),
        topic: newTopic.trim() || 'Creator Talk',
      });
      const created = res.data?.data;
      if (created) {
        setSpaces((prev) => [created, ...prev]);
        setSelectedSpace(created);
        setShowCreateModal(false);
        setNewTitle('');
        setNewTopic('');
        addToast('🎙️ Live Space started!', { type: 'success' });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      addToast(err.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to start space', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mb-6">
      {/* Spaces Horizontal Row */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar py-2">
        {/* Create Space Action Button */}
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(true)}
          className="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-[18px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8]/25 via-[#052E24]/20 to-[#00F2FE]/20 border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.22)] text-[#F8FAFC] hover:border-[#00F2FE] shadow-silverGlass transition-all whitespace-nowrap text-xs font-bold shrink-0 group hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(100,223,223,0.3)]"
        >
          <div className="h-6 w-6 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#00F2FE] text-[#04070D] flex items-center justify-center text-xs group-hover:scale-110 transition shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(100,223,223,0.6)]">
            <FaPlus size={10} className="text-white" />
          </div>
          <span className="tracking-wide">Start Audio Space</span>
        </button>

        {/* Active Spaces List */}
        {spaces.map((sp) => (
          <motion.button
            key={sp._id}
            onClick={() => setSelectedSpace(sp)}
            whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }}
            whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}
            className="flex items-center gap-3 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-[20px] bg-[#070B14]/85 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] hover:border-[#00F2FE]/70 shadow-silverGlass transition-all shrink-0 max-w-xs text-left group"
          >
            {/* Host Avatar with animated kinetic story ring */}
            <div className="relative shrink-0">
              <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-full p-[2px] bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37] animate-pulse">
                <UserAvatar user={sp.host} size="w-full h-full" />
              </div>
              <span className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 flex h-3.5 w-3.5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#052E24] text-[8px] text-white shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(139,0,24,0.6)]">
                <FaBroadcastTower />
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="min-w-0 pr-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-[#10B981] uppercase tracking-wider">
                  <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#10B981] animate-ping" />
                  Live
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[#CBD5E1]/70 truncate">• {sp.topic}</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#F8FAFC] truncate max-w-[130px] group-hover:text-[#00F2FE] transition-colors">
                {sp.title}
              </p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-[#CBD5E1]/60">
                <FaHeadphones size={9} className="text-[#0F766E]" />
                <span>{(sp.listeners?.length || 0) + (sp.speakers?.length || 1)} listening</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </motion.button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Create Space Dialog Modal */}
      {showCreateModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md">
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
            className="w-full max-w-md rounded-[24px] bg-[#070B14] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.18)] p-6 text-[#F8FAFC] shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden"
          >
            {/* Ambient specular highlight */}
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-20 -right-20 h-40 w-40 rounded-full bg-[#1D4ED8]/25 blur-3xl" />
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-20 -left-20 h-40 w-40 rounded-full bg-[#052E24]/25 blur-3xl" />

            <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#00F2FE] text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(100,223,223,0.5)]">
                  <FaBroadcastTower />
                </div>
                <h3 className="font-display text-lg font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">Start a SocialVerse Space</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}
                className="text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:text-white transition-colors"
              >
                <FaTimes />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleCreateSpace} className="relative z-10 mt-4 space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1] mb-1">
                  Space Title
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="e.g. Late Night Tech & Creators Talk"
                  value={newTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTitle(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full rounded-[14px] bg-[#04070D] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.15)] px-4 py-3 text-sm text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00F2FE] transition-all"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1] mb-1">
                  Topic / Category
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. AI & Future, Music, Design"
                  value={newTopic}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTopic(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full rounded-[14px] bg-[#04070D] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.15)] px-4 py-3 text-sm text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00F2FE] transition-all"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-[14px] bg-white/[0.07] hover:bg-white/[0.12] text-xs font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1] transition-colors"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={creating}
                  className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-[14px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#2563EB] to-[#00F2FE] text-white text-xs font-bold hover:opacity-95 transition shadow-lg shadow-[#1D4ED8]/40 disabled:opacity-60"
                >
                  {creating ? 'Launching Space...' : 'Go Live Now'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Active Space Audio Room Modal */}
      {selectedSpace && (
        <AudioSpaceModal
          space={selectedSpace}
          isOpen={!!selectedSpace}
          onClose={() => setSelectedSpace(null)}
          onSpaceEnded={fetchSpaces}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
      _id: 'demo_u_sneha',
      name: 'Sneha',
      avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1524504388940-b1c1722653e1?auto=format&fit=crop&w=300&q=80',

    mediaUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1501785888041-af3ef285b470?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80',
  },
];

export default function Stories() {
  const [stories, setStories] = useState(DEMO_STORIES);
  const [editorFile, setEditorFile] = useState(null);

      if (loaded.length > 0) {
        setStories(loaded);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Fallback stays as DEMO_STORIES
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const handleFileSelect = (e) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      setEditorFile(e.target.files[0]);
    }
  };

  const userAvatar = user?.avatar || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=300&q=80';

  return (
    <>
      <div
        className="mb-6 rounded-[26px] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.14)] bg-[#070B14]/85 p-3.5 md:p-4 shadow-[0_16px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] backdrop-blur-2xl"
        style={{
          boxShadow: `0 16px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65), 0 0 25px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
          borderColor: currentTheme.border || 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)',
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar py-1">
          {/* 1. "Your Story" Bubble with + Badge */}
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 min-w-[68px] md:min-w-[72px] cursor-pointer group relative">
            <div
              className="relative h-[66px] w-[66px] md:h-[72px] md:w-[72px] rounded-full p-[2.5px] transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105"
              style={{
                boxShadow: `0 0 16px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
              }}
            >
              {/* Rotating Border Glow */}
              <motion.div
                animate={{ rotate: 360 }}
                transition={{ duration: 15, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' }}
                className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full"
                style={{
                  background: `conic-gradient(from 0deg, ${currentTheme.color}, ${currentTheme.accent}, #F4D49A, ${currentTheme.color})`,
                }}
              />

              <div className="relative h-full w-full rounded-full bg-[#04070D] p-[2px] overflow-hidden z-10">
                <img
                  src={getImageUrl(userAvatar)}
                  alt="Your story"
                  className="h-full w-full rounded-full object-cover"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Pink / Rose-Gold + Badge on Bottom Right */}
              <div
                className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 z-20 flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-[#04070D] shadow-md transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"
                style={{
                  background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #EC4899 0%, #F43F5E 100%)',
                }}
              >
                <IoAdd className="text-white text-xs font-bold" />
              </div>

              <input
                type="file"
                accept="image/*,video/*"
                className="absolute inset-0 opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-30"
                onChange={handleFileSelect}
                title="Add to Your Story"
              />
            </div>

            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-white tracking-tight truncate w-16 text-center">
              Your Story
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* 2. Friends Stories List */}
          {stories.map((story, i) => {
            const avatarUrl = getImageUrl(story.user?.avatar);
            const firstName = story.user?.name ? story.user.name.split(' ')[0] : 'Story';
            const ringGradient =
              i % 3 === 0
                ? `conic-gradient(from 0deg, ${currentTheme.color}, ${currentTheme.accent}, #F4D49A, ${currentTheme.color})`
                : i % 3 === 1
                ? `conic-gradient(from 0deg, #00F2FE, #38BDF8, ${currentTheme.color}, #00F2FE)`
                : `conic-gradient(from 0deg, #F43F5E, #EC4899, #D48C7B, #F43F5E)`;

            return (
              <motion.div
                key={story._id || i}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.8 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                transition={{ delay: i * 0.03 }}
                onClick={() => setViewIndex(i)}
                className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 min-w-[68px] md:min-w-[72px] cursor-pointer group"
              >
                <div
                  className="relative h-[66px] w-[66px] md:h-[72px] md:w-[72px] rounded-full p-[2.5px] transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105"
                  style={{
                    boxShadow: `0 0 16px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
                  }}
                >
                  {/* Rotating Gradient Ring */}
                  <motion.div
                    animate={{ rotate: 360 }}
                    transition={{ duration: 18 + i * 2, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' }}
                    className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full"
                    style={{ background: ringGradient }}
                  />

                  <div className="relative h-full w-full rounded-full bg-[#04070D] p-[2px] overflow-hidden z-10">
                    <img
                      src={avatarUrl}
                      alt={firstName}
                      className="h-full w-full rounded-full object-cover transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-[#CBD5E1] group-hover:text-white transition-colors truncate w-16 text-center">
                  {firstName}
                </span>
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}

          {/* 3. "More..." Bubble (Images 1 & 2) */}
          <div
            onClick={() => setViewIndex(0)}
            className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 min-w-[68px] md:min-w-[72px] cursor-pointer group"
          >
            <div className="relative h-[66px] w-[66px] md:h-[72px] md:w-[72px] rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/[0.04] p-[2px] flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300 group-hover:border-white/40 group-hover:scale-105 shadow-md">
              <IoEllipsisHorizontal className="text-xl text-[#CBD5E1] group-hover:text-white transition-colors" />
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-[#CBD5E1]/70 group-hover:text-white transition-colors">
              More
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Story Editor Modal */}
      {editorFile && (
        <StoryEditor
          file={editorFile}
          onClose={() => setEditorFile(null)}
          onPosted={() => {
            setEditorFile(null);
            load();
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Fullscreen Story Viewer */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {viewIndex !== null && (
          <StoryViewer
            stories={stories}
            initialIndex={viewIndex}
            onClose={() => setViewIndex(null)}
          />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/stories/StoryCreate.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import { FaStar } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function StoryCreate({ onCreated }) {
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  const [isCloseFriends, setIsCloseFriends] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const { add } = useToast();

  const submit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!file) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('media', file);
      fd.append('privacy', isCloseFriends ? 'close_friends' : 'public');
      
      await API.post('/stories', fd, { headers: { 'Content-Type':'multipart/form-data' } });
      add('Story posted', { type:'info' });
      setFile(null);
      setIsCloseFriends(false);
      onCreated && onCreated();
    } catch (err) {
      add(err.userMessage || 'Failed', { type:'error' });
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-4 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl bg-[#070B14] backdrop-blur-xl shadow-lg">
      
      {/* File Input */}
      <input 
        type="file" 
        accept="image/*,video/*" 
        onChange={e=>setFile(e.target.files[0])} 
        className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/70 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-full file:border file:border-white/10 file:text-xs file:font-semibold file:bg-[#1D4ED8]/20 file:text-[#00F2FE] hover:file:bg-[#1D4ED8]/30 transition"
      />

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
        {/* Close Friends Checkbox */}
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none">
            <input 
                type="checkbox" 
                checked={isCloseFriends} 
                onChange={(e) => setIsCloseFriends(e.target.checked)}
                className="w-4 h-4 accent-[#14B8A6] rounded"
            />
            <div className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold ${isCloseFriends ? 'text-[#14B8A6]' : 'text-[#CBD5E1]/70'}`}>
                <FaStar size={12} className={isCloseFriends ? 'text-[#14B8A6]' : 'text-[#CBD5E1]/40'} />
                Close Friends Only
            </div>
        </label>

        <button disabled={!file || busy} className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-md hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-40 transition">
            {busy ? 'Posting...' : 'Add Story'}
        </button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/stories/StoryEditor.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { FaTimes, FaPaperPlane, FaFont, FaPalette, FaStar } from 'react-icons/fa'; // 🔥 Added FaStar
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import { compressImage } from '../../utils/compressor';

const COLORS = ['#ffffff', '#000000', '#ff0055', '#00ccff', '#ffcc00'];

export default function StoryEditor({ file, onClose, onPosted }) {
  const [caption, setCaption] = useState('');
  const [color, setColor] = useState('#ffffff');
  const [isCloseFriends, setIsCloseFriends] = useState(false); // 🔥 NEW State
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const { add } = useToast();

  const previewUrl = file ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : null;
  const isVideo = file?.type.startsWith('video');

  const handlePost = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      
      let fileToSend = file;
      if (!isVideo) {
          try {
            fileToSend = await compressImage(file);
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn("Compression skipped", err);
          }
      }

      fd.append('media', fileToSend);
      fd.append('caption', caption);
      fd.append('color', color); 
      
      // 🔥 NEW: Send Privacy Flag
      if (isCloseFriends) {
        fd.append('privacy', 'close_friends');
      }

      await API.post('/stories', fd);
      add('Story added to your ring!', { type: 'success' });
      onPosted();
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      add('Failed to upload', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] bg-black flex flex-col">
      {/* Top Bar */}
      <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 flex justify-between items-center z-20">
        <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 bg-black/40 rounded-full text-white backdrop-blur-md">
          <FaTimes />
        </button>
        <div className="flex gap-4">
          <button className="p-2 bg-black/40 rounded-full text-white backdrop-blur-md"><FaFont /></button>
          <div className="flex gap-2 bg-black/40 p-1.5 rounded-full backdrop-blur-md">
            {COLORS.map(c => (
              <button 
                key={c} 
                onClick={() => setColor(c)} 
                className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-full border-2 ${color === c ? 'border-white' : 'border-transparent'}`}
                style={{ backgroundColor: c }}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Preview */}
      <div className="flex-1 relative flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-900">
        {isVideo ? (
          <video src={previewUrl} autoPlay loop className="w-full h-full object-contain" />
        ) : (
          <img src={previewUrl} className="w-full h-full object-contain" />
        )}
        
        <div className="absolute bottom-32 w-full px-8 text-center">
          <input 
            value={caption}
            onChange={e => setCaption(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Add a caption..."
            className="bg-black/50 text-white p-3 rounded-xl w-full text-center outline-none placeholder-gray-300 backdrop-blur-sm"
            style={{ color: color }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Footer */}
      <div className="p-6 bg-gradient-to-t from-black via-black/80 to-transparent absolute bottom-0 w-full flex justify-between items-center gap-4">
        
        {/* 🔥 NEW: Close Friends Toggle */}
        <button 
            onClick={() => setIsCloseFriends(!isCloseFriends)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-full font-bold text-sm transition-all ${isCloseFriends ? 'bg-green-500 text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(34,197,94,0.6)]' : 'bg-white/20 text-white'}`}
        >
            <FaStar /> {isCloseFriends ? 'Close Friends' : 'Everyone'}
        </button>

        <button 
          onClick={handlePost}
          disabled={loading}
          className="bg-white text-black px-6 py-3 rounded-full font-bold flex items-center gap-2 hover:scale-105 transition shadow-lg shadow-white/20"
        >
          {loading ? 'Posting...' : <><FaPaperPlane /> Share</>}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/components/stories/StoryViewer.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { FaTimes, FaPause, FaPlay, FaTrash, FaPaperPlane, FaEye } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { getImageUrl } from '../../utils/imageUtils';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { playSound } from '../../utils/soundEffects';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';

const QUICK_EMOJIS = ['❤️', '🔥', '👏', '😂', '😍', '💎', '✨'];

export default function StoryViewer({ stories, initialIndex = 0, onClose, onDelete }) {
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(initialIndex);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const [replyText, setReplyText] = useState('');
  const [sendingReply, setSendingReply] = useState(false);
  const [flyingReactions, setFlyingReactions] = useState([]);
  const [showViewers, setShowViewers] = useState(false);
  const [viewersList, setViewersList] = useState([]);
  const [loadingViewers, setLoadingViewers] = useState(false);

  const viewedStoriesRef = useRef(new Set());
  const videoRef = useRef(null);
  const { add } = useToast();
  const myId = useSelector((s) => s.auth.user?._id);

  const activeStory = stories[current];
  const IMAGE_DURATION = 5000; // 5 seconds per image

  const handleOpenViewers = async () => {
    setPaused(true);
    setShowViewers(true);
    setLoadingViewers(true);
    playSound('cyber');
    try {
      const res = await API.get(`/stories/${activeStory._id}/viewers`);
      setViewersList(res.data?.viewers || []);
    } catch (_) {
      setViewersList([]);
    } finally {
      setLoadingViewers(false);
    }
  };

  // Mark active story viewed in backend
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeStory?._id) return;
    if (viewedStoriesRef.current.has(activeStory._id)) return;

    viewedStoriesRef.current.add(activeStory._id);
    API.post(`/stories/${activeStory._id}/view`).catch(() => {});
  }, [activeStory]);

  // Reset progress when current story changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setProgress(0);
    setPaused(false);
  }, [current]);

  const next = useCallback(() => {
    if (current < stories.length - 1) {
      setCurrent((c) => c + 1);
    } else {
      onClose();
    }
  }, [current, stories.length, onClose]);

  const prev = useCallback(() => {
    if (current > 0) {
      setCurrent((c) => c - 1);
    }
  }, [current]);

  // Image Timer Logic
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeStory || paused) return;

    const isVideo =
      activeStory.type === 'video' ||
      (activeStory.media && activeStory.media.match(/\.(mp4|webm)$/i));

    if (isVideo) {
      if (videoRef.current && videoRef.current.paused) {
        videoRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
      }
      return;
    }

    let animationFrame;
    let startTime;

    const tick = (timestamp) => {
      if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
      if (paused) {
        startTime = timestamp - (progress / 100) * IMAGE_DURATION;
        return requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      }

      const elapsed = timestamp - startTime;
      const pct = Math.min((elapsed / IMAGE_DURATION) * 100, 100);
      setProgress(pct);

      if (elapsed < IMAGE_DURATION) {
        animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        next();
      }
    };

    animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
  }, [current, paused, activeStory, progress, next]);

  const handleDelete = async (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setPaused(true);

    if (!window.confirm('Delete this story permanently?')) {
      setPaused(false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      await API.delete(`/stories/${activeStory._id}`);
      add('Story deleted', { type: 'success' });

      if (onDelete) {
        onDelete(activeStory._id);
      }

      if (stories.length <= 1) {
        onClose();
      } else if (current >= stories.length - 1) {
        setCurrent((c) => Math.max(0, c - 1));
      }
    } catch (_) {
      add('Failed to delete story', { type: 'error' });
      setPaused(false);
    }
  };

  const handleQuickReaction = async (emoji) => {
    playSound('pop');

    // Spawn floating emoji animation
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    setFlyingReactions((prev) => [...prev, { id, emoji, left: 30 + Math.random() * 40 }]);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFlyingReactions((prev) => prev.filter((r) => r.id !== id));
    }, 1500);

    try {
      await API.post(`/stories/${activeStory._id}/react`, { emoji });
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  const handleSendReply = async (e) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    if (!replyText.trim() || sendingReply) return;

    setSendingReply(true);
    playSound('cyber');

    try {
      await API.post(`/stories/${activeStory._id}/reply`, { text: replyText.trim() });
      add(`Reply sent to ${activeStory.user?.name || 'creator'}!`, { type: 'success' });
      setReplyText('');
      setPaused(false);
    } catch (err) {
      add(err.response?.data?.message || 'Could not send reply', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setSendingReply(false);
    }
  };

  const handleVideoUpdate = () => {
    if (videoRef.current && videoRef.current.duration) {
      const pct = (videoRef.current.currentTime / videoRef.current.duration) * 100;
      setProgress(pct);
    }
  };

  const handleVideoEnded = () => {
    next();
  };

  if (!activeStory) return null;

  const mediaUrl = getImageUrl(activeStory.media, 'story');
  const userAvatar = getImageUrl(activeStory.user?.avatar, 'avatar');
  const isVideo =
    activeStory.type === 'video' ||
    (activeStory.media && activeStory.media.match(/\.(mp4|webm)$/i));
  const isMine = String(activeStory.user?._id || activeStory.user || '') === String(myId || '');

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] bg-[#04070D]/95 backdrop-blur-2xl flex items-center justify-center p-0 md:p-6 animate-fade-in">
      <div className="relative w-full h-full md:max-w-[420px] md:h-[90vh] md:rounded-[32px] overflow-hidden bg-[#070B14] border border-white/15 shadow-[0_25px_80px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9)] flex flex-col justify-between">
        
        {/* Progress Bars */}
        <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 right-3 z-30 flex gap-1.5 pointer-events-none">
          {stories.map((_, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} className="h-1 flex-1 bg-white/20 rounded-full overflow-hidden backdrop-blur-sm">
              <div
                className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#00F2FE] transition-all ease-linear duration-75"
                style={{
                  width: idx < current ? '100%' : idx === current ? `${progress}%` : '0%',
                }}
              />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="absolute top-6 left-4 right-4 z-30 flex items-center justify-between pointer-events-auto">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-0.5 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#00F2FE]">
              <img
                src={userAvatar}
                className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full object-cover border border-[#04070D]"
                alt="user"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-white font-bold text-xs drop-shadow-md flex items-center gap-1.5">
                {activeStory.user?.name || 'Creator'}
                {isMine && (
                  <span className="text-[9px] uppercase px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-[#052E24]/50 border border-[#052E24] text-[#F4D49A]">
                    You
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <span className="text-white/60 text-[10px] drop-shadow font-mono">
                {new Date(activeStory.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {/* Pause / Resume Button */}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setPaused(!paused);
                if (videoRef.current) {
                  paused ? videoRef.current.play() : videoRef.current.pause();
                }
              }}
              className="text-white/80 hover:text-white p-2 rounded-full bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 transition"
              title={paused ? 'Resume' : 'Pause'}
            >
              {paused ? <FaPlay size={12} /> : <FaPause size={12} />}
            </button>

            {/* Delete Button (Owner Only) */}
            {isMine && (
              <button
                onClick={handleDelete}
                className="text-white/80 hover:text-[#F87171] p-2 rounded-full bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 transition hover:bg-[#052E24]/40"
                title="Delete Story"
              >
                <FaTrash size={12} />
              </button>
            )}

            {/* Close Button */}
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="text-white/80 hover:text-white p-2 rounded-full bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 transition hover:bg-white/10"
              title="Close"
            >
              <FaTimes size={15} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Floating Flying Emoji Particle Layer */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none z-40 overflow-hidden">
          {flyingReactions.map((r) => (
            <div
              key={r.id}
              className="absolute text-4xl animate-fly-up"
              style={{
                left: `${r.left}%`,
                bottom: '120px',
              }}
            >
              {r.emoji}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Tap Navigation Zones (Left / Right / Center) */}
        <div
          className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-1/4 z-20 cursor-pointer"
          onClick={prev}
        />
        <div
          className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 w-1/4 z-20 cursor-pointer"
          onClick={next}
        />
        <div
          className="absolute inset-y-0 left-1/4 w-1/2 z-10 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer"
          onClick={() => {
            setPaused(!paused);
            if (videoRef.current) {
              paused ? videoRef.current.play() : videoRef.current.pause();
            }
          }}
        >
          {paused && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-full bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-white/90 animate-pulse">
              <FaPause size={28} />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Media Canvas */}
        <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-black relative">
          {isVideo ? (
            <video
              ref={videoRef}
              src={mediaUrl}
              autoPlay
              playsInline
              onTimeUpdate={handleVideoUpdate}
              onEnded={handleVideoEnded}
              className="w-full h-full object-cover"
            />
          ) : (
            <img src={mediaUrl} className="w-full h-full object-cover" alt="story" />
          )}

          {/* Caption Overlay */}
          {activeStory.caption && (
            <div className="absolute bottom-28 left-4 right-4 z-30 pointer-events-none text-center">
              <span
                className="inline-block px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl text-white text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/15 shadow-2xl"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: activeStory.color ? activeStory.color + '90' : 'rgba(14,5,8,0.75)',
                }}
              >
                {activeStory.caption}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer Interaction Bar (Reactions & DM Reply) */}
        <div className="relative z-30 p-3 pb-4 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#04070D] via-[#04070D]/85 to-transparent">
          {/* Quick Reaction Pills */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2 px-1">
            {QUICK_EMOJIS.map((emoji) => (
              <button
                key={emoji}
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handleQuickReaction(emoji);
                }}
                className="text-lg p-1.5 rounded-full hover:scale-125 transition-transform active:scale-95 hover:bg-white/10"
                title={`React ${emoji}`}
              >
                {emoji}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Reply Form (Viewer) or Analytics (Author) */}
          {isMine ? (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 pt-1 pb-1">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleOpenViewers}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-[#00F2FE] text-xs font-bold transition border border-white/10 shadow-md backdrop-blur-md active:scale-95"
              >
                <FaEye size={12} /> Viewers ({activeStory.viewersCount || activeStory.viewers?.length || 0})
              </button>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-white/60 font-mono tracking-wider uppercase">
                {activeStory.privacy === 'close_friends' ? '★ Close Friends' : 'Public Broadcast'}
              </span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <form
              onSubmit={handleSendReply}
              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
              className="flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <input
                type="text"
                value={replyText}
                onChange={(e) => setReplyText(e.target.value)}
                onFocus={() => setPaused(true)}
                onBlur={() => !replyText && setPaused(false)}
                placeholder={`Reply to ${activeStory.user?.name || 'story'}...`}
                className="flex-1 bg-black/60 border border-white/20 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-white/50 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE] backdrop-blur-md transition"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={sendingReply || !replyText.trim()}
                className="p-2.5 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white disabled:opacity-40 transition hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-md flex items-center justify-center"
              >
                <FaPaperPlane size={11} />
              </button>
            </form>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Viewers Drawer for Story Author */}
        <AnimatePresence>
          {showViewers && (
            <motion.div 
              initial={{ y: '100%' }}
              animate={{ y: 0 }}
              exit={{ y: '100%' }}
              transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 220 }}
              className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 max-h-[60%] bg-[#070B14]/95 border-t border-white/15 rounded-t-[32px] p-5 z-50 flex flex-col backdrop-blur-2xl shadow-2xl"
              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3 border-b border-white/10 pb-2.5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <FaEye className="text-[#00F2FE]" size={14} />
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-wide font-display">
                    Story Viewers ({viewersList.length})
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => { setShowViewers(false); setPaused(false); }}
                  className="p-1 rounded-full text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-white transition"
                >
                  <FaTimes size={13} />
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 pr-1 no-scrollbar">
                {loadingViewers && (
                  <div className="text-center py-6 text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] animate-pulse">Scanning viewers ledger...</div>
                )}
                {!loadingViewers && viewersList.length === 0 && (
                  <div className="text-center py-8 text-xs text-[#A5A9BB]">No viewers recorded yet.</div>
                )}
                {viewersList.map((viewer) => (
                  <div key={viewer._id} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/5">
                    <img 
                      src={getImageUrl(viewer.avatar, 'avatar')} 
                      className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full object-cover border border-white/10" 
                      alt="" 
                    />
                    <div className="flex flex-col">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#F7F7FC]">{viewer.name}</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-[#A5A9BB]">@{viewer.username || viewer.name?.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '')}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
    </div>
  );
}
```
