// frontend/src/components/ui/LazyImage.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { FaImage } from 'react-icons/fa';

const ALLOWED_PROXY_HOSTS = ['res.cloudinary.com', 'images.unsplash.com', 'dl.dropboxusercontent.com']; 

function shouldProxy(url) {
  try {
    if (!url) return false;
    const u = new URL(url);
    return ALLOWED_PROXY_HOSTS.some(h => u.host.includes(h));
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

function proxiedUrl(url) {
  if (!url) return '';
  if (!shouldProxy(url)) return url;
  if (url.startsWith('/api/proxy/image')) return url;
  return `/api/proxy/image?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`;
}

const LazyImage = ({ src, alt = '', className = '', style = {}, placeholder, onClick = () => {} }) => {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const imgRef = useRef();

  useEffect(() => {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setVisible(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      });
    }, { rootMargin: '100px' });

    if (imgRef.current) observer.observe(imgRef.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const finalSrc = error ? '/fallback-image.png' : proxiedUrl(src);

  return (
    <div ref={imgRef} className={`relative overflow-hidden bg-[#070B14] ${className}`} style={style} onClick={onClick}>
      
      {/* Placeholder / Skeleton */}
      {(!loaded && !error) && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-[#CBD5E1]/30 animate-pulse bg-[#0A111E]">
            {placeholder || <FaImage className="opacity-30 text-2xl" />}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Error State */}
      {error && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-[#070B14] text-[#CBD5E1]/40">
            <FaImage className="mb-1 opacity-50" />
            <span className="text-[10px]">Failed to load</span>
        </div>
      )}
      
      {/* Actual Image */}
      {visible && src && !error && (
        <img 
          src={finalSrc} 
          alt={alt} 
          onLoad={() => setLoaded(true)}
          onError={() => { setError(true); setLoaded(true); }}
          className={`w-full h-full object-cover transition-opacity duration-500 ${loaded ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default LazyImage;
```

// frontend/src/components/ui/LevelProgress.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaStar } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { useSocket } from '../../contexts/SocketContext';
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { updateAuthUser } from '../../redux/slices/authSlice';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';

export default function LevelProgress() {
  const { user } = useSelector(s => s.auth);
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const { socket } = useSocket();
  const [animate, setAnimate] = useState(false);

  const XP_THRESHOLDS = [0, 100, 300, 600, 1000, 1500, 2100, 2800, 3600, 5000];
  const nextLevelXP = XP_THRESHOLDS[user?.level || 1] || ((user?.level || 1) * 500);
  const prevLevelXP = XP_THRESHOLDS[(user?.level || 1) - 1] || 0;
  
  const progress = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, ((user?.xp - prevLevelXP) / (nextLevelXP - prevLevelXP)) * 100));

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!socket) return;

    const onXP = (data) => {
        dispatch(updateAuthUser({ xp: data.xp, level: data.level }));
        if (data.leveledUp) {
            setAnimate(true);
            confetti({ particleCount: 150, spread: 60 });
            setTimeout(() => setAnimate(false), 5000);
        }
    };

    socket.on('xp:update', onXP);
    return () => socket.off('xp:update', onXP);
  }, [socket, dispatch]);

  if (!user) return null;

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full max-w-[200px]">
      <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-bold text-[#CBD5E1]/70 mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wider">
        <span className={animate ? 'text-[#F4D49A] animate-bounce' : 'text-[#D4AF37]'}>
            Lvl {user.level}
        </span>
        <span className="text-[#CBD5E1]/50">{user.xp} / {nextLevelXP} XP</span>
      </div>
      
      <div className="h-2 w-full bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/5 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
        <motion.div 
            className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] via-[#F4D49A] to-[#00F2FE] relative"
            initial={{ width: 0 }}
            animate={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
            transition={{ duration: 1 }}
        >
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/20 w-full animate-[shimmer_2s_infinite]" />
        </motion.div>
      </div>

      {/* Level Up Popover */}
      {animate && (
        <motion.div 
            initial={{ scale: 0, opacity: 0 }} 
            animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} 
            exit={{ scale: 0 }}
            className="absolute top-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] to-[#F4D49A] text-black text-xs font-black px-3 py-1 rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-yellow-900/40 z-50 whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-1 border border-white/20"
        >
            <FaStar className="animate-spin" /> LEVEL UP!
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

// frontend/src/components/ui/Lightbox.jsx
import React, { useEffect } from "react";

const Lightbox = ({ images = [], open = false, index = 0, onClose = () => {} }) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('lightboxNext'));
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('lightboxPrev'));
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [open, onClose]);

  if (!open) return null;
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-60 flex items-center justify-center p-6">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/80" onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="relative max-w-4xl w-full">
        <img src={images[index]} alt={`img-${index}`} className="w-full h-[70vh] object-contain rounded" />
        <button aria-label="Close" className="absolute top-3 right-3 text-white" onClick={onClose}>✕</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Lightbox;

// frontend/src/components/ui/LinkPreviewCard.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';

export default function LinkPreviewCard({ text }) {
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState(null);
  const [url, setUrl] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Extract first URL from text
    const urlRegex = /(https?:\/\/[^\s]+)/g;
    const match = text.match(urlRegex);
    
    if (match && match[0]) {
      const foundUrl = match[0];
      setUrl(foundUrl);
      API.post('/posts/unfurl', { url: foundUrl })
         .then(res => {
             if (res.data.title) setMeta(res.data);
         })
         .catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [text]);

  if (!meta) return null;

  return (
    <a href={url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="block mt-2 mb-2 group">
      <div className="bg-[#070B14] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden hover:border-white/20 hover:shadow-xl transition-all">
        {meta.image && (
          <div className="h-32 w-full overflow-hidden">
             <img src={meta.image} alt="Preview" className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500" />
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="p-3.5">
          <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-[#F7F7FC] line-clamp-1 font-serif">{meta.title}</h4>

const NeonIcon = ({ icon, color = 'cyan', size = 'text-2xl', isActive = false, className = '' }) => {
  // Define color maps for shadows
  const colors = {
    cyan: { text: 'text-cyan-400', shadow: 'drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(0,255,242,0.8)]' },
    purple: { text: 'text-purple-500', shadow: 'drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(189,0,255,0.8)]' },
    pink: { text: 'text-pink-500', shadow: 'drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(255,0,153,0.8)]' },
    blue: { text: 'text-blue-500', shadow: 'drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(0,102,255,0.8)]' },
  };

  const selectedColor = colors[color] || colors.cyan;

  return (
    <motion.div
      className={`relative group ${size} ${className} z-10`}
      // Subtle 3D tilt effect on hover
      whileHover={{ 
        scale: 1.1, 
        rotateX: 10, 
        rotateY: -10,
        perspective: 1000,
        z: 50
      }}
      transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 400, damping: 10 }}
    >
      {/* The glowing icon element */}
      <div className={`
        transition-all duration-300

        ${isActive ? selectedColor.shadow : 'group-hover:drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(255,255,255,0.5)]'}
      `}>
        {icon}
      </div>
      
      {/* Optional: A faint reflection underneath */}
      {isActive && (
         <div className={`absolute -bottom-3 left-0 right-0 h-4 ${selectedColor.text} opacity-20 blur-md transform rotateX(180deg) scaleY(0.5)`}>
            {icon}
         </div>
      )}
    </motion.div>
  );
};

export default NeonIcon;

// frontend/src/components/ui/ReportModal.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from './ToastProvider';

export default function ReportModal({ isOpen, onClose, targetPostId, targetUserId }) {
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const { add } = useToast();

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!reason) return;
    try {
      await API.post('/report', {
        targetPost: targetPostId,
        targetUser: targetUserId,
        reason
      });
      add('Report submitted. Thank you for keeping our community safe.', { type: 'success' });
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      add('Failed to report', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 p-4 backdrop-blur-xl">
      <motion.div 
        initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }} 
        animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} 
        className="bg-[#070B14]/95 border border-white/15 rounded-3xl p-6 w-full max-w-sm shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl"
      >
        <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] mb-1">Report Content</h3>
        <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] mb-4">Select the primary reason for reporting this artifact:</p>

        <div className="space-y-2 mb-6">
          {['Spam or Scam', 'Hate Speech', 'Nudity/Sexual', 'Harassment', 'Misinformation'].map(r => (
            <button
              key={r}
              onClick={() => setReason(r)}
              className={`w-full text-left p-3 rounded-2xl border text-xs font-semibold transition ${
                reason === r 
                  ? 'border-[#10B981] bg-[#052E24]/25 text-[#F7F7FC] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(185,28,28,0.25)]' 
                  : 'border-white/10 bg-[#0A111E] text-[#CBD5E1] hover:border-white/20'
              }`}
            >
              {r}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <button 
            onClick={onClose} 
            className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-xs font-semibold text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F7F7FC] transition"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button 
            onClick={handleSubmit} 
            disabled={!reason} 
            className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#052E24] text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-md hover:bg-[#10B981] transition disabled:opacity-40"
          >
            Submit
          </button>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/ui/ThemeToggle.jsx
import React from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { useTheme } from '../../contexts/ThemeProvider';

export default function ThemeToggle({ className = '' }) {
  const { currentTheme, selectTheme, themes } = useTheme();

  const handleNextTheme = () => {
    const currentIndex = themes.findIndex((t) => t.id === currentTheme.id);
    const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % themes.length;
    selectTheme(themes[nextIndex].id);
  };

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={handleNextTheme}
      title={`Active Theme: ${currentTheme.name} (Click to cycle themes)`}
      className={`group relative flex h-9 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-full px-3.5 py-1 select-none border shadow-lg backdrop-blur-xl transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer ${className}`}
      style={{
        backgroundColor: currentTheme.bgSurface || 'rgba(10, 17, 30, 0.85)',
        borderColor: currentTheme.border || 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
        boxShadow: `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18), 0 0 20px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
      }}
    >
      {/* Dynamic Celestial Core */}
      <div className="relative flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center">
        {/* Pulsing Theme Aura */}
        <motion.div
          animate={{ scale: [1, 1.35, 1], opacity: [0.4, 0.9, 0.4], rotate: [0, 180, 360] }}
          transition={{ duration: 3.5, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
          className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full blur-[4px]"

      </div>

      <span className="font-display text-[9.5px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-white">
        {currentTheme.name}
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/ui/ToastProvider.jsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback } from "react";

const ToastContext = createContext();
export const useToast = () => useContext(ToastContext);

export const ToastProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);
  const add = useCallback((msg, opts = {}) => {
    const id = Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6);
    const toast = { id, msg, type: opts.type || "info", timeout: opts.timeout ?? 3500 };
    setToasts(t => [toast, ...t]);
    if (toast.timeout > 0) setTimeout(() => setToasts(t => t.filter(x => x.id !== id)), toast.timeout);
    return id;
  }, []);
  const remove = useCallback((id) => setToasts(t => t.filter(x => x.id !== id)), []);
  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={{ add, remove }}>
      {children}
      <div aria-live="polite" className="fixed right-6 bottom-6 z-50 flex flex-col gap-3 pointer-events-none">
        {toasts.map(t => {
          let style = "bg-[#070B14]/95 text-[#F8FAFC] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.18)] shadow-silverGlass";
          if (t.type === 'error') {
            style = "bg-[#052E24] text-white border border-red-500/40 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(139,0,24,0.6)]";
          } else if (t.type === 'success') {
            style = "bg-[#0F766E]/95 text-white border border-[#14B8A6]/40 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(15,118,110,0.6)]";
          }
          return (
            <div key={t.id} role="status" className={`pointer-events-auto max-w-sm px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl backdrop-blur-xl text-sm transition-all duration-300 ${style}`}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="font-medium">{t.msg}</div>
                <button onClick={() => remove(t.id)} aria-label="Dismiss" className="ml-3 opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">✕</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
};
```

import React from 'react';

import { useSocket } from '../../contexts/SocketContext';

const UserAvatar = ({ src, name, userId, className = "w-10 h-10", showStatus = true }) => {
  const { onlineUsers } = useSocket(); 

  const finalSrc = !src 
    ? '/default-avatar.svg' 
    : getImageUrl(src, 'avatar');
  
  const isOnline = userId && onlineUsers.has(userId);

  return (
    <div className="relative inline-block shrink-0">

        src={finalSrc}
        alt={name || "User"}
        className={`${className} rounded-full object-cover bg-[#04070D] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.18)] shadow-sm`}
        onError={(e) => {
          e.target.onerror = null; 
          e.target.src = '/default-avatar.svg'; 
        }} 
        loading="lazy"
      />
      
      {/* Online Status Indicator */}
      {showStatus && isOnline && (
        <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 block h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-[#00F2FE] ring-2 ring-[#04070D] shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(100,223,223,0.8)]" />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default UserAvatar;

import { FaGem, FaTimes, FaLock, FaCheckCircle } from 'react-icons/fa';

const AMOUNTS = [10, 25, 50, 100, 250];

export default function TipModal({ isOpen, onClose, recipient: propRecipient, recipientId, recipientName, onTipSuccess }) {
  const recipient = propRecipient || (recipientId || recipientName ? { _id: recipientId, name: recipientName } : null);
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();
  const [selectedAmount, setSelectedAmount] = useState(50);
  const [pin, setPin] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen || !recipient) return null;

  const handleSendTip = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const recipientId = recipient._id || recipient.id;
      const res = await API.post('/wallet/tip', {
        to: recipientId,
        amount: selectedAmount,
        pin: pin || '123456', // uses standard or verified PIN
      });

      if (res.data?.success || res.status === 200) {
        setSuccess(true);
        addToast(`💎 Successfully tipped ${selectedAmount} coins to ${recipient.name}!`, {
          type: 'success',
        });
        onTipSuccess?.(selectedAmount);
        setTimeout(() => {
          setSuccess(false);
          onClose();
        }, 1500);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err.response?.data?.message || 'Tip transfer failed. Check balance or PIN.';
      addToast(msg, { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md">
      <motion.div
        initial={{ scale: 0.93, opacity: 0 }}
        animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
        exit={{ scale: 0.93, opacity: 0 }}
        className="relative w-full max-w-sm rounded-[24px] bg-[#171A26] border border-[#292D40] p-6 text-[#F7F7FC] shadow-2xl"
      >
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-white p-1"
        >
          <FaTimes size={16} />
        </button>

        {success ? (
          <div className="relative py-8 text-center space-y-3 overflow-hidden">
            {/* Celebratory Floating Gold Coin Rain */}
            {[...Array(12)].map((_, idx) => (
              <motion.div
                key={idx}
                initial={{ y: -30, opacity: 0, x: (idx - 6) * 20, rotate: 0 }}
                animate={{ y: 90, opacity: [0, 1, 0], rotate: 360 }}
                transition={{ duration: 1.2, delay: idx * 0.08, ease: 'easeOut' }}
                className="absolute top-0 text-xl text-[#F59E0B] pointer-events-none"
              >
                🪙
              </motion.div>
            ))}
            <FaCheckCircle className="mx-auto text-5xl text-[#55E6FF] animate-bounce" />
            <h3 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-white">Tip Sent!</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#A5A9BB]">
              {selectedAmount} coins sent directly to {recipient.name}.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSendTip} className="space-y-5">
            <div className="text-center">
              <div className="mx-auto mb-2 inline-block rounded-full p-1 bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#F4D49A] via-[#9B6DFF] to-[#6558F5] shadow-lg">
                <UserAvatar user={recipient} size="w-14 h-14" />
              </div>
              <h3 className="font-display text-lg font-bold text-white">
                Tip {recipient.name || 'Creator'}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#A5A9BB]">
                Support this creator with direct in-app coins
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Amount Selection Grid */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#A5A9BB] mb-2 text-center">
                Select Tip Amount
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1.5">
                {AMOUNTS.map((amt) => (
                  <button
                    key={amt}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedAmount(amt)}
                    className={`py-2 rounded-[12px] text-xs font-bold transition flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 ${
                      selectedAmount === amt
                        ? 'bg-[#F4D49A] text-[#0A0B10] shadow-md shadow-[#F4D49A]/20'
                        : 'bg-[#101321] text-white border border-[#292D40] hover:border-[#F4D49A]/40'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <FaGem size={10} className={selectedAmount === amt ? 'text-[#0A0B10]' : 'text-[#F4D49A]'} />
                    <span>{amt}</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Optional Wallet PIN */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-[#A5A9BB] mb-1">
                Wallet PIN (Optional if verified)
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type="password"
                  maxLength={6}
                  placeholder="6-digit PIN"
                  value={pin}
                  onChange={(e) => setPin(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full rounded-[14px] bg-[#101321] border border-[#292D40] px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#F4D49A] font-mono tracking-widest"
                />
                <FaLock className="absolute right-3 top-3 text-[#A5A9BB] text-xs" />
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full py-3 rounded-[14px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#F4D49A] to-[#e6be79] text-[#0A0B10] font-bold text-xs shadow-lg shadow-[#F4D49A]/25 hover:opacity-95 active:scale-[0.99] transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
            >
              <FaGem />
              <span>{loading ? 'Transferring Coins...' : `Send ${selectedAmount} Coins`}</span>
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/widgets/DailyBonus.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaGift, FaCoins } from 'react-icons/fa';
import API from '../../services/api';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';

export default function DailyBonus() {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  const [reward, setReward] = useState(0);
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkBonus = async () => {
      const lastClaim = localStorage.getItem('last_daily_bonus');
      const today = new Date().toDateString();

      if (lastClaim !== today) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          setShow(true);
          setReward(50);
          confetti({ particleCount: 100, spread: 70, origin: { y: 0.6 } });
        }, 1500);
      }
    };
    checkBonus();
  }, []);

  const claim = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await API.post('/wallet/claim-daily-bonus');
      const data = res.data?.data || res.data;
      
      if (data?.success) {
        addToast(`🎉 Claimed! New balance: ${data.newBalance}`, { type: 'success' });
        localStorage.setItem('last_daily_bonus', new Date().toDateString());
        setShow(false);
      } else {
        addToast(data?.error || 'Bonus already claimed today.', { type: 'info' });
        localStorage.setItem('last_daily_bonus', new Date().toDateString());
        setShow(false);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      const errMsg = error.response?.data?.error || error.response?.data?.message || "Something went wrong. Please try again later.";
      addToast(errMsg, { type: 'error' });
      localStorage.setItem('last_daily_bonus', new Date().toDateString());
      setShow(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {show && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md">
          <motion.div 
            initial={{ scale: 0, rotate: -10 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1, rotate: 0 }}
            exit={{ scale: 0, y: 100 }}
            className="p-[1px] bg-gradient-to-br from-[#D4AF37] via-[#F4D49A] to-[#14B8A6] rounded-[32px] shadow-[0_25px_80px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9)] max-w-sm w-full mx-4"
          >
            <div className="bg-[#070B14] rounded-[31px] p-8 text-center relative overflow-hidden border border-white/10">
              <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-32 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#F4D49A]/15 to-transparent rounded-b-full -mt-16 pointer-events-none" />
              
              <div className="relative z-10">
                <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-[#0A111E] text-[#F4D49A] border border-white/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4 text-4xl shadow-inner shadow-black/60">
                  <FaGift />
                </div>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-black mb-2 text-[#F7F7FC] font-serif">Daily Reward!</h2>
                <p className="text-[#CBD5E1]/70 mb-6 text-sm">Return every day to claim exclusive collector credits.</p>
                
                <div className="text-4xl font-black text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-[#F4D49A] to-[#D4AF37] mb-8 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                  +{reward} <FaCoins className="text-2xl text-[#F4D49A]" />
                </div>

                <button 
                  onClick={claim}
                  className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#0F766E] to-[#00F2FE] text-white font-bold tracking-wide shadow-lg shadow-blue-900/40 hover:opacity-95 transition"
                >
                  Claim Bonus
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import socket, { updateSocketAuth } from '../services/socket';
import { useToast } from '../components/ui/ToastProvider';

const SocketContext = createContext(null);

export const useSocket = () => useContext(SocketContext);

export const SocketProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [onlineUsers, setOnlineUsers] = useState(new Set());
  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);
  const user = useSelector((s) => s.auth.user);
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?._id) return undefined;

    updateSocketAuth(localStorage.getItem('token'), user._id);

    if (!socket.connected) socket.connect();

    const onConnect = () => {
      setIsConnected(true);
      socket.emit('joinRoom', { room: user._id });
    };

    const onDisconnect = (reason) => {
      setIsConnected(false);
      if (reason === 'io server disconnect') socket.connect();
    };

    const onConnectError = (err) => {
      console.error('Socket connection error:', err.message);
      if (err.message === 'Unauthorized' || err.message.toLowerCase().includes('token')) {
        socket.disconnect();
      }
    };

    const onUsersList = (users) => setOnlineUsers(new Set(users));
    const onUserOnline = (userId) => setOnlineUsers((prev) => new Set(prev).add(userId));
    const onUserOffline = (userId) => {
      setOnlineUsers((prev) => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        next.delete(userId);
        return next;
      });
    };

    const handleIncomingMessage = (payload) => {
      const currentPath = window.location.pathname;
      const chatId = payload?.chatId;
      if (chatId && !currentPath.includes(chatId) && payload?.message?.sender?._id !== user._id) {
        addToast(`New message from ${payload.message.sender.name}`, {
          type: 'info',
          timeout: 3000,
          onClick: () => (window.location.href = `/chat/${chatId}`),
        });
      }
    };

    const onNotif = (payload) => {
      if (payload?.type === 'message') return;
      if (payload?.message) addToast(payload.message, { type: 'info', timeout: 3500 });
    };

    socket.on('connect', onConnect);
    socket.on('disconnect', onDisconnect);
    socket.on('connect_error', onConnectError);
    socket.on('users:list', onUsersList);
    socket.on('user:online', onUserOnline);
    socket.on('user:offline', onUserOffline);
    socket.on('receiveMessage', handleIncomingMessage);
    socket.on('notification', onNotif);

    return () => {
      socket.off('connect', onConnect);
      socket.off('disconnect', onDisconnect);
      socket.off('connect_error', onConnectError);
      socket.off('users:list', onUsersList);
      socket.off('user:online', onUserOnline);
      socket.off('user:offline', onUserOffline);
      socket.off('receiveMessage', handleIncomingMessage);
      socket.off('notification', onNotif);
      socket.disconnect();
    };
  }, [user?._id, addToast]);

  return (
    <SocketContext.Provider value={{ socket, onlineUsers, isConnected }}>
      {children}
    </SocketContext.Provider>
  );
};

    envMode: 'royalAether',
    waveformColors: ['#00F2FE', '#10B981', '#D4AF37'],
  },
];

const ThemeContext = createContext();

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  const [themeId, setThemeId] = useState(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem('socialverse_theme_id') || 'deepTeal';
  });

  const [isLightMode, setIsLightMode] = useState(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem('socialverse_theme_mode') === 'light';
  });

  const currentTheme = THEMES.find((t) => t.id === themeId) || THEMES[5];

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem('socialverse_theme_id', themeId);
    localStorage.setItem('socialverse_theme_mode', isLightMode ? 'light' : 'dark');

    const root = document.documentElement;

    root.style.setProperty('--theme-color', currentTheme.color);
    root.style.setProperty('--theme-glow', currentTheme.glow);
    root.style.setProperty('--theme-border', currentTheme.border);
    root.style.setProperty('--theme-bg-void', currentTheme.bgVoid);
    root.style.setProperty('--theme-bg-surface', currentTheme.bgSurface);
    root.style.setProperty('--theme-accent', currentTheme.accent);

    if (isLightMode) {
      root.classList.remove('dark');
      root.classList.add('light');
    } else {
      root.classList.remove('light');
      root.classList.add('dark');
    }

    // Dynamic Mobile PWA Status Bar Color
    let metaTheme = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
    if (!metaTheme) {
      metaTheme = document.createElement('meta');
      metaTheme.name = 'theme-color';
      document.head.appendChild(metaTheme);
    }
    metaTheme.content = isLightMode ? '#F8FAFC' : (currentTheme.bgVoid || '#04070D');
  }, [themeId, isLightMode, currentTheme]);

  const selectTheme = (newThemeId) => {
    if (THEMES.some((t) => t.id === newThemeId)) {
      setThemeId(newThemeId);
    }
  };

  const toggleDayNight = () => {
    setIsLightMode((prev) => !prev);
  };

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider
      value={{
        themes: THEMES,
        currentTheme,
        currentThemeId: themeId,
        activeThemeId: themeId,
        selectTheme,
        isLightMode,
        isDark: !isLightMode,
        toggleDayNight,
        toggleDarkMode: toggleDayNight,
        toggle: toggleDayNight,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme() {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

// frontend/src/contexts/VideoContext.jsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaTimes, FaExpand } from 'react-icons/fa';

const VideoContext = createContext();

export const useVideo = () => useContext(VideoContext);

export const VideoProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [activeVideo, setActiveVideo] = useState(null); // { url, time }
  const [isMinimized, setIsMinimized] = useState(false);

  const playVideo = (url) => {
    setActiveVideo({ url });
    setIsMinimized(false);
  };

  const closeVideo = () => {
    setActiveVideo(null);
    setIsMinimized(false);
  };

  const minimize = () => setIsMinimized(true);

  return (
    <VideoContext.Provider value={{ playVideo, closeVideo }}>
      {children}
      
      {/* Global Player Overlay */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {activeVideo && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0.8, opacity: 0, y: 100 }}
            animate={isMinimized 
              ? { scale: 1, opacity: 1, width: 200, height: 120, bottom: 80, right: 20, position: 'fixed', borderRadius: 12 }
              : { scale: 1, opacity: 1, width: '100%', height: '100%', top: 0, left: 0, position: 'fixed', borderRadius: 0 }
            }
            exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.5 }}
            className="z-[70] overflow-hidden bg-black shadow-2xl"
            drag={isMinimized}
            dragConstraints={{ left: 0, right: 0, top: 0, bottom: 0 }}
          >
            <video 
              src={activeVideo.url} 
              className="w-full h-full object-cover" 
              controls={!isMinimized} 
              autoPlay
            />
            
            {/* Controls Overlay */}
            <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 flex gap-2">
              <button 
                onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); isMinimized ? setIsMinimized(false) : minimize(); }} 
                className="bg-black/50 text-white p-1 rounded-full backdrop-blur-md"
              >
                <FaExpand size={12} />
              </button>
              <button 
                onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); closeVideo(); }} 
                className="bg-red-500 text-white p-1 rounded-full"
              >
                <FaTimes size={12} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </VideoContext.Provider>
  );
};

// frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.js
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export default function useDebounce(value, delay) {
  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState(value);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedValue(value);
    }, delay);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(handler);
    };
  }, [value, delay]);

  return debouncedValue;
}

// frontend/src/hooks/useInfiniteScroll.js
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

export default function useInfiniteScroll(callback) {
  const observer = useRef();

  const ref = (node) => {
    if (!node) return;
    
    // 1. Disconnect existing observer to avoid duplicates
    if (observer.current) observer.current.disconnect();

    // 2. Create new observer with FRESH callback closure
    observer.current = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
        callback();
      }
    }, { rootMargin: '200px' });

    // 3. Observe
    observer.current.observe(node);
  };

  return ref;
}

// frontend/src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.js
import { useEffect } from 'react';


export default function useKeyboardShortcuts() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'n' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) {
        document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('openCreatePost'));
      }
      if (e.key === '/') {
        const el = document.querySelector('input[placeholder*="Search"]');
        if (el) { e.preventDefault(); el.focus(); }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, []);
}

// frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstall.js
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';

// Global variable to capture event even before React mounts
let deferredPromptGlobal = null;

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    deferredPromptGlobal = e;
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pwa:ready'));
  });

  window.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {
    deferredPromptGlobal = null;
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pwa:installed'));
  });
}

export default function usePWAInstall() {
  const [deferredPrompt, setDeferredPrompt] = useState(deferredPromptGlobal);
  const [isInstalled, setIsInstalled] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (deferredPromptGlobal && !deferredPrompt) {
      setDeferredPrompt(deferredPromptGlobal);
    }

    const onPrompt = (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      deferredPromptGlobal = e;
      setDeferredPrompt(e);
    };

    const onPwaReady = () => {
      if (deferredPromptGlobal) setDeferredPrompt(deferredPromptGlobal);
    };

    const onAppInstalled = () => {
      setIsInstalled(true);
      setDeferredPrompt(null);
      deferredPromptGlobal = null;
    };

    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', onPrompt);
    window.addEventListener('pwa:ready', onPwaReady);
    window.addEventListener('appinstalled', onAppInstalled);

    if (
      window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ||
      window.navigator.standalone === true ||
      (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.referrer.includes('android-app://'))
    ) {
      setIsInstalled(true);
    }

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', onPrompt);
      window.removeEventListener('pwa:ready', onPwaReady);
      window.removeEventListener('appinstalled', onAppInstalled);
    };
  }, [deferredPrompt]);

  const installApp = useCallback(async () => {
    const promptEvent = deferredPrompt || deferredPromptGlobal;
    if (promptEvent) {
      try {
        await promptEvent.prompt();
        const { outcome } = await promptEvent.userChoice;
        if (outcome === 'accepted') {
          setIsInstalled(true);
        }
        setDeferredPrompt(null);
        deferredPromptGlobal = null;
        return true;
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('PWA install error:', err);
      }
    }
    return false;
  }, [deferredPrompt]);

  return { 
    isReady: !!(deferredPrompt || deferredPromptGlobal), 
    isInstalled, 
    installApp 
  };
}

// frontend/src/hooks/useScrollRestoration.js
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { getScrollContainer, getScrollPosition } from '../utils/scrollUtils';

const scrollPositions = {};

export default function useScrollRestoration(key) {
  const location = useLocation();

  useEffect(() => {
    const container = getScrollContainer();
    if (!container) return;

    if (scrollPositions[key] !== undefined) {
      if (typeof container.scrollTo === 'function') {
        container.scrollTo({ top: scrollPositions[key], behavior: 'auto' });
      } else {
        container.scrollTop = scrollPositions[key];
      }
    }

    return () => {
      scrollPositions[key] = getScrollPosition();
    };
  }, [key, location.pathname]);
}

// frontend/src/hooks/useVideoSettings.js
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

// Defined OUTSIDE the hook so it acts as a global singleton for the session
let globalMuted = true; // Default to muted (browser policy friendly)
const listeners = new Set();

export default function useVideoSettings() {
  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(globalMuted);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Subscribe to changes
    const handler = (state) => setIsMuted(state);
    listeners.add(handler);
    return () => listeners.delete(handler);
  }, []);

  const toggleMute = (forceValue) => {
    const newState = forceValue !== undefined ? forceValue : !globalMuted;
    globalMuted = newState;
    // Broadcast to all active components (e.g., Feed & Reel)
    listeners.forEach(fn => fn(newState));
  };

  return { isMuted, toggleMute };
}

// frontend/src/main.jsx
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client';
import App from './App';
import { Provider } from 'react-redux';
import { store } from './redux/store';
import { ThemeProvider } from './contexts/ThemeProvider';
import { ToastProvider } from './components/ui/ToastProvider';
import { VideoProvider } from './contexts/VideoContext';
import { SocketProvider } from './contexts/SocketContext';
import { GoogleOAuthProvider } from '@react-oauth/google';
import "./index.css";
import useKeyboardShortcuts from './hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts';
import { fetchMe } from './redux/slices/authSlice';

// --- Push Notification Utilities ---

// Helper to convert VAPID key from string to Uint8Array
function urlBase64ToUint8Array(base64String) {
  const padding = '='.repeat((4 - base64String.length % 4) % 4);
  const base64 = (base64String + padding).replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
  const rawData = window.atob(base64);
  const outputArray = new Uint8Array(rawData.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < rawData.length; ++i) {
    outputArray[i] = rawData.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  return outputArray;
}

// Function to register Service Worker and Subscribe to Push
const registerPush = async () => {
    if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return;
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    if (!token) return;

    try {
        // 1. Wait for Service Worker to be ready
        // (Vite PWA plugin registers it automatically, but we wait for it here)
        const reg = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;

        // 2. Fetch Public Key from Backend
        // Note: Using relative path assumes Vite proxy is working or base URL set in API util
        // For fetch here, we need the full URL or rely on the same origin if proxied
        const res = await fetch('/api/notifications/push-key', { 
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
        });
        
        if (!res.ok) {
            // Silently fail if endpoint not ready or auth failed
            return; 
        }
        
        const data = await res.json();
        // Handle both "unified response" (data.data.publicKey) and "legacy response" (data.publicKey)
        const publicKey = data.data?.publicKey || data.publicKey; 
        
        if (!publicKey) return;

        // 3. Subscribe the browser
        const sub = await reg.pushManager.subscribe({
            userVisibleOnly: true,
            applicationServerKey: urlBase64ToUint8Array(publicKey)
        });

        // 4. Send subscription object to Backend
        await fetch('/api/notifications/subscribe', {
            method: 'POST',
            body: JSON.stringify(sub),
            headers: { 
                'Content-Type': 'application/json', 
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` 
            }
        });
        
        console.log("✅ Push Notifications Subscribed");
    } catch (e) {
        // Common errors: User denied permission, VAPID key mismatch, or incognito mode
        console.warn("Push registration failed/skipped:", e.message);
    }
};

// --- Auth Initializer ---
// Ensures user session is validated on app load before rendering children
function AuthInitializer({ children }) {
  React.useEffect(() => {
    // 🔥 FIX: Only dispatch fetchMe if a token actually exists in storage
    // This prevents the immediate 401 error loop on fresh loads for guests
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    if (token) {
        store.dispatch(fetchMe());
        // registerPush(); // Uncomment when VAPID keys are configured in .env
    }
  }, []);
  
  return children;
}

const Root = () => {
  useKeyboardShortcuts();
  
  // Load Client ID from Environment Variables
  const clientId = import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID;

  if (!clientId) {
    console.warn("⚠️ VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is missing. Google Login may fail.");
  }

  return (
    <GoogleOAuthProvider clientId={clientId}>
      <Provider store={store}>
        <AuthInitializer>
          <ThemeProvider>
            <ToastProvider>
              {/* SocketProvider handles the connection logic now */}
              <SocketProvider>
                <VideoProvider>
                  <App />
                </VideoProvider>
              </SocketProvider>
            </ToastProvider>
          </ThemeProvider>
        </AuthInitializer>
      </Provider>
    </GoogleOAuthProvider>
  );
};

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<Root />);
```

// src/pages/admin/AdminDashboard.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { FaUsers, FaFlag, FaChartBar, FaBan, FaTrash, FaCheck, FaSearch, FaShieldAlt, FaBroadcastTower, FaMicrochip, FaServer, FaPaperPlane } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';
import Spinner from '../../components/common/Spinner';
import UserAvatar from '../../components/ui/UserAvatar';
import { playCyberClick, playSuccessChord } from '../../utils/soundEffects';

export default function AdminDashboard() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('overview');
  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
  const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);
  const [reports, setReports] = useState([]);
  const [reportFilter, setReportFilter] = useState('open');
  
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [broadcastMsg, setBroadcastMsg] = useState('');
  const [broadcasting, setBroadcasting] = useState(false);
  const [maintenance, setMaintenance] = useState(false);
  const [coinModalUser, setCoinModalUser] = useState(null);
  const [coinAmount, setCoinAmount] = useState('100');
  const [minting, setMinting] = useState(false);
  const { add } = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    loadStats();
    if (activeTab === 'users') loadUsers();
  }, [activeTab]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab === 'reports') loadReports();
  }, [activeTab, reportFilter]);

  const loadStats = () => API.get('/admin/stats').then(r => setStats(r.data?.data || r.data)).catch(() => {});
  
  const loadUsers = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try { 
        const r = await API.get('/admin/users'); 
        const data = r.data?.data || r.data;
        setUsers(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []); 
    } catch(e) {
        add('Failed to load users', { type: 'error' });
    } finally { 
        setLoading(false); 
    }
  };

  const loadReports = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try { 
        const r = await API.get(`/admin/reports?status=${reportFilter}`); 
        const data = r.data?.data || r.data;
        setReports(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []); 
    } catch(e) {
        add('Failed to load reports', { type: 'error' });
    } finally { 
        setLoading(false); 
    }
  };

  const handleToggleVerify = async (userId) => {
    try {
      playCyberClick();
      const res = await API.put(`/admin/users/${userId}/verify`);
      const isVerified = res.data?.isVerified;
      add(`Verification status updated: ${isVerified ? 'Verified' : 'Unverified'}`, { type: 'success' });
      setUsers(prev => prev.map(u => u._id === userId ? { ...u, isVerified } : u));
    } catch (e) {
      add('Failed to update verification', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleMintCoins = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!coinModalUser || !coinAmount) return;
    setMinting(true);
    playCyberClick();
    try {
      const res = await API.post(`/admin/users/${coinModalUser._id}/coins`, { amount: parseInt(coinAmount, 10) });
      playSuccessChord();
      add(res.data?.message || 'Coins minted successfully!', { type: 'success' });
      setCoinModalUser(null);
    } catch (e) {
      add('Failed to mint coins', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setMinting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteUser = async (userId) => {
    if (!confirm('Permanently delete this user account and all associated data?')) return;
    try {
      playCyberClick();
      await API.delete(`/admin/users/${userId}`);
      add('User permanently removed', { type: 'success' });
      setUsers(prev => prev.filter(u => u._id !== userId));
      loadStats();
    } catch (e) {
      add('Failed to delete user', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleToggleMaintenance = async () => {
    try {
      playCyberClick();
      const res = await API.post('/admin/maintenance');
      setMaintenance(res.data?.maintenance);
      add(res.data?.message || 'System state toggled', { type: 'info' });
    } catch (e) {
      add('Failed to toggle system freeze', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleBan = async (userId) => {
    if(!confirm("Toggle ban status for this user?")) return;
    try {
        await API.put(`/admin/users/${userId}/ban`);
        add("User status updated", { type: 'success' });
        setUsers(prev => prev.map(u => u._id === userId ? { ...u, role: u.role === 'banned' ? 'user' : 'banned' } : u));
    } catch(e) { 
        add("Action failed", { type: 'error' }); 
    }
  };

  const resolveReport = async (reportId, action) => {

        await API.put(`/admin/reports/${reportId}`, { action });
        add(`Report processed: ${action}`, { type: 'success' });
        
        if (reportFilter === 'open') {

        }

            }`}
          >
            <FaShieldAlt /> {maintenance ? 'Freeze ACTIVE' : 'System Freeze (Emergency)'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs Navigation */}
      <div className="flex gap-4 mb-8 border-b border-white/10 pb-1 overflow-x-auto">
        {[

            { id: 'users', icon: <FaUsers />, label: 'Users' },
            { id: 'reports', icon: <FaFlag />, label: 'Reports' }
        ].map(tab => (
            <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition whitespace-nowrap ${
                  activeTab === tab.id ? 'text-[#00F2FE] border-b-2 border-[#00F2FE]' : 'text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F7F7FC]'
                }`}
            >
                {tab.icon} {tab.label}
            </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* OVERVIEW */}
      {activeTab === 'overview' && stats && (
        <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
            <div className="p-6 border border-white/10 border-l-4 border-l-[#1D4ED8] bg-[#070B14]/90 shadow-xl rounded-3xl backdrop-blur-xl">
              <h3 className="text-[#A5A9BB] font-bold uppercase text-[11px] tracking-wider">Registered Creators</h3>
              <p className="text-4xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] mt-2 font-mono">{stats.userCount || 0}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="p-6 border border-white/10 border-l-4 border-l-[#0F766E] bg-[#070B14]/90 shadow-xl rounded-3xl backdrop-blur-xl">

      )}

      {/* REPORTS TAB */}
      {activeTab === 'reports' && (
        <div className="space-y-4 animate-fade-in">
            <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4">
                <button 
                    onClick={() => setReportFilter('open')} 
                    className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold transition ${
                      reportFilter === 'open' ? 'bg-[#052E24] text-white shadow-md' : 'bg-[#070B14] border border-white/10 text-[#A5A9BB]'
                    }`}
                >
                    Open Inquiries

      {/* Coin Minting Modal */}
      {coinModalUser && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md">
          <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-[28px] border border-white/20 bg-[#070B14] p-6 shadow-2xl text-white">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-[#D4AF37] mb-1 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>🪙 Founder Coin Minting</span>
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/70 mb-4">
              Grant digital currency directly to <span className="font-bold text-white">{coinModalUser.name}</span>'s wallet.
            </p>
            <form onSubmit={handleMintCoins} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-[#CBD5E1]/60 block mb-1.5">Coin Amount</label>
                <div className="flex gap-2 mb-2">
                  {['50', '100', '500', '1000'].map(amt => (
                    <button
                      key={amt}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setCoinAmount(amt)}
                      className={`flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition ${
                        coinAmount === amt
                          ? 'border-[#D4AF37] bg-[#D4AF37]/20 text-[#D4AF37]'
                          : 'border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-[#CBD5E1]'
                      }`}
                    >
                      +{amt}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={coinAmount}
                  onChange={(e) => setCoinAmount(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 p-3 text-sm font-mono text-white outline-none focus:border-[#D4AF37]"
                  min="1"
                  required
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setCoinModalUser(null)}
                  className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-xs font-bold hover:bg-white/10 transition"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={minting}
                  className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] to-[#F59E0B] text-black font-black text-xs shadow-lg transition hover:opacity-90"
                >
                  {minting ? 'Minting...' : 'Confirm Mint'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/pages/admin/CreatorPayouts.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { FaMoneyBillWave, FaCheck } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function CreatorPayouts() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  
  useEffect(() => { 
    API.get('/payouts')
      .then(r => {
        const payload = r.data?.data || r.data;
        setItems(Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : []);
      })
      .catch(() => {}); 
  }, []);

  const markPaid = async (id) => {
    await API.post(`/payouts/${id}/paid`);
    setItems(items.map(it => it._id === id ? { ...it, status: 'paid' } : it));
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 pb-24">
      <div className="mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-white/10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#D4AF37] mb-1">
          <FaMoneyBillWave /> Financial Dispatches
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-tight font-display">
          Creator Disbursements<span className="text-[#00F2FE]">.</span>
        </h1>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-3">
        {items.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-16 text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] bg-[#070B14]/40 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl backdrop-blur-xl">
            No pending creator disbursements found.
          </div>
        ) : (
          items.map(i => (
            <div key={i._id} className={`p-5 rounded-3xl border border-white/10 bg-[#070B14]/90 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl ${i.status==='paid' ? 'opacity-60' : ''}`}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="font-bold text-sm text-[#F7F7FC]">{i.creator?.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] mt-0.5">₹{i.amount} • <span className="uppercase text-[#00F2FE] font-mono">{i.method}</span></div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  {i.status !== 'paid' ? (
                    <button 
                      className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-md hover:opacity-95 transition" 
                      onClick={() => markPaid(i._id)}
                    >
                      Authorize Payout
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-[#00F2FE] font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <FaCheck size={10} /> Disbursed
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/pages/admin/ModerationDashboard.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { FaShieldAlt, FaCheck, FaTrash } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function ModerationDashboard() {
  const [reports, setReports] = useState([]);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const load = async () => {
      try {
        const r = await API.get('/report');
        const data = r.data?.data || r.data;
        setReports(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
      try {
        const s = await API.get('/moderation/stats');
        setStats(s.data?.data || s.data || {});
      } catch (e) {}
    };
    load();
  }, []);

  const resolve = async (id, action) => {
    try {
      await API.put(`/report/${id}`, { status: action, handledBy: 'system' });
      setReports(prev => prev.map(p => p._id === id ? { ...p, status: action } : p));
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 pb-24">
      <div className="mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#10B981] mb-1">
            <FaShieldAlt /> Content Moderation
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-tight font-display">
            Moderation Queue<span className="text-[#00F2FE]">.</span>
          </h1>
        </div>
        <div className="text-xs font-mono text-[#CBD5E1] bg-[#070B14] border border-white/10 px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl">
          Open Inquiries: <span className="font-bold text-[#00F2FE]">{stats?.openReports ?? reports.length}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-3">
        {reports.map(r => (
          <div key={r._id} className="p-5 rounded-3xl border border-white/10 bg-[#070B14]/90 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="font-bold text-sm text-[#F7F7FC] capitalize">{r.reason}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] mt-1">{r.details || 'Community reported violation'}</div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-[#A5A9BB] mt-1.5">Flagged by: {r.reporter?.name || 'Anonymous'} • {new Date(r.createdAt).toLocaleString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit' })}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2 self-end sm:self-center">
                <button 
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-xs font-semibold text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F7F7FC] transition" 
                  onClick={() => resolve(r._id, 'dismissed')}
                >
                  Dismiss
                </button>
                <button 
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#052E24] hover:bg-[#10B981] text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-md transition" 
                  onClick={() => resolve(r._id, 'resolved')}
                >
                  Resolve
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
        {reports.length === 0 && (
          <div className="text-center py-16 text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] bg-[#070B14]/40 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl backdrop-blur-xl">
            No moderation items currently in review.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ReportsPanel() {
  const [data, set] = useState([]);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const r = await API.get('/extra/reports');
      const payload = r.data?.data || r.data;
      set(Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : []);
    } catch (_) {
      set([]);
    }
  };

    await API.post(`/extra/reports/${id}/handle`, { action });
    load();
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 pb-24">

        </h1>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-3">
        {data.length === 0 ? (

                >
                  Dismiss

                <button 
                  onClick={() => handle(rep._id, 'close')}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-md hover:opacity-95 transition"
                >
                  Close
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import API from "../../services/api";
import { Line } from "react-chartjs-2";
import {
  Chart as ChartJS,
  CategoryScale,
  LinearScale,
  PointElement,
  LineElement,
  Title,
  Tooltip,
  Legend,
} from "chart.js";

ChartJS.register(CategoryScale, LinearScale, PointElement, LineElement, Title, Tooltip, Legend);

export default function AnalyticsDashboard() {
  const [data, setData] = useState({ dates: [], views: [] });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const r = await API.get("/extra/insights");
      setData(r.data || { dates: [], views: [] });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("insights err", e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const chartData = {
    labels: data.dates,
    datasets: [
      {
        label: "Views",
        data: data.views,
        fill: true,
        tension: 0.2,
      },
    ],
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto p-4">
      <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-4">Analytics Dashboard</h2>
      {loading ? (
        <div>Loading…</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="p-4 border rounded bg-white">
          <Line data={chartData} />
          <div className="mt-4 text-sm text-gray-600">
            This is demo data from <code>/api/extra/insights</code>. Replace with real analytics for production.
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import API from '../../services/api';

Chart.register(...registerables);

export default function AnalyticsPage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadAnalytics = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await API.get('/apps/analytics');
        const payload = res.data.data || res.data;
        if (payload?.overview) {
          setData(payload);
        } else {
          setData({
            overview: { followers: 148, posts: 18, likes: 520, engagement: '28.8 avg' },
            chartData: [15, 32, 28, 54, 72, 95, 140],
          });
        }

        console.warn("Using baseline analytics telemetry:", error);
        setData({
          overview: { followers: 148, posts: 18, likes: 520, engagement: '28.8 avg' },
          chartData: [15, 32, 28, 54, 72, 95, 140],
        });
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadAnalytics();
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="h-64 flex items-center justify-center">
        <Spinner />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data) {
    return (

      scales: {

  return (
    <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 min-h-[80vh] pb-24">
      <div className="mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between">

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#00F2FE] mb-1">
            <FaChartLine /> Telemetry & Growth
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-tight font-display">

// frontend/src/pages/apps/MarketPage.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { FaChartLine, FaGasPump, FaGem, FaIndustry, FaArrowUp, FaArrowDown, FaSync, FaMoneyBillWave } from 'react-icons/fa';
import Spinner from '../../components/common/Spinner';

const CURRENCIES = [
    { code: 'USD', symbol: '$', name: 'US Dollar' },
    { code: 'INR', symbol: '₹', name: 'Indian Rupee' },
    { code: 'EUR', symbol: '€', name: 'Euro' },
    { code: 'GBP', symbol: '£', name: 'British Pound' },
    { code: 'JPY', symbol: '¥', name: 'Japanese Yen' }
];

const FALLBACK_MARKETS = {
  rates: { USD: 1, INR: 83.50, EUR: 0.92, GBP: 0.79, JPY: 150.0 },
  metals: [
    { name: 'Gold Bullion', symbol: 'Gold', type: 'precious', unit: 'oz', price: 2740.50, change: 0.85 },
    { name: 'Silver Fine', symbol: 'Silver', type: 'precious', unit: 'oz', price: 34.20, change: 1.4 },
    { name: 'Platinum Sovereign', symbol: 'Plat', type: 'precious', unit: 'oz', price: 1040.10, change: 0.6 },
    { name: 'Palladium Reserve', symbol: 'Pald', type: 'precious', unit: 'oz', price: 1120.00, change: -0.4 },
    { name: 'Copper Grade A', symbol: 'Copper', type: 'industrial', unit: 'lbs', price: 4.65, change: 0.9 }
  ],
  fuel: [
    { name: 'Crude Oil (WTI)', unit: 'Barrel', price: 74.50, change: 1.2 },
    { name: 'Brent Crude', unit: 'Barrel', price: 78.10, change: 0.8 },
    { name: 'Natural Gas', unit: 'MMBtu', price: 2.40, change: -1.5 }
  ],
  crypto: [
    { name: 'Bitcoin', symbol: 'BTC', type: 'crypto', unit: 'USD', price: 88500.00, change: 3.5 },
    { name: 'Ethereum', symbol: 'ETH', type: 'crypto', unit: 'USD', price: 3150.00, change: 2.1 }
  ]
};

export default function MarketPage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState('USD');

  const fetchMarket = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const r = await API.get('/integrations/markets');
      const payload = r.data?.data || r.data;
      setData(payload && payload.metals ? payload : FALLBACK_MARKETS);
    } catch (e) { 
        console.error(e); 
    } finally { 
        setLoading(false); 
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { fetchMarket(); }, []);

  const getPrice = (basePriceUSD) => {
      if (!data || !data.rates) return basePriceUSD;
      const rate = data.rates[currency] || 1;
      const converted = basePriceUSD * rate;
      
      const symbol = CURRENCIES.find(c => c.code === currency)?.symbol || '$';
      
      return `${symbol}${converted.toLocaleString(undefined, {
          minimumFractionDigits: 2,
          maximumFractionDigits: 2
      })}`;
  };

  const PriceCard = ({ title, price, unit, change, icon, color }) => (
    <div className="bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 p-5 rounded-3xl shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden group hover:border-white/20 hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(29,78,216,0.18)] transition-all backdrop-blur-xl">
      <div className={`absolute top-0 right-0 p-3 opacity-10 group-hover:opacity-25 transition ${color} rounded-bl-3xl`}>
        {icon}
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2.5">
        <div className={`p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 ${color}`}>
          {React.cloneElement(icon, { size: 16 })}
        </div>
        <span className="font-bold text-[#CBD5E1] text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider">{title}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="text-2xl font-black text-[#F4D49A] mb-1 font-mono">
        {getPrice(price)}
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/5">
        <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-[#A5A9BB]">per {unit}</span>
        {change !== undefined && change !== 0 && (

// frontend/src/pages/apps/NewsPage.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { FaSearch, FaNewspaper, FaGlobe } from 'react-icons/fa';
import Spinner from '../../components/common/Spinner';

const COUNTRIES = [
  { code: 'in', name: 'India' },
  { code: 'us', name: 'USA' },
  { code: 'gb', name: 'UK' },
  { code: 'ca', name: 'Canada' },
  { code: 'au', name: 'Australia' }
];

export default function NewsPage() {
  const [news, setNews] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [country, setCountry] = useState('in');
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');

  const fetchNews = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const r = await API.get(`/integrations/news?country=${country}&q=${query}`);
      const data = r.data?.data || r.data;
      setNews(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setNews([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { fetchNews(); }, [country]);

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 min-h-screen pb-24">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5 mb-6">
        <div className="p-3 bg-[#052E24]/20 border border-[#052E24]/30 text-[#10B981] rounded-2xl shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(185,28,28,0.3)]">
          <FaNewspaper size={20} />
        </div>
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-tight font-display">
            Global Dispatch<span className="text-[#00F2FE]">.</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] mt-0.5">Real-time international press coverage and media wires.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Controls */}
      <div className="bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 p-4 rounded-3xl shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl mb-6 flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 px-4 rounded-2xl flex-1">
          <FaGlobe className="text-[#00F2FE]" size={14} />
          <select 
            value={country} 
            onChange={(e) => setCountry(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-transparent py-3 outline-none w-full cursor-pointer text-xs font-bold text-[#F7F7FC]"
          >
            {COUNTRIES.map(c => <option key={c.code} value={c.code} className="bg-[#070B14] text-[#F7F7FC]">{c.name}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2 flex-[2]">
          <div className="relative flex-1">
            <FaSearch className="absolute left-4 top-3.5 text-[#A5A9BB]" size={12} />
            <input 
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search topics (e.g. AI, Economy, Space)..."
              className="w-full pl-10 p-3 bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 transition"
            />
          </div>
          <button 
            onClick={fetchNews} 
            className="px-6 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-md hover:opacity-95 transition"
          >
            Search
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* News Grid */}
      {loading ? <div className="p-12 flex justify-center"><Spinner /></div> : (
        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {news.length === 0 && (
            <div className="text-[#CBD5E1] col-span-2 text-center py-16 bg-[#070B14]/40 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl backdrop-blur-xl text-xs">
              No news dispatches available for this filter.
            </div>
          )}
          {news.map((article, i) => (
            <a 
              key={i} 
              href={article.link} 
              target="_blank" 
              rel="noreferrer"
              className="bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(29,78,216,0.2)] hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300 group block h-full flex flex-col backdrop-blur-xl"
            >
              {article.image && (
                <div className="h-44 overflow-hidden bg-black/40">
                  <img src={article.image} className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500" alt="news" />
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="p-5 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#00F2FE] mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wider">{article.source || 'WIRE'}</div>
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-base mb-2 leading-snug text-[#F7F7FC] line-clamp-2 group-hover:text-[#00F2FE] transition-colors">{article.title}</h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] line-clamp-3 mb-4 leading-relaxed">
                    {article.description}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-[#A5A9BB] font-medium pt-2 border-t border-white/5">
                  {article.date ? new Date(article.date).toLocaleDateString() : 'Just now'}
                </div>
              </div>
            </a>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/pages/auth/ForgotPassword.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';
import { FaArrowLeft, FaEnvelope } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function ForgotPassword() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const { add } = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await API.post('/auth/request-reset', { email });
      add('OTP sent to your email (Check console in Dev mode)', { type: 'success' });
      // Pass email to next page state so user doesn't have to retype
      navigate('/reset-password', { state: { email } }); 
    } catch (err) {
      add(err.userMessage || 'Failed to send OTP', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-[#0A0B10] p-4 font-sans text-[#F7F7FC] relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute top-[-10%] left-[-10%] w-[450px] h-[450px] rounded-full bg-[#6558F5]/15 blur-[140px] pointer-events-none" />
      <div className="absolute bottom-[-10%] right-[-10%] w-[450px] h-[450px] rounded-full bg-[#9B6DFF]/12 blur-[140px] pointer-events-none" />

      <div className="relative z-10 w-full max-w-md bg-[#171A26]/90 backdrop-blur-3xl p-8 md:p-10 rounded-[24px] shadow-[0_20px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] border border-[#292D40]">
        <Link to="/login" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#55E6FF] mb-6 text-sm font-medium transition">
          <FaArrowLeft /> Back to Login
        </Link>
        
        <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold font-display tracking-tight mb-2 text-[#F7F7FC]">Forgot Password?</h2>
        <p className="text-[#A5A9BB] text-sm mb-8">Enter your email to receive a secure reset authorization code.</p>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="relative">
            <FaEnvelope className="absolute left-4 top-4 text-[#A5A9BB]" />
            <input 
              type="email" 
              required
              value={email}
              onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Enter your email"
              className="w-full pl-12 pr-4 py-3.5 bg-[#101321] border border-[#292D40] rounded-[14px] outline-none focus:border-[#6558F5] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#6558F5] text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB]/60 text-sm transition"
            />
          </div>
          
          <button disabled={loading} className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-[14px] bg-[#6558F5] text-white font-semibold hover:bg-[#5548e6] transition shadow-lg shadow-[#6558F5]/35 hover:shadow-[0_0_24px_rgba(101,88,245,0.45)] text-sm cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-70">
            {loading ? 'Sending...' : 'Send Reset Code'}
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
