// frontend/src/pages/auth/Login.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { Link, useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import Spinner from '../../components/common/Spinner';
import GoogleLoginButton from '../../components/auth/GoogleLoginButton';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaEye, FaEyeSlash, FaShieldAlt, FaKey } from 'react-icons/fa';
import AppIcon from '../../components/ui/AppIcon';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { setUser } from '../../redux/slices/authSlice';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';
import AdminCyberGateway from '../../components/common/AdminCyberGateway';
import { playCyberClick } from '../../utils/soundEffects';

export default function Login() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { user, loading, error } = useSelector((s) => s.auth);
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();

  const [form, setForm] = useState({ email: '', password: '' });
  const [showPass, setShowPass] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [showAdminPortal, setShowAdminPortal] = useState(false);

  const from = location.state?.from?.pathname || '/';

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) {
      navigate(from, { replace: true });
    }
  }, [user, navigate, from]);

  // Global secret shortcut listener: Ctrl + Shift + A or Ctrl + Alt + A
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'a') ||
          (e.ctrlKey && e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'a')) {
        e.preventDefault();
        playCyberClick();
        setShowAdminPortal(true);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  const fillDemo = (email, password) => {
    playCyberClick();
    setForm({ email, password });
    addToast(`Filled creator credentials for ${email}`, { type: 'info' });
  };

  const submit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await API.post('/auth/login', form);
      const requires2FA = res.data?.requires2FA || res.data?.data?.requires2FA;
      const targetEmail = res.data?.email || res.data?.data?.email || form.email;

      if (requires2FA) {
        navigate('/verify-account', {
          state: { email: targetEmail, isLogin: true }
        });
        return;
      }

      const payload = res.data?.data || res.data;
      const { token, refreshToken, user: authUser } = payload || {};
      if (token) localStorage.setItem('token', token);
      if (refreshToken) localStorage.setItem('refreshToken', refreshToken);
      if (authUser?._id) localStorage.setItem('meId', authUser._id);

      if (authUser) dispatch(setUser(authUser));
      addToast('Signed in successfully! Welcome back.', { type: 'success' });
      navigate(from, { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Login failed';
      addToast(msg, { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden bg-[#04070D] px-4 font-sans text-[#F7F7FC]">
      {/* Specular Ambient Glow Mesh */}
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute top-[-15%] left-[-10%] h-[550px] w-[550px] rounded-full bg-[#1D4ED8]/18 blur-[160px]" />
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-[-15%] right-[-10%] h-[600px] w-[600px] rounded-full bg-[#052E24]/16 blur-[180px]" />
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-[450px] w-[450px] rounded-full bg-[#00F2FE]/08 blur-[170px]" />

      <motion.div
        initial={{ y: 24, opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
        animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.45, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
        className="relative z-10 w-full max-w-md rounded-[28px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.16)] bg-[#070B14]/90 p-8 md:p-10 shadow-[0_25px_70px_rgba(0,0,0,0.7)] backdrop-blur-3xl ring-1 ring-white/10"
      >
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="inline-flex justify-center mb-3 drop-shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(29,78,216,0.4)]">
            <AppIcon size={64} />
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-display text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#F7F7FC]">
            Welcome to SocialVerse<span className="text-[#38BDF8]"> ∞</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-[#CBD5E1]/80 font-sans tracking-[0.25em] uppercase mt-1.5 font-semibold">
            BEYOND SOCIAL &bull; NEXT-GEN NETWORK
          </p>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
            className="mb-6 p-3 bg-[#052E24]/20 border border-[#10B981]/40 rounded-[14px] text-rose-300 text-sm text-center font-medium shadow-inner"
          >
            {error}
          </motion.div>
        )}

        <div className="space-y-5">
          {/* Public 1-Click Creator Demo Experience */}
          <div className="rounded-[18px] border border-white/10 bg-[#04070D]/80 p-3.5 text-center shadow-silverGlass">
            <span className="block text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CBD5E1]/70 mb-2">
              ⚡ Instant Creator Access
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => fillDemo('user@socialapp.com', 'password123')}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8]/20 via-[#052E24]/15 to-[#D4AF37]/20 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-[#F8FAFC] shadow-sm transition hover:border-[#00F2FE] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(100,223,223,0.3)] active:scale-98"
            >
              <span>👤 Elena Vance (Digital Creator)</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <GoogleLoginButton />

          <div className="relative flex items-center py-1">
            <div className="flex-grow border-t border-white/10" />
            <span className="flex-shrink-0 mx-3 text-[#CBD5E1]/60 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
              Or continue with email
            </span>
            <div className="flex-grow border-t border-white/10" />
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
            <div className="relative group">
              <input
                type="email"
                placeholder="Email Address"
                autoComplete="username"
                value={form.email}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })}
                required
                className="w-full bg-[#04070D] border border-white/15 rounded-[14px] px-4 py-3.5 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00F2FE] text-[#F7F7FC] transition placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="relative group">
              <input
                type={showPass ? 'text' : 'password'}
                placeholder="Password"
                autoComplete="current-password"
                value={form.password}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, password: e.target.value })}
                required
                className="w-full bg-[#04070D] border border-white/15 rounded-[14px] pl-4 pr-11 py-3.5 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00F2FE] text-[#F7F7FC] transition placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 text-sm"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPass(!showPass)}
                className="absolute right-3.5 top-3.5 text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:text-[#00F2FE] transition-colors"
              >
                {showPass ? <FaEyeSlash size={18} /> : <FaEye size={18} />}
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end">
              <Link
                to="/forgot-password"
                className="text-xs font-medium text-[#CBD5E1]/70 hover:text-[#00F2FE] transition-colors"
              >
                Forgot Password?
              </Link>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading || isSubmitting}
              className="w-full py-3.5 px-6 rounded-[14px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37] text-white font-bold hover:opacity-95 active:scale-[0.99] transition shadow-[0_4px_25px_rgba(29,78,216,0.35)] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm disabled:opacity-70 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              <span>
                {loading || isSubmitting ? (
                  <Spinner className="border-current" />
                ) : (
                  'Sign In to SocialVerse'
                )}
              </span>
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="text-center text-sm text-[#CBD5E1]/70">
            Don't have an account?{' '}
            <Link to="/register" className="text-[#00F2FE] font-semibold hover:underline">
              Create one
            </Link>
          </div>

          {/* Concealed High-Tech Architect Enclave Access Trigger */}
          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/5 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                playCyberClick();
                setShowAdminPortal(true);
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CBD5E1]/50 hover:text-[#00F2FE] hover:bg-white/5 transition-all group"
            >
              <FaShieldAlt className="text-[#10B981] group-hover:text-[#00F2FE] transition-colors" />
              <span>Architect Gateway [Ctrl+Shift+A]</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.div>

      {/* Cybernetic High-Tech Admin Gateway Modal */}
      <AdminCyberGateway
        isOpen={showAdminPortal}
        onClose={() => setShowAdminPortal(false)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import API from '../../services/api';

// frontend/src/pages/auth/VerifyAccount.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useLocation, useNavigate, Link, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux';
import { setUser } from '../../redux/slices/authSlice';
import { FaKey, FaShieldAlt } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

export default function VerifyAccount() {
  const { state } = useLocation();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { add } = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();

  // Get email/code from URL (Magic Link) or Navigation State (Manual Entry)
  const email = searchParams.get('email') || state?.email;
  const urlCode = searchParams.get('code');
  const isLogin = state?.isLogin;

  const [otp, setOtp] = useState(urlCode || '');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  // Auto-submit if opened via Magic Link
  useEffect(() => {
    if (urlCode && urlCode.length === 6 && email) {
        setOtp(urlCode);
        handleVerify(null, urlCode); // Auto trigger
    }
  }, [urlCode, email]);

  const handleVerify = async (e, codeOverride) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    const codeToSubmit = codeOverride || otp;
    
    if (!codeToSubmit || codeToSubmit.length !== 6) {
        return add("Please enter a 6-digit code", { type: "info" });
    }
    
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await API.post('/auth/verify-otp', { email, otp: codeToSubmit });
      
      // Handle the response (unified format)
      const payload = res.data.data || res.data;
      const { token, refreshToken, user } = payload;
      
      if (!token || !user) throw new Error("Invalid response from server");

      // 1. Store Session
      localStorage.setItem('token', token);
      if (refreshToken) localStorage.setItem('refreshToken', refreshToken);
      localStorage.setItem('meId', user._id);
      
      // 2. Update Redux State
      dispatch(setUser(user));
      
      add(isLogin ? 'Welcome back!' : 'Account verified! Welcome.', { type: 'success' });
      
      // 3. Force Redirect to Home
      // Using window.location to ensure a full refresh and socket reconnection
      setTimeout(() => {
          window.location.href = '/'; 
      }, 500);
      
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Verification error:", err);
      const msg = err.response?.data?.message || 'Verification failed';
      add(msg, { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!email) {
      return (
          <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-[#0A0B10] text-center p-4">
              <div className="bg-[#171A26] border border-[#292D40] rounded-[24px] p-8 max-w-sm">
                  <p className="text-[#A5A9BB] mb-4">No email provided. Session expired.</p>
                  <Link to="/login" className="btn-primary">Go to Login</Link>
              </div>
          </div>
      );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-[#0A0B10] p-4 font-sans text-[#F7F7FC] relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute top-[-10%] left-[-10%] w-[450px] h-[450px] rounded-full bg-[#6558F5]/15 blur-[140px] pointer-events-none" />
      <div className="absolute bottom-[-10%] right-[-10%] w-[450px] h-[450px] rounded-full bg-[#55E6FF]/10 blur-[140px] pointer-events-none" />

      <motion.div 
        initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }}
        animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
        className="relative z-10 w-full max-w-md bg-[#171A26]/90 backdrop-blur-3xl border border-[#292D40] rounded-[24px] shadow-[0_20px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] p-8 md:p-10 text-center"
      >
        <div className="mb-8">
            <div className="inline-flex p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#101321] border border-[#292D40] text-[#55E6FF] shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(85,230,255,0.25)] mb-4">
                <FaShieldAlt size={32} />
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold font-display tracking-tight text-[#F7F7FC]">
                {isLogin ? "Two-Factor Auth" : "Verify Account"}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[#A5A9BB] text-sm mt-2">
                Enter the 6-digit code sent to <br/> 
                <span className="font-semibold text-[#55E6FF]">{email}</span>
            </p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={(e) => handleVerify(e)} className="space-y-6">
          <div className="relative group">
            <FaKey className="absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#A5A9BB] group-focus-within:text-[#55E6FF] transition-colors" />
            <input 
              type="text" 
              inputMode="numeric"
              required
              value={otp}
              onChange={e => setOtp(e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''))}
              placeholder="000000"
              className="w-full bg-[#101321] border border-[#292D40] rounded-[16px] pl-12 pr-4 py-4 text-center font-mono text-2xl tracking-[0.45em] font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#6558F5] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#6558F5] transition"
              maxLength={6}
              autoFocus
              autoComplete="one-time-code"
            />
          </div>
          
          <button 
            disabled={loading} 
            className="w-full py-4 rounded-[14px] bg-[#6558F5] text-white font-semibold hover:bg-[#5548e6] transition shadow-lg shadow-[#6558F5]/35 hover:shadow-[0_0_24px_rgba(101,88,245,0.45)] text-base flex justify-center items-center cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-70"
          >
            {loading ? <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" /> : 'Verify Code'}
          </button>
        </form>

        <div className="mt-6 text-center">
            <Link to="/login" className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#55E6FF] transition">
                Back to Login
            </Link>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/pages/chat/CallRoom.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import Peer from 'simple-peer';
import socket from '../../services/socket';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';
import {
  FaMicrophone,
  FaMicrophoneSlash,
  FaVideo,
  FaVideoSlash,
  FaPhoneSlash,
  FaDesktop,
} from 'react-icons/fa';

const FALLBACK_ICE = [
  { urls: 'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302' },
  { urls: 'stun:global.stun.twilio.com:3478' },
];

export default function CallRoom() {
  const { roomId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { add } = useToast();

  const myVideo = useRef(null);
  const peerVideo = useRef(null);
  const peerRef = useRef(null);
  const streamRef = useRef(null);
  const initialized = useRef(false);

  const [stream, setStream] = useState(null);
  const [callAccepted, setCallAccepted] = useState(false);
  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(false);
  const [isVideoOff, setIsVideoOff] = useState(false);
  const [isScreenSharing, setIsScreenSharing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialized.current) return;
    initialized.current = true;

    const initCall = async () => {
      try {
        let iceServers = FALLBACK_ICE;
        try {
          const turnRes = await API.get('/integrations/turn');
          if (Array.isArray(turnRes.data) && turnRes.data.length > 0) {
            iceServers = turnRes.data;
          } else if (Array.isArray(turnRes.data?.data) && turnRes.data.data.length > 0) {
            iceServers = turnRes.data.data;
          }
        } catch (_) {}

        const localStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          video: true,
          audio: true,
        });

        setStream(localStream);
        streamRef.current = localStream;

        if (myVideo.current) myVideo.current.srcObject = localStream;

        if (!socket.connected) socket.connect();
        socket.emit('joinRoom', { room: roomId });

        socket.on('user-joined', ({ userId }) => {
          createPeer(userId, localStream, iceServers);
        });

        socket.on('call:signal', ({ from, signal }) => {
          if (!peerRef.current) answerPeer(from, signal, localStream, iceServers);
          else peerRef.current.signal(signal);
        });

        socket.on('call:rejected', () => {
          add('Call rejected or busy', { type: 'error' });
          cleanupAndLeave();
        });

        socket.on('call:ended', () => {
          add('Call ended', { type: 'info' });
          cleanupAndLeave();
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Media Error:', err);
        add('Camera/Microphone access denied', { type: 'error' });
        navigate('/chat');
      }
    };

    initCall();

    return () => {
      socket.off('user-joined');
      socket.off('call:signal');
      socket.off('call:rejected');
      socket.off('call:ended');

      if (streamRef.current) {
        streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      }

      if (peerRef.current) peerRef.current.destroy();
    };
  }, [roomId, navigate, add]);

  const createPeer = (toSocketId, localStream, iceServers) => {
    const peer = new Peer({
      initiator: true,
      trickle: false,
      stream: localStream,
      config: { iceServers },
    });

    peer.on('signal', (signal) => {
      socket.emit('call:signal', {
        to: toSocketId,
        from: socket.id,
        signal,
      });
    });

    peer.on('stream', (remoteStream) => {
      if (peerVideo.current) peerVideo.current.srcObject = remoteStream;
      setCallAccepted(true);
    });

    peerRef.current = peer;
  };

  const answerPeer = (from, signal, localStream, iceServers) => {
    const peer = new Peer({
      initiator: false,
      trickle: false,
      stream: localStream,
      config: { iceServers },
    });

    peer.on('signal', (signalData) => {
      socket.emit('call:signal', {
        to: from,
        signal: signalData,
      });
    });

    peer.on('stream', (remoteStream) => {
      if (peerVideo.current) peerVideo.current.srcObject = remoteStream;
      setCallAccepted(true);
    });

    peer.signal(signal);
    peerRef.current = peer;
  };

  const toggleMute = () => {
    if (!stream) return;
    const track = stream.getAudioTracks()[0];
    if (track) {
      track.enabled = !track.enabled;
      setIsMuted(!track.enabled);
    }
  };

  const toggleVideo = () => {
    if (!stream) return;
    const track = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];
    if (track) {
      track.enabled = !track.enabled;
      setIsVideoOff(!track.enabled);
    }
  };

  const handleScreenShare = async () => {
    if (!stream) return;

    if (isScreenSharing) {
      try {
        const camStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true, audio: true });
        const camTrack = camStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
        const audioTrack = stream.getAudioTracks()[0];

        if (streamRef.current) {
          streamRef.current.getVideoTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
        }

        if (peerRef.current?._pc) {
          const sender = peerRef.current._pc.getSenders().find((s) => s.track?.kind === 'video');
          if (sender) sender.replaceTrack(camTrack);
        }

        const newStream = new MediaStream([camTrack, audioTrack].filter(Boolean));
        setStream(newStream);
        streamRef.current = newStream;
        if (myVideo.current) myVideo.current.srcObject = newStream;
        setIsScreenSharing(false);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed reverting to camera stream:', err);
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      const screenStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({ cursor: true });
      const screenTrack = screenStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
      screenTrack.onended = () => {
        if (isScreenSharing) handleScreenShare();
      };

      if (streamRef.current) {
        streamRef.current.getVideoTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      }

      if (peerRef.current?._pc) {
        const sender = peerRef.current._pc.getSenders().find((s) => s.track?.kind === 'video');
        if (sender) sender.replaceTrack(screenTrack);
      }

      const newStream = new MediaStream([screenTrack, stream.getAudioTracks()[0]].filter(Boolean));
      setStream(newStream);
      streamRef.current = newStream;
      if (myVideo.current) myVideo.current.srcObject = newStream;
      setIsScreenSharing(true);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Screen share failed', e);
    }
  };

  const cleanupAndLeave = () => {
    if (streamRef.current) {
      try {
        streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    if (peerRef.current) {
      try {
        peerRef.current.destroy();
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    navigate('/chat');
  };

  const leaveCall = () => {
    socket.emit('call:ended', { roomId });
    cleanupAndLeave();
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative flex h-screen flex-col bg-[#04070D] text-[#F7F7FC] select-none">
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden p-4 relative">
        {callAccepted ? (
          <video ref={peerVideo} autoPlay playsInline className="h-full w-full rounded-[28px] object-cover border border-white/10 shadow-2xl" />
        ) : (
          <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 text-base font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1]">
            <div className="h-16 w-16 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-white/10 border-t-[#00F2FE] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(100,223,223,0.3)]" />
            Connecting encrypted peer channel...
          </div>
        )}

        {stream && !isVideoOff ? (
          <video
            ref={myVideo}
            autoPlay
            muted
            playsInline
            className={`absolute bottom-28 right-6 z-20 rounded-3xl border border-white/20 object-cover shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md ${
              callAccepted ? 'h-48 w-36 ring-2 ring-white/10' : 'h-2/3 w-2/3 opacity-50 blur-sm'
            }`}
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="absolute bottom-28 right-6 z-20 flex h-48 w-36 items-center justify-center rounded-3xl border border-white/15 bg-[#070B14]/90 text-center text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl">
            Camera Off
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-4 border-t border-white/10 bg-[#070B14]/90 px-6 py-5 backdrop-blur-2xl">
        <button 
          onClick={toggleMute} 
          className={`grid h-12 w-12 place-items-center rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
            isMuted 
              ? 'bg-[#052E24]/30 border-[#052E24]/40 text-[#F87171]' 
              : 'bg-[#0A111E] border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] hover:bg-white/10'
          }`}
        >
          {isMuted ? <FaMicrophoneSlash size={16} /> : <FaMicrophone size={16} />}
        </button>
        <button 
          onClick={toggleVideo} 
          className={`grid h-12 w-12 place-items-center rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
            isVideoOff 
              ? 'bg-[#052E24]/30 border-[#052E24]/40 text-[#F87171]' 
              : 'bg-[#0A111E] border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] hover:bg-white/10'
          }`}
        >
          {isVideoOff ? <FaVideoSlash size={16} /> : <FaVideo size={16} />}
        </button>
        <button 
          onClick={handleScreenShare} 
          className={`grid h-12 w-12 place-items-center rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
            isScreenSharing 
              ? 'bg-[#0F766E]/30 border-[#0F766E]/40 text-[#00F2FE]' 
              : 'bg-[#0A111E] border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] hover:bg-white/10'
          }`}
        >
          <FaDesktop size={16} />
        </button>
        <button 
          onClick={leaveCall} 
          className="grid h-13 w-13 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-[#052E24] text-white transition hover:bg-[#10B981] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(185,28,28,0.5)] border border-[#10B981]"
        >
          <FaPhoneSlash size={18} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/pages/chat/ChatPage.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import API from '../../services/api';
import socket from '../../services/socket';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { FaUsers, FaUserPlus, FaSearch, FaTrashAlt, FaComments } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';
import UserAvatar from '../../components/ui/UserAvatar';
import CreateGroupModal from '../../components/chat/CreateGroupModal';
import NewChatModal from '../../components/chat/NewChatModal';
import ChatBox from '../../components/chat/ChatBox';

// Rich Seed Conversations ensuring Chat is never empty
const SEED_CONVERSATIONS = [
  {

      {

        name: "Elena Vance",

    isGroup: false,

      {
        _id: "demo_u_aman",
        name: "Aman Verma",
        avatar: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1500648767791-00dcc994a43e?w=200",
        isVerified: true
      }

  },
  {
    _id: "demo_chat_neha",
    name: "Neha Sharma",
    isGroup: false,
    participants: [
      {
        _id: "demo_u_neha",
        name: "Neha Sharma",
        avatar: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494790108377-be9c29b29330?w=200",
        isVerified: true
      }
    ],
    lastMessage: {
      content: "The new Royal Aether theme looks breathtaking on mobile!",
      createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - 720 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()
    },
    updatedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 720 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()
  }
];

export default function ChatPage() {
  const { id: paramChatId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();

  const myId = useSelector((s) => s.auth?.user?._id || localStorage.getItem('meId'));
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState([]);
  const [chatSearch, setChatSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedChatId, setSelectedChatId] = useState(paramChatId || null);
  const [typingMap, setTypingMap] = useState({});
  const [showNewChat, setShowNewChat] = useState(false);
  const [showGroupModal, setShowGroupModal] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedChatId(paramChatId || null);
  }, [paramChatId]);

  const normalizeChats = (payload) => {
    if (Array.isArray(payload)) return payload;
    return payload?.data || [];
  };

  const loadConversations = async () => {
    try {
      const r = await API.get('/chat');
      const list = normalizeChats(r.data);
      if (list && list.length > 0) {
        setConversations(list);
        if (!selectedChatId && window.innerWidth >= 768) setSelectedChatId(list[0]._id);
      } else {
        setConversations(SEED_CONVERSATIONS);
        if (!selectedChatId && window.innerWidth >= 768) setSelectedChatId(SEED_CONVERSATIONS[0]._id);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setConversations(SEED_CONVERSATIONS);
      if (!selectedChatId && window.innerWidth >= 768) setSelectedChatId(SEED_CONVERSATIONS[0]._id);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadConversations();

    const onMsg = (payload) => {
      if (!payload?.chatId) return;
      setConversations((prev) => {
        const updated = prev.find((c) => c._id === payload.chatId);
        const rest = prev.filter((c) => c._id !== payload.chatId);

        if (updated) {
          const next = {
            ...updated,
            lastMessage: payload.message,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          };
          return [next, ...rest];
        }

        loadConversations();
        return prev;
      });
    };

    const onTyping = ({ chatId, userId }) => {
      if (!chatId || !userId || userId === myId) return;
      setTypingMap((prev) => ({ ...prev, [chatId]: true }));
      window.clearTimeout(window.__chatTypingTimer?.[chatId]);
      window.__chatTypingTimer = window.__chatTypingTimer || {};
      window.__chatTypingTimer[chatId] = window.setTimeout(() => {
        setTypingMap((prev) => {
          const next = { ...prev };
          delete next[chatId];
          return next;
        });
      }, 2500);
    };

    socket.on('receiveMessage', onMsg);
    socket.on('typing', onTyping);

    return () => {
      socket.off('receiveMessage', onMsg);
      socket.off('typing', onTyping);
    };
  }, [myId]);

  const getOther = (c) => {
    if (!c) return { name: 'Chat' };
    if (c.isGroup || c.isGroupChat) return { name: c.name || c.chatName || 'Group Chat', avatar: null };
    return c.participants?.find((p) => String(p._id) !== String(myId)) || c.participants?.[0] || { name: 'User' };
  };

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = chatSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return conversations;
    return conversations.filter((c) => {
      const other = getOther(c);
      const haystack = [
        other?.name,
        c.name,
        c.chatName,
        c.lastMessage?.content,
        c.lastMessage?.sender?.name,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' ')
        .toLowerCase();
      return haystack.includes(q);
    });
  }, [chatSearch, conversations, myId]);

  const startNewChat = async (targetUserId) => {
    try {
      const res = await API.post('/chat', { participants: [targetUserId], isGroup: false });
      const newConv = res.data?.data || res.data;
      if (newConv?._id) {
        setConversations((prev) => [newConv, ...prev.filter((c) => c._id !== newConv._id)]);
        navigate(`/chat/${newConv._id}`);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      addToast('Failed to start chat', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteChat = async (chatId, e) => {
    e?.stopPropagation?.();
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this conversation?')) return;
    try {
      await API.delete(`/chat/${chatId}`);
      setConversations((prev) => prev.filter((c) => c._id !== chatId));
      if (selectedChatId === chatId) navigate('/chat');
      addToast('Conversation deleted', { type: 'success' });
    } catch (e2) {
      addToast(e2.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to delete conversation', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const openChat = (chatId) => {
    setSelectedChatId(chatId);
    navigate(`/chat/${chatId}`);
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex h-[calc(100vh-140px)] max-w-6xl gap-4 p-4 md:h-[85vh]">
      <aside className={`${selectedChatId ? 'hidden md:flex' : 'flex'} w-full flex-col rounded-[28px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#070B14]/90 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-silverGlass md:w-1/3 overflow-hidden`}>
        <div className="rounded-t-[28px] border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] bg-[#04070D]/80 p-4">
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
            <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xl font-black text-[#F8FAFC]">
              <FaComments className="text-[#00F2FE]" /> Chats
            </h2>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowGroupModal(true)}
                className="rounded-full bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.12] p-2 text-[#CBD5E1] hover:text-white transition-colors"
                title="Create group"
              >
                <FaUsers />
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowNewChat(true)}
                className="rounded-full bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.12] p-2 text-[#CBD5E1] hover:text-white transition-colors"
                title="New chat"
              >
                <FaUserPlus />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="relative">
            <FaSearch className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#CBD5E1]/50" />
            <input
              value={chatSearch}
              onChange={(e) => setChatSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search chats..."
              className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)] bg-[#04070D] py-2.5 pl-10 pr-3 text-sm text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00F2FE] transition-all"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-2">
          {filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="mt-10 text-center text-sm text-[#CBD5E1]/50">
              No chats yet.
            </div>
          ) : (
            filtered.map((c) => {
              const other = getOther(c);
              const isActive = String(selectedChatId || '') === String(c._id);
              const isUnread = c.unread && myId ? Number(c.unread?.[myId] || 0) > 0 : false;
              const previewTyping = typingMap[c._id];

              return (
                <button
                  key={c._id}
                  onClick={() => openChat(c._id)}
                  className={`mb-2 flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-[22px] border px-3 py-3 text-left transition-all ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.16)] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8]/20 via-[#052E24]/15 to-[#00F2FE]/10 shadow-silverGlass'
                      : 'border-transparent hover:bg-white/[0.04]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <UserAvatar src={other?.avatar} name={other?.name} userId={other?._id} className="h-11 w-11 shrink-0" />

                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                      <div className="truncate font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">
                        {other?.name || 'Chat'}
                      </div>
                      {isUnread && (
                        <span className="rounded-full bg-[#052E24] px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black text-white shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(139,0,24,0.6)]">
                          NEW
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="truncate text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/60">
                      {previewTyping ? (
                        <span className="text-[#00F2FE] font-bold animate-pulse">Typing...</span>
                      ) : c.lastMessage?.content ? (
                        c.lastMessage.content
                      ) : c.lastMessage?.media ? (
                        'Media attachment'
                      ) : (
                        'Start chatting'
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    onClick={(e) => handleDeleteChat(c._id, e)}
                    className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#CBD5E1]/40 hover:text-[#10B981] hover:bg-[#052E24]/15 transition-colors"
                    title="Delete conversation"
                  >
                    <FaTrashAlt />
                  </button>
                </button>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      </aside>

      <section className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-[28px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#070B14]/90 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-silverGlass overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
        {selectedChatId ? (
          <ChatBox chatId={selectedChatId} onBack={() => navigate('/chat')} />
        ) : (
          <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center p-8 text-center">
            <div>
              <div className="mx-auto mb-4 grid h-16 w-16 place-items-center rounded-3xl bg-[#04070D] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)] text-3xl text-[#00F2FE] shadow-[0_0_24px_rgba(100,223,223,0.25)]">
                <FaComments />
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-black text-[#F8FAFC]">Select a chat</div>
              <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm text-[#CBD5E1]/60">
                Choose a conversation or start a new one to begin messaging.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      <NewChatModal
        isOpen={showNewChat}
        onClose={() => setShowNewChat(false)}
        onUserSelect={startNewChat}
      />

      <CreateGroupModal
        isOpen={showGroupModal}
        onClose={() => setShowGroupModal(false)}
        onCreated={(chat) => {
          const next = chat?._id ? chat : null;
          if (next) {
            setConversations((prev) => [next, ...prev.filter((c) => c._id !== next._id)]);
            navigate(`/chat/${next._id}`);
          } else {
            loadConversations();
          }
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/pages/discovery/FollowSuggestions.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import UserAvatar from '../../components/ui/UserAvatar';
import FollowButton from '../../components/profile/FollowButton';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';

let memorySuggestionsCache = null;
let lastSuggestionsFetchTime = 0;
const CACHE_TTL = 3 * 60 * 1000; // 3 minutes

const DEFAULT_SUGGESTIONS = [
  { _id: 'suggest_user_1', name: 'Elena Rostova', username: 'elena', avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?w=200' },
  { _id: 'suggest_user_2', name: 'Marcus Thorne', username: 'marcus', avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507003211169-0a1dd7228f2d?w=200' },
  { _id: 'suggest_user_3', name: 'Aria Chen', username: 'aria', avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1517841905240-472988babdf9?w=200' },
  { _id: 'suggest_user_4', name: 'Dr. Alistair Vance', username: 'alistair', avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1500648767791-00dcc994a43e?w=200' }
];

export default function FollowSuggestions() {
  const { user } = useSelector(s => s.auth);
  const [list, setList] = useState(memorySuggestionsCache || []);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!memorySuggestionsCache);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;

    if (memorySuggestionsCache && Date.now() - lastSuggestionsFetchTime < CACHE_TTL) {
      setList(memorySuggestionsCache);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const fetchSuggestions = async () => {
      try {
        const r = await API.get('/follow-suggest/suggest');
        const data = Array.isArray(r.data) ? r.data : (r.data.data || []);
        const unique = data.filter((v, i, a) => a.findIndex(t => (t._id === v._id)) === i);
        memorySuggestionsCache = unique;
        lastSuggestionsFetchTime = Date.now();
        setList(unique.length > 0 ? unique : DEFAULT_SUGGESTIONS);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch suggestions:", e);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchSuggestions();
  }, [user]);

  if (!user || loading) return (
      <div className="card p-5 bg-[#070B14]/85 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] rounded-[24px] shadow-silverGlass">
          <div className="animate-pulse flex flex-col gap-4">
              <div className="h-5 bg-[#04070D] rounded w-1/2"></div>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex gap-3">
                      <div className="rounded-full bg-[#04070D] h-10 w-10"></div>
                      <div className="flex-1 space-y-2 py-1">
                          <div className="h-2 bg-[#04070D] rounded w-3/4"></div>
                          <div className="h-2 bg-[#04070D] rounded w-1/2"></div>
                      </div>
                  </div>
              </div>
          </div>
      </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="card p-5 bg-[#070B14]/85 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] rounded-[24px] shadow-silverGlass">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-[#F8FAFC]">
          Who to follow
        </h3>
        <Link to="/explore" className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#00F2FE] hover:underline">
          Explore
        </Link>
      </div>
      
      {list.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-[#CBD5E1]/50 text-sm">No suggestions available.</div>
      ) : (
          <div className="space-y-3.5">
            {list.slice(0, 5).map(u => (
              <div key={u._id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <Link to={`/profile/${u._id}`} className="flex items-center gap-2.5 group min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <UserAvatar src={u.avatar} name={u.name} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full shrink-0 border border-white/10" />
                    <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <span className="font-bold text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] group-hover:text-[#00F2FE] transition-colors truncate">{u.name}</span>
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-[#CBD5E1]/60 truncate">@{u.username || 'creator'}</span>
                    </div>
                </Link>
                <div className="shrink-0">
                  <FollowButton userId={u._id} initialStatus={false} />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/pages/discovery/SwipeExplore.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, useMotionValue, useTransform, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { FaTimes, FaHeart, FaBolt, FaSync } from 'react-icons/fa';
import UserAvatar from '../../components/ui/UserAvatar';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';
import { getImageUrl } from '../../utils/imageUtils';
import { playSound } from '../../utils/soundEffects';

const DEFAULT_CREATORS = [
  { _id: 'creator_1', name: 'Elena Rostova', username: 'elena', avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?w=600', bio: 'Digital Art Director • Neo-Tokyo Aesthetic', followers: [1,2,3] },
  { _id: 'creator_2', name: 'Marcus Thorne', username: 'marcus', avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507003211169-0a1dd7228f2d?w=600', bio: 'Modular Synthesizer Architect • London Soundscapes', followers: [1,2] },
  { _id: 'creator_3', name: 'Aria Chen', username: 'aria', avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1517841905240-472988babdf9?w=600', bio: 'Cinematic Fashion & Visual Storyteller', followers: [1,2,3,4] },
  { _id: 'creator_4', name: 'Dr. Alistair Vance', username: 'alistair', avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1500648767791-00dcc994a43e?w=600', bio: 'DeFi Research Fellow • Cryptographic Systems', followers: [1] }

export default function SwipeExplore() {
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState([]);

  const { add } = useToast();

  const loadProfiles = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await API.get('/follow-suggest/suggest');
      const list = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : (res.data?.data || []);
      setProfiles(list && list.length > 0 ? list : DEFAULT_CREATORS);
    } catch (_) {
      setProfiles([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProfiles();
  }, []);

  const handleSwipe = (direction, user) => {
    setProfiles(prev => prev.filter(p => p._id !== user._id));
    
    if (direction === 'right') {
      playSound('pop');
      API.post(`/users/${user._id}/follow`);
      add(`Following ${user.name}!`, { type: 'success' });
    } else {
      playSound('cyber');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="h-[80vh] flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden select-none px-4">
      <div className="text-center mb-6">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#D4AF37] mb-1">
          <FaBolt /> Rapid Discovery
        </div>
        <h2 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] font-display">
          Swipe Creators<span className="text-[#00F2FE]">.</span>
        </h2>
      </div>

      <div className="relative w-full max-w-sm h-[500px]">
        <AnimatePresence>
          {profiles.map((profile, index) => (
            <Card 
              key={profile._id} 
              profile={profile} 
              onSwipe={handleSwipe} 
              isTop={index === profiles.length - 1}
            />
          ))}
        </AnimatePresence>
        
        {profiles.length === 0 && (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-[#A5A9BB] bg-[#070B14]/40 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-8 backdrop-blur-xl">
            <div className="text-5xl mb-3">✨</div>
            <p className="font-semibold text-sm text-[#F7F7FC]">You've reached the end of the orbit!</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] mt-1 text-center">Check back soon for new creator suggestions.</p>
            <button 
              onClick={loadProfiles} 
              className="mt-6 px-6 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-md hover:opacity-95 transition flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <FaSync size={11} className={loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''} /> Refresh Deck
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const Card = ({ profile, onSwipe, isTop }) => {
  const x = useMotionValue(0);
  const rotate = useTransform(x, [-200, 200], [-25, 25]);
  const opacity = useTransform(x, [-200, -100, 0, 100, 200], [0, 1, 1, 1, 0]);

  const handleDragEnd = (e, info) => {
    if (info.offset.x > 100) onSwipe('right', profile);
    else if (info.offset.x < -100) onSwipe('left', profile);
  };

  if (!isTop) return null;

  return (
    <motion.div
      style={{ x, rotate, opacity }}
      drag="x"
      dragConstraints={{ left: 0, right: 0 }}
      onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
      className="absolute inset-0 bg-[#070B14] rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing border border-white/15 backdrop-blur-xl"
    >
      <div className="h-3/4 relative bg-black/40">
        <img src={getImageUrl(profile.avatar)} className="w-full h-full object-cover pointer-events-none" alt={profile.name} />
        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#04070D]/95 via-[#04070D]/60 to-transparent p-6 pt-24">
          <h3 className="text-[#F7F7FC] text-2xl font-bold font-display">{profile.name}</h3>
          <p className="text-[#CBD5E1] text-xs line-clamp-2 mt-1 leading-relaxed">{profile.bio || "Creator & storyteller on SocialVerse."}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Actions */}
      <div className="h-1/4 flex items-center justify-center gap-8 bg-[#070B14]">
        <button 
          onClick={() => onSwipe('left', profile)} 
          className="p-4 rounded-full bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-[#F87171] shadow-lg hover:scale-110 active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
        >
          <FaTimes size={20} />
        </button>
        <button 
          onClick={() => onSwipe('right', profile)} 
          className="p-4 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37] text-white shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(29,78,216,0.4)] hover:scale-110 active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
        >
          <FaHeart size={20} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

  const loadEvents = async () => {
    try {

const TRENDING_PLACES = [
  { name: "Mumbai, India", count: "142K posts", img: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1570168007204-dfb528c6958f?w=400" },
  { name: "Swiss Alps", count: "98K posts", img: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1464822759023-fed622ff2c3b?w=400" },
  { name: "Bali, Indonesia", count: "86K posts", img: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507525428034-b723cf961d3e?w=400" },
  { name: "Kyoto, Japan", count: "64K posts", img: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1503899036084-c55cdd92da26?w=400" },
];

export default function Explore() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { currentTheme } = useTheme();

  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState("For You"); // 'For You' | 'Trending' | 'People' | 'Places'
  const [results, setResults] = useState({ users: [], posts: [], hashtags: [] });
  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState({ users: [], trendingHashtags: [] });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [categoryPosts, setCategoryPosts] = useState([]);
  const [loadingPosts, setLoadingPosts] = useState(false);

  // Load Suggestions
  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchSuggestions = async () => {
      try {
        const r = await API.get("/extra/suggestions");
        const payload = r.data.data || r.data || {};
        setSuggestions({
          users: Array.isArray(payload.users) ? payload.users : [],
          trendingHashtags: Array.isArray(payload.trendingHashtags) ? payload.trendingHashtags : [],
        });
      } catch (e) {
        // Fallback demo users
      }
    };
    fetchSuggestions();
  }, []);

  // Fetch Feed for current category
  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchPosts = async () => {
      setLoadingPosts(true);
      try {
        let res;
        if (activeCategory === "For You" || activeCategory === "Trending") {
          res = await API.get("/posts/trending");
        } else if (activeCategory === "Places") {
          res = await API.get("/search/global?q=places");
        } else {
          res = await API.get(`/search/global?q=${encodeURIComponent(activeCategory)}`);
        }
        const raw = res.data?.data || res.data;
        const postsList = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : raw?.posts || [];
        setCategoryPosts(postsList);
      } catch (e) {
        setCategoryPosts([]);
      } finally {
        setLoadingPosts(false);
      }
    };
    fetchPosts();
  }, [activeCategory]);

  // Handle Search
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!query.trim()) {
      setResults({ users: [], posts: [], hashtags: [] });
      return;
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const r = await API.get(`/search/global?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`);
        setResults(r.data.data || r.data || { users: [], posts: [], hashtags: [] });
      } catch (e) {
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [query]);

  // Combined grid posts (database posts or curated showcase pieces)
  const mosaicPieces =
    categoryPosts.length >= 4 ? categoryPosts : CURATED_EXPLORE_PIECES;

  return (
    <div className="w-full pb-28 text-[#F8FAFC]">
      {/* =====================================================================
          HEADER (Mobile Screen 2: Hamburger + Explore + Search with QR Scanner)
          ===================================================================== */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 bg-[#070B14]/90 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10 px-4 pt-3 pb-3">
        {/* Title Row */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => navigate("/")}
              className="p-1 -ml-1 text-white/80 hover:text-white md:hidden"
            >
              <IoMenuOutline size={26} />
            </button>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black font-display text-white tracking-tight">
              Explore
            </h1>
          </div>

          <span
            className="text-[11px] font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider"
            style={{
              background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${currentTheme.color}25, ${currentTheme.accent}20)`,
              border: `1px solid ${currentTheme.color}50`,
              color: currentTheme.accent,
            }}
          >
            Curated Feed
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Search Bar with QR Scanner Icon (Screen 2) */}
        <div className="relative mb-3">
          <IoSearchOutline className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-white/50 text-lg" />
          <input
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search posts, people, tags..."
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-11 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#04070D]/85 border border-white/15 outline-none focus:border-white/40 transition-all text-white placeholder-white/40 text-sm shadow-inner"
          />
          {query ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setQuery("")}
              className="absolute right-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-white/50 hover:text-white p-1"
            >
              <IoClose size={18} />
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => navigate("/profile")}
              className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 p-1.5 rounded-lg text-white/70 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition"
              title="Scan QR"
            >
              <IoScanOutline size={20} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* CATEGORY FILTER PILLS (Screen 2: For You | 🔥 Trending | 👥 People | 📍 Places) */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pt-1">
          {[
            { id: "For You", label: "For You", icon: null },
            { id: "Trending", label: "Trending", icon: <IoFlame className="text-[#FF6B8A]" /> },
            { id: "People", label: "People", icon: <IoPeopleOutline className="text-[#00F2FE]" /> },
            { id: "Places", label: "Places", icon: <IoLocationOutline className="text-[#F59E0B]" /> },
          ].map((cat) => {
            const isActive = activeCategory === cat.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={cat.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  playSound("pop");
                  setActiveCategory(cat.id);
                }}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all duration-200 border cursor-pointer ${
                  isActive
                    ? "text-white shadow-lg scale-105"
                    : "bg-[#04070D]/70 border-white/10 text-white/70 hover:text-white hover:border-white/20"
                }`}
                style={
                  isActive
                    ? {
                        background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${currentTheme.color}40, ${currentTheme.accent}30)`,
                        borderColor: currentTheme.accent,
                        boxShadow: `0 0 14px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
                      }
                    : {}
                }
              >
                {cat.icon}
                <span>{cat.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-3 sm:px-4 pt-4">
        {/* =====================================================================
            SEARCH RESULTS VIEW (When query is active)
            ===================================================================== */}
        {query ? (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            {loading && (
              <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
                <Spinner />
              </div>
            )}

            {!loading && results.users?.length === 0 && results.posts?.length === 0 && (
              <div className="text-center text-white/60 py-14 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-white/15 bg-white/[0.02]">
                No direct results found for "{query}". Try browsing the curated feed.
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Users */}
            {results.users?.length > 0 && (
              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/15 bg-[#070B14]/85 p-4 backdrop-blur-md">
                <h3 className="font-bold mb-3 text-white/70 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Creators
                </h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  {results.users.map((u) => (
                    <Link
                      key={u._id}
                      to={`/profile/${u._id}`}
                      className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 rounded-xl hover:bg-white/[0.05] transition border border-transparent hover:border-white/10"
                    >
                      <UserAvatar src={u.avatar} name={u.name} className="w-10 h-10" />
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <div className="font-bold text-sm text-white truncate">{u.name}</div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-white/50 truncate">
                          @{u.username || "creator"}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </Link>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Posts Grid */}
            {results.posts?.length > 0 && (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                {results.posts.map((post) => (
                  <div
                    key={post._id}
                    onClick={() => navigate(`/post/${post._id}`)}
                    className="relative aspect-square rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black/40 border border-white/10 cursor-pointer group"
                  >
                    <img
                      src={getImageUrl(post.image || post.images?.[0] || post.mediaUrl, "feed")}
                      alt="Result"
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105"
                    />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : activeCategory === "People" ? (
          /* ===================================================================
              PEOPLE VIEW (When "👥 People" tab is selected)
              =================================================================== */
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white/70">
              Suggested Creators For You
            </h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {(suggestions.users.length > 0
                ? suggestions.users
                : [
                    { _id: "u1", name: "Aarav Deshmukh", username: "aaravd", followersCount: "42.1K" },
                    { _id: "u2", name: "Riya Sharma", username: "riyas", followersCount: "28.5K" },
                    { _id: "u3", name: "Karan Patel", username: "karanp", followersCount: "19.3K" },
                    { _id: "u4", name: "Neha Verma", username: "nehav", followersCount: "35.8K" },
                  ]
              ).map((u) => (
                <div
                  key={u._id}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-white/15 bg-[#070B14]/85 backdrop-blur-xl"
                >
                  <Link
                    to={`/profile/${u._id}`}
                    className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1"
                  >
                    <UserAvatar src={u.avatar} name={u.name} className="w-12 h-12" />
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="font-bold text-sm text-white truncate">{u.name}</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-white/50 truncate">
                        @{u.username || "creator"}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#00F2FE] mt-0.5">
                        {u.followersCount || `${u.followers?.length || 12} followers`}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Link>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      playSound("pop");
                    }}
                    className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-md hover:scale-105 transition-transform"
                    style={{
                      background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${currentTheme.color}, ${currentTheme.accent})`,
                    }}
                  >
                    Follow
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : activeCategory === "Places" ? (
          /* ===================================================================
              PLACES VIEW (When "📍 Places" tab is selected)
              =================================================================== */
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white/70">
              Trending Destinations & Spots
            </h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {TRENDING_PLACES.map((place, idx) => (
                <div
                  key={idx}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setQuery(place.name.split(",")[0]);
                  }}
                  className="group relative h-40 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-white/15 cursor-pointer shadow-lg"
                >
                  <img
                    src={place.img}
                    alt={place.name}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-110"
                  />
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/85 via-black/30 to-transparent flex flex-col justify-end p-3.5">
                    <span className="font-bold text-white text-sm drop-shadow">
                      {place.name}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-white/70 font-medium">
                      {place.count}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* ===================================================================
              MOSAIC MASONRY GRID (Screen 2: For You / Trending)
              Staggered 2-column on mobile, 3-4 column on desktop
              =================================================================== */
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {activeCategory === "Trending" && (
              <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pb-1">
                {[
                  { tag: "#IndiaTechSummit", count: "142K posts" },
                  { tag: "#MumbaiRains", count: "98K posts" },
                  { tag: "#AIRevolution", count: "276K posts" },
                  { tag: "#CreatorEconomy", count: "64K posts" },
                ].map((item, idx) => (
                  <button
                    key={idx}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setQuery(item.tag)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap px-3.5 py-2 rounded-2xl bg-white/[0.04] border border-white/10 hover:border-white/25 text-xs text-white transition-all cursor-pointer group shrink-0"
                  >
                    <span className="font-bold text-[#38BDF8]">{item.tag}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-[#CBD5E1]/60">{item.count}</span>
                    <span className="text-[#10B981] text-xs font-bold transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-0.5 group-hover:-translate-y-0.5">↗</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 sm:gap-3.5">
            {mosaicPieces.map((piece, idx) => {
              const img = piece.image || piece.images?.[0] || piece.mediaUrl;
              const isVideo = piece.isVideo;
              const viewCount = piece.viewCount;
              const isCarousel = piece.isCarousel;
              const isTall = piece.aspect === "tall" || idx % 3 === 0;

              return (
                <div
                  key={piece._id || idx}
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (piece._id?.startsWith("exp")) {
                      if (isVideo) {
                        navigate("/reels");
                      }
                    } else {
                      navigate(`/post/${piece._id}`);
                    }
                  }}
                  className={`group relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-[#070B14] border border-white/10 cursor-pointer shadow-md hover:border-white/30 transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isTall ? "row-span-2 aspect-[4/5] sm:aspect-[3/4]" : "aspect-square"
                  }`}
                >
                  <img
                    src={getImageUrl(img, "feed")}
                    alt="Explore piece"
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-105"
                    loading="lazy"
                  />

                  {/* Stacked Carousel Icon (Top Right, Screen 2) */}
                  {isCarousel && (
                    <div className="absolute top-2.5 right-2.5 p-1 rounded-md bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md text-white/90 shadow-md">
                      <IoCopyOutline size={14} />
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Video Play Badge (Bottom Left, Screen 2: ▷ 1.2M / ▷ 432K) */}
                  {isVideo && viewCount && (
                    <div className="absolute bottom-2.5 left-2.5 flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-white font-bold text-[11px] shadow-lg">
                      <IoPlay size={11} className="text-white" />
                      <span>{viewCount}</span>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Hover Overlay with Creator & Reactions */}
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/85 via-black/20 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200 flex flex-col justify-end p-3.5">
                    {piece.user && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
                        <UserAvatar
                          src={piece.user.avatar}
                          name={piece.user.name}
                          className="w-6 h-6 border border-white/30"
                        />
                        <span className="text-white text-xs font-semibold truncate">
                          {piece.user.name}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-white text-xs font-bold">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[#FF6B8A]">
                        <IoHeart size={12} /> {piece.likes || piece.likesCount || 0}
                      </span>
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[#00F2FE]">
                        <IoChatbubble size={11} /> {piece.comments || piece.commentsCount || 0}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import LazyImage from '../../components/ui/LazyImage';
import { getImageUrl } from '../../utils/imageUtils';

export default function MasonryGrid({ posts }) {
  if (!posts || posts.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="columns-2 md:columns-3 lg:columns-4 gap-4 space-y-4">
      {posts.map((post) => (
        <Link 
          to={`/post/${post._id}`} 
          key={post._id} 
          className="block break-inside-avoid group relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 mb-4 hover:border-white/20 hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(29,78,216,0.25)] transition-all duration-300 backdrop-blur-xl"
        >
          {post.images?.[0] ? (
            <LazyImage src={getImageUrl(post.images[0], 'feed')} className="w-full h-auto object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500" />
          ) : post.videos?.[0] ? (
            <video src={getImageUrl(post.videos[0])} className="w-full h-auto object-cover" muted loop onMouseOver={e=>e.target.play()} onMouseOut={e=>e.target.pause()} />
          ) : (
            <div className="p-6 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] text-center bg-[#171A26]/80 leading-relaxed">{post.content}</div>
          )}
          
          {/* Hover Overlay */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-black/20 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-end p-4">
            <div className="text-[#F7F7FC] text-xs font-semibold flex gap-3">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[#FF6B8A]">❤️ {post.likes?.length || 0}</span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[#00F2FE]">💬 {post.comments?.length || 0}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Link>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/pages/explore/SearchAdvanced.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { FaSearch, FaHashtag, FaUsers, FaCompass } from 'react-icons/fa';
import UserAvatar from '../../components/ui/UserAvatar';

export default function SearchAdvanced() {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [out, setOut] = useState(null);

  const go = async (e) => { 
    e.preventDefault(); 
    try {
      const res = await API.get(`/search/global?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`);
      const payload = res.data?.data || res.data;
      setOut(payload);
    } catch (_) {
      setOut({ users: [], posts: [], hashtags: [] });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 pb-24">
      <div className="mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-white/10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#00F2FE] mb-1">
          <FaCompass /> Universal Search
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-tight font-display">
          Deep Network Index<span className="text-[#00F2FE]">.</span>
        </h1>
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={go} className="flex gap-3 mb-6">
        <div className="relative flex-1">
          <FaSearch className="absolute left-4 top-3.5 text-[#A5A9BB]" size={14} />
          <input 
            value={q} 
            onChange={e => setQ(e.target.value)} 
            className="w-full pl-11 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 transition backdrop-blur-xl" 
            placeholder="Search profiles, broadcasts, and #hashtags..."
          />
        </div>
        <button className="px-6 py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37] text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-lg hover:opacity-95 transition">
          Search
        </button>
      </form>

      {out && (
        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mt-6 animate-fade-in">
          {/* Users column */}
          <div className="p-5 bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl">
            <div className="font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[#D4AF37] mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
              <FaUsers /> People ({out.users?.length || 0})
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {out.users?.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] py-4">No profiles found</div>
              ) : out.users?.map(u => (
                <Link to={`/profile/${u._id}`} key={u._id} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 rounded-2xl hover:bg-white/5 transition">
                  <UserAvatar src={u.avatar} name={u.name} className="w-9 h-9 border border-white/10" />
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="font-bold text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] truncate">{u.name}</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-[#A5A9BB] truncate">@{u.username || 'creator'}</div>
                  </div>
                </Link>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Posts column */}
          <div className="p-5 bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl md:col-span-2">
            <div className="font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[#00F2FE] mb-4">
              Broadcast Matches ({out.posts?.length || 0})
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {out.posts?.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] py-4">No matching posts found</div>
              ) : out.posts?.map(p => (
                <div key={p._id} className="p-3.5 bg-[#171A26]/80 border border-white/5 rounded-2xl">
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] mb-1">{p.user?.name || 'Creator'}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] leading-relaxed line-clamp-2">{p.content}</div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {out?.hashtags && out.hashtags.length > 0 && (
        <div className="p-5 mt-6 bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl">
          <div className="font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[#D4AF37] mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
            <FaHashtag /> Related Tags
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {out.hashtags.map(h => (
              <Link 
                to={`/tag/${h}`} 
                key={h} 
                className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#171A26] border border-white/10 text-xs font-bold text-[#00F2FE] hover:border-[#00F2FE]/40 hover:bg-[#00F2FE]/10 transition"
              >
                #{h}
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
