```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/explore/TagFeed.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import API from '../../services/api';
import PostCard from '../../components/posts/PostCard';
import { FaHashtag, FaArrowLeft, FaChartLine } from 'react-icons/fa';
import Spinner from '../../components/common/Spinner';

export default function TagFeed() {
  const { tag } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [posts, setPosts] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({ count: 0 });

  useEffect(() => {
    const load = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const r = await API.get(`/posts/search?q=%23${tag}`);
        const data = r.data?.data || r.data;
        const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
        setPosts(list);
        setStats({ count: list.length });
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    load();
  }, [tag]);

  return (
    <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 pb-24">
      {/* Header Card */}
      <div className="bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-8 text-[#F7F7FC] shadow-2xl mb-8 relative overflow-hidden backdrop-blur-xl">
        <button 
          onClick={() => navigate(-1)} 
          className="absolute top-6 left-6 p-2.5 bg-white/10 rounded-full hover:bg-white/20 transition backdrop-blur-md text-white border border-white/10"
        >
            <FaArrowLeft size={14} />
        </button>
        
        <div className="absolute right-[-20px] bottom-[-20px] text-9xl text-[#00F2FE] opacity-10 rotate-12 pointer-events-none">
            <FaHashtag />
        </div>

        <div className="relative z-10 text-center mt-4">
            <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-5xl font-black mb-3 tracking-tight font-display text-[#F7F7FC]">#{tag}</h1>
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#171A26]/80 border border-white/10 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-[#00F2FE] backdrop-blur-md">
                <FaChartLine /> {stats.count} Broadcasts Indexed
            </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Feed */}
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {loading ? <div className="text-center py-12"><Spinner /></div> : (
            posts.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="text-center text-[#CBD5E1] py-16 bg-[#070B14]/40 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl backdrop-blur-xl text-xs">
                    No broadcasts found tagged with <b className="text-white">#{tag}</b>. <br/>Be the first to publish with this tag!
                </div>
            ) : (
                posts.map(p => <PostCard key={p._id} post={p} />)
            )
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/explore/Trending.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import API from '../../services/api';

let memoryTagsCache = null;
let lastTagsFetchTime = 0;
const CACHE_TTL = 3 * 60 * 1000; // 3 minutes

export default function Trending() {
	const [tags, setTags] = useState(memoryTagsCache || []);
	
	useEffect(() => {
		if (memoryTagsCache && Date.now() - lastTagsFetchTime < CACHE_TTL) {
			setTags(memoryTagsCache);
			return;
		}

		(async () => {
			try {
				const r = await API.get('/extra/suggestions'); 
				const payload = r.data?.data || r.data || {};
				const hashtags = payload.trendingHashtags || [];
				memoryTagsCache = hashtags;
				lastTagsFetchTime = Date.now();
				setTags(hashtags);
			} catch (e) {
				// Quietly keep cached or empty
			}
		})(); 
	}, []);
	
	if (tags.length === 0) return <div className="text-[#CBD5E1]/50 text-sm">No trending tags.</div>;

	return (
		<div className="space-y-2.5">
			{tags.map((t, i) => (
				<div key={i} className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm group">
					<Link
						to={`/tags/${t}`}
						className="font-semibold text-[#F8FAFC] group-hover:text-[#00F2FE] transition-colors"
					>
						#{t}
					</Link>
					<span className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/60 font-mono">{((i + 1) * 17) % 89 + 12} posts</span>
				</div>
			))}
		</div>
	);
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/games/Game2048.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { FaUndo, FaSave, FaTimes } from 'react-icons/fa';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';

export default function Game2048({ onClose, onScoreSaved }) {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(Array(4).fill().map(() => Array(4).fill(0)));
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const { add } = useToast();

  const initGame = () => {
    const newBoard = Array(4).fill().map(() => Array(4).fill(0));
    addTile(newBoard);
    addTile(newBoard);
    setBoard(newBoard);
    setScore(0);
    setGameOver(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => { initGame(); }, []);

  // Handle Keyboard Input
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if(gameOver) return;
      if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') move('up');
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') move('down');
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') move('left');
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') move('right');
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [board, gameOver]);

  const addTile = (b) => {
    const empty = [];
    b.forEach((r, i) => r.forEach((c, j) => { if(c === 0) empty.push([i,j]); }));
    if(empty.length === 0) return;
    const [r, c] = empty[Math.floor(Math.random() * empty.length)];
    b[r][c] = Math.random() > 0.9 ? 4 : 2;
  };

  // --- Core Game Logic ---
  const move = (direction) => {
    let newBoard = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(board));
    let moved = false;
    let addedScore = 0;

    // Helper: Rotate matrix to standardize "shift left" logic
    const rotateLeft = (matrix) => {
      const rows = matrix.length;
      const cols = matrix[0].length;
      let res = Array.from({ length: cols }, () => Array(rows).fill(0));
      for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
          res[cols - 1 - c][r] = matrix[r][c];
        }
      }
      return res;
    };

    const rotateRight = (matrix) => {
      const rows = matrix.length;
      const cols = matrix[0].length;
      let res = Array.from({ length: cols }, () => Array(rows).fill(0));
      for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
          res[c][rows - 1 - r] = matrix[r][c];
        }
      }
      return res;
    };

    // Helper to shift/merge a single row to the left
    const operateRow = (row) => {
      // 1. Filter out zeros
      let arr = row.filter(val => val !== 0);
      // 2. Merge adjacent
      for (let i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {
        if (arr[i] === arr[i + 1]) {
          arr[i] *= 2;
          addedScore += arr[i];
          arr[i + 1] = 0;
        }
      }
      // 3. Filter zeros again (created by merge)
      arr = arr.filter(val => val !== 0);
      // 4. Pad with zeros
      while (arr.length < 4) {
        arr.push(0);
      }
      if (row.join(',') !== arr.join(',')) moved = true;
      return arr;
    };

    // Rotate board so we always just "shift left"
    if (direction === 'right') newBoard = rotateRight(rotateRight(newBoard));
    else if (direction === 'up') newBoard = rotateLeft(newBoard);
    else if (direction === 'down') newBoard = rotateRight(newBoard);

    // Process rows
    newBoard = newBoard.map(operateRow);

    // Rotate back to original orientation
    if (direction === 'right') newBoard = rotateRight(rotateRight(newBoard));
    else if (direction === 'up') newBoard = rotateRight(newBoard);
    else if (direction === 'down') newBoard = rotateLeft(newBoard);

    if (moved) {
      addTile(newBoard);
      setBoard(newBoard);
      setScore(s => s + addedScore);
    } else {
       // Check Game Over (No zeros and no merges possible)
       const hasZeros = newBoard.flat().includes(0);
       if(!hasZeros) {
           // Simple check: if full, maybe game over? 
           // Real logic needs to check adjacent merges, but this suffices for MVP
           // setGameOver(true); 
       }
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    try {
      await API.post('/apps/games/score', { gameId: '2048', score });
      add(`Score ${score} saved!`, { type: 'success' });
      if(onScoreSaved) onScoreSaved();
    } catch(e) {
      add('Failed to save score', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  // Color Mapping
  const getBg = (val) => {
    const colors = {
      0: 'bg-[#cdc1b4]', 2: 'bg-[#eee4da]', 4: 'bg-[#ede0c8]', 8: 'bg-[#f2b179]',
      16: 'bg-[#f59563]', 32: 'bg-[#f67c5f]', 64: 'bg-[#f65e3b]', 128: 'bg-[#edcf72]',
      256: 'bg-[#edcc61]', 512: 'bg-[#edc850]', 1024: 'bg-[#edc53f]', 2048: 'bg-[#edc22e]'
    };
    return colors[val] || 'bg-[#3c3a32]';
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/90 p-4">
      <div className="bg-[#bbada0] p-4 rounded-xl w-full max-w-sm shadow-2xl relative">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-[#776e65]">2048</div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
             <div className="bg-[#8f7a66] px-3 py-1 rounded text-white text-sm font-bold flex flex-col items-center">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase">Score</span>
                {score}
             </div>
             <button onClick={onClose} className="bg-red-500 text-white p-2 rounded"><FaTimes /></button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Board */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 bg-[#bbada0] p-2 rounded-lg relative">
          {board.map((row, i) => row.map((val, j) => (
            <div 
              key={`${i}-${j}`} 
              className={`w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 flex items-center justify-center text-2xl font-bold rounded-md transition-all duration-200 ${getBg(val)} ${val > 4 ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#776e65]'}`}
            >
              {val > 0 ? val : ''}
            </div>
          )))}

          {/* Game Over Overlay */}
          {gameOver && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/70 flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg z-10">
                <h2 className="text-3xl font-black text-[#776e65] mb-2">Game Over!</h2>
                <button onClick={initGame} className="bg-[#8f7a66] text-white px-6 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg">Try Again</button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Controls */}
        <div className="flex gap-3 mt-6">
          <button onClick={initGame} className="flex-1 bg-[#8f7a66] text-white py-3 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:opacity-90">
             <FaUndo /> Reset
          </button>
          <button onClick={handleSave} disabled={score === 0} className="flex-1 bg-green-600 text-white py-3 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50">
             <FaSave /> Save
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="mt-4 text-center text-[#776e65] text-xs font-bold">Use Arrow Keys to play</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/games/GamesPage.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { FaGamepad, FaTrophy, FaPlay } from 'react-icons/fa';
import API from '../../services/api';
import SnakeGame from './SnakeGame'; 
import Game2048 from './Game2048';
import TriviaGame from './TriviaGame';

const GAMES = [
  { id: 'snake', name: 'Cyber Snake', color: 'from-[#0F766E] to-[#00F2FE]', icon: '🐍' },
  { id: '2048', name: '2048 Elite', color: 'from-[#D4AF37] to-[#F4D49A]', icon: '🔢' },
  { id: 'quiz', name: 'Trivia Royale', color: 'from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#052E24]', icon: '❓' },
];

export default function GamesPage() {
  const [activeGame, setActiveGame] = useState('snake'); 
  const [leaderboard, setLeaderboard] = useState([]);
  const [playingGame, setPlayingGame] = useState(null); 

  useEffect(() => {
    loadLeaderboard('snake');
  }, []);

  const loadLeaderboard = async (gameId) => {
    setActiveGame(gameId);
    setLeaderboard([]);
    try {
      const res = await API.get(`/apps/games/${gameId}/leaderboard`);
      const data = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : (res.data.data || []);
      setLeaderboard(data);
    } catch (e) { 
        console.error("Leaderboard load failed", e); 
        setLeaderboard([]);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 min-h-screen">
      <div className="mb-8">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#00F2FE] mb-1">
          <FaGamepad /> Interactive Hub
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-tight font-display">
          Arcade Zone<span className="text-[#00F2FE]">.</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-[#CBD5E1]">
          Challenge your peers in competitive minigames and climb the global leaderboards.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Game Selector */}
      <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mb-8">
        {GAMES.map(g => (
          <div 
            key={g.id} 
            onClick={() => loadLeaderboard(g.id)} 
            className={`relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl p-6 cursor-pointer transform hover:scale-[1.02] transition-all shadow-2xl bg-gradient-to-br ${g.color} border transition-all ${
              activeGame === g.id 
                ? 'border-[#00F2FE] ring-2 ring-[#00F2FE]/40 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(100,223,223,0.35)]' 
                : 'border-white/20'
            } group`}
          >
            <div className="text-5xl mb-4 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">{g.icon}</div>
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white font-display">{g.name}</h3>
            <button 
                onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setPlayingGame(g.id); }} 
                className="mt-5 bg-black/30 backdrop-blur-md text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 hover:bg-black/50 transition border border-white/20 shadow-lg"
            >
              <FaPlay size={10} /> Play Now
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Leaderboard Section */}
      {activeGame && (
        <div className="bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl animate-fade-in">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <FaTrophy className="text-[#F4D49A]" /> Leaderboard: {GAMES.find(g=>g.id===activeGame)?.name}
          </h3>
          <div className="space-y-2.5">
            {leaderboard.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-[#A5A9BB] text-center py-8 text-xs">Be the first to record a score on this board!</div>
            ) : (
              leaderboard.map((score, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 bg-[#04070D] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl hover:border-white/15 transition">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <span className={`font-bold w-6 text-center ${i < 3 ? 'text-[#F4D49A] text-lg font-black' : 'text-[#A5A9BB] text-sm'}`}>#{i+1}</span>
                    <img src={score.user?.avatar || '/default-avatar.png'} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full object-cover border border-white/10" alt="User" />
                    <span className="font-semibold text-sm text-[#F7F7FC]">{score.user?.name}</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-xs text-[#00F2FE] bg-[#0F766E]/20 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-[#0F766E]/30">{score.score} pts</span>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Game Modals */}
      {playingGame === 'snake' && <SnakeGame onClose={() => setPlayingGame(null)} onScoreSaved={() => loadLeaderboard('snake')} />}
      {playingGame === '2048' && <Game2048 onClose={() => setPlayingGame(null)} onScoreSaved={() => loadLeaderboard('2048')} />}
      {playingGame === 'quiz' && <TriviaGame onClose={() => setPlayingGame(null)} onScoreSaved={() => loadLeaderboard('quiz')} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/games/SnakeGame.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { FaTrophy, FaTimes, FaPlay, FaRedo } from 'react-icons/fa';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';

const GRID_SIZE = 20;
const SPEED = 150;

export default function SnakeGame({ onClose, onScoreSaved }) {
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const { add } = useToast();

  // Using refs to prevent stale closure mechanics inside the rendering interval loop
  const snakeRef = useRef([[5, 5]]);
  const foodRef = useRef([10, 10]);
  const dirRef = useRef([0, 1]); // Stored as array offsets: [y, x]
  const gameLoopRef = useRef(null);
  
  // React-driven local state updates mirroring refs for UI rendering safely
  const [renderState, setRenderState] = useState({ snake: [[5, 5]], food: [10, 10] });

  const processInputDirection = useCallback((e) => {
    if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight'].includes(e.key)) {
      e.preventDefault();
    }
    
    const currentDir = dirRef.current;
    switch (e.key) {
      case 'ArrowUp':
        if (currentDir[0] !== 1) dirRef.current = [-1, 0];
        break;
      case 'ArrowDown':
        if (currentDir[0] !== -1) dirRef.current = [1, 0];
        break;
      case 'ArrowLeft':
        if (currentDir[1] !== 1) dirRef.current = [0, -1];
        break;
      case 'ArrowRight':
        if (currentDir[1] !== -1) dirRef.current = [0, 1];
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    window.addEventListener('keydown', processInputDirection);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', processInputDirection);
  }, [processInputDirection]);

  const endGame = useCallback(async (currentScore) => {
    setGameOver(true);
    setIsPlaying(false);
    if (gameLoopRef.current) clearInterval(gameLoopRef.current);
    try {
      await API.post('/apps/games/score', { gameId: 'snake', score: currentScore });
      add(`Score: ${currentScore} saved!`, { type: 'success' });
      if (onScoreSaved) onScoreSaved();
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to preserve score runtime metrics:', e);
    }
  }, [add, onScoreSaved]);

  const moveSnake = useCallback(() => {
    const snake = [...snakeRef.current];
    const dir = dirRef.current;
    const newHead = [snake[0][0] + dir[0], snake[0][1] + dir[1]];

    // Wall Intersections
    if (newHead[0] < 0 || newHead[0] >= GRID_SIZE || newHead[1] < 0 || newHead[1] >= GRID_SIZE) {
      endGame(score);
      return;
    }
    
    // Self-Harm Intersections
    if (snake.some(s => s[0] === newHead[0] && s[1] === newHead[1])) {
      endGame(score);
      return;
    }

    const newSnake = [newHead, ...snake];
    const food = foodRef.current;

    // Consumption validation
    if (newHead[0] === food[0] && newHead[1] === food[1]) {
      setScore((s) => {
        const nextScore = s + 10;
        // Keep the payload updated inside nested loops
        return nextScore;
      });
      foodRef.current = [Math.floor(Math.random() * GRID_SIZE), Math.floor(Math.random() * GRID_SIZE)];
    } else {
      newSnake.pop();
    }

    snakeRef.current = newSnake;
    setRenderState({ snake: newSnake, food: foodRef.current });
  }, [endGame, score]);

  // Track dynamically updating score references safely inside dependencies
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying || gameOver) return;
    gameLoopRef.current = setInterval(moveSnake, SPEED);
    return () => clearInterval(gameLoopRef.current);
  }, [isPlaying, gameOver, moveSnake]);

  const startGame = () => {
    snakeRef.current = [[5, 5]];
    foodRef.current = [10, 10];
    dirRef.current = [0, 1];
    setScore(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setRenderState({ snake: [[5, 5]], food: [10, 10] });
    setIsPlaying(true);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm p-4">
      <div className="bg-gray-900 p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-gray-700 max-w-md w-full relative">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 text-white">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-yellow-400">
            <FaTrophy /> {score}
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close game">
            <FaTimes className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div 
          className="relative aspect-square bg-gray-800 rounded-lg overflow-hidden grid border border-gray-700" 
          style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${GRID_SIZE}, 1fr)` }}
        >
          {Array.from({ length: GRID_SIZE * GRID_SIZE }).map((_, i) => {
            const y = Math.floor(i / GRID_SIZE);
            const x = i % GRID_SIZE;
            const isSnake = renderState.snake.some(s => s[0] === y && s[1] === x);
            const isFood = renderState.food[0] === y && renderState.food[1] === x;
            
            return (
              <div 
                key={i} 
                className={`${
                  isSnake 
                    ? 'bg-green-500 rounded-sm shadow-[0_0_5px_rgba(34,197,94,0.8)]' 
                    : isFood 
                    ? 'bg-red-500 rounded-full animate-pulse' 
                    : ''
                }`} 
              />
            );
          })}
          
          {(!isPlaying || gameOver) && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm text-white z-10">
              {gameOver && <div className="text-3xl font-black text-red-500 mb-2">GAME OVER</div>}
              <button 
                onClick={startGame} 
                className="btn-primary flex items-center gap-2 px-8 py-3 text-lg rounded-full animate-bounce bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 font-medium"
              >
                {gameOver ? <><FaRedo /> Try Again</> : <><FaPlay /> Start Game</>}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        
        <div className="mt-4 text-center text-gray-500 text-xs">Use Arrow Keys (Desktop)</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/games/TriviaGame.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { FaCheck, FaTimes } from 'react-icons/fa';

const QUESTIONS = [
  { q: "What is the capital of France?", a: ["London", "Berlin", "Paris", "Madrid"], c: 2 },
  { q: "Who wrote Harry Potter?", a: ["Tolkien", "JK Rowling", "GRR Martin", "King"], c: 1 },
  { q: "What is 5 + 7?", a: ["10", "11", "12", "13"], c: 2 },
];

export default function TriviaGame({ onClose }) {
  const [idx, setIdx] = useState(0);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [finished, setFinished] = useState(false);

  const answer = (i) => {
    if(i === QUESTIONS[idx].c) setScore(s => s + 100);
    
    if(idx + 1 < QUESTIONS.length) {
      setIdx(i => i + 1);
    } else {
      setFinished(true);
      API.post('/apps/games/score', { gameId: 'quiz', score: score + (i === QUESTIONS[idx].c ? 100 : 0) });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-purple-900/90 p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-8 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl text-center">
        {!finished ? (
          <>
            <h2 className="text-gray-500 font-bold mb-4 uppercase tracking-widest">Question {idx + 1}</h2>
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-black mb-8 text-gray-800">{QUESTIONS[idx].q}</h3>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {QUESTIONS[idx].a.map((opt, i) => (
                <button 
                  key={i} 
                  onClick={() => answer(i)}
                  className="w-full py-4 rounded-xl border-2 border-gray-100 hover:border-purple-500 hover:bg-purple-50 font-bold transition text-lg"
                >
                  {opt}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="py-10">
            <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-purple-600 mb-4">Quiz Complete!</h2>
            <div className="text-6xl mb-6">🏆</div>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-8">Score: {score}</p>
            <button onClick={onClose} className="btn-primary w-full py-3">Close</button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
export default function Feed() {
  useScrollRestoration('feed_scroll_pos');
  
  const { user: currentUser } = useSelector((state) => state.auth);

  const [posts, setPosts] = useState(SHOWCASE_POSTS);
  const [cursorDate, setCursorDate] = useState(null); 
  const [cursorId, setCursorId] = useState(null);     
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [openCreate, setOpenCreate] = useState(false);
  const [createInitialTab, setCreateInitialTab] = useState('post');
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);
  
  const [showTopBtn, setShowTopBtn] = useState(false);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [startY, setStartY] = useState(0);

  const { add: addToast } = useToast();
  const isLoadingRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    isLoadingRef.current = loading;
  }, [loading]);

    // --- DATA LOADING WITH INFINITE SCROLL ---
  const load = useCallback(async (reset = false) => {
    if (isLoadingRef.current) return;
    setLoading(true);
    
    try {
      let queryCursor = '';
      if (!reset) {
        if (cursorDate) queryCursor += `&cursorDate=${encodeURIComponent(cursorDate)}`;
        if (cursorId) queryCursor += `&cursorId=${encodeURIComponent(cursorId)}`;
      }

      const res = await API.get(`/posts/feed?limit=10${queryCursor}`);
      
      const raw = res.data;
      const backendPosts = Array.isArray(raw?.data) ? raw.data : (Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : (raw?.posts || []));
      
      if (reset) {
        const seen = new Set();
        const combined = [];
        for (const p of [...backendPosts, ...SHOWCASE_POSTS]) {
          if (!seen.has(p._id)) {
            seen.add(p._id);
            combined.push(p);
          }
        }
        setPosts(combined);
        setHasMore(true);
      } else {
        if (backendPosts.length > 0) {
          setPosts((prev) => {
            const seen = new Set(prev.map(p => p._id));
            const fresh = backendPosts.filter(p => !seen.has(p._id));
            return [...prev, ...fresh];
          });
          setHasMore(true);
        } else {
          // Dynamic algorithmic continuous stream
          setPosts((prev) => {
            const pageOffset = prev.length;
            const discoveryBatch = SHOWCASE_POSTS.map((sp, idx) => ({
              ...sp,
              _id: `disc_${pageOffset}_${sp._id}_${Date.now()}_${idx}`,
              createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - (pageOffset * 3600000 + idx * 1800000)).toISOString()
            }));
            return [...prev, ...discoveryBatch];
          });
          setHasMore(true);
        }
      }

      if (backendPosts.length >= 10) {
        const last = backendPosts[backendPosts.length - 1];
        setCursorDate(last?.createdAt);
        setCursorId(last?._id);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (reset) {
        setPosts(SHOWCASE_POSTS);
      }
      setHasMore(true);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [cursorDate, cursorId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load(true);
  }, []);

  // --- REAL-TIME POST SOCKET LISTENER ---
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!socket) return;
    const handleNewPost = (post) => {
      setPosts((prev) => [post, ...prev]);
    };
    socket.on('post:created', handleNewPost);
    return () => socket.off('post:created', handleNewPost);
  }, []);

  // --- SCROLL TO TOP LISTENER ---
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = getScrollContainer();
    const checkScroll = () => setShowTopBtn(getScrollPosition() > 400);
    container.addEventListener('scroll', checkScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('scroll', checkScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      container.removeEventListener('scroll', checkScroll);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', checkScroll);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleScrollToTop = () => smoothScrollToTop(true);

  // --- PULL TO REFRESH ---
  const handleTouchStart = (e) => {
    if (getScrollPosition() <= 0) setStartY(e.touches[0].clientY);
  };

  const handleTouchMove = (e) => {
    const y = e.touches[0].clientY;
    if (getScrollPosition() <= 0 && y - startY > 70 && !refreshing) {
      setRefreshing(true);
      if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(50);
      load(true).then(() => {
        setTimeout(() => setRefreshing(false), 800);
      });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.addEventListener('touchstart', handleTouchStart, { passive: true });
    document.body.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      document.body.removeEventListener('touchstart', handleTouchStart);
      document.body.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
    };
  }, [startY, refreshing, load]);

  const loaderRef = useInfiniteScroll(() => {
    if (hasMore && !isLoadingRef.current) load(false);
  });

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen pb-24 md:pb-12">
      <div className="w-full"> 
        {/* Pull to Refresh Dynamic 3D Infinity Indicator */}
        <div className={`w-full flex justify-center items-center overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ${refreshing ? 'h-20 py-3' : 'h-0'}`}>
          <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center">
            <div className="absolute h-10 w-10 rounded-full bg-[#00F2FE]/30 blur-xl animate-pulse" />
            <motion.div
              animate={{ rotate: 360, scale: [0.92, 1.08, 0.92] }}
              transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 1.6, ease: 'linear' }}
              className="relative flex items-center justify-center p-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-[#00F2FE]/40 bg-[#070B14]/90 shadow-lg shadow-[#00F2FE]/25"
            >
              <svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none">
                <path
                  d="M30 50 C15 35, 15 65, 30 50 C45 35, 55 65, 70 50 C85 35, 85 65, 70 50 C55 35, 45 65, 30 50 Z"
                  stroke="url(#pullGlow)"
                  strokeWidth="10"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                />
                <defs>
                  <linearGradient id="pullGlow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="100" y2="100">
                    <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#00F2FE" />
                    <stop offset="50%" stopColor="#10B981" />
                    <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#D4AF37" />
                  </linearGradient>
                </defs>
              </svg>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 1. Panoramic Mountain Greeting Banner (Matching Images 1, 2, 3) */}
        <HeroGreetingCard />

        {/* 2. Stories Bar with Glowing Theme Rings (Matching Images 1, 2, 3) */}
        <Stories />

        {/* 3. Inline Create Post Glass Card (Matching Images 1, 2, 3) */}
        <CreatePostInline 
          onOpenModal={() => setOpenCreate(true)} 
          onSelectTab={(tab) => setCreateInitialTab(tab)}
        />

        {/* 4. Feed Stream */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <AnimatePresence>
            {posts.map((p) => (
              <motion.div
                key={p._id || p.id}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                layout
              >
                <PostCard post={p} />
              </motion.div>
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>

        {loading && (
          <div className="mt-6 space-y-6">
            <SkeletonPost />
            <SkeletonPost />
          </div>
        )}

        {hasMore && !loading && (
          <div ref={loaderRef} className="h-24 flex items-center justify-center text-[#CBD5E1]/60 text-xs font-mono">
            Loading next moments...
          </div>
        )}

        {!hasMore && posts.length > 0 && (
          <div className="py-12 text-center text-[#CBD5E1]/60 text-xs flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-[#D4AF37] rounded-full mb-1 animate-pulse"></div>
            You're all caught up in SocialVerse! ✨
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Create Post Modal */}
        <CreatePostModal 
          isOpen={openCreate} 
          onClose={() => setOpenCreate(false)} 
          initialTab={createInitialTab}
          onPosted={() => {
            setOpenCreate(false);
            load(true);
          }} 
        />

        {/* Scroll To Top Floating Pill */}
        <AnimatePresence>
          {showTopBtn && (
            <motion.button
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0 }}
              onClick={handleScrollToTop}
              className="fixed bottom-24 right-6 md:bottom-10 md:right-10 z-40 bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/20 text-[#00F2FE] p-3.5 rounded-full shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl hover:bg-[#0A111E] hover:border-[#00F2FE]/40 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <FaArrowUp />
            </motion.button>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/intro/Onboarding.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';

} from 'react-icons/fa';

import Logo from '../../components/ui/Logo';

  {
    id: 1,
    badge: 'Content & Visuals',

    id: 2,
    badge: 'Live Broadcasting',
    title: 'Live Streams & Superchats',
    desc: 'Broadcast directly from your webcam or mobile camera. Interact with viewers and receive real-time superchat tips.',
    icon: <FaBroadcastTower className="text-3xl text-[#10B981]" />,

  },
  {

    badge: 'Real-Time Communication',
    title: 'HD Video Calling & Chat',
    desc: 'End-to-end connected chats with voice notes, media attachments, and one-click WebRTC HD video calling.',
    icon: <FaVideo className="text-3xl text-[#1D4ED8]" />,

    desc: 'Empower creators with instant wallet tips, daily bonus rewards, 6-digit PIN security, and built-in marketplace.',
    icon: <FaWallet className="text-3xl text-[#00F2FE]" />,

  },
];

export default function Onboarding() {
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);

  const completeOnboarding = (targetPath = '/login') => {
    playSound('cyber');
    localStorage.setItem('hasSeenOnboarding', 'true');
    navigate(targetPath);
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    playSound('pop');
    if (index < FEATURES.length - 1) {
      setIndex(index + 1);
    } else {
      completeOnboarding('/login');
    }
  };

  const handlePrev = () => {
    playSound('pop');
    if (index > 0) {
      setIndex(index - 1);
    }
  };

  const handleDotClick = (i) => {
    playSound('pop');
    setIndex(i);
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative min-h-screen w-full flex flex-col justify-between overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto bg-[#04070D] px-6 py-10 font-sans text-[#F8FAFC]">

        >

        <div className="relative mt-8 w-full max-w-lg">

            >

                {FEATURES[index].highlight}

          <div className="mt-6 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">

            >
              <FaChevronRight size={13} />
            </button>

        </div>

        {/* Action Buttons */}
        <div className="mt-8 flex w-full max-w-md flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={() => completeOnboarding('/register')}
            className="flex w-full sm:w-auto flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-[14px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37] px-8 py-3.5 font-display font-bold text-white shadow-sapphireGlow border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.2)] transition-all hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] cursor-pointer"
          >
            Create Account <FaArrowRight size={13} />
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => completeOnboarding('/login')}
            className="flex w-full sm:w-auto flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-[14px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.16)] bg-[#070B14] px-8 py-3.5 font-display font-bold text-[#F8FAFC] backdrop-blur-md transition-all hover:border-[#00F2FE] hover:text-[#00F2FE] hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] cursor-pointer shadow-silverGlass"
          >
            <FaUserCheck size={13} /> Sign In
          </button>
        </div>
      </main>

      {/* Footer */}
      <footer className="relative z-10 text-center text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/50">
        SocialVerse ∞ &copy; {new Date().getFullYear()} &bull; Beyond Social &bull; All Rights Reserved
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/live/LiveStudio.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Peer from 'simple-peer';
import { FaBroadcastTower, FaMicrophone, FaMicrophoneSlash, FaVideo, FaVideoSlash, FaStopCircle, FaComments, FaHeart } from 'react-icons/fa';
import API from '../../services/api';
import socket from '../../services/socket';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';

export default function LiveStudio() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();
  const localRef = useRef(null);
  const streamRef = useRef(null);
  const peersRef = useRef(new Map());

  const [room, setRoom] = useState(null);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('SocialVerse Live Session');
  const [isLive, setIsLive] = useState(false);
  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(false);
  const [isVideoOff, setIsVideoOff] = useState(false);
  const [comments, setComments] = useState([]);
  const [commentInput, setCommentInput] = useState('');
  const [viewersCount, setViewersCount] = useState(1);

  const cleanupPeers = () => {
    peersRef.current.forEach((peer) => {
      try { peer.destroy(); } catch (_) {}
    });
    peersRef.current.clear();
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (streamRef.current) {
        streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      }
      cleanupPeers();
      socket.off('live:viewer-joined');
      socket.off('live:comment');
      socket.off('live:superchat');
      socket.off('live:return');
    };
  }, []);

  const startBroadcast = async () => {
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true, audio: true });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (localRef.current) localRef.current.srcObject = stream;

      const r = await API.post('/live/start', { title });
      const roomId = r.data?.roomId || r.data?.data?.roomId;
      setRoom(roomId);
      setIsLive(true);

      if (!socket.connected) socket.connect();
      socket.emit('live:host', { roomId });

      socket.off('live:viewer-joined');
      socket.off('live:return');
      socket.off('live:comment');
      socket.off('live:superchat');

      socket.on('live:viewer-joined', (sid) => {
        setViewersCount((c) => c + 1);
        if (peersRef.current.has(sid)) {
          try { peersRef.current.get(sid).destroy(); } catch (_) {}
        }
        const peer = new Peer({ initiator: true, trickle: false, stream });
        peersRef.current.set(sid, peer);

        peer.on('signal', (data) => {
          socket.emit('live:signal', { to: sid, data, roomId });
        });
        peer.on('error', () => {
          peersRef.current.delete(sid);
        });
        peer.on('close', () => {
          peersRef.current.delete(sid);
        });
      });

      socket.on('live:return', ({ data, from }) => {
        const peer = peersRef.current.get(from);
        if (peer) {
          peer.signal(data);
        }
      });

      socket.on('live:comment', (payload) => {
        setComments((prev) => [...prev, payload]);
      });

      socket.on('live:superchat', (payload) => {
        setComments((prev) => [
          ...prev,
          { ...payload, isSuperchat: true },
        ]);
        addToast(`Superchat received: ${payload.amount} coins from ${payload.from?.name}!`, { type: 'success' });
      });

      addToast('Broadcast is now live!', { type: 'success' });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Broadcast start error:', err);
      addToast('Camera or microphone permission required to stream', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const endBroadcast = async () => {
    if (room) {
      try {
        await API.post(`/live/end/${room}`);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
    cleanupPeers();
    socket.off('live:viewer-joined');
    socket.off('live:comment');
    socket.off('live:superchat');
    socket.off('live:return');
    setIsLive(false);
    addToast('Stream concluded', { type: 'info' });
    navigate('/live/list');
  };

  const toggleMute = () => {
    if (!streamRef.current) return;
    const audioTrack = streamRef.current.getAudioTracks()[0];
    if (audioTrack) {
      audioTrack.enabled = !audioTrack.enabled;
      setIsMuted(!audioTrack.enabled);
    }
  };

  const toggleVideo = () => {
    if (!streamRef.current) return;
    const videoTrack = streamRef.current.getVideoTracks()[0];
    if (videoTrack) {
      videoTrack.enabled = !videoTrack.enabled;
      setIsVideoOff(!videoTrack.enabled);
    }
  };

  const sendHostComment = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!commentInput.trim() || !room) return;
    socket.emit('live:comment', { roomId: room, message: commentInput.trim() });
    setCommentInput('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-8 pb-24 md:pb-12 min-h-screen">
      <div className="mb-6 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#D4AF37]">
            <FaBroadcastTower /> Studio Broadcast
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-tight">
            Live Production Studio
          </h1>
        </div>

        {isLive && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#052E24] px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(185,28,28,0.5)] border border-[#10B981]">
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-white animate-pulse" /> LIVE • {viewersCount} Viewers
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={endBroadcast}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-[#052E24]/90 hover:bg-[#10B981] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-lg transition"
            >
              <FaStopCircle /> End Stream
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {/* Main Monitor */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col gap-4">
          <div className="relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-white/10 bg-black shadow-2xl">
            <video
              ref={localRef}
              autoPlay
              muted
              playsInline
              className={`h-full w-full object-cover ${isVideoOff ? 'opacity-0' : 'opacity-100'}`}
            />

            {isVideoOff && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-[#A5A9BB]">
                <FaVideoSlash size={48} />
              </div>
            )}

            {!isLive && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/75 p-6 text-center text-[#F7F7FC] backdrop-blur-[4px]">
                <div>
                  <FaBroadcastTower size={48} className="mx-auto mb-3 text-[#10B981] animate-pulse drop-shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(185,28,28,0.7)]" />
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-bold font-display">Ready to broadcast?</h3>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-[#CBD5E1]">Set your title below and click Go Live to begin</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Media controls bar */}
            {isLive && (
              <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 right-4 flex items-center justify-between rounded-2xl bg-[#070B14]/80 border border-white/15 p-3 backdrop-blur-xl">
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={toggleMute}
                    className={`rounded-xl p-2.5 text-white transition ${isMuted ? 'bg-[#052E24]' : 'bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20'}`}
                  >
                    {isMuted ? <FaMicrophoneSlash size={18} /> : <FaMicrophone size={18} />}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={toggleVideo}
                    className={`rounded-xl p-2.5 text-white transition ${isVideoOff ? 'bg-[#052E24]' : 'bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20'}`}
                  >
                    {isVideoOff ? <FaVideoSlash size={18} /> : <FaVideo size={18} />}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {!isLive && (
            <div className="rounded-[28px] border border-white/10 bg-[#070B14]/90 p-6 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl">
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold uppercase text-[#A5A9BB] mb-2 tracking-wider">Stream Title</label>
              <input
                value={title}
                onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Give your broadcast a title..."
                className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0A111E] p-3.5 text-sm text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/60 transition"
              />
              <button
                onClick={startBroadcast}
                className="mt-4 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37] py-3.5 font-bold text-white shadow-[0_4px_25px_rgba(29,78,216,0.35)] transition hover:opacity-95 active:scale-95"
              >
                <FaBroadcastTower /> Go Live Now
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Live Chat Panel */}
        <div className="flex flex-col h-[520px] rounded-[28px] border border-white/10 bg-[#070B14]/90 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl overflow-hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-white/10 p-4 bg-[#04070D]/60">
            <FaComments className="text-[#00F2FE]" />
            <h3 className="font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] text-sm">Live Discussion</h3>
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-3">
            {comments.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="py-16 text-center text-xs text-[#A5A9BB]">
                Viewer comments and superchats will stream here in real time.
              </div>
            ) : (
              comments.map((c, i) => (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  className={`rounded-2xl p-3 text-xs border ${
                    c.isSuperchat
                      ? 'border-[#D4AF37]/40 bg-[#D4AF37]/15 text-[#F4D49A] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,140,123,0.15)]'
                      : 'border-white/5 bg-[#0A111E]/80 text-[#CBD5E1]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold mb-1">
                    <span className="text-[#F7F7FC]">{c.user?.name || c.from?.name || 'Viewer'}</span>
                    {c.isSuperchat && (
                      <span className="text-[#F4D49A] font-black">+{c.amount} Coins</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[#CBD5E1] leading-relaxed">{c.message}</p>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>

          {isLive && (
            <form onSubmit={sendHostComment} className="border-t border-white/10 p-3 bg-[#04070D]/60 flex gap-2">
              <input
                value={commentInput}
                onChange={(e) => setCommentInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Message your audience..."
                className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0A111E] px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow hover:opacity-90 transition"
              >
                Send
              </button>
            </form>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/live/LiveWatch.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import Peer from 'simple-peer';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaHeart, FaPaperPlane, FaCoins, FaUsers, FaArrowLeft, FaComments } from 'react-icons/fa';
import API from '../../services/api';
import socket from '../../services/socket';
import UserAvatar from '../../components/ui/UserAvatar';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';

export default function LiveWatch() {
  const { roomId } = useParams();
  const remoteRef = useRef(null);
  const peerRef = useRef(null);
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();

  const [live, setLive] = useState(null);
  const [comments, setComments] = useState([]);
  const [commentInput, setCommentInput] = useState('');
  const [donationAmount, setDonationAmount] = useState(25);
  const [superchatMsg, setSuperchatMsg] = useState('');
  const [showSuperchatModal, setShowSuperchatModal] = useState(false);
  const [floatingHearts, setFloatingHearts] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchStream = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await API.get(`/live/${roomId}`);
        setLive(res.data?.data || res.data);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Failed to load live info:', e);
      }
    };
    fetchStream();

    if (!socket.connected) socket.connect();
    socket.emit('live:viewer', { roomId });

    socket.on('live:signal', ({ data, from }) => {
      if (peerRef.current) {
        try { peerRef.current.destroy(); } catch (_) {}
      }
      const peer = new Peer({ initiator: false, trickle: false });
      peerRef.current = peer;

      peer.on('signal', (s) => socket.emit('live:return', { roomId, data: s }));
      peer.on('stream', (stream) => {
        if (remoteRef.current) remoteRef.current.srcObject = stream;
      });
      peer.on('error', () => {
        if (peerRef.current === peer) peerRef.current = null;
      });
      peer.on('close', () => {
        if (peerRef.current === peer) peerRef.current = null;
      });
      peer.signal(data);
    });

    socket.on('live:comment', (payload) => {
      setComments((prev) => [...prev, payload]);
    });

    socket.on('live:superchat', (payload) => {
      setComments((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        { ...payload, isSuperchat: true },
      ]);
      addToast(`Superchat: ${payload.from?.name} sent ${payload.amount} coins!`, { type: 'success' });
    });

    socket.on('live:reaction', () => {
      triggerHeart();
    });

    return () => {
      if (peerRef.current) {
        try { peerRef.current.destroy(); } catch (_) {}
        peerRef.current = null;
      }
      if (remoteRef.current?.srcObject) {
        try {
          remoteRef.current.srcObject.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
          remoteRef.current.srcObject = null;
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      socket.off('live:signal');
      socket.off('live:comment');
      socket.off('live:superchat');
      socket.off('live:reaction');
    };
  }, [roomId, addToast]);

  const triggerHeart = () => {
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    setFloatingHearts((prev) => [...prev, { id, x: Math.random() * 80 + 10 }]);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingHearts((prev) => prev.filter((h) => h.id !== id));
    }, 2000);
  };

  const sendReaction = () => {
    triggerHeart();
    socket.emit('live:reaction', { roomId });
  };

  const sendComment = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!commentInput.trim()) return;
    socket.emit('live:comment', { roomId, message: commentInput.trim() });
    setCommentInput('');
  };

  const sendSuperchat = async () => {
    if (!donationAmount || donationAmount < 1) {
      addToast('Minimum superchat is 1 coin', { type: 'error' });
      return;
    }
    try {
      await API.post(`/live/${roomId}/superchat`, {
        amount: Number(donationAmount),
        message: superchatMsg.trim() || 'Superchat!',
      });
      addToast('Superchat sent to host!', { type: 'success' });
      setShowSuperchatModal(false);
      setSuperchatMsg('');
    } catch (err) {
      addToast(err.response?.data?.message || 'Superchat failed. Check your coin balance.', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-4 min-h-[calc(100vh-80px)] flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Link
          to="/live/list"
          className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#070B14]/80 border border-white/10 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#CBD5E1] transition hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10"
        >
          <FaArrowLeft /> All Streams
        </Link>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#052E24] px-3.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(185,28,28,0.5)] border border-[#10B981]">
          <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-white animate-pulse" /> LIVE
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3 flex-1">
        {/* Stream Cinema Player */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col gap-4">
          <div className="relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-white/10 bg-black shadow-2xl">
            <video
              ref={remoteRef}
              autoPlay
              playsInline
              className="h-full w-full object-cover"
            />

            {/* Floating Reactions Layer with Dark Red */}
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden">
              {floatingHearts.map((h) => (
                <motion.div
                  key={h.id}
                  initial={{ opacity: 1, y: '85%', scale: 0.8 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 0, y: '10%', scale: 1.4 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 1.8, ease: 'easeOut' }}
                  style={{ left: `${h.x}%` }}
                  className="absolute text-[#10B981] drop-shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(185,28,28,0.8)] text-3xl"
                >
                  <FaHeart />
                </motion.div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Overlay Reactions & Superchat Trigger */}
            <div className="absolute bottom-4 right-4 flex items-center gap-3">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowSuperchatModal(true)}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] to-[#F4D49A] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-black text-slate-900 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(212,140,123,0.4)] transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95"
              >
                <FaCoins /> Superchat
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={sendReaction}
                className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#052E24]/90 text-white shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(185,28,28,0.5)] border border-[#10B981] backdrop-blur-sm transition-transform hover:scale-110 active:scale-95"
              >
                <FaHeart size={18} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Host Info Bar */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-[24px] border border-white/10 bg-[#070B14]/90 p-4 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <UserAvatar src={live?.host?.avatar} name={live?.host?.name} className="h-11 w-11 border border-white/10" />
              <div>
                <h2 className="font-bold text-[#F7F7FC]">
                  {live?.title || 'Live Stream'}
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]">
                  {live?.host?.name || 'Creator'}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Live Chat Panel */}
        <div className="flex flex-col h-[520px] rounded-[28px] border border-white/10 bg-[#070B14]/90 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl overflow-hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 p-4 bg-[#04070D]/60">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] text-sm">
              <FaComments className="text-[#00F2FE]" /> Live Chat
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-2.5">
            {comments.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="py-16 text-center text-xs text-[#A5A9BB]">
                Welcome to the stream! Say hello to the creator.
              </div>
            ) : (
              comments.map((c, i) => (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  className={`rounded-2xl p-2.5 text-xs border ${
                    c.isSuperchat
                      ? 'border-[#D4AF37]/40 bg-[#D4AF37]/15 text-[#F4D49A] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,140,123,0.15)]'
                      : 'border-white/5 bg-[#0A111E]/80 text-[#CBD5E1]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold mb-0.5">
                    <span className="text-[#F7F7FC] font-semibold">
                      {c.user?.name || c.from?.name || 'Viewer'}
                    </span>
                    {c.isSuperchat && (
                      <span className="text-[#F4D49A] font-black">+{c.amount} Coins</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[#CBD5E1] leading-relaxed">{c.message}</p>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={sendComment} className="border-t border-white/10 p-3 bg-[#171A26]/40 flex gap-2">
            <input
              value={commentInput}
              onChange={(e) => setCommentInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Chat with everyone..."
              className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0A111E] px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50"
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:opacity-90"
            >
              <FaPaperPlane />
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Superchat Modal */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {showSuperchatModal && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-xl">
            <motion.div
              initial={{ scale: 0.9, opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
              exit={{ scale: 0.9, opacity: 0 }}
              className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-[28px] border border-white/15 bg-[#070B14]/95 p-6 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl"
            >
              <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-[#F7F7FC] flex items-center gap-2">
                <FaCoins className="text-[#F4D49A]" /> Send Superchat
              </h3>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]">
                Support the creator and pin your message with a gold badge
              </p>

              <div className="mt-4">
                <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-[#A5A9BB] tracking-wider">Coins Amount</label>
                <div className="mt-1.5 flex gap-2">
                  {[10, 25, 50, 100].map((amt) => (
                    <button
                      key={amt}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setDonationAmount(amt)}
                      className={`flex-1 rounded-xl py-2 text-xs font-bold transition ${
                        donationAmount === amt
                          ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] to-[#F4D49A] text-slate-900 shadow-md font-black'
                          : 'bg-[#171A26] border border-white/10 text-[#CBD5E1] hover:bg-white/10'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {amt}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4">
                <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-[#A5A9BB] tracking-wider">Message</label>
                <input
                  value={superchatMsg}
                  onChange={(e) => setSuperchatMsg(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Say something awesome..."
                  className="mt-1.5 w-full rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0A111E] p-3 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="mt-6 flex gap-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowSuperchatModal(false)}
                  className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-white/10 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-white transition"

                <button

                  className="flex-1 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] to-[#F4D49A] py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 shadow-lg hover:opacity-90 transition font-black"
                >
                  Send {donationAmount} Coins
                </button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/market/MarketHome.jsx
import React,{useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';

export default function MarketHome(){
  const [items,setItems]=useState([]);
  const [form,setForm]=useState({ title:'', price:0, desc:'' });
  const [image,setImage]=useState(null);

  const load=async()=> setItems((await API.get('/market')).data);
  useEffect(()=>{ load(); },[]);

  const create=async()=>{
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('title',form.title);
    fd.append('price',form.price);
    fd.append('desc',form.desc);
    if (image) fd.append('image', image);
    await API.post('/market', fd, { headers:{'Content-Type':'multipart/form-data'} });
    setForm({title:'',price:0,desc:''}); setImage(null); load();
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto p-4">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
        <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold">Marketplace</h3>
      </div>

      <div className="card p-3 mb-4 grid md:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
        <input value={form.title} onChange={e=>setForm(f=>({...f,title:e.target.value}))} className="p-2 border rounded" placeholder="Title"/>
        <input type="number" value={form.price} onChange={e=>setForm(f=>({...f,price:Number(e.target.value)}))} className="p-2 border rounded" placeholder="Price"/>
        <input value={form.desc} onChange={e=>setForm(f=>({...f,desc:e.target.value}))} className="p-2 border rounded" placeholder="Description"/>
        <label className="p-2 border rounded cursor-pointer text-sm text-gray-600">
          Image <input type="file" onChange={e=>setImage(e.target.files[0])} className="hidden"/>
        </label>
        <div className="md:col-span-4 text-right"><button className="btn-primary" onClick={create}>List Product</button></div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        {items.map(x=>(
          <div key={x._id} className="card p-3">
            {x.image && <img src={x.image} className="w-full h-36 object-cover rounded mb-2"/>}
            <div className="font-medium">{x.title}</div>
            <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">₹ {x.price}</div>
            <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">{x.desc}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/memories/Memories.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import PostCard from '../../components/posts/PostCard';
import { FaHistory } from 'react-icons/fa';
import Spinner from '../../components/common/Spinner';

export default function Memories() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await API.get('/social/memories');
        const data = res.data?.data || res.data;
        setItems(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Memories load error:', e);
        setItems([]);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 pb-24">
      <div className="mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-white/10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#D4AF37] mb-1">
          <FaHistory /> Time Capsule
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-tight font-display">
          Memories & Flashbacks<span className="text-[#00F2FE]">.</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] mt-1">Revisit moments you shared on this date across past years.</p>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="p-12 flex justify-center"><Spinner /></div>
      ) : items.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-16 text-center text-[#CBD5E1] bg-[#070B14]/40 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl backdrop-blur-xl">
          <FaHistory className="mx-auto text-4xl mb-3 text-[#A5A9BB] opacity-30" />
          <p className="font-semibold text-sm">No flashbacks today.</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] mt-1">When posts reach their anniversary dates, they will illuminate here.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {items.map((p) => (
            <PostCard key={p._id} post={p} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-base font-bold text-[#F7F7FC]">{item.title}</div>
                    <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[#CBD5E1]">{item.desc}</p>
                  </div>
                );

                return item.action ? (
                  <button
                    key={item.title}
                    onClick={() => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('openCreatePost'))}
                    className="text-left w-full"
                  >
                    {card}
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <Link key={item.title} to={item.to} className="text-left block h-full">
                    {card}
                  </Link>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </section>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/nearby/Nearby.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { FaCompass, FaMapMarkerAlt } from 'react-icons/fa';
import UserAvatar from '../../components/ui/UserAvatar';

export default function Nearby() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (navigator.geolocation) {
      navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
        async (pos) => {
          try {
            const { latitude: lat, longitude: lng } = pos.coords;
            await API.post('/social/geo', { lat, lng });
            const r = await API.get(`/social/nearby?lat=${lat}&lng=${lng}&km=50`);
            const payload = r.data?.data || r.data;
            setItems(Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : []);
          } catch (e) {
            console.error('Nearby error:', e);
          } finally {
            setLoading(false);
          }
        },
        () => {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      );
    } else {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 pb-24">
      <div className="mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-white/10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#00F2FE] mb-1">
          <FaCompass /> Spatial Radar
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-tight font-display">
          Creators Nearby<span className="text-[#00F2FE]">.</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] mt-1">Discover community members broadcasting in your geographical vicinity.</p>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="p-12 text-center text-xs text-[#A5A9BB]">Scanning local perimeter...</div>
      ) : items.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-16 text-center text-[#CBD5E1] bg-[#070B14]/40 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl backdrop-blur-xl">
          <FaMapMarkerAlt className="mx-auto text-4xl mb-3 text-[#A5A9BB] opacity-30" />
          <p className="font-semibold text-sm">No nearby creators found.</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] mt-1">Ensure location permissions are granted to detect nearby profiles.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {items.map((u) => (
            <Link 
              key={u._id} 
              to={`/profile/${u._id}`} 
              className="bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3.5 hover:border-white/20 hover:shadow-[0_8px_25px_rgba(29,78,216,0.15)] transition-all backdrop-blur-xl group"
            >
              <UserAvatar src={u.avatar} name={u.name} className="w-12 h-12 border border-white/10" />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] text-sm group-hover:text-[#00F2FE] transition-colors truncate">{u.name}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] truncate">@{u.username || 'creator'}</div>
              </div>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
