```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/notifications/NotificationsPage.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import API from "../../services/api";
import socket from "../../services/socket";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import { useToast } from "../../components/ui/ToastProvider";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import Spinner from "../../components/common/Spinner";
import { useSelector } from "react-redux";
import { FaBell, FaCircle, FaCheckDouble } from 'react-icons/fa';
import UserAvatar from "../../components/ui/UserAvatar";

// Helper to determine the link based on notification type
const getNotificationLink = (n) => {
    if (n.data?.link) return n.data.link;

    switch (n.type) {
        case 'like':
            return n.data?.postId ? `/post/${n.data.postId}` : null;
        case 'comment':
        case 'mention':
            return n.data?.postId ? `/post/${n.data.postId}?comments=true` : null;
        case 'follow':
            return n.actor?._id ? `/profile/${n.actor._id}` : null;
        case 'message':
            return n.data?.chatId ? `/chat/${n.data.chatId}` : '/chat';
        case 'wallet':
        case 'system':
            return '/wallet';
        case 'report':
            return '/report';
        default:
            return null;
    }
};

export default function NotificationsPage() {
    const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const { add: addToast } = useToast();
    const myId = useSelector(s => s.auth?.user?._id);

    const load = async () => {
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const r = await API.get('/notifications');
            const data = Array.isArray(r.data) ? r.data : (r.data?.data || []);
            setItems(data);
        } catch (e) { 
            console.warn('Notifications load error:', e?.message);
            setItems([]);
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!myId) return; 
        load();
        
        const onNotif = (payload) => {
            setItems(prev => {
                const safePrev = Array.isArray(prev) ? prev : [];
                if (safePrev.find(n => n._id === payload._id)) return safePrev;
                return [payload, ...safePrev].slice(0, 100);
            });
        };
        
        socket.on('notification', onNotif);
        
        if (socket.connected) {
            socket.emit('joinRoom', { room: myId });
        }
        
        return () => { 
            socket.off('notification', onNotif); 
        };
    }, [myId]);

    const markSingleRead = async (id) => {
        const safeItems = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
        const target = safeItems.find(i => i._id === id);
        if (target && target.isRead) return;

        setItems(prev => {
            const safePrev = Array.isArray(prev) ? prev : [];
            return safePrev.map(i => i._id === id ? { ...i, isRead: true } : i);
        });
        
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('notificationsRead')); 

        try {
            await API.post(`/notifications/${id}/read`);
        } catch (e) { 
            // Silent fail
        }
    };

    const handleMarkAllRead = async () => {
        setItems(prev => {
            const safePrev = Array.isArray(prev) ? prev : [];
            return safePrev.map(n => ({ ...n, isRead: true }));
        });
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('notificationsRead'));
        
        try {
            await API.put('/notifications/mark-read');
            addToast("All marked as read", { type: 'success' });
        } catch(e) {
            addToast("Failed to mark all read", { type: 'error' });
        }
    };

    if (loading) return <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-[50vh]"><Spinner /></div>;

    const safeItemsToRender = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];

    return (
        <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-8 py-8 min-h-screen">
            
            {/* Header with Glass Pill Actions */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8 sticky top-0 z-30 pt-4 pb-4 bg-[#04070D]/85 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10">
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#F7F7FC] flex items-center gap-3">
                 <div className="p-2.5 bg-[#0F766E]/20 border border-[#0F766E]/30 rounded-2xl text-[#00F2FE] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(100,223,223,0.2)]">
                    <FaBell size={18} />
                 </div>
                 Activity
              </h1>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <button 
                    onClick={load} 
                    className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F7F7FC] transition-colors px-3 py-1.5"
                  >
                    Refresh
                  </button>
                  <button 
                    onClick={handleMarkAllRead}
                    className="px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-full bg-[#070B14] border border-white/15 text-[#CBD5E1] hover:text-[#00F2FE] hover:border-[#00F2FE]/40 transition-all shadow-md active:scale-95"
                  >
                    <FaCheckDouble /> Mark all read
                  </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Notification Items Wrapper */}
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
                    {safeItemsToRender.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-[#A5A9BB] bg-[#070B14]/40 border border-white/5 rounded-3xl">
                            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-[#171A26] rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4 border border-white/10 shadow-inner">
                                <FaBell className="text-4xl text-[#A5A9BB] opacity-40" />
                            </div>
                            <p className="font-medium tracking-wide text-[#CBD5E1] text-sm">No notifications yet.</p>
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        safeItemsToRender.map(n => {
                            const link = getNotificationLink(n);
                            
                            const Content = (
                                <div className={`relative group flex items-start gap-4 p-4 md:p-5 rounded-2xl backdrop-blur-xl border transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer overflow-hidden ${
                                  n.isRead 
                                      ? 'bg-[#070B14]/60 border-white/5 opacity-80 hover:opacity-100 hover:border-white/15' 
                                      : 'bg-[#171A26]/90 border-white/15 shadow-[0_8px_25px_rgba(29,78,216,0.15)] transform hover:-translate-y-0.5'
                                  }`}>
                                    
                                    {/* Unread Glow Indicator */}
                                    {!n.isRead && (
                                      <div className="absolute left-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-1.5 h-12 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#052E24] rounded-r-full shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(29,78,216,0.8)]" />
                                    )}

                                    {/* Avatar */}
                                    <div className="flex-shrink-0 relative">
                                        <UserAvatar 
                                          src={n.actor?.avatar} 
                                          name={n.actor?.name} 
                                          className="w-11 h-11 border border-white/10"
                                        />
                                    </div>

                                    {/* Content */}
                                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 pt-0.5">
                                      <p className="text-sm text-[#F7F7FC] leading-relaxed">
                                        <span className="font-bold cursor-pointer hover:text-[#00F2FE] transition-colors">
                                          {n.actor?.name || 'Someone'}
                                        </span>
                                        {' '}
                                        <span className="text-[#CBD5E1]">
                                          {n.message?.replace(n.actor?.name, '') || 'interacted with you.'}
                                        </span>
                                      </p>
                                      <span className="text-xs text-[#00F2FE] mt-1.5 block font-medium tracking-wide">
                                        {new Date(n.createdAt || n.ts || Date.now()).toLocaleString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit' })}
                                      </span>
                                    </div>

                                    {/* Optional: Related Post Image Thumbnail */}
                                    {n.data?.postImage && (
                                      <img 
                                        src={n.data.postImage} 
                                        alt="Post" 
                                        className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl object-cover border border-white/10 opacity-80 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex-shrink-0"
                                      />
                                    )}

                                    {/* Manual Mark Read Button (Visible on Hover if Unread) */}
                                    {!n.isRead && (
                                        <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex-shrink-0">
                                            <button 
                                                onClick={(e) => {
                                                    e.preventDefault();
                                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                                    markSingleRead(n._id);
                                                }}
                                                className="p-1.5 text-[#00F2FE] hover:bg-[#0F766E]/20 rounded-full transition-colors"
                                                title="Mark as read"
                                            >
                                                <FaCircle size={10} />
                                            </button>
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            );
                            
                            return (
                                <motion.div 
                                    key={n._id || n.id} 
                                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} 
                                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} 
                                    exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} 
                                    layout
                                >
                                    {link ? (
                                        <Link 
                                            to={link} 
                                            onClick={() => markSingleRead(n._id)} 
                                            className="block focus:outline-none"
                                        >
                                            {Content}
                                        </Link>
                                    ) : (
                                        <div 
                                            onClick={() => markSingleRead(n._id)} 
                                            className="focus:outline-none"
                                        >
                                            {Content}
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </motion.div>
                            );
                        })
                    )}
                </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/posts/DraftsPage.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { FaEdit, FaTrash, FaStickyNote } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';
import Spinner from '../../components/common/Spinner';

export default function DraftsPage() {
  const [drafts, setDrafts] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const { add } = useToast();

  useEffect(() => { loadDrafts(); }, []);

  const loadDrafts = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await API.get('/posts/drafts');
      const payload = res.data?.data || res.data;
      setDrafts(Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      add("Failed to load drafts", { type: 'error' });
    } finally { 
      setLoading(false); 
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if(!confirm("Delete this draft permanently?")) return;
    try {
        await API.delete(`/posts/${id}`);
        setDrafts(prev => prev.filter(d => d._id !== id));
        add("Draft deleted", { type: 'success' });
    } catch(e) { 
        add("Failed to delete draft", { type: 'error' }); 
    }
  };

  const handlePublish = (draft) => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('openCreatePost', { 
          detail: { 
              content: draft.content, 
              _id: draft._id, 
              isDraft: true
          } 
      }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 pb-24">
      <div className="mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#F4D49A] mb-1">
            <FaStickyNote /> Working Studio
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-tight font-display">
            Unpublished Drafts<span className="text-[#00F2FE]">.</span>
          </h1>
        </div>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="p-12 flex justify-center"><Spinner /></div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
            {drafts.length === 0 && (
                <div className="text-[#CBD5E1] text-center py-16 bg-[#070B14]/40 rounded-3xl border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl text-xs">
                    No drafts saved in your queue.
                </div>
            )}
            
            {drafts.map(draft => (
                <div key={draft._id} className="p-5 flex justify-between items-start bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl transition hover:border-white/20">
                    <div className="flex-1 pr-4">
                        <p className="text-[#F7F7FC] font-medium text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap line-clamp-3 leading-relaxed">
                            {draft.content || "Untitled Draft"}
                        </p>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-[#A5A9BB] mt-2">
                            Last edited: {new Date(draft.updatedAt).toLocaleString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit' })}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <button 
                            onClick={() => handlePublish(draft)} 
                            className="p-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] rounded-2xl text-white shadow-md hover:opacity-95 transition text-xs"
                            title="Edit / Publish"
                        >
                            <FaEdit />
                        </button>
                        <button 
                            onClick={() => handleDelete(draft._id)} 
                            className="p-2.5 bg-[#052E24]/20 border border-[#052E24]/30 rounded-2xl text-[#F87171] hover:bg-[#052E24]/40 transition text-xs"
                            title="Delete"
                        >
                            <FaTrash />
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/posts/PostPage.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useParams, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom"; // 🔥 Import useSearchParams
import API from "../../services/api";
import PostCard from "../../components/posts/PostCard";
import SkeletonPost from "../../components/ui/SkeletonPost";
import { useToast } from "../../components/ui/ToastProvider";

export default function PostPage() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams(); // 🔥 Get Query Params
  const [post, setPost] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const toast = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    const load = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      if (!id) {
        toast.add("Invalid post id", { type: "error" });
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      try {
        const res = await API.get(`/posts/${id}`).catch(() => API.get(`/post/${id}`));
        setPost(res.data?.data || res.data);

        // 🔥 FIX: Auto-open comments if query param exists
        if (searchParams.get('comments') === 'true') {
            // Slight delay to ensure modal mounts correctly and data is ready
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('openComments', { detail: id }));
            }, 500);
        }

      } catch (err) {
        console.error("load single post err", err);
        toast.add("Failed to load post", { type: "error" });
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    load();
  }, [id, toast, searchParams]);

  return (
    <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto p-4">
      {loading ? <SkeletonPost /> : (
        post ? (
          <PostCard post={post} />
        ) : (
          <div className="rounded-[24px] border border-white/10 bg-[#070B14]/80 p-12 text-center text-[#CBD5E1]/60 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-silverGlass">
            <p className="font-semibold text-sm">Post not found</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/40 mt-1">This piece may have been removed or is no longer accessible.</p>
          </div>
        )
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/posts/ScheduledPosts.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';
import { FaCalendarAlt, FaClock, FaPaperclip, FaPaperPlane } from 'react-icons/fa';
import UserAvatar from '../../components/ui/UserAvatar';
import Spinner from '../../components/common/Spinner';

export default function ScheduledPostsPage() {
  const [list, setList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [content, setContent] = useState('');
  const [files, setFiles] = useState([]);
  const [scheduledAt, setScheduledAt] = useState('');
  const { add } = useToast();

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await API.get('/posts/scheduled');
      const data = res.data?.data || res.data;
      setList(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('load scheduled', err);
      add(err.userMessage || 'Failed to load scheduled posts', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const handleFiles = (e) => setFiles(Array.from(e.target.files || []));

  const submit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!scheduledAt) return add('Pick a future time', { type: 'error' });
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('content', content);
      fd.append('scheduledAt', scheduledAt);
      files.forEach(f => fd.append('media', f));
      await API.post('/posts/scheduled', fd, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } });
      add('Post scheduled successfully!', { type: 'success' });
      setContent(''); setFiles([]); setScheduledAt('');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('schedule err', err);
      add(err.userMessage || 'Failed to schedule post', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 pb-24">
      <div className="mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-white/10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#00F2FE] mb-1">
          <FaCalendarAlt /> Automation Scheduler
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-tight font-display">
          Scheduled Broadcasts<span className="text-[#00F2FE]">.</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] mt-1">Compose posts and program publication times for autonomous publishing.</p>
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={submit} className="bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 p-5 md:p-6 rounded-3xl shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl mb-8">
        <textarea 
          value={content} 
          onChange={(e)=>setContent(e.target.value)}

          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      <div className="bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 p-6 rounded-3xl shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl">
        <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-[#F7F7FC] mb-4">Pending Queue</h3>
        {loading ? <div className="p-8 flex justify-center"><Spinner /></div> : (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {list.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-10 text-xs text-[#A5A9BB]">No scheduled broadcasts in queue.</div>
            ) : list.map(p => (
              <div key={p._id} className="p-4 bg-[#171A26]/80 border border-white/5 rounded-2xl">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <UserAvatar src={p.user?.avatar} name={p.user?.name} className="w-10 h-10 border border-white/10" />
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="font-bold text-xs text-[#F7F7FC]">{p.user?.name}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-[#00F2FE] font-mono bg-[#0F766E]/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-[#0F766E]/30">
                        {new Date(p.scheduledAt).toLocaleString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit' })}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] leading-relaxed line-clamp-3">{p.content}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/profile/AiAvatar.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { FaMagic, FaUpload, FaSpinner } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function AiAvatar() {
  const [image, setImage] = useState(null);
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const upload = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setImage(URL.createObjectURL(file));
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append('avatar', file);

      const r = await API.post('/extra/ai/avatar', form, {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
      });

      setResult(r.data?.url || null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('AI avatar upload failed:', err);
      setResult(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl p-4 md:p-6 pb-24">
      <div className="bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 md:p-8 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#00F2FE] mb-1">
          <FaMagic /> Neural Synthesis
        </div>
        <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] mb-2 font-display">AI Avatar Synthesis Studio</h3>
        <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] mb-6">Upload a portrait to transform it into an Aurora Noir digital representation.</p>
        
        <label className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-white/20 hover:border-white/40 cursor-pointer transition bg-[#0A111E] text-xs font-bold text-[#F7F7FC]">
          <FaUpload className="text-[#00F2FE]" />
          <span>Select Source Portrait</span>
          <input type="file" accept="image/*" onChange={upload} className="hidden" />
        </label>

        <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-center justify-center">
          {image && (
            <div className="text-center">
              <span className="block text-[10px] text-[#A5A9BB] uppercase mb-1">Original</span>
              <img src={image} alt="Preview" className="h-32 w-32 rounded-2xl object-cover border border-white/10" />
            </div>
          )}
          {loading && (
            <div className="flex flex-col h-32 w-32 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#171A26] text-xs text-[#00F2FE] gap-2">
              <FaSpinner className="animate-spin text-lg" />
              <span>Generating...</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {result && (
            <div className="text-center">
              <span className="block text-[10px] text-[#00F2FE] uppercase font-bold mb-1">Synthesized</span>
              <img src={result} alt="Result" className="h-32 w-32 rounded-2xl object-cover ring-2 ring-[#00F2FE] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(100,223,223,0.3)]" />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { Line } from 'react-chartjs-2';

export default function Analytics() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;

    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await API.get('/extra/insights');
        if (mounted) setData(res.data || null);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load analytics:', err);
        if (mounted) setData(null);
      } finally {
        if (mounted) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl p-4 text-gray-500">Loading analytics...</div>;
  }

  if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.dates) || !Array.isArray(data.views)) {
    return <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl p-4 text-gray-500">No analytics available.</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl p-4">
      <h3 className="mb-3 font-bold">Profile Growth</h3>
      <Line
        data={{
          labels: data.dates,
          datasets: [
            {
              label: 'Visits',
              data: data.views,
              borderWidth: 3,
            },
          ],
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { FaUsers } from 'react-icons/fa';
import UserAvatar from '../../components/ui/UserAvatar';

export default function FollowersList() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const [list, setList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const r = await API.get(`/users/${id}`);
        const data = r.data?.data || r.data;
        setList(data.followers || []);
      } catch (e) { 
        console.error(e); 
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
  }, [id]);

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 pb-24">
      <div className="mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-white/10">
```

```jsx
const uniqueUsers = (arr) => {

  });

export default function ProfilePage() {

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { add: toast } = useToast();

  const { currentTheme } = useTheme();

  const tab = searchParams.get("tab") || "posts";
  const [activeMediaTab, setActiveMediaTab] = useState("grid"); // 'grid' | 'reels' | 'videos' | 'tagged'
  const effectiveId = id && id !== "me" ? id : (myId || loggedInUser?._id);
  const isMe = Boolean(
    !id ||
    id === "me" ||
    (myId && String(myId) === String(id)) ||
    (loggedInUser?.username && String(loggedInUser.username).toLowerCase() === String(id).toLowerCase()) ||
    (user?._id && myId && String(user._id) === String(myId)) ||
    (user?.username && loggedInUser?.username && String(user.username).toLowerCase() === String(loggedInUser.username).toLowerCase())
  );

  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [posts, setPosts] = useState([]);
  const [followers, setFollowers] = useState([]);
  const [following, setFollowing] = useState([]);
  const [savedPosts, setSavedPosts] = useState([]);

  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [hasMorePosts, setHasMorePosts] = useState(true);
  const [postsLoading, setPostsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isPrivateError, setIsPrivateError] = useState(false);

  // UI state modals
  const [editOpen, setEditOpen] = useState(false);
  const [createPostOpen, setCreatePostOpen] = useState(false);
  const [viewAvatar, setViewAvatar] = useState(false);
  const [qrOpen, setQrOpen] = useState(false);
  const [qrScannerOpen, setQrScannerOpen] = useState(false);

  // Load profile data
  useEffect(() => {
    setLoading(true);
    setPosts([]);
    setPage(0);
    setHasMorePosts(true);
    setIsPrivateError(false);

    const loadProfile = async () => {
      try {
        const targetParam = effectiveId || "me";
        const res = await API.get(`/users/${targetParam}`);
        const data = res.data.data || res.data;
        setUser(data);

        const targetUserId = data?._id || targetParam;

        const [folRes, followingRes] = await Promise.all([
          API.get(`/users/${targetUserId}/followers`).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
          API.get(`/users/${targetUserId}/following`).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
        ]);

        setFollowers(uniqueUsers(folRes.data.data || folRes.data || []));
        setFollowing(uniqueUsers(followingRes.data.data || followingRes.data || []));

        if (isMe) {
          API.get(`/extra/save/${targetUserId}`)
            .then((r) => setSavedPosts(r.data.data || r.data || []))
            .catch(() => {});
        }

        const postRes = await API.get(`/posts/user/${targetUserId}?page=0&limit=12`);
        const postData = postRes.data.data || postRes.data || [];
        setPosts(postData);
        if (postData.length < 12) setHasMorePosts(false);
        setPage(1);
      } catch (err) {
        if (err.response?.status === 403) {
          setIsPrivateError(true);
        } else if (isMe && loggedInUser) {
          setUser(loggedInUser);
        }
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadProfile();
  }, [id, isMe, loggedInUser]);

  // Infinite Scroll
  const loadMore = useCallback(async () => {

    setPostsLoading(true);

      const newPosts = res.data.data || res.data || [];
      setPosts((p) => [...p, ...newPosts]);

                  className="text-center md:text-left cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity"

                  <span className="block text-lg md:text-xl font-bold font-display text-white">
                    {following.length > 0 ? following.length : "842"}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] md:text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/70 font-medium">
                    Following
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* BIO CONTENT (Screen 4) */}
              <div className="text-xs md:text-sm text-[#CBD5E1] space-y-1 mb-4 leading-relaxed">
                <div className="font-semibold text-white">{bioHeadline}</div>
                <div>{bioText}</div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center md:justify-start gap-1 text-[#CBD5E1]/80 text-[11px] md:text-xs">
                  <IoLocationOutline className="text-[#00F2FE]" />
                  <span>{locationText}</span>
                </div>
                {websiteUrl && (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center md:justify-start gap-1 text-[11px] md:text-xs pt-0.5">
                    <IoLinkOutline className="text-[#38BDF8]" />
                    <a
                      href={websiteUrl.startsWith("http") ? websiteUrl : `https://${websiteUrl}`}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noreferrer"
                      className="text-[#38BDF8] hover:underline font-medium truncate max-w-[240px]"
                    >
                      {websiteUrl.replace(/^https?:\/\//, "")}
                    </a>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* ACTION BUTTONS (Edit Profile / Share / QR) */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                {isMe ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setEditOpen(true)}
                    className="flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs md:text-sm text-white border border-white/20 bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.12] transition-all shadow-sm active:scale-95 cursor-pointer backdrop-blur-md"
                    style={{
                      borderColor: currentTheme.border || "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
                    }}
                  >
                    Edit Profile
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <FollowButton userId={id} />
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Share Button */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={copyProfileLink}
                  className="p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-white/[0.04] text-white/90 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.08] transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm"
                  title="Share Profile"
                >
                  <IoShareSocialOutline size={18} />
                </button>

                {/* QR Code Button */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setQrOpen(true)}
                  className="p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-white/[0.04] text-white/90 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.08] transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm"
                  title="My QR Code"
                >
                  <IoQrCodeOutline size={18} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* STORY HIGHLIGHTS (Screen 4: Travel, Coding, Trading, Life, More) */}
          <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-white/10">
            <ProfileHighlights isMe={isMe} onAddHighlight={() => setCreatePostOpen(true)} />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* =====================================================================
            CONTENT TABS BAR (Grid, Reels, Videos, Tagged)
            ===================================================================== */}
        <div className="mt-6 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-around">
          {[
            { id: "grid", label: "Grid", icon: <IoGrid size={19} /> },
            { id: "reels", label: "Reels", icon: <IoVideocamOutline size={21} /> },
            { id: "videos", label: "Videos", icon: <IoPlayOutline size={21} /> },
            { id: "tagged", label: "Tagged", icon: <IoIdCardOutline size={21} /> },
          ].map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              onClick={() => setActiveMediaTab(t.id)}
              className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 px-4 relative font-semibold text-xs md:text-sm tracking-wide transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                activeMediaTab === t.id ? "text-white" : "text-[#CBD5E1]/50 hover:text-white/80"
              }`}
            >
              <span style={activeMediaTab === t.id ? { color: currentTheme.accent } : {}}>
                {t.icon}
              </span>
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">{t.label}</span>

              {activeMediaTab === t.id && (
                <motion.div
                  layoutId="profile-tab-line"
                  className="absolute bottom-0 left-2 right-2 h-[2.5px] rounded-full"
                  style={{
                    background: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${currentTheme.color}, ${currentTheme.accent})`,
                    boxShadow: `0 0 10px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
                  }}
                  transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 400, damping: 28 }}
                />
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* =====================================================================
            MEDIA GRID (3-Column Mosaic matching Screen 4)
            ===================================================================== */}
        <div className="mt-4">
          {isPrivateError ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 border border-white/10 rounded-[24px] bg-[#070B14]/70 backdrop-blur-md">
              <IoLockClosed className="text-4xl text-[#CBD5E1]/60 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-lg font-bold font-display text-white">This Account Is Private</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/60 mt-1">Follow this user to view posts.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5 sm:gap-3">
              {displayGridPosts.map((post, idx) => {
                const img = post.image || post.images?.[0] || post.mediaUrl;
                const isCarousel = post.isCarousel || (post.images && post.images.length > 1);

                return (
                  <div
                    key={post._id || idx}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (post._id?.startsWith("showcase")) {
                        toast("Viewing curated showcase item", { type: "info" });
                      } else {
                        navigate(`/post/${post._id}`);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="group relative aspect-square rounded-xl sm:rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-[#070B14] border border-white/10 cursor-pointer shadow-md hover:border-white/30 transition-all duration-300"
                  >
                    {img ? (
                      <img
                        src={getImageUrl(img, "feed")}
                        alt="Profile post"
                        className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105"
                        loading="lazy"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="w-full h-full bg-[#04070D] p-3 flex items-center justify-center">
                        <p className="text-white text-xs line-clamp-3 text-center">
                          {post.content}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Stacked Carousel Icon (Top Right, matching Screen 4) */}
                    {isCarousel && (
                      <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 p-1 rounded-md bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md text-white/90 shadow-md">
                        <IoCopyOutline size={13} />
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Hover Reaction Overlay */}
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/85 via-black/30 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200 flex items-center justify-center gap-4 text-white text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[#FF6B8A] drop-shadow">
                        <FaHeart size={12} /> {post.likesCount || post.likes?.length || 0}
                      </span>
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[#00F2FE] drop-shadow">
                        <FaComment size={12} /> {post.commentsCount || post.comments?.length || 0}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          {hasMorePosts && !postsLoading && <div ref={loaderRef} className="h-10" />}
          {postsLoading && (
            <div className="text-center pt-6">
              <div className="w-7 h-7 border-2 border-[#00F2FE] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mx-auto" />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Modals */}
      {editOpen && (
        <ProfileEditModal
          isOpen={editOpen}
          user={user || loggedInUser}
          onClose={() => setEditOpen(false)}
          onUpdate={(updated) => {
            setUser(updated);
            setEditOpen(false);
          }}
          onUpdated={(updated) => {
            setUser(updated);
            setEditOpen(false);
          }}
        />
      )}

      {createPostOpen && (
        <CreatePostModal
          open={createPostOpen}
          onClose={() => setCreatePostOpen(false)}
          onPostCreated={(p) => setPosts((prev) => [p, ...prev])}
        />
      )}

      {viewAvatar && (
        <Lightbox
          images={[getImageUrl(user?.avatar || loggedInUser?.avatar, "avatar")]}
          onClose={() => setViewAvatar(false)}
        />
      )}

      {qrOpen && <MyQR user={user || loggedInUser} onClose={() => setQrOpen(false)} />}
      {qrScannerOpen && <ScanQR onClose={() => setQrScannerOpen(false)} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```css
/* url(reels.css) */
.reels-wrapper {
  scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
  overflow-y: scroll;
  /* Use dvh (Dynamic Viewport Height) for mobile browser support */
  height: 100vh;
  height: 100dvh; 
}

.reel-item {
  scroll-snap-align: start;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100vh;
  height: 100dvh; 
  background: #000;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Fix video sizing to ensure it covers without stretch */
.reel-video {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover; 
}

/* Adjust action buttons to be safe from bottom nav bars */
.reel-actions {
  position: absolute;
  right: 16px;
  bottom: 120px; /* Push up slightly higher */
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 24px;
  z-index: 20;
}
```

```jsx
// --- Sub-Component: Single Reel Item ---
const ReelItem = ({ reel, isActive, toggleLike, onDelete }) => {
  const videoRef = useRef(null);
  const [isLiked, setIsLiked] = useState(false);
  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(true);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [showPlayIcon, setShowPlayIcon] = useState(false);

  const [showReport, setShowReport] = useState(false);
  const [showDelete, setShowDelete] = useState(false);
  const [showHeartOverlay, setShowHeartOverlay] = useState(false);
  const [expandedCaption, setExpandedCaption] = useState(false);
  const [isFollowing, setIsFollowing] = useState(false);
  const [showTipModal, setShowTipModal] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [playbackRate, setPlaybackRate] = useState(1);

  useEffect(() => {
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video) return;
    const handleTimeUpdate = () => {
      if (video.duration) {
        setProgress((video.currentTime / video.duration) * 100);
      }
    };
    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', handleTimeUpdate);
    return () => video.removeEventListener('timeupdate', handleTimeUpdate);
  }, []);

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const myId = useSelector((s) => s.auth.user?._id);
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();
  const { currentTheme } = useTheme();

  // Autoplay when slide is active
  useEffect(() => {
    let viewTimer = null;
    if (isActive && videoRef.current) {
      videoRef.current.currentTime = 0;
      const playPromise = videoRef.current.play();
      if (playPromise !== undefined) {
        playPromise
          .then(() => setIsPlaying(true))
          .catch(() => setIsPlaying(false));
      }
      if (reel._id && !String(reel._id).startsWith("demo")) {
        viewTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          API.post(`/reels/view/${reel._id}`).catch(() => {});
        }, 3000);
      }
    } else if (videoRef.current) {
      videoRef.current.pause();
      setIsPlaying(false);
    }

  

  return () => {
      clearTimeout(viewTimer);
      if (videoRef.current) {
        try {
          videoRef.current.pause();
          setIsPlaying(false);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    };
  }, [isActive, reel._id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsLiked(Array.isArray(reel?.likes) && reel.likes.includes(myId));
  }, [reel, myId]);

  const onToggleLike = async () => {
    const newVal = !isLiked;
    setIsLiked(newVal);
    if (newVal) playSound("pop");
    try {
      if (toggleLike) await toggleLike(reel._id);
    } catch (e) {
      setIsLiked(!newVal);
    }
  };

  const handleDoubleTap = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!isLiked) onToggleLike();
    setShowHeartOverlay(true);
    setTimeout(() => setShowHeartOverlay(false), 700);
  };

  const togglePlayPause = () => {
    if (!videoRef.current) return;
    if (videoRef.current.paused) {
      videoRef.current.play();
      setIsPlaying(true);
    } else {
      videoRef.current.pause();
      setIsPlaying(false);
    }
    setShowPlayIcon(true);
    setTimeout(() => setShowPlayIcon(false), 600);
  };

  const handleToggleMute = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsMuted((m) => !m);
    playSound("cyber");
  };

  const handleShare = async () => {
    const url = `${window.location.origin}/reels`;
    if (navigator.share) {
      try {
        await navigator.share({ title: "SocialVerse Reel", url });
      } catch (e) {}
    } else {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      addToast("Reel link copied to clipboard!", { type: "success" });
    }
  };

  const videoSrc = getImageUrl(reel.videoUrl || reel.videos?.[0]);
  const posterSrc =
    reel.posterUrl ||
    reel.thumbnail ||
    (reel.videoUrl ? reel.videoUrl.replace(/\.mp4($|\?)/, ".jpg$1") : undefined);

  const creatorName = reel.user?.name || "Sidhanta Sahu";
  const isVerified = reel.user?.isVerified !== false;
  const audioTitle = reel.audioTrack || "Acoustic Vibes • Original Audio";
  const displayLikes = isLiked
    ? "24.9K"
    : reel.likesCount || `${reel.likes?.length || 1}K`;
  const displayComments = reel.commentsCount || `${reel.comments?.length || 427}`;
  const displayShares = reel.sharesCount || "1.6K";



  return (
    <div className="relative w-full h-[100dvh] snap-start shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black overflow-hidden select-none">
      {/* Container 9:16 aspect ratio or fullscreen on mobile */}
      <div
        className="relative w-full max-w-[480px] h-full flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer"
        onClick={togglePlayPause}

      >

        <video

          poster={posterSrc}
          className="w-full h-full object-cover"
          loop
          playsInline
          muted={isMuted}
          preload="metadata"
        />

        {/* Fallback image poster if video fails */}
        {posterSrc && (
          <img
            src={posterSrc}
            alt="Poster"
            className={`absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover pointer-events-none transition-opacity duration-700 ${
              isPlaying ? "opacity-0" : "opacity-100"
            }`}
          />
        )}

        {/* Dark Vignette Gradients (top and bottom for readable text) */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-black/60 via-transparent to-black/80 pointer-events-none" />

        {/* Center Double-Tap Animated Heart Overlay */}
        <AnimatePresence>
          {showHeartOverlay && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ scale: 0, opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ scale: 1.3, opacity: 1 }}
              exit={{ scale: 0.8, opacity: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
              className="absolute z-30 pointer-events-none"
            >
              <FaHeart size={90} className="text-[#FF6B8A] drop-shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,107,138,0.8)]" />
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>

        {/* Play/Pause Pulse Indicator */}
        <AnimatePresence>
          {showPlayIcon && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ scale: 0.5, opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ scale: 1.1, opacity: 0.8 }}
              exit={{ scale: 1.5, opacity: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
              className="absolute z-20 p-5 rounded-full bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md text-white pointer-events-none"
            >
              {isPlaying ? <FaPlay size={36} /> : <FaPause size={36} />}
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>

        {/* Playback Speed Controller (Top Left) */}
        <div className="absolute top-16 left-4 z-20 pointer-events-auto">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              const speeds = [1, 1.5, 2, 0.5];
              const nextIdx = (speeds.indexOf(playbackRate) + 1) % speeds.length;
              const nextSpeed = speeds[nextIdx];
              setPlaybackRate(nextSpeed);
              if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.playbackRate = nextSpeed;
              addToast(`Speed: ${nextSpeed}x`, { type: 'info' });
            }}
            className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-white/90 text-xs font-bold font-mono hover:text-white hover:scale-105 transition shadow-lg cursor-pointer"
            title="Change Playback Speed"
          >
            {playbackRate}x
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Mute / Unmute Button (Top Right of Reel Container) */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleToggleMute}
          className="absolute top-16 right-4 z-20 p-2.5 rounded-full bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-white/90 hover:text-white hover:scale-105 transition shadow-lg cursor-pointer"
        >
          {isMuted ? <FaVolumeMute size={16} /> : <FaVolumeUp size={16} />}
        </button>

        {/* ===================================================================
            RIGHT INTERACTION RAIL (Matching Screen 3)
            =================================================================== */}
        <div className="absolute right-3.5 bottom-28 z-20 flex flex-col items-center gap-4 pointer-events-auto">
          {/* Creator Avatar with Pink + Follow Badge */}
          <div className="relative mb-2">
            <div
              className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full p-[2px] transition-transform hover:scale-105 cursor-pointer"
              style={{
                background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${currentTheme.color}, ${currentTheme.accent})`,
              }}
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (reel.user?._id) navigate(`/profile/${reel.user._id}`);
              }}
            >
              <UserAvatar
                src={reel.user?.avatar}
                name={creatorName}
                className="w-full h-full rounded-full border border-black"
                showStatus={false}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Pink Follow Plus Badge */}
            {!isFollowing && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  setIsFollowing(true);
                  playSound("pop");
                  addToast(`Following ${creatorName}`, { type: "success" });
                }}
                className="absolute -bottom-1.5 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-[#FF6B8A] text-white flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-black hover:scale-110 active:scale-95 transition shadow-md cursor-pointer"
              >
                <IoAdd size={14} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* 1. Like Button */}
          <ActionBtn
            icon={isLiked ? <FaHeart /> : <FaRegHeart />}

            active={isLiked}

            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();

            }}
          />

          {/* 2. Comment Button */}
          <ActionBtn
            icon={<FaComment />}

            onClick={(e) => {

            }}
          />

          {/* 3. Share Button */}
          <ActionBtn
            icon={<FaShare />}

            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              handleShare();
            }}
          />

          {/* 4. Tip Coins Button */}
          <ActionBtn
            icon={<FaCoins />}
            label="Tip"
            color="text-[#F4D49A]"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setShowTipModal(true);
            }}
          />

          {/* 4. More Options */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setShowMenu((m) => !m);
            }}
            className="p-2.5 rounded-full bg-black/40 border border-white/15 backdrop-blur-md text-white/90 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <FaEllipsisV size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* ===================================================================
            BOTTOM OVERLAY (Matching Screen 3)
            =================================================================== */}
        <div className="absolute left-4 right-20 bottom-28 z-20 pointer-events-auto text-left">
          {/* Creator Name + Verified Badge + Follow Button */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <span
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (reel.user?._id) navigate(`/profile/${reel.user._id}`);
              }}
              className="font-bold text-white text-sm md:text-base drop-shadow-md hover:underline cursor-pointer"
            >
              {creatorName}
            </span>
            {isVerified && (
              <IoCheckmarkCircle className="text-[#38BDF8] text-base shrink-0 drop-shadow" />
            )}

            {/* Frosted Glass Follow Button (Screen 3) */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                setIsFollowing((f) => !f);
                playSound("pop");
              }}
              className={`px-3 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all border shadow-sm cursor-pointer ${
                isFollowing
                  ? "bg-white/15 border-white/30 text-white/80"
                  : "bg-white/20 border-white/40 text-white hover:bg-white/30"
              }`}
            >
              {isFollowing ? "Following" : "Follow"}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Caption with Expand / Collapse */}
          <div className="text-white/95 text-xs md:text-sm drop-shadow-md mb-3 pr-2 leading-relaxed">
            <span className={expandedCaption ? "" : "line-clamp-2"}>
              {reel.caption}
            </span>
            {reel.caption && reel.caption.length > 50 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  setExpandedCaption((ex) => !ex);
                }}
                className="text-white/70 font-semibold ml-1.5 hover:text-white"
              >
                {expandedCaption ? "less" : "...more"}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Animated Glowing Audio Pill (Screen 3: 🎵 Acoustic Vibes • Original Audio) */}
          <div
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-black/60 border border-white/20 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-lg cursor-pointer hover:bg-black/75 transition-all"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              addToast(`Playing track: ${audioTitle}`, { type: "info" });
            }}
          >
            <IoMusicalNotes className="text-[#00F2FE] text-xs shrink-0" />
            <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-white/90 truncate max-w-[170px] sm:max-w-[220px]">
              {audioTitle}
            </span>

            {/* 4 Animated Soundwave Equalizer Bars */}
            <div className="flex items-end gap-[2px] h-3 ml-1 shrink-0">
              <span
                className={`w-[2.5px] rounded-full bg-[#00F2FE] transition-all duration-300 ${
                  isPlaying ? "h-3 animate-pulse" : "h-1"
                }`}
              />
              <span
                className={`w-[2.5px] rounded-full bg-[#FF6B8A] transition-all duration-200 ${
                  isPlaying ? "h-2.5 animate-pulse delay-75" : "h-1.5"
                }`}
              />
              <span
                className={`w-[2.5px] rounded-full bg-[#D4AF37] transition-all duration-300 ${
                  isPlaying ? "h-3.5 animate-pulse delay-150" : "h-1"
                }`}
              />
              <span
                className={`w-[2.5px] rounded-full bg-[#38BDF8] transition-all duration-200 ${
                  isPlaying ? "h-2 animate-pulse" : "h-1"
                }`}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Interactive Video Progress Scrubber Bar */}
        <div
          className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-30 h-1.5 bg-white/20 hover:h-2.5 transition-all cursor-pointer pointer-events-auto"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
            const pos = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width));
            if (videoRef.current && videoRef.current.duration) {
              videoRef.current.currentTime = pos * videoRef.current.duration;
              setProgress(pos * 100);
            }
          }}
        >
          <div
            className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00F2FE] via-[#10B981] to-[#D4AF37] transition-all"
            style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <TipModal
        isOpen={showTipModal}
        onClose={() => setShowTipModal(false)}
        recipientId={reel.user?._id}
        recipientName={creatorName}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

// --- MAIN REELS PAGE ---
export default function ReelsPage() {
  const [reels, setReels] = useState([]);
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("forYou"); // 'forYou' | 'following' | 'trending'

  // Upload State
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState(0);

  const containerRef = useRef(null);
  const { add: addToast } = useToast();
  const { currentTheme } = useTheme();

  useEffect(() => {
    loadReels();
  }, []);

  const loadReels = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await API.get("/reels/feed");
      const payload = res?.data?.data || res?.data;
      const list = Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : [];
      setReels(list.length > 0 ? list : DEMO_REELS);
    } catch (e) {
      setReels(DEMO_REELS);
    }
  };

  const onFileSelect = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const MAX_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024;
    if (file.size > MAX_SIZE) {
      addToast("File too large! Max 50MB.", { type: "error" });
      return;
    }
    setSelectedFile(file);
  };

  const performUpload = async (caption) => {
    if (!selectedFile) return;
    setUploading(true);
    setUploadProgress(0);

    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append("video", selectedFile);
    fd.append("caption", caption);

    try {
      await API.post("/reels/upload", fd, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
        onUploadProgress: (progressEvent) => {
          const percent = Math.round(
            (progressEvent.loaded * 100) / progressEvent.total
          );
          setUploadProgress(percent);
        },
      });
      addToast("Reel uploaded successfully!", { type: "success" });
      setSelectedFile(null);
      await loadReels();
    } catch (err) {
      addToast("Upload failed.", { type: "error" });
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
      setUploadProgress(0);
    }
  };

  const handleScroll = () => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;
    const index = Math.round(
      containerRef.current.scrollTop / containerRef.current.clientHeight
    );
    if (index !== activeIndex && index >= 0 && index < reels.length) {
      setActiveIndex(index);
    }
  };

  const touchStartY = useRef(0);
  const handleTouchStart = (e) => {
    if (e.touches?.[0]) touchStartY.current = e.touches[0].clientY;
  };
  const handleTouchEnd = (e) => {
    if (!e.changedTouches?.[0] || !containerRef.current) return;
    const endY = e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
    const deltaY = touchStartY.current - endY;
    if (Math.abs(deltaY) > 45) {
      const h = containerRef.current.clientHeight;
      if (deltaY > 0 && activeIndex < reels.length - 1) {
        containerRef.current.scrollTo({
          top: (activeIndex + 1) * h,
          behavior: "smooth",
        });
      } else if (deltaY < 0 && activeIndex > 0) {
        containerRef.current.scrollTo({
          top: (activeIndex - 1) * h,
          behavior: "smooth",
        });
      }
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = containerRef.current;
    if (el) el.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, { passive: true });
  

  return () => el && el.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
  }, [activeIndex, reels.length]);



  const handleToggleLikeReel = async (reelId) => {
    try {
      if (reelId && !String(reelId).startsWith("demo")) {
        await API.put(`/posts/like/${reelId}`);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative h-[100dvh] w-full flex flex-col items-center bg-black overflow-hidden select-none">
      {/* =====================================================================
          TOP HEADER BAR (Matching Screen 3: For You | Following | Trending + Camera)
          ===================================================================== */}
      <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 flex items-center justify-between px-5 pt-3 pb-2 bg-gradient-to-b from-black/80 via-black/40 to-transparent">
        {/* Title for desktop / left branding */}
        <div className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="font-display font-black text-white text-lg tracking-tight">
            SocialVerse <span style={{ color: currentTheme.color }}>Reels</span>
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Center Sub-Tabs (Screen 3: For You | Following | Trending) */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-6 mx-auto">
          {[
            { id: "forYou", label: "For You" },
            { id: "following", label: "Following" },
            { id: "trending", label: "Trending" },
          ].map((tab) => (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
              className={`relative py-1 font-bold text-sm tracking-wide transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === tab.id ? "text-white" : "text-white/60 hover:text-white/90"
              }`}
            >
              <span>{tab.label}</span>
              {activeTab === tab.id && (
                <motion.div
                  layoutId="reels-active-tab-line"
                  className="absolute -bottom-1 left-0 right-0 h-[2.5px] rounded-full"
                  style={{
                    background: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${currentTheme.color}, ${currentTheme.accent})`,
                    boxShadow: `0 0 10px ${currentTheme.glow}`,
                  }}
                  transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 450, damping: 30 }}
                />
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Top Right Camera Icon (Screen 3) */}
        <label
          className="p-2 -mr-1 rounded-full text-white/90 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition cursor-pointer"
          title="Create Reel"
        >
          <IoCameraOutline size={26} />
          <input
            type="file"
            accept="video/*"
            className="hidden"
            onChange={onFileSelect}
            disabled={uploading}
          />
        </label>
      </div>

      {/* =====================================================================
          SNAP SCROLL CONTAINER
          ===================================================================== */}
      <div
        ref={containerRef}
        onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
        onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
        className="h-full w-full overflow-y-scroll snap-y snap-mandatory no-scrollbar scroll-smooth"
      >
        {reels.map((reel, i) => (
          <ReelItem
            key={reel._id}
            reel={reel}
            isActive={i === activeIndex}
            toggleLike={handleToggleLikeReel}
            onDelete={() => {}}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Upload Modal */}
      <ReelUploadModal
        file={selectedFile}
        onClose={() => setSelectedFile(null)}
        onConfirm={performUpload}
        uploading={uploading}
        progress={uploadProgress}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/safety/SafetyPage.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { FaShieldAlt, FaBan, FaCheckCircle, FaUserShield, FaClock } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';
import Spinner from '../../components/common/Spinner';
import UserAvatar from '../../components/ui/UserAvatar';

export default function SafetyPage() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('reports');
  const [blockedList, setBlockedList] = useState([]);
  const [myReports, setMyReports] = useState([]); 
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const { add } = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab === 'blocked') loadBlocked();
    if (activeTab === 'reports') loadReports(); 
  }, [activeTab]);

  const loadBlocked = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
        const res = await API.get('/users/blocked');
        setBlockedList(res.data.data || res.data || []);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const loadReports = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
        const res = await API.get('/report/mine');
        const data = res.data?.data || res.data;
        setMyReports(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const handleUnblock = async (userId) => {
      try {
          await API.post(`/users/${userId}/block`);
          setBlockedList(prev => prev.filter(u => u._id !== userId));
          add("User unblocked", { type: 'success' });
      } catch (e) {
          add("Failed to unblock", { type: 'error' });
      }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 pb-24">
      {/* Banner */}
      <div className="bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 md:p-8 text-[#F7F7FC] mb-8 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden backdrop-blur-xl">
        <FaShieldAlt className="absolute right-[-20px] bottom-[-20px] text-9xl text-[#10B981] opacity-15" />
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#00F2FE] mb-1">
          <FaUserShield /> Platform Integrity
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-black relative z-10 font-display">Safety & Trust Center<span className="text-[#00F2FE]">.</span></h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] mt-1 relative z-10">Monitor moderation tickets, content reports, and manage access blacklists.</p>
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-4 border-b border-white/10 mb-6 pb-1">
        <button 
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('reports')} 
          className={`pb-2 px-4 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition ${
            activeTab==='reports' ? 'border-b-2 border-[#00F2FE] text-[#00F2FE]' : 'text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F7F7FC]'
          }`}
        >
          My Reports
        </button>
        <button 
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('blocked')} 
          className={`pb-2 px-4 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition ${
            activeTab==='blocked' ? 'border-b-2 border-[#00F2FE] text-[#00F2FE]' : 'text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F7F7FC]'
          }`}
        >
          Blocked Users
        </button>
      </div>

      {loading ? <div className="text-center py-12"><Spinner /></div> : (
        <>
        {/* --- REPORTS TAB --- */}
        {activeTab === 'reports' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
                {myReports.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="text-center py-16 text-[#CBD5E1] bg-[#070B14]/40 rounded-3xl border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl">
                        <FaUserShield className="text-4xl mb-3 mx-auto text-[#A5A9BB] opacity-30"/>
                        <p className="font-semibold text-sm">No active tickets found.</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] mt-1">When you report objectionable content or actors, track resolutions here.</p>
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    myReports.map(rep => (
                        <div key={rep._id} className="p-5 flex justify-between items-start bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl border-l-4 border-l-[#052E24]">
                            <div>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
                                    <span className="font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] text-sm capitalize">{rep.reason}</span>
                                    <span className={`text-[10px] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold uppercase ${
                                      rep.status === 'open' 
                                        ? 'bg-[#D4AF37]/20 text-[#F4D49A] border border-[#D4AF37]/30' 
                                        : 'bg-[#0F766E]/20 text-[#00F2FE] border border-[#0F766E]/30'
                                    }`}>
                                        {rep.status}
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                                <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] mb-2">
                                    Target: {rep.targetUser?.name || 'Content Artifact'}
                                </p>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-[#A5A9BB]">
                                    <FaClock size={10} /> {new Date(rep.createdAt).toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            {rep.action && rep.action !== 'none' && (
                                <div className="bg-[#171A26] border border-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-[#F7F7FC]">
                                    Action: <span className="font-bold text-[#00F2FE]">{rep.action}</span>
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    ))
                )}
            </div>
        )}

        {/* --- BLOCKED TAB --- */}
        {activeTab === 'blocked' && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {blockedList.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="text-center py-16 text-[#CBD5E1] bg-[#070B14]/40 rounded-3xl border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl text-xs">
                    Your blacklist is empty. You haven't blocked any accounts.
                  </div>
              ) : (
                blockedList.map(u => (
                    <div key={u._id} className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl backdrop-blur-xl">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <UserAvatar src={u.avatar} name={u.name} className="w-10 h-10 border border-white/10" />
                        <div className="font-bold text-sm text-[#F7F7FC]">{u.name}</div>
                    </div>
                    <button 
                        onClick={() => handleUnblock(u._id)}
                        className="text-xs text-[#F87171] font-bold border border-[#052E24]/30 bg-[#052E24]/15 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-[#052E24]/30 transition"
                    >
                        Unblock
                    </button>
                    </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
        )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/saved/Saved.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import PostCard from '../../components/posts/PostCard';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import Spinner from '../../components/common/Spinner';
import useInfiniteScroll from '../../hooks/useInfiniteScroll'; 
import { FaBookmark } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function SavedPage() {
    const [posts, setPosts] = useState([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);
    const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false);

    const { add: addToast } = useToast();
    const myId = useSelector(s => s.auth?.user?._id || localStorage.getItem('meId'));

    const load = useCallback(async (isReset = false) => {
        if (!myId) return;
        if (loadingMore) return;
        
        const pageToLoad = isReset ? 0 : page;
        if (isReset) setLoading(true);
        else setLoadingMore(true);

        try {
            let newPosts = [];
            try {
                const r = await API.get(`/extra/save/${myId}?page=${pageToLoad}&limit=12`);
                const raw = r.data?.data || r.data;
                newPosts = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : [];
            } catch (_) {
                const r2 = await API.get('/posts/bookmarks/me');
                const raw2 = r2.data?.data || r2.data;
                newPosts = Array.isArray(raw2) ? raw2 : [];
            }

            if (newPosts.length < 12) setHasMore(false);
            
            setPosts(prev => isReset ? newPosts : [...prev, ...newPosts]);
            setPage(p => isReset ? 1 : p + 1);

        } catch (err) {
            addToast('Failed to load saved posts', { type: 'error' });
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
            setLoadingMore(false);
        }
    }, [myId, page, loadingMore, addToast]);

    useEffect(() => { load(true); }, [myId]);

    const loaderRef = useInfiniteScroll(() => { if(hasMore) load(); });

    if (!myId) return <div className="p-8 text-center text-[#CBD5E1]">Please login to view bookmarks.</div>;

    return (
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 pb-24">
            <div className="mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#D4AF37] mb-1">
                    <FaBookmark /> Curated Collection
                  </div>
                  <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-tight font-display">
                    Saved Editorial Artifacts<span className="text-[#00F2FE]">.</span>
                  </h1>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            {loading && <div className="p-12 flex justify-center"><Spinner /></div>}

            {!loading && posts.length === 0 && (
                <div className="p-16 text-center text-[#CBD5E1] bg-[#070B14]/40 border border-dashed border-white/10 rounded-3xl backdrop-blur-xl">
                    <FaBookmark className="mx-auto text-4xl mb-3 text-[#A5A9BB] opacity-30" />
                    <p className="font-semibold text-sm">No saved posts yet.</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] mt-1">Bookmark posts from your feed to revisit them anytime.</p>
                </div>
            )}

            <div className="space-y-6">
                {posts.map(p => <PostCard key={p._id} post={p} />)}
            </div>

            {hasMore && !loading && (
                <div ref={loaderRef} className="h-20 flex items-center justify-center">
                    <Spinner />
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/settings/RequestsPage.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';

export default function RequestsPage() {
  const [reqs, setReqs] = useState([]);

  const load = async () => {
    const r = await API.get('/users/follow-requests');
    setReqs(r.data);
  };

  useEffect(()=>{ load(); }, []);

  const accept = async (id) => {
    await API.post(`/users/accept-request/${id}`);
    load();
  };

  const decline = async (id) => {
    await API.post(`/users/decline-request/${id}`);
    load();
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto p-4">
      <h3 className="font-bold mb-2">Follow Requests</h3>
      {reqs.map(r => (
        <div key={r._id} className="card p-3 flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
          <div>{r.from.name}</div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button className="btn-primary" onClick={()=>accept(r._id)}>Accept</button>
            <button className="btn-error" onClick={()=>decline(r._id)}>Decline</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```
