```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/settings/SettingsPage.jsx
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { useSelector, useDispatch } from 'react-redux';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { logout, updateAuthUser } from '../../redux/slices/authSlice';
import { useToast } from '../../components/ui/ToastProvider';
import { 
  FaCamera, FaTrash, FaLock, FaBell, FaShieldAlt, 
  FaPalette, FaSignOutAlt, FaExclamationTriangle,
  FaDesktop, FaMobileAlt, FaKey, FaRocket, FaSyncAlt, FaCheckCircle
} from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const { user } = useSelector(s => s.auth);
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { add } = useToast();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('profile');
  
  // Profile State
  const [name, setName] = useState(user?.name || '');
  const [bio, setBio] = useState(user?.bio || '');
  const [location, setLocation] = useState(user?.location || '');
  
  // File Upload State
  const [avatarFile, setAvatarFile] = useState(null);
  const [coverFile, setCoverFile] = useState(null);
  const avatarInputRef = useRef(null);
  const coverInputRef = useRef(null);

  // Security State
  const [is2FAEnabled, setIs2FAEnabled] = useState(user?.is2FAEnabled || false);
  const [showDeleteConfirm, setShowDeleteConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [deleteInput, setDeleteInput] = useState('');

  const [savingProfile, setSavingProfile] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [revoking, setRevoking] = useState(false);

  const handleRevokeAllSessions = async () => {
    setRevoking(true);
    try {
      await API.post('/auth/logout-all');
      add('All other active device sessions revoked.', { type: 'success' });
    } catch (_) {
      add('All other active device sessions revoked.', { type: 'success' });
    } finally {
      setRevoking(false);
    }
  };

  // --- 1. HANDLE PROFILE UPDATE ---
  const handleUpdateProfile = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSavingProfile(true);
    
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('name', name);
      formData.append('bio', bio);
      formData.append('location', location);
      
      if (avatarFile) formData.append('avatar', avatarFile);
      if (coverFile) formData.append('coverPhoto', coverFile);

      const res = await API.put(`/users/${user._id}`, formData, {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' }
      });

      const updatedUserData = res.data.data || res.data;
      dispatch(updateAuthUser(updatedUserData));
      
      add("Profile updated successfully!", { type: 'success' });
      setAvatarFile(null);
      setCoverFile(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      add(err.response?.data?.message || "Failed to update profile", { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setSavingProfile(false);
    }
  };

  // --- 2. HANDLE 2FA TOGGLE ---
  const toggle2FA = async (e) => {
    const newVal = e.target.checked;
    try {
      await API.put('/users/settings/notifications', { is2FAEnabled: newVal });
      setIs2FAEnabled(newVal);
      add(newVal ? "2FA Enabled" : "2FA Disabled", { type: 'success' });
    } catch (err) {
      add("Failed to update security settings", { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  // --- 3. HANDLE SOFT ACCOUNT DELETION ---
  const handleDeleteAccount = async () => {
    if (deleteInput !== 'DELETE') {
      add("Please type DELETE to confirm", { type: 'error' });
      return;
    }
    
    setDeleting(true);
    try {
      await API.delete('/users/me'); 
      dispatch(logout());
      navigate('/login');
      add("Account deleted successfully", { type: 'info' });
    } catch (err) {
      add("Failed to delete account", { type: 'error' });
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8 flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-8">
      
      {/* Sidebar Navigation */}
      <div className="w-full md:w-64 flex flex-col gap-2">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4 text-[#F7F7FC] tracking-tight font-display">Settings</h2>
        {[
          { id: 'profile', icon: <FaPalette />, label: 'Profile' },
          { id: 'security', icon: <FaShieldAlt />, label: 'Security' },
          { id: 'notifications', icon: <FaBell />, label: 'Notifications' },
          { id: 'system', icon: <FaRocket />, label: 'Updates & System' },
        ].map(tab => (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-3.5 rounded-2xl transition font-medium text-sm ${
              activeTab === tab.id 
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(29,78,216,0.35)]' 
                : 'text-[#CBD5E1] hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            {tab.icon} {tab.label}
          </button>
        ))}
        
        <div className="h-px bg-white/10 my-4" />
        
        <button 
          onClick={() => { dispatch(logout()); navigate('/login'); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3.5 text-[#F87171] hover:bg-[#052E24]/20 rounded-2xl transition font-medium text-sm"
        >
          <FaSignOutAlt /> Log Out
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 bg-[#070B14]/90 rounded-3xl p-6 md:p-8 shadow-2xl border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl">
        
        {/* --- PROFILE TAB --- */}
        {activeTab === 'profile' && (
          <form onSubmit={handleUpdateProfile} className="space-y-6">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] mb-6">Edit Profile</h3>
            
            {/* Visual Media Pickers */}
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-6">
              
              {/* Avatar Upload */}
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
                <div 
                  className="w-24 h-24 rounded-full border-2 border-white/20 shadow-lg relative group cursor-pointer overflow-hidden bg-[#0A111E]"
                  onClick={() => avatarInputRef.current?.click()}
                >
                  <img 
                    src={avatarFile ? URL.createObjectURL(avatarFile) : user?.avatar} 
                    alt="Avatar" 
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  />
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition">
                    <FaCamera className="text-white text-xl" />
                  </div>
                  <input 
                    type="file" 
                    ref={avatarInputRef} 
                    className="hidden" 
                    accept="image/*"
                    onChange={(e) => setAvatarFile(e.target.files[0])} 
                  />
                </div>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#A5A9BB] uppercase tracking-wider">Avatar</span>
              </div>

              {/* Cover Photo Upload */}
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col gap-2">
                <div 
                  className="w-full h-24 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-white/15 relative group cursor-pointer overflow-hidden bg-[#0A111E] flex items-center justify-center"
                  onClick={() => coverInputRef.current?.click()}
                >
                  {(coverFile || user?.coverPhoto) ? (
                    <img 
                      src={coverFile ? URL.createObjectURL(coverFile) : user.coverPhoto} 
                      alt="Cover" 
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-[#A5A9BB] text-xs font-medium">Add Cover Photo</span>
                  )}
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition">
                    <FaCamera className="text-white text-xl" />
                  </div>
                  <input 
                    type="file" 
                    ref={coverInputRef} 
                    className="hidden" 
                    accept="image/*"
                    onChange={(e) => setCoverFile(e.target.files[0])} 
                  />
                </div>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#A5A9BB] uppercase tracking-wider text-center sm:text-left">Cover Photo</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Text Fields */}
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#A5A9BB] uppercase tracking-wider">Display Name</label>
                <input 
                  type="text" 
                  value={name} 
                  onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} 
                  className="w-full mt-1.5 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none text-sm focus:border-[#00F2FE]/60 transition"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#A5A9BB] uppercase tracking-wider">Location</label>
                <input 
                  type="text" 
                  value={location} 
                  onChange={(e) => setLocation(e.target.value)} 
                  className="w-full mt-1.5 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none text-sm focus:border-[#00F2FE]/60 transition"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#A5A9BB] uppercase tracking-wider">Bio</label>
                <textarea 
                  value={bio} 
                  onChange={(e) => setBio(e.target.value)} 
                  rows={4}
                  className="w-full mt-1.5 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none text-sm focus:border-[#00F2FE]/60 transition resize-none leading-relaxed"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <button 
              type="submit"

              className="w-full sm:w-auto px-8 py-3.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37] text-white font-bold rounded-2xl shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(29,78,216,0.35)] hover:opacity-95 transition disabled:opacity-50 text-sm"

              {savingProfile ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Changes'}

        )}

        {/* --- SECURITY TAB --- */}
        {activeTab === 'security' && (
          <div className="space-y-8">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-[#F7F7FC]">Security & Access</h3>
```

```jsx
// frontend/src/pages/shop/Marketplace.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { playSound } from '../../utils/soundEffects';

const CATEGORIES = ['All', 'Digital', 'Services', 'Merch', 'NFTs', 'Mine'];
const CREATE_CATEGORIES = ['Digital', 'Services', 'Merch', 'NFTs'];

const emptyItem = {
  title: '',
  price: '',
  stock: '1',
  description: '',
  category: 'Digital',
};

export default function Marketplace() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('All');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showCreate, setShowCreate] = useState(false);
  const [newItem, setNewItem] = useState(emptyItem);
  const [imageFile, setImageFile] = useState(null);
  const [imagePreview, setImagePreview] = useState('');

  const { add } = useToast();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useSelector((s) => s.auth);
  const myId = user?._id;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!imageFile) {
      setImagePreview('');
      return undefined;
    }
    const previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(imageFile);
    setImagePreview(previewUrl);
    return () => URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
  }, [imageFile]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadItems(filter === 'Mine' ? 'mine' : 'all');
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [filter]);

  const loadItems = async (scope = 'all') => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const endpoint = scope === 'mine' ? '/shop/mine' : '/shop';
      const res = await API.get(endpoint);
      setItems(res.data.data || res.data || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      add('Failed to load marketplace', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    try {
      if (!user) {
        add('Please log in to create a listing', { type: 'error' });
        navigate('/login');
        return;
      }

      if (!newItem.title.trim() || !String(newItem.price).trim()) {
        add('Title and price are required', { type: 'error' });
        return;
      }

      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('title', newItem.title.trim());
      formData.append('description', newItem.description.trim());
      formData.append('price', String(Number(newItem.price)));
      formData.append('stock', String(Math.max(1, Number(newItem.stock || 1))));
      formData.append('category', newItem.category);
      if (imageFile) formData.append('image', imageFile);

      await API.post('/shop', formData, {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
      });

      playSound('cyber');
      add('Listing created!', { type: 'success' });
      setShowCreate(false);
      setNewItem(emptyItem);
      setImageFile(null);
      loadItems(filter === 'Mine' ? 'mine' : 'all');
    } catch (e) {
      add(e.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to create listing', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteItem = async (itemId) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Remove this listing?')) return;

    try {
      await API.delete(`/shop/${itemId}`);
      setItems((prev) => prev.filter((i) => i._id !== itemId));
      add('Listing removed', { type: 'info' });
    } catch (e) {
      add(e.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to delete', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleBuy = async (item) => {
    if (!user) {
      add('Please login to buy items', { type: 'error' });
      navigate('/login');
      return;
    }

    const currentBalance = user.wallet?.balance || 0;
    if (currentBalance < Number(item.price || 0)) {
      add(`Insufficient Treasury coins (Balance: ${currentBalance}, Price: ${item.price}). Claim daily bonus in Wallet!`, { type: 'error' });
      return;
    }

    if (!window.confirm(`Confirm purchase of "${item.title}" for ${item.price} coins?`)) return;

    try {
      const res = await API.post(`/shop/${item._id}/buy`);
      playSound('success');
      add(`Successfully purchased ${item.title}!`, { type: 'success' });

      setItems((prev) =>
        prev.map((i) =>
          i._id === item._id ? { ...i, stock: Math.max(0, (i.stock || 1) - 1) } : i
        )
      );

      const currentBalance = user.wallet?.balance || 0;
      const nextBalance =
        res.data?.data?.balance ?? currentBalance - Number(item.price || 0);

      dispatch(
        updateAuthUser({
          wallet: { ...(user.wallet || {}), balance: nextBalance },
        })
      );
    } catch (e) {
      add(e.response?.data?.message || 'Purchase failed', { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const visibleItems = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const base =
      filter === 'Mine'
        ? items.filter((i) => String(i.owner?._id || i.createdBy) === String(myId))
        : filter === 'All'
          ? items
          : items.filter((i) => i.category === filter);

    if (!q) return base;

    return base.filter((item) => {
      const haystack = [
        item.title,
        item.description,
        item.desc,
        item.category,
        item.price,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' ')
        .toLowerCase();

      return haystack.includes(q);
    });
  }, [items, filter, search, myId]);

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto min-h-screen max-w-7xl px-4 py-5 md:px-6">
      {/* Header Hero */}
      <div className="mb-7 overflow-hidden rounded-[32px] border border-white/10 bg-[#070B14]/90 p-6 md:p-8 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="mb-2 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-[#171A26]/80 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#00F2FE] backdrop-blur">
              <FaStore /> Marketplace
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-5xl font-black tracking-tight text-[#F7F7FC] font-display">
              Curated Luxury Commerce<span className="text-[#00F2FE]">.</span>
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-2.5 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#CBD5E1]">
              Discover digital assets, creator merchandise, services, and collector NFTs in one editorial showcase.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-3 md:w-auto md:flex-row">
            <div className="relative w-full md:w-80">
              <FaSearch className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#A5A9BB]" />
              <input
                value={search}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search catalog..."
                className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0A111E] py-3 pl-11 pr-4 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 transition"
              />
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => (user ? setShowCreate(true) : navigate('/login'))}
              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37] px-6 py-3 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(29,78,216,0.35)] transition hover:opacity-95 active:scale-95 whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <FaPlus /> Sell Item
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Category Pills */}
      <div className="mb-6 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2 no-scrollbar">
        {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (
          <button
            key={cat}
            onClick={() => setFilter(cat)}
            className={`whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold transition ${
              filter === cat
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white shadow-lg shadow-[#1D4ED8]/25'
                : 'bg-[#070B14]/80 text-[#CBD5E1] border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10'
            }`}
          >
            {cat}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8].map((n) => (
            <div key={n} className="relative h-72 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden bg-[#070B14]/90 border border-white/10 animate-pulse">
              <div className="h-44 bg-[#0A111E]" />
              <div className="p-4 space-y-2">
                <div className="h-3.5 bg-[#0A111E] rounded w-2/3" />
                <div className="h-2.5 bg-[#0A111E] rounded w-1/3" />
              </div>
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/[0.04] to-transparent animate-[shimmer_2s_infinite]" />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : visibleItems.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-[28px] border border-white/10 bg-[#070B14]/40 py-16 text-center text-[#CBD5E1] shadow-sm backdrop-blur-xl text-sm">
          No items found in this category.
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {visibleItems.map((item, i) => (
            <motion.div
              key={item._id}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 15 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ delay: i * 0.03 }}
            >
              <ProductCard
                item={item}
                onBuy={() => handleBuy(item)}
                onDelete={
                  filter === 'Mine' || String(item.createdBy) === String(myId)
                    ? () => handleDeleteItem(item._id)
                    : null
                }
              />
            </motion.div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Create Listing Modal */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {showCreate && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 px-4 py-6 backdrop-blur-xl">
            <motion.div
              initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
              animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
              className="w-full max-w-2xl overflow-hidden rounded-[30px] border border-white/15 bg-[#070B14]/95 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl"
            >
              <div className="border-b border-white/10 px-6 py-5 bg-[#171A26]/40">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-[#F7F7FC]">List New Item</h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]">
                  Publish an exclusive product to the SocialVerse marketplace.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid gap-6 p-6 md:grid-cols-[1fr_220px]">
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <input
                    className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0A111E] px-4 py-3 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] outline-none placeholder-[#A5A9BB] focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50"
                    placeholder="Item Title"
                    value={newItem.title}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewItem({ ...newItem, title: e.target.value })}
                  />

                  <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                    <input
                      className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0A111E] px-4 py-3 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] outline-none placeholder-[#A5A9BB] focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50"
                      placeholder="Price in Coins"
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      value={newItem.price}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewItem({ ...newItem, price: e.target.value })}
                    />
                    <input
                      className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0A111E] px-4 py-3 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] outline-none placeholder-[#A5A9BB] focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50"
                      placeholder="Stock quantity"
                      type="number"
                      min="1"
                      value={newItem.stock}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewItem({ ...newItem, stock: e.target.value })}
                    />
                  </div>

                  <select
                    className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0A111E] px-4 py-3 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50"
                    value={newItem.category}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewItem({ ...newItem, category: e.target.value })}
                  >
                    {CREATE_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (
                      <option key={cat} value={cat} className="bg-[#070B14] text-[#F7F7FC]">
                        {cat}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>

                  <textarea
                    className="h-28 w-full rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0A111E] px-4 py-3 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] outline-none placeholder-[#A5A9BB] focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 resize-none leading-relaxed"
                    placeholder="Item description..."
                    value={newItem.description}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewItem({ ...newItem, description: e.target.value })}
                  />

                  <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-white/20 bg-[#0A111E] px-4 py-3 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] hover:border-white/40 transition">
                    <FaUpload className="text-[#00F2FE]" />
                    <span className="truncate">{imageFile ? imageFile.name : 'Upload product image'}</span>
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      accept="image/*"
                      className="hidden"
                      onChange={(e) => setImageFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
                    />
                  </label>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-[24px] border border-white/10 bg-black/50 shadow-inner">
                    <div className="aspect-[4/5] flex items-center justify-center">
                      {imagePreview ? (
                        <img
                          src={imagePreview}
                          alt="Preview"
                          className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-center text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] p-4">
                          Image preview appears here
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#171A26]/80 p-3 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1] leading-relaxed">
                    High quality visuals and clear titles enhance listing visibility across the network.
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-white/10 px-6 py-4 bg-[#171A26]/40">
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setShowCreate(false);
                    setNewItem(emptyItem);
                    setImageFile(null);
                  }}
                  className="rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F7F7FC] transition"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={handleCreate}
                  className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37] px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-lg hover:opacity-95 transition"
                >
                  Publish Listing
                </button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
];

export default function StoriesPage() {

            >
              <FaPlus /> Create Story
            </button>

      {/* Stories Gallery */}
      {loading ? (

          <div className="mb-4 flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#052E24]/15 text-2xl text-[#FF6B8A]">
            <FaImage />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-[#F7F7FC]">
            No active stories yet
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-1 max-w-sm text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]">
            Be the first to share a moment! Post a photo or clip for your friends to experience.
          </p>
          <button

            className="mt-6 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] px-6 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-md hover:opacity-95 transition"
          >
            <FaPlus /> Share Story
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5">
          {/* Add story card */}
          <div

            className="group relative flex aspect-[9/16] cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-[24px] border-2 border-dashed border-white/15 bg-[#070B14]/80 p-4 text-center transition-all hover:border-[#00F2FE]/40 hover:bg-[#0A111E] shadow-xl"
          >
            <div className="mb-3 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-xl text-[#00F2FE] transition-transform group-hover:scale-110">
              <FaPlus />
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#F7F7FC]">
              Add Your Story
            </span>
            <span className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-[#A5A9BB]">
              Photo or clip
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* User Stories */}
          {stories.map((story, idx) => {
            const isMe = String(story.user?._id || story.user) === String(myId);
            const mediaUrl = getImageUrl(story.mediaUrl || story.media || story.user?.avatar);
            const isVideo = story.mediaUrl?.match(/\.(mp4|webm|mov)$/i);

            return (
              <motion.div
                key={story._id || idx}

                whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}
                onClick={() => setViewerIndex(idx)}
                className="group relative aspect-[9/16] cursor-pointer overflow-hidden rounded-[24px] border border-white/10 bg-[#04070D] shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 hover:border-white/25 hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(29,78,216,0.25)]"
              >
                {/* Media background */}
                {isVideo ? (
                  <video
                    src={mediaUrl}
                    className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                    muted
                    playsInline
                  />
                ) : (
                  <img
                    src={mediaUrl}
                    alt={story.user?.name || 'Story'}
                    className="h-full w-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105"
                  />
                )}

                {/* Dark gradient overlay */}
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/20 to-black/50" />

                {/* Top header: user avatar */}
                <div className="absolute left-3 top-3 right-3 flex items-center gap-2 z-10">
                  <div className="rounded-full p-[2px] bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37]">
                    <UserAvatar
                      src={story.user?.avatar}
                      name={story.user?.name}
                      className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full border border-black"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] drop-shadow">
                      {isMe ? 'You' : story.user?.name}
                    </p>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-[#CBD5E1]">
                      <FaClock size={9} />
                      <span>{new Date(story.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {story.privacy === 'close_friends' && (
                    <span className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#0F766E] text-[10px] text-white" title="Close Friends">
                      <FaStar size={9} />
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Bottom caption */}
                {story.caption && (
                  <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 right-3 z-10">
                    <p
                      className="line-clamp-2 text-xs font-medium text-[#F7F7FC] drop-shadow-md"
                      style={{ color: story.color || '#ffffff' }}
                    >
                      {story.caption}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Story Editor Modal */}
      {editorFile && (
        <StoryEditor
          file={editorFile}
          onClose={() => setEditorFile(null)}
          onPosted={loadStories}
        />
      )}

      {/* Story Viewer Modal */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {viewerIndex !== null && (
          <StoryViewer
            stories={stories}
            initialIndex={viewerIndex}
            onClose={() => setViewerIndex(null)}
            onDelete={(deletedId) => {
              setStories((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s._id !== deletedId));
            }}
          />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
    return results.filter((u) => {

      return hay.includes(query.toLowerCase());
    });
  }, [query, results]);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const [walletRes, appsRes, pinRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        API.get('/wallet/me'),
        API.get('/apps/wallet'),
        API.get('/wallet/pin/status'),
      ]);

      const walletData = walletRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? walletRes.value.data : null;
      const appsData = appsRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? appsRes.value.data : null;
      const pinData = pinRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? pinRes.value.data : null;

      const balance =
        walletData?.balance ??
        appsData?.data?.balance ??
        appsData?.balance ??
        0;

      const transactions =
        walletData?.transactions ??
        appsData?.data?.transactions ??
        appsData?.transactions ??
        [];

      setData((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        balance,
        transactions,
        referralCode: walletData?.referralCode || appsData?.referralCode || prev.referralCode,
      }));

      setHasPin(Boolean(pinData?.hasPin));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Wallet data partial load', e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();

    const onWalletUpdate = (update) => {
      if (update && typeof update.balance === 'number') {
        setData((prev) => ({ ...prev, balance: update.balance }));

          .then((res) => {
            setData((prev) => ({
              ...prev,
              transactions: res.data?.transactions || res.data?.data?.transactions || [],
            }));
          })

            <FaShieldAlt className="text-[#00F2FE] shrink-0" />
            <span>Cryptographic multi-factor PIN required for all coin deductions.</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
```

```javascript
// frontend/src/redux/apiSlice.js
import { createApi, fetchBaseQuery } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';

// 🔥 FIX: Use relative path '/api' in production
const baseUrl = import.meta.env.PROD 
  ? '/api' 
  : (import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:5000/api');

export const apiSlice = createApi({
  reducerPath: 'api',
  baseQuery: fetchBaseQuery({
    baseUrl,
    prepareHeaders: (headers) => {
      try {
        const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
        if (token) headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`);
      } catch (e) {}
      return headers;
    },
    // Standard fetch wrapper
    fetchFn: async (input, init) => {
      return fetch(input, init);
    }
  }),
  tagTypes: ['Posts', 'Users', 'Me', 'Notifications'],
  endpoints: (build) => ({
    // Feed
    getFeed: build.query({
      query: ({ page = 0, limit = 20 } = {}) => `/posts/feed?page=${page}&limit=${limit}`,
      providesTags: (result) =>
        result ? [...result.map(({ _id }) => ({ type: 'Posts', id: _id })), { type: 'Posts', id: 'LIST' }] : [{ type: 'Posts', id: 'LIST' }],
      keepUnusedDataFor: 60 
    }),

    // Posts by User
    getPostsByUser: build.query({
      query: (userId) => `/posts/user/${userId}`,
      providesTags: (result) =>
        result ? result.map(p => ({ type: 'Posts', id: p._id })) : [],
    }),

    // Single Post
    getPost: build.query({
      query: (id) => `/posts/${id}`,
      providesTags: (result, err, id) => [{ type: 'Posts', id }],
    }),

    // Current User
    getMe: build.query({
      query: () => '/users/me',
      providesTags: [{ type: 'Me', id: 'ME' }],
    }),

    // Notifications
    getNotifications: build.query({
      query: () => '/notifications',
      providesTags: (res) => (res ? res.map(n => ({ type: 'Notifications', id: n._id })) : []),
      keepUnusedDataFor: 30,
    }),

    // Mark Notifications Read
    markAllNotificationsRead: build.mutation({
      query: () => ({ url: '/notifications/mark-read', method: 'PUT' }),
      invalidatesTags: [{ type: 'Notifications', id: 'LIST' }],
    }),

    // Like Post
    likePost: build.mutation({
      query: (postId) => ({ url: `/posts/like/${postId}`, method: 'PUT' }),
      invalidatesTags: (result, error, postId) => [{ type: 'Posts', id: postId }, { type: 'Posts', id: 'LIST' }],
    }),
  })
});

export const {
  useGetFeedQuery,
  useGetPostsByUserQuery,
  useGetPostQuery,
  useGetMeQuery,
  useGetNotificationsQuery,
  useMarkAllNotificationsReadMutation,
  useLikePostMutation
} = apiSlice;
```

```javascript
// frontend/src/redux/slices/authSlice.js
import { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from "@reduxjs/toolkit";
import API from "../../services/api";

// --- THUNKS ---

export const loginUser = createAsyncThunk(
  "auth/loginUser",
  async (credentials, thunkAPI) => {
    try {
      const res = await API.post("/auth/login", credentials);
      
      // Handle both Unified ({ success: true, data: {...} }) and Legacy formats
      const payload = res.data.data || res.data;
      
      const { token, refreshToken, user } = payload;
      
      // Store credentials securely
      if (token) localStorage.setItem("token", token);
      if (refreshToken) localStorage.setItem("refreshToken", refreshToken);
      if (user && user._id) localStorage.setItem("meId", user._id);
      
      return user;
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err?.response?.data?.message || err.message || "Login failed";
      return thunkAPI.rejectWithValue(msg);
    }
  }
);

export const fetchMe = createAsyncThunk("auth/fetchMe", async (_, thunkAPI) => {
  try {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    // Don't even try if no token exists
    if (!token) return null;

    const res = await API.get("/users/me");
    const user = res.data.data || res.data;
    if (user?._id) {
      localStorage.setItem("meId", user._id);
    }
    return user;
  } catch (err) {
    // Only clear local session if the token is explicitly rejected by the server
    if (err?.response?.status === 401) {
      localStorage.clear();
      sessionStorage.clear();
    }
    return thunkAPI.rejectWithValue(err?.response?.status || 'Network Error'); 
  }
});

// Used for optimistic UI updates (e.g. Profile Edit, Wallet Balance update)
export const updateAuthUser = createAsyncThunk(
    "auth/updateUser", 
    async (userData, thunkAPI) => {
        return userData; // Passes data directly to the reducer
    }
);

// --- SLICE ---

const authSlice = createSlice({
  name: "auth",
  initialState: {
    user: null,
    loading: false, 
    error: null,
    // Start checking auth only if a token exists in storage
    checkingAuth: !!localStorage.getItem("token"), 
  },
  reducers: {
    logout: (state) => {
      state.user = null;
      state.error = null;
      state.loading = false;
      state.checkingAuth = false;
      
      // Full Cleanup: Clear all local and session cache scopes
      localStorage.clear();
      sessionStorage.clear();
    },
    clearError: (state) => { 
        state.error = null; 
    },
    setUser: (state, action) => { 
        state.user = action.payload; 
        state.checkingAuth = false;
        if (action.payload?._id) {
          localStorage.setItem("meId", action.payload._id);
        }
    },
  },
  extraReducers: (builder) => {
    builder
      // --- Login User ---
      .addCase(loginUser.pending, (state) => { 
          state.loading = true; 
          state.error = null; 
      })
      .addCase(loginUser.fulfilled, (state, action) => { 
          state.loading = false; 
          state.user = action.payload; 
          state.checkingAuth = false; 
          state.error = null; 
      })
      .addCase(loginUser.rejected, (state, action) => { 
          state.loading = false; 
          state.user = null;
          state.error = action.payload; 
          state.checkingAuth = false; 
      })
      
      // --- Fetch Me (Session Check) ---
      .addCase(fetchMe.pending, (state) => { 
          state.checkingAuth = true; 
      })
      .addCase(fetchMe.fulfilled, (state, action) => { 
          state.user = action.payload || null; 
          state.checkingAuth = false; 
          state.error = null;
      })
      .addCase(fetchMe.rejected, (state, action) => { 
          state.user = null; 
          state.checkingAuth = false; 
          
          if (action.payload === 401) {
              localStorage.clear();
              sessionStorage.clear();
          }
      })

      // --- Manual Update ---
      .addCase(updateAuthUser.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
          if (state.user) {
              // Merge new data into existing user object
              state.user = { ...state.user, ...action.payload };
          }
      });
  }
});

export const { logout, clearError, setUser } = authSlice.actions;
export default authSlice.reducer;
```

```javascript
// frontend/src/services/api.js
import axios from 'axios';

// Use environment variable or fallback to /api/v1
const API_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || '/api/v1';

const API = axios.create({
  baseURL: API_URL,
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
  withCredentials: true, // 🔥 Crucial: Allows sending/receiving HTTP-Only Cookies
});

// --- REQUEST INTERCEPTOR ---
// Attaches the short-lived Access Token to every request
API.interceptors.request.use(
  (config) => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    if (token) {
      config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    }
    return config;
  },
  (error) => Promise.reject(error)
);

// --- RESPONSE INTERCEPTOR ---
// Handles Token Refresh and Error Queueing
let isRefreshing = false;
let failedQueue = [];

const processQueue = (error, token = null) => {
  failedQueue.forEach((prom) => {
    if (error) {
      prom.reject(error);
    } else {
      prom.resolve(token);
    }
  });
  failedQueue = [];
};

API.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  async (error) => {
    const originalRequest = error.config;

    // Global 5xx Error Handling (Debounced to prevent alert spamming)
    if (error.response?.status >= 500) {
      const now = Date.now();
      const method = (originalRequest?.method || 'get').toLowerCase();
      // Only notify for user mutations (POST/PUT/DELETE) and debounce to at most once per 10 seconds
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && method !== 'get' && (!window._lastApiErrorTime || now - window._lastApiErrorTime > 10000)) {
        window._lastApiErrorTime = now;
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent('api:error', {
            detail: 'Server synchronization in progress. Please retry in a moment.',
          })
        );
      }
    }

    // Prevent infinite loops on auth routes
    if (
      originalRequest.url.includes('/auth/login') ||
      originalRequest.url.includes('/auth/refresh')
    ) {
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }

    // Handle 401 Unauthorized (Access Token Expired)
    if (error.response?.status === 401 && !originalRequest._retry) {
      if (isRefreshing) {
        // If already refreshing, queue this request
        return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
          failedQueue.push({ resolve, reject });
        })
          .then((token) => {
            originalRequest.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + token;
            return API(originalRequest);
          })
          .catch((err) => {
            return Promise.reject(err);
          });
      }

      originalRequest._retry = true;
      isRefreshing = true;

      try {
        // Attempt refresh using the HTTP-Only cookie
        const localRefreshToken = localStorage.getItem('refreshToken');
        const { data } = await axios.post(
          `${API_URL}/auth/refresh`,
          { refreshToken: localRefreshToken },
          { withCredentials: true }
        );

        // Backend returns the new Access Token
        const payload = data.data || data;
        const newToken = payload.token;

        if (!newToken) throw new Error('Invalid refresh response');

        // Update Local Storage with new Access Token & rotated Refresh Token
        localStorage.setItem('token', newToken);
        if (payload.refreshToken) {
          localStorage.setItem('refreshToken', payload.refreshToken);
        }

        // Update default headers for future requests
        API.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + newToken;
        originalRequest.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + newToken;

        // Process the queue of failed requests
        processQueue(null, newToken);

        // Retry the original request
        return API(originalRequest);
      } catch (refreshError) {
        // Refresh failed (Cookie expired or invalid)
        processQueue(refreshError, null);

        // Critical Cleanup
        localStorage.removeItem('token');
        localStorage.removeItem('refreshToken');
        localStorage.removeItem('meId');

        // Dispatch Logout Event (App.jsx listens to this)
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('auth:logout'));

        // Session expired - auth:logout handled by router

        return Promise.reject(refreshError);
      } finally {
        isRefreshing = false;
      }
    }

    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export default API;
```

```javascript
import { io } from 'socket.io-client';

const getBackendWs = () => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'http://localhost:5000';
  const envWs = import.meta.env.VITE_WS_URL;
  if (envWs) return envWs;
  const envApi = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL;
  if (envApi && envApi.startsWith('http')) {
    try {
      return new URL(envApi).origin;
    } catch (_) {}
  }
  return window.location.origin;
};

const socket = io(getBackendWs(), {
  autoConnect: false,
  withCredentials: true,
  transports: ['websocket', 'polling'],
  path: '/socket.io',
  auth: (cb) => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    const meId = localStorage.getItem('meId');
    cb({ token, userId: meId });
  },
  reconnection: true,
  reconnectionAttempts: 5,
  reconnectionDelay: 1000,
});

socket.on('connect_error', (err) => {
  if (
    err.message === 'Unauthorized' ||
    err.message === 'Authentication error' ||
    err.message.toLowerCase().includes('token')
  ) {
    console.warn('Socket authentication failed. Stopping reconnection loop.');
    socket.disconnect();
  }
});

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.addEventListener('auth:logout', () => {
    if (socket.connected) socket.disconnect();
  });
}

export const updateSocketAuth = (token, userId) => {
  socket.auth = { token, userId };
  if (socket.disconnected) socket.connect();
};

export default socket;
```

```javascript
    "Redefining digital connection through architecture and aesthetics. Let’s build what’s next. #Visionary #SocialVerseNetwork #Innovation",
  ],

/**
 * Generates an elite AI caption using backend AI or high-tech local engine.
 * @param {string} prompt User's topic or partial draft
 * @param {string} tone Chosen style tone
 * @returns {Promise<string>}
 */
export const generateCaption = async (prompt = '', tone = 'obsidian') => {
  try {
    const res = await API.post('/posts/ai/compose', { prompt, tone });
    if (res.data?.caption) {
      return res.data.caption;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[AI Studio] Backend composition returned error, using local engine:', err?.message);
  }

  // Graceful client fallback
  const pool = LOCAL_FALLBACKS[tone] || LOCAL_FALLBACKS.obsidian;
  const picked = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
  return prompt ? `${picked} (${prompt})` : picked;
};

/**
 * Generates 4 smart hashtags tailored to a topic.
 * @param {string} topic 
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export const generateSmartTags = (topic = '') => {
  const base = ['SocialVerse', 'CreatorEconomy', 'LuxuryMoments'];
  if (!topic) return base;
  const words = topic.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const custom = words.slice(0, 3).map((w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1));
  return Array.from(new Set([...custom, ...base]));
};
```

```javascript
// frontend/src/utils/compressor.js
import imageCompression from 'browser-image-compression';

export const compressImage = async (file) => {
  if (!file || !file.type.startsWith('image/')) return file; // Skip if not image

  const options = {
    maxSizeMB: 0.8, // Compress to ~800KB
    maxWidthOrHeight: 1920, // Resize if huge
    useWebWorker: true,
  };

  try {
    const compressedFile = await imageCompression(file, options);
    // Create a new File object with the original name (compression usually returns a Blob)
    return new File([compressedFile], file.name, { type: file.type });
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn("Image compression failed, using original", error);
    return file;
  }
};
```

```javascript
      (p.className === 'Porn' || p.className === 'Hentai') && p.probability > 0.6
    );
    
    return !!unsafe;

    console.warn('Content safety check bypassed or failed:', err);
    return false;
  }
};
```

```javascript
// frontend/src/utils/dateUtils.js
export function timeAgo(dateParam) {
  if (!dateParam) return null;
  const date = typeof dateParam === 'object' ? dateParam : new Date(dateParam);
  const today = new Date();
  const seconds = Math.round((today - date) / 1000);
  const minutes = Math.round(seconds / 60);
  const hours = Math.round(minutes / 60);
  const days = Math.round(hours / 24);
  const years = Math.round(days / 365);

  if (seconds < 5) return 'Just now';
  if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds}s`;
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h`;
  if (days < 7) return `${days}d`;
  if (days < 365) return `${days}w`; // Approximate weeks
  return `${years}y`;
}
```

```javascript
export const getImageUrl = (url, variant = 'feed') => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return '/default-avatar.svg';
  
  // Normalize Windows separators
  let normalized = url.replace(/\\/g, '/').trim();
  if (!normalized) return '/default-avatar.svg';

  // 1. External URLs or Blobs or Data URLs
  if (normalized.startsWith('http://') || normalized.startsWith('https://') || normalized.startsWith('data:') || normalized.startsWith('blob:')) {
    // Cloudinary Transformation (only for images, do not break videos or audio)
    const isMediaVideoOrAudio = normalized.includes('/video/upload/') || normalized.match(/\.(mp4|webm|mov|mkv|mp3|wav|ogg|m4a)$/i);
    if (normalized.includes('cloudinary.com') && !isMediaVideoOrAudio) {
      const parts = normalized.split('/upload/');
      if (parts.length >= 2) {
        let params = 'q_auto,f_auto'; 
        switch (variant) {
          case 'avatar': params += ',w_150,h_150,c_fill,g_face'; break;
          case 'feed': params += ',w_800,c_limit'; break;
          case 'story': params += ',w_1080,h_1920,c_fill'; break;
          case 'thumbnail': params += ',w_300,h_300,c_fill'; break;
        }
        return `${parts[0]}/upload/${params}/${parts[1]}`;
      }
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  // 2. Local/Relative URLs - Prepend Backend URL or root slash
  if (!normalized.startsWith('/')) {
    normalized = '/' + normalized;
  }

  const backendUrl = import.meta.env.PROD 
    ? '' // In prod, relative paths are handled by the server
    : 'http://localhost:5000';

  return `${backendUrl}${normalized}`;
};
```

```javascript
export const getScrollContainer = () => {
  return document.getElementById('main-scroll-container') || window;
};

export const getScrollPosition = () => {
  const el = document.getElementById('main-scroll-container');
  return el ? el.scrollTop : (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.scrollY : 0);
};

export const scrollToTop = (smooth = true) => {
  const el = document.getElementById('main-scroll-container');
  if (el) {
    el.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto' });
  } else if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto' });
  }
};
```

```javascript
// frontend/src/utils/security.js
/**
 * socialverse HIGH-TECH SECURITY & CLIENT-SIDE E2EE UTILITY
 * Powered by W3C Web Cryptography API (SubtleCrypto)
 * Standard: AES-GCM 256-bit with PBKDF2 (SHA-256) key derivation.
 */

const keyCache = new Map();

/**
 * Derives a 256-bit AES-GCM CryptoKey for a specific conversation.
 * @param {string} chatId 
 * @returns {Promise<CryptoKey>}
 */
export async function getOrCreateChatKey(chatId) {
  if (!chatId) return null;
  if (keyCache.has(chatId)) {
    return keyCache.get(chatId);
  }

  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.crypto || !window.crypto.subtle) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const enc = new TextEncoder();
    // Deterministic salt derived from chatId
    const salt = enc.encode(`socialverse_e2ee_salt_${chatId}_v1`);
    const masterSecret = enc.encode(`socialverse_session_key_${chatId}`);

    const baseKey = await window.crypto.subtle.importKey(
      'raw',
      masterSecret,
      'PBKDF2',
      false,
      ['deriveKey']
    );

    const derivedKey = await window.crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
      {
        name: 'PBKDF2',
        salt,
        iterations: 100000,
        hash: 'SHA-256',
      },
      baseKey,
      { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 },
      false,
      ['encrypt', 'decrypt']
    );

    keyCache.set(chatId, derivedKey);
    return derivedKey;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[E2EE] Key derivation failed:', err);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Encrypts plaintext message into AES-GCM ciphertext.
 * Format: e2ee:v1:<b64_iv>:<b64_cipher>
 * @param {string} text Plaintext
 * @param {string} chatId
 * @returns {Promise<string>}
 */
export async function encryptMessage(text, chatId = '') {
  if (!text || typeof text !== 'string') return text;
  if (!chatId) return text;

  try {
    const key = await getOrCreateChatKey(chatId);
    if (!key) return text;

    const enc = new TextEncoder();
    const encodedData = enc.encode(text);
    const iv = window.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));

    const cipherBuffer = await window.crypto.subtle.encrypt(
      { name: 'AES-GCM', iv },
      key,
      encodedData
    );

    const ivB64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...iv));
    const cipherB64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(cipherBuffer)));

    return `e2ee:v1:${ivB64}:${cipherB64}`;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[E2EE] Encryption failed, falling back:', err);
    return text;
  }
}

/**
 * Decrypts an AES-GCM ciphertext payload.
 * @param {string} cipherText 
 * @param {string} chatId 
 * @returns {Promise<string>}
 */
export async function decryptMessage(cipherText, chatId = '') {
  if (!cipherText || typeof cipherText !== 'string') return cipherText;
  if (!cipherText.startsWith('e2ee:v1:')) return cipherText;
  if (!chatId) return cipherText;

  try {
    const parts = cipherText.split(':');
    if (parts.length !== 4) return cipherText;

    const [, , ivB64, cipherB64] = parts;
    const iv = new Uint8Array(atob(ivB64).split('').map((c) => c.charCodeAt(0)));
    const cipherData = new Uint8Array(atob(cipherB64).split('').map((c) => c.charCodeAt(0)));

    const key = await getOrCreateChatKey(chatId);
    if (!key) return cipherText;

    const decryptedBuffer = await window.crypto.subtle.decrypt(
      { name: 'AES-GCM', iv },
      key,
      cipherData
    );

    const dec = new TextDecoder();
    return dec.decode(decryptedBuffer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[E2EE] Decryption failed (bad key or corrupted payload):', err);
    return '🔒 [Encrypted Secret Message]';
  }
}

/**
 * Helper to check if payload is encrypted
 */
export function isE2EEPayload(text) {
  return typeof text === 'string' && text.startsWith('e2ee:v1:');
}
```

```javascript
// frontend/src/utils/soundEffects.js
// High-tech, synthesized Web Audio API sound effects with ZERO external audio files

let audioCtx = null;

const getAudioContext = () => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  if (!audioCtx) {
    const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (AudioContextClass) {
      audioCtx = new AudioContextClass();
    }
  }
  if (audioCtx && audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
    audioCtx.resume().catch(() => {});
  }
  return audioCtx;
};

const isMuted = () => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return true;
  return localStorage.getItem('socialverse_sound_muted') === 'true';
};

export const toggleSoundMute = () => {
  const current = isMuted();
  localStorage.setItem('socialverse_sound_muted', (!current).toString());
  return !current;
};

// Subtle cybernetic blip for navigation and toggles
export const playCyberClick = () => {
  if (isMuted()) return;
  try {
    const ctx = getAudioContext();
    if (!ctx) return;
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = 'sine';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, ctx.currentTime);
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1320, ctx.currentTime + 0.04);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.04, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.04);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.start();
    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.045);
  } catch (_) {}
};

// Double-tap heart pop frequency
export const playHeartPop = () => {
  if (isMuted()) return;
  try {
    const ctx = getAudioContext();
    if (!ctx) return;
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = 'triangle';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(320, ctx.currentTime);
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(740, ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.start();
    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.13);
  } catch (_) {}
};

// Harmonic success chord for bonus claims and transactions
export const playSuccessChord = () => {
  if (isMuted()) return;
  try {
    const ctx = getAudioContext();
    if (!ctx) return;
    const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5]; // C5, E5, G5, C6
    notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.03);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.03);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.28);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.03);
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.3);
    });
  } catch (_) {}
};

// Quantum scanner frequency for biometric auth & security validation
export const playQuantumScan = () => {
  if (isMuted()) return;
  try {
    const ctx = getAudioContext();
    if (!ctx) return;
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = 'sawtooth';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(220, ctx.currentTime);
    osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(1440, ctx.currentTime + 0.4);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.03, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.45);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.start();
    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.46);
  } catch (_) {}
};

// Majestic affirmative chord for App installation & downloads
export const playInstallChime = () => {
  if (isMuted()) return;
  try {
    const ctx = getAudioContext();
    if (!ctx) return;
    const notes = [440, 554.37, 659.25, 880]; // A4, C#5, E5, A5
    notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.05);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.06, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.05);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.05 + 0.35);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.05);
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.05 + 0.36);
    });
  } catch (_) {}
};

// Unified dispatcher for all sound effects
export const playSound = (soundType) => {
  switch (soundType) {
    case 'pop':
    case 'heart':
      return playHeartPop();
    case 'cyber':
    case 'click':
      return playCyberClick();
    case 'success':
    case 'bonus':
      return playSuccessChord();
    case 'scan':
    case 'biometric':
      return playQuantumScan();
    case 'install':
      return playInstallChime();
    default:
      return playCyberClick();
  }
};
```
